episodes.name: Welcome to Charmswell
episodes.summary: It's Sofia's first day of royal magic school, and she teams up with new friends to win a race and gets a magical visit from Rapunzel.

episodes.name: Abracadazzle; Show and Spell
episodes.summary: Sofia joins a magical challenge against students from the other castles; Layla tries a levitation spell but instead reveals her ability to sprout butterfly wings.

episodes.name: Give it a Twirl; The Tippity Tap Dance
episodes.summary: Sofía and Layla co-captain a magical parade, but they can't agree on anything; Zane uses magic to improve his dance moves, but when the charm becomes a curse, Sofia helps solve it.

episodes.name: Magic Mayhem; Royal Mix It Up
episodes.summary: Camila wants to be Cedric's apprentice but causes chaos with advanced spells; Sofia is paired up with Zane's sister Zaria for a tri-castle activity, but they have nothing in common.

episodes.name: A Royal Family Picnic; The Royal Playdate
episodes.summary: While on a family picnic, Amber wants to prove she's just as amazing as Sofia; when Layla meets Sofia's siblings, Amber and James, she goes to great lengths to impress them.

episodes.name: New Horse on the Block; The Green-Eyed Monster
episodes.summary: Sofia meets Wildfyre; Zane creates a Goo Monster.

episodes.name: Sleepy Time Spell; Zane the Hero
episodes.summary: At a sleepover at Sofia's castle with Camila and Layla, stuffies magically come to life; a grumpy dragon is on the loose at Charmswell; Zane tries to tame the bumbling beast.

episodes.name: Veggie Good Deed; The Lilygnome
episodes.summary: Wanting to do a good deed, Amber helps Sofia with the village feast but causes some magical problems instead; Sofia needs Layla's help to tame a mischievous magical flower.

episodes.name: Crown Chaos / Off to the Races
episodes.summary: Sofia defends Charmswell Academy from the wicked sorceress, Zandrya, with help from Rapunzel. Camila learns to be there for her friends during the school's flying derby race.

episodes.name: When Clover Met Pepper / A Wand-erful Day
episodes.summary: Clover meets Pepper when he visits Sofia's castle, and Clover worries Sofia has a new best pet friend. James accidentally breaks Sofia's wand and replaces it with a trick wand.

episodes.name: Kidding Around; Puppercorn Ruckus
episodes.summary: Follows Sofia as she attends The Charmswell School for Royal Magic, where princes and princesses from across the EverRealm will continue their royal studies and also learn all types of magic.

episodes.name: The Abrasive Side; Earworm
episodes.summary: SpongeBob orders a product that will help him learn to say no; SpongeBob gets a song stuck in his head.

episodes.name: New Fish in Town; Love That Squid
episodes.summary: A new neighbor moves into town and becomes Squidward's best friend; SpongeBob helps Squidward prepare for a date.

episodes.name: Trenchbillies; Sponge-Cano
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick fall into a deep sea trench and are held captive by a clan of trenchbillies; an ancient warrior claims the only way to stop the volcano from erupting is to sacrifice Squidward.

episodes.name: The Monster Who Came to Bikini Bottom; Welcome to the Bikini Bottom Triangle
episodes.summary: Patrick befriends a sea monster that has wandered into Bikini Bottom; SpongeBob and Squidward search for answers when things begin to disappear from Bikini Bottom.

episodes.name: You Don't Know Sponge; Tunnel of Glove
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick take a friendship test; Pearl is embarrassed when she has to sit next to SpongeBob in the Tunnel of Glove.

episodes.name: Big Sister Sam; Perfect Chemistry
episodes.summary: Patrick's big sister Samantha comes for a visit.

episodes.name: La malédiction de la sorcière; La vidange vorace
episodes.summary: Madame Hagfish puts a hex on the Krusty Krab; SpongeBob and Patrick search for a legendary drain on the ocean floor.

episodes.name: A Friendly Game; Sentimental Sponge
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick turn SpongeBob's house into an indoor miniature golf course! When SpongeBob realizes how many memories are attached to all of his possessions, he is reluctant to throw anything way.

episodes.name: Squidward's School for Grown-Ups; Oral Report
episodes.summary: When Pat suddenly grows a grown-up beard, he decides it's time to act like a grown-up, too; while preparing to give an oral report for boating school, SpongeBob realizes that he's got a case of stage fright.

episodes.name: Frozen Face Off
episodes.summary: Everyone in Bikini Bottom competes in a worm-sled race to the South Pole.

episodes.name: Accidents Will Happen; The Other Patty
episodes.summary: Squidward threatens to take legal action against Mr. Krabs when he gets hurt on the job; Mr. Krabs and Plankton find a common enemy in the new Flabby Patty restaurant.

episodes.name: Drive Thru; The Hot Shot
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs turns a hole in the wall of his restaurant into a drive-through window; a famous race car driver's son teaches SpongeBob how to drive.

episodes.name: Sweet and Sour Squidward; The Googly Artiste
episodes.summary: Plankton tries to befriend Squidward so he can get the Krabby Patty formula; the citizens of Bikini Bottom clamor for Patrick's artwork after an art critic praises him.

episodes.name: Barnacle Face; Pet Sitter Pat
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs asks SpongeBob to help Pearl get rid of a barnacle on her face; SpongeBob asks Patrick to watch Gary while he's away.

episodes.name: Mermaidman Begins / Plankton's Good Eye
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick learn the secret origins of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy; Plankton grows a second eye and becomes nice.

episodes.name: House Sittin' for Sandy; Smoothe Jazz at Bikini Bottom
episodes.summary: SpongeBob house-sits for Sandy; SpongeBob and Squidward go to the Kelpy G concert.

episodes.name: Ghoul Fools
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick get caught in the feud between a crew of ghost pirates and the Flying Dutchman.

episodes.name: Patrick's Staycation; Walking the Plankton
episodes.summary: SpongeBob comes up with a solution when Patrick cannot afford a vacation; Mr. Krabs and SpongeBob win a free cruise, thanks to Plankton.

episodes.name: Mooncation; Mr. Krabs Takes a Vacation
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs takes Pearl and SpongeBob on a vacation to the Ocean Mint.

episodes.name: SquarePants Family Vacation
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick get lost during a family road trip to the Great Barrier Reef.

episodes.name: The Krabby Patty That Ate Bikini Bottom; Bubble Buddy Returns
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs uses Sandy's experimental growth formula on a Krabby Patty with disastrous results; SpongeBob creates a buddy out of bubbles when none of his friends have time to play with him.

episodes.name: Bubble Troubles; The Way of the Sponge
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick accidentally destroy Sandy's air supply and have to help her find more oxygen; SpongeBob wants to earn his belt from karate master Fuzzy Acorns with Sandy's help.

episodes.name: Are You Happy Now; Planet of the Jellyfish
episodes.summary: Squidward has trouble recalling his happiest memory; SpongeBob and Sandy must defeat an evil Jellien overlord who has replaced everyone with clones.

episodes.name: Restraining SpongeBob; Fiasco!
episodes.summary: Squidward issues a restraining order against SpongeBob; Plankton mistakenly believes that a piece of art is a stolen Krabby patty.

episodes.name: Free Samples; Home Sweet Rubble
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs is forced to give out free food to win back customers; SpongeBob needs all of his friends to help him remodel his pineapple home.

episodes.name: Karen 2.0; InSPONGEiac
episodes.summary: Plankton replaces his computer wife with a new version; SpongeBob asks Patrick to help him fall asleep.

episodes.name: Treats!; For Here or to Go
episodes.summary: SpongeBob brings home a box of new snail treats for Gary; when Plankton wins a free Krabby Patty, Mr. Krabs tries to keep him from collecting his prize.

episodes.name: Squiditis; Demolition Doofus
episodes.summary: Squidward pretends to have a disease to go home sick and hypochondriac SpongeBob thinks he has caught the fake illness; Mrs. Puff finally finds a use for SpongeBob's reckless driving and enters him in the Demolition Derby.

episodes.name: Face Freeze!; Glove World R.I.P.
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick make a bet to see who can hold a funny face the longest; SpongeBob and Patrick spend a day at Glove World before it closes.

episodes.name: Hello Bikini Bottom!
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs decides to manage SpongeBob and Squidward's world tour.

episodes.name: The Good Krabby Name; Move It or Lose It
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick go on an advertising blitz to drum up business for the Krusty Krab; Mr. Krabs and Plankton circulate petitions about the bulldozing of a Bikini Bottom restaurant.

episodes.name: Super Evil Aquatic Villain Team Up Is Go!; Chum Fricassee
episodes.summary: Plankton teams up with Man Ray to take over the Krusty Krab and then the world.

episodes.name: It's a SpongeBob Christmas!
episodes.summary: SpongeBob inadvertently helps Plankton get all the citizens of Bikini Bottom on Santa's naughty list.

episodes.name: Extreme Spots; Squirrel Record
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick try to join an extreme sports team; Sandy finds a book of world records and proceeds to try to break them all.

episodes.name: License to Milkshake; Squid Baby
episodes.summary: SpongeBob is forced to go back to the milkshake academy when he learns that his milkshake license has expired; SpongeBob and Patrick must take care of Squidward when he reverts to being a baby.

episodes.name: Eek, an Urchin!; Squid's Defense
episodes.summary: SpongeBob finds a sea urchin living in the Krusty Krab; Squidward convinces SpongeBob and Sandy to teach him karate.

episodes.name: Patrick-Man!; Gary's New Toy
episodes.summary: Patrick becomes a superhero and plans to clean up Bikini Bottom; SpongeBob must take drastic measures when Gary becomes obsessed with his new red ball.

episodes.name: Little Yellow Book/Bumper to Bumper
episodes.summary: Squidward finds SpongeBob's diary, and starts reading it out loud in the Krusty Krab; SpongeBob fails his driving test, forcing Mrs Puff to think outside the box and off the road.

episodes.name: Jailbreak!; Evil Spatula
episodes.summary: While in prison, Plankton teams up with his fellow inmates to break out of jail and steal the secret Krabby Patty formula; SpongeBob replaces his broken spatula with one from Plankton.

episodes.name: Safe Deposit Krabs; Plankton's Pet
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick must save Mr. Krabs when he gets trapped in the bank; Plankton gets a pet to cheer himself up after failing to steal the Krabby Patty recipe.

episodes.name: Don't Look Now; Séance Schméance
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick go to see a horror film; SpongeBob holds a séance at the Krusty Krab to learn a long-lost sandwich recipe.

episodes.name: SpongeBob, You're Fired!
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs fires SpongeBob to save money; SpongeBob tries to get back to work.

episodes.name: SpongeBob vs. the Goo
episodes.summary: A giant purple ball of goo rises from the deep and threatens to release its toxic, gooey wrath all over the city.

episodes.name: Kenny the Cat; Yeti Krabs
episodes.summary: SpongeBob is desperate to meet his newest hero, Kenny the Cat; Mr. Krabs tries to scare Squidward into working harder.

episodes.name: Tutor Sauce; Lost in Bikini Bottom
episodes.summary: When SpongeBob fails his driver's test again, Mr. Krabs decides to teach him how to drive; SpongeBob gets lost while trying to take a shortcut to work.

episodes.name: Squid Plus One; The Executive Treatment
episodes.summary: Squidward receives an invitation to a gallery opening and scrambles to find a friend to take with him; while trying to order a special sandwich, Patrick gets swept up in the fast-paced world of business.

episodes.name: Company Picnic; Pull Up a Barrel
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs throws a company picnic to boost morale, but Plankton hosts his own picnic on the same day; Mr. Krabs tells SpongeBob tales from his old navy days.

episodes.name: Sanctuary!; What's Eating Patrick?
episodes.summary: When stray snails begin appearing around Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob decides to care for them himself; Patrick enters a Krabby Patty eating competition in order to defend Bikini Bottom's honor.

episodes.name: Patrick! the Game; The Sewers of Bikini Bottom
episodes.summary: Patrick invents a new board game and invites SpongeBob, Sandy and Squidward to play it with him; after accidentally flushing Mr. Krabs' safe, SpongeBob and Squidward must go into the sewers to find it.

episodes.name: SpongeBob LongPants; Larry's Gym
episodes.summary: When SpongeBob gets a pair of long pants, they change his life in unexpected ways; when Larry the Lobster opens a new gym in Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob becomes his best customer.

episodes.name: Mall Girl Pearl; Two Thumbs Down
episodes.summary: Pearl gets a job to be cool like her friends, but the only store that is hiring is the lamest store at the mall; SpongeBob loses the use of his thumbs.

episodes.name: The Fishbowl; Married to Money
episodes.summary: When Sandy tries to study SpongeBob and Patrick's behavioral patterns, her science experiment goes awry; after following Plankton's advice, Mr. Krabs decides to marry the only thing he has ever loved - money.

episodes.name: Sharks vs. Pods; CopyBob DittoPants
episodes.summary: The next confrontation of the toughest guys in town, "The Sharks," may be too much for SpongeBob to handle; Plankton clones SpongeBob to steal the secret formula, but his plans may be ruined by the original SpongeBob.

episodes.name: Sold!; Lame and Fortune
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick think their homes have been sold and move away, pleasing Squidward; fortune cookies predict the future, so Plankton uses them for his schemes.

episodes.name: Pineapple Invasion; Salsa Imbecilicus
episodes.summary: When SpongeBob hides the secret Krabby Patty formula in his home, Gary must protect it from Plankton; Sandy must save the day when a freak accident causes everyone in town to become as stupid as Patrick.

episodes.name: Sandy's Nutmare; Bulletin Board
episodes.summary: Sandy creates the latest acorn-based food sensation, but her tree pays the price for her greed; SpongeBob puts up a community bulletin board at the Krusty Krab, but anonymous reviews lead to trouble.

episodes.name: Food Con Castaways; Snail Mail
episodes.summary: The gang heads to a food convention, but things go awry when they become stranded in the woods; SpongeBob accidentally fibs to his pen pal, but when his friend comes to visit, he must keep the ruse going.

episodes.name: Mutiny on the Krusty; The Whole Tooth
episodes.summary: When a storm sweeps the Krusty Krab away, the crew and customers must rely on a crazed Krabs to lead them back home; Patrick's last baby tooth needs to come out, but he fears letting it go.

episodes.name: Goodbye, Krabby Patty?
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs manufactures Krabby Patties on an industrial scale, but it drives a wedge between SpongeBob and Patrick.

episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs' customers abandon him when SpongeBob starts cooking at home; when Plankton gets kicked out of the house, SpongeBob must teach him how to win his computer wife back.

episodes.summary: After a misunderstanding, SpongeBob and Patrick try to prove their life insurance protects them from any danger; when SpongeBob blows himself a bubble boat, everyone in town starts to want one.

episodes.summary: Plankton closes the Chum Bucket and moves to a new town, but Mr. Krabs suspects he is still up to no good; when SpongeBob accidentally picks up Neptune's magic trident, there is no telling what trouble he may cause.

episodes.name: Unreal Estate; Code Yellow
episodes.summary: When SpongeBob thinks he has an allergy to his pineapple, Squidward offers to help find him a new home; Squidward gets a nose job at the local hospital and SpongeBob tags along as moral support.

episodes.name: The Getaway; Lost and Found
episodes.summary: When SpongeBob mistakes an escaped convict for his driving instructor, it is the new teacher who learns a lesson; Mr. Krabs sends SpongeBob in search of a missing toy, and SpongeBob finds himself lost in the lost-and-found.

episodes.name: Patrick's Coupon; Out of the Picture
episodes.summary: Patrick has a coupon for free ice cream, but he has to get to the store if he wants to use it; Mr. Krabs buys Squidward's art, but to make a profit on his purchase he will have to get the artist out of the picture.

episodes.name: The Incredible Shrinking Sponge; Sportz?
episodes.summary: SpongeBob must figure out how to do his job after accidentally shrinking himself; Squidward invents a new sport to get back at SpongeBob and Patrick for annoying him.

episodes.name: Feral Friends; Don't Wake Patrick!
episodes.summary: A strange moon turns everyone in town into wild animals, and Sandy is the only one who can save them; Patrick is sleepwalking, and SpongeBob is unable to wake him up.

episodes.summary: When his pet amoeba Spot has puppies, Plankton decides to use them in another of his nefarious plots; Mr. Krabs is afraid to get his physical, but if he does not pass the Krusty Krab will be shut down.

episodes.name: Spin the Bottle; There's a Sponge in My Soup
episodes.summary: Plankton poses as a wish-granting genie in his latest scheme to get the secret formula; customers love Mr. Krabs' new krabby soup, until some heat-loving hippies move into the soup vat.

episodes.name: Cave Dwelling Sponge; The Clam Whisperer
episodes.summary: When a prehistoric sponge is unfrozen, he causes chaos all over town and only SpongeBob can communicate with him; when a flock of clams descends on Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob has to get them out before they ruin the whole town.

episodes.name: Man Ray Returns; Larry the Floor Manager
episodes.summary: When Man Ray rents Squidward's house for the weekend, SpongeBob and Patrick must stop his evil vacation; Mr. Krabs takes a vacation and makes Larry the Lobster the temporary manager of the Krusty Krab.

episodes.name: The Legend of Boo-Kini Bottom
episodes.summary: It's Halloween in Bikini Bottom, and the Flying Dutchman is going to make sure everyone's scared - including SpongeBob.

episodes.name: Krabby Patty Creature Feature; Teacher's Pests
episodes.summary: A new secret Krabby Patty formula has disastrous results for Bikini Bottom, and only SpongeBob can save the day; Mr. Krabs and Plankton have to take boating school classes.

episodes.name: No Pictures, Please; Stuck on the Roof
episodes.summary: Patrick leads an enthusiastic stranger on a tour of his favorite places in Bikini Bottom; SpongeBob is afraid to get off the roof of the Krusty Krab, but he will not let that stop him from living his life.

episodes.name: Squid Noir; ScavengerPants
episodes.summary: When his clarinet goes missing, Squidward must become a hard-boiled detective to track it down; Squidward sends SpongeBob and Patrick on an increasingly difficult scavenger hunt to get them out of his hair.

episodes.name: Cuddle E. Hugs; Pat the Horse
episodes.summary: SpongeBob's new friend is a giant, fluffy hamster that no one else can see; Patrick wants to be a horse.

episodes.name: Chatterbox Gary; Don't Feed the Clowns
episodes.summary: Gary has a pet translation collar, and he's talking up a storm; when a small clown gets left behind by the circus, SpongeBob takes the hapless harlequin under his wing.

episodes.name: Drive Happy; Old Man Patrick
episodes.summary: SpongeBob can't drive, but he learns one does not need a license to operate a self-driving car; Patrick thinks he is an old man, so SpongeBob tries to remind him how much fun being a child can be.

episodes.name: Fun-Sized Friends; Grandmum's the Word
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick exchange tiny living versions of themselves; Plankton tells his grandma that he owns the Krusty Krab, but must keep the lie going when she comes to visit.

episodes.name: Doodle Dimension; Moving Bubble Bass
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick become trapped in an alternate dimension where anything they draw comes to life; SpongeBob and Patrick help Bubble Bass move out of his mother's basement.

episodes.name: High Sea Diving; Bottle Burglars
episodes.summary: SpongeBob wants to be the first sponge to dive all the way up to the surface of the ocean; when SpongeBob and Squidward accidentally let Plankton steal the secret formula, it is up to them to steal it back.

episodes.name: Sanitation Insanity; Bunny Hunt
episodes.summary: When Mr. Krabs gets in trouble for littering, he makes SpongeBob and Squidward clean up Bikini Bottom; a sea bunny ravages Squidward's garden, but SpongeBob thinks it's cute.

episodes.name: My Leg!; Ink Lemonade
episodes.summary: Once Fred's leg heals up, SpongeBob is determined to keep it out of harm's way; Patrick's lemonade stand is unsuccessful until he gets a secret ingredient from Squidward.

episodes.name: Mustard O' Mine; Shopping List
episodes.summary: When the Krusty Krab runs out of mustard, Mr. Krabs sends SpongeBob, Patrick and Squidward to dig up some more; SpongeBob and Sandy have to collect Krabby Patty ingredients, but Plankton follows their every step.

episodes.name: Whale Watching; Clean Livin'
episodes.summary: Mr. Krabs hires Squidward to babysit Pearl for the night, but she just wants to sneak out to a cool teen party; after spilling a milkshake during a delivery, SpongeBob vows to return and clean the entire building.

episodes.name: Patnocchio; ChefBob
episodes.summary: Plankton tells Patrick he's his conscience so he can convince the wooden-headed star to steal him a Krabby Patty; when Mr. Krabs puts in an open kitchen, SpongeBob gets stage fright and has to invent a new persona.

episodes.name: Plankton Paranoia; Library Cards
episodes.summary: When Patrick discovers the pineapple's library, SpongeBob introduces him to the wonderful world of book learning; Plankton hasn't tried to steal the secret formula in a while, which makes Mr. Krabs nervous.

episodes.name: The Grill Is Gone; The Night Patty
episodes.summary: When a gang of kids steals the Krusty Krab's grill, SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs go to extreme lengths to win it back; SpongeBob helps out the Krusty Krab's night shift crew, but the customers crave something creepier than usual.

episodes.name: Call the Cops; Surf N' Turf
episodes.summary: Plankton goes to jail, but the secret formula is taken as evidence, so SpongeBob and Mr. Krabs plot to get it back; Sandy struggles to build a ship-in-a-bottle before a big contest, so SpongeBob calls in a little extra help.

episodes.name: Appointment TV; Karen's Virus
episodes.summary: The long-lost episode of "Mermaid Man" is finally showing on TV, but SpongeBob may not make it home in time to watch; Karen gets a computer virus, and it's up to SpongeBob to get it out of her.

episodes.name: Bubbletown; Girls' Night Out
episodes.summary: SpongeBob visits his old pal Bubble Buddy's hometown, Bubbletown; Sandy invites Karen and Mrs. Puff out for a night on the town, so the ladies decide to blow off some steam.

episodes.name: Squirrel Jelly; The String
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick have their peaceful day of jelly fishing disturbed by Sandy's competitive nature; SpongeBob pulls from Squidward's shirt a loose string that never seems to end.

episodes.name: Goons on the Moon
episodes.summary: Sandy leads the scouts through space for scientific exploration, where SpongeBob finds life exists in the form of a Krabby Patty, Sandy studies the moon's gravitational effect on nuts, and Squidward goes to the dark side.

episodes.name: Episode 226
episodes.summary: A square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, in the city of Bikini Bottom on the floor of the Pacific Ocean.

episodes.name: The Nitwitting; The Ballad of Filthy Muck
episodes.summary: Patrick inducts SpongeBob into his prestigious society of dullards and doofuses; Patrick takes his grime to a new extreme, playing around in so much trash that he becomes unrecognizable.

episodes.name: Sandy's Nutty Nieces; Insecurity Guards
episodes.summary: SpongeBob volunteers to baby-sit; SpongeBob and Patrick volunteer as guards at the museum, while Squidward attempts to hang his painting unnoticed.

episodes.name: SpongeBob's Big Birthday Blowout
episodes.summary: Patrick and SpongeBob journey to the surface world, where they come across a few familiar characters during lunchtime rush at The Trusty Slab restaurant; the Bikini Bottom residents set up a surprise party for SpongeBob.

episodes.name: SpongeBob's Big Birthday Blowout
episodes.summary: Patrick and SpongeBob journey to the surface world, where they come across a few familiar characters during lunchtime rush at The Trusty Slab restaurant; the Bikini Bottom residents set up a surprise party for SpongeBob.

episodes.name: Gary's Got Legs; King Plankton
episodes.summary: Gary is given a set of limbs to keep up with SpongeBob, but soon makes his owner look sluggish; Plankton practices ruling the world by shrinking himself and declaring himself king of SpongeBob's aquarium.

episodes.name: FarmerBob; Gary & Spot
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Patrick work a day on Old Man Jenkins' farm, much to his dismay; Sandy narrates the nocturnal adventures of Gary and his secret pal, Spot.

episodes.name: Broken Alarm; Karen's Baby
episodes.summary: SpongeBob breaks his precious alarm clock, but nothing else is loud enough to wake him up on time; Karen quickly learns that kids grow up too fast after her new child arrives in the mail.

episodes.name: SpongeBob in RandomLand; SpongeBob's Bad Habit
episodes.summary: SpongeBob and Squidward take a delivery to a dreaded town where the laws of logic no longer apply; SpongeBob can't stop biting his nails, but he also can't figure out why.

episodes.name: The Krusty Bucket; Squid's on a Bus
episodes.summary: Plankton creates a clone of himself and Mr. Krabs, but neither restaurant is safe from the newcomer; Squidward gleefully switches jobs with a bus driver for an easy ride, until SpongeBob and Patrick climb aboard.

episodes.name: Mind the Gap; Dirty Bubble Returns
episodes.summary: Squidward closes the gap in SpongeBob's teeth, which causes a dramatic and unexpected change in his demeanor; the newly reformed Clean Bubble takes a dishwashing job at the Krusty Krab, where he is tempted by the grime.

episodes.name: Handemonium; Breakin'

episodes.summary: A massive arctic hurricane shocks the fleet with high winds and big waves; an unstable stack threatens to capsize the Saga; as the captains rush to pull and set pots before harbor, Wild Bill risks driving straight into the storm to snatch his quota.

episodes.name: Clash of Kings
episodes.summary: Jake makes a devil's bargain, huge crab for hidden perils, until his boat is on the line; Sig serves cold justice at sea; Wild Bill chases a King Crab jackpot; the Cornelia Marie crew learns that the wheelhouse always wins.

episodes.name: Becoming Captain
episodes.summary: On the brink of failure, Josh Harris discovers secret fishing grounds in his late father's logbooks; a deck mishap could end Jake's season; the Coast Guard braves pitching seas in an attempt to hoist an injured sailor from inside a ship's tank.

episodes.name: Purgatory
episodes.summary: Circumstances force Keith to hand over the Wizard; Josh fights for the helm despite a bad showing; major engine trouble threatens Wild Bill's season.

episodes.name: Winter's Curse
episodes.summary: A tidal surge threatens Josh and Monte as they chase their bounty deep into an arctic storm; Wild Bill hopes to get his broken boat off the dock; the rest of the fleet arrives for the start of Opilio.

episodes.name: Blackout
episodes.summary: A blackout leaves the Saga close to disaster in unfamiliar waters; unwilling to partner, Josh must fill his quota single-handedly; Keith makes an offer only a captain could refuse.

episodes.name: Winter's Fury
episodes.summary: Winter unleashes 40-knot winds and 20-foot waves; as accidents plague crews, the Bering Sea singles out one greenhorn for punishment; strategy is critical with the crabs on the move; the Wizard co-captains reach a breaking point.

episodes.name: Baptism by Fire
episodes.summary: It's baptism by fire aboard the Northwestern as Mandy takes her first shift in heavy seas; a Wizard crewman isn't pulling his weight; caught short on bait gear and battered by high seas, Wild Bill changes his strategy.

episodes.name: Supermoon Storm
episodes.summary: A 150-year super-moon storm wreaks havoc on tides, churning undersea currents that rip pots off their lines; the Coast Guard attempts a rescue mission in the heart of the storm, while Wild Bill faces his worst nightmare as a greenhorn goes overboard.

episodes.name: Greenhorn Overboard
episodes.summary: A greenhorn's life hangs in the balance; the Summer Bay crew scrambles to rescue one of their own from the Bering Sea's icy grip; Saga and Cornelia Marie battle colossal waves; Mandy tackles her first haul in extreme weather.

episodes.name: Turf Wars
episodes.summary: Sig pushes Mandy to invade the Cornelia Marie's ground which sparks a battle; Casey takes extreme measures to defend his turf; a Saga distress signal sends panic across the fleet.

episodes.name: No Safe Harbor
episodes.summary: A severe arctic gale batters the fleet, forcing captains to fight extreme wind and waves; for the second time, a greenhorn's life hangs in the balance on the Summer Bay; the Saga crew seeks shelter at St. Paul, where tidal forces snap Jake's anchor.

episodes.name: Blood & Water
episodes.summary: As rogue waves threaten to capsize their boats, Jake and Sean must make life-or-death decisions for their crews on deck; Wild Bill faces a choice that could end his career; Keith returns to the Wizard and puts an unexpected end to his brother's rule.

episodes.name: Storm Surge
episodes.summary: Captains take on the steepest waves yet in an epic final surge to hit their quotas; Jake fights through a debilitating crew injury on deck; Josh gambles big on his crab count; engine failure leaves Sig dead in the water.

episodes.name: Battle Scars
episodes.summary: With scars still fresh from a harrowing season on the Bering Sea and battered by a super-moon storm, the captains reveal the most critical decisions they've made and how those choices and actions made them the captains they are today.

episodes.name: Battle of Kings
episodes.summary: Hours before king crab season, a renegade captain discovers the crab are all in one spot; as the fleet races to find the quarter billion-dollar hoard, captains battle each other and the sea to claim their share of the bounty.

episodes.name: Super Swarm
episodes.summary: Atop the king crab super swarm, full pots boil over into conflict as young guns Sean and Jake join forces to set down Sig; Keith and Harley re-ignite a decades old rivalry; Sean faces the long arm of Alaska law when crab in his tank come up short.

episodes.name: Price of Punishment
episodes.summary: As the first arctic storm of the season arrives, Saga's deck boss takes a knife to the ribs; a hand gets tangled in the coiler and interrupts Josh and Casey's record-setting haul; Capt. Bill takes one last stab at motivating a lazy greenhorn.

episodes.name: Single Point of Failure
episodes.summary: With Mandy alone at the helm, an accident threatens the Northwestern crew; Josh changes course on the Cornelia while Casey sleeps; Harley's launcher snaps at the worst possible moment; a short circuit cuts power to the Wizard's forward lights.

episodes.name: Shifting Stack
episodes.summary: In the biggest storm of the season, Jake faces a life and death decision when a shifting stack threatens to capsize the Saga; Sig and Mandy haul through angry seas, while Josh and Casey gamble on quota but find there's more on the line than numbers.

episodes.name: Winter Is Here
episodes.summary: Monte must fill his tanks fast to get home to his ailing father; a shocking mishap leaves a Hansen family member grasping for life.

episodes.name: Winter Is Here
episodes.summary: The coldest weather in nearly a decade threatens to crush hulls and freeze the sea; Monte must fill his tanks fast to get home to his ailing father, while a shocking mishap leaves a Hansen family member clinging to life.

episodes.name: Tough Inheritance
episodes.summary: As winter intensifies, Sean faces an engine-room fire; the Summer Bay deck boss suffers a season-threatening injury; Harley offers a trial run to his nephew; Monte races to fill Wizard's Bairdi quota, so Keith can say farewell to their father.

episodes.name: Russian Roulette
episodes.summary: Josh and Casey risk a 500-mile trek north to the Russian line; Jake tracks a fast-moving crab horde; Sig does double duty on the Northwestern; the Bering Sea cracks the Wizard's 74-year-old steel hull; the Colburns face the loss of their father.

episodes.name: Curse of the Russian Line
episodes.summary: Josh and Casey haul their pots, starting a rush to the Russian line; Capt. Bill gets inside intelligence, while Harley confirms numbers his own way; Arctic Storm Elsa builds in fury, casting a spell over the fleet.

episodes.name: Hell Hath No Fury
episodes.summary: The wrath of Arctic Storm Elsa hits the Cornelia hardest as a breakaway pot thrashes Josh and Casey's crew; Capt. Keith orders deckhands onto the stack as Elsa's icy blasts threaten to capsize the Wizard; the Saga takes a rogue wave.

episodes.name: Sixty Foot Monster
episodes.summary: As Arctic superstorm Elsa intensifies, a forecast warns of isolated waves of unusual size; trapped in the crab-rich northern grounds, the Cornelia Marie, Wizard and Southern Wind haul pots as big as the waves, until one boat faces a 60-foot wave.

episodes.name: Crane Wreck
episodes.summary: In storm-driven seas, Cornelia Marie's crane goes off the rails, smashing Josh and Casey's wheelhouse and injuring deckhand Taylor; Sig risks navigating a rocky passage in treacherous conditions, and the Wizard crew face a rogue wave without warning.

episodes.name: Devil's Cut
episodes.summary: Deckhands pay in blood as captains make up for time lost to the storm; on the Cornelia Marie, Josh takes the wheel as Casey conducts surgery at sea; Brenna A tests the mettle of a former Marine; a call from home has Sig facing a worst-case scenario.

episodes.name: Unbreakable
episodes.summary: The fleet battles a freight train of back-to-back storms; Sig's crew pays a price for stuffed pots; Harley risks gear on an elusive hoard under the ice; Freddy attempts self-surgery on the Wizard; the Summer Bay crew gets news on Nick's future.

episodes.name: Hell or High Water
episodes.summary: Monte returns to co-captain the Wizard just as storms slam the fleet from the south; Jake battles the risk of hauling pots in 30-foot seas to return to his family; Wild Bill drives farther north into the icy Arctic than any other boat.

episodes.name: Unholy Alliance
episodes.summary: As crabs become elusive, veterans Sig Hansen and Harley-Davidson form an unlikely alliance, but trust doesn't come easy to old-school captains; Freddy pays a price for Keith's decision to haul in intense seas; Jake tempts fate to become a boat owner.

episodes.name: Dark Ship
episodes.summary: As smoke fills the Wizard, the Colburns face a dark ship nightmare; towering breakers shatter Jake's anchor forcing him to fight to avoid the rocks of St. Paul Island; battered by relentless seas, Sig turns to family to fill the Northwestern's tanks.

episodes.name: Time and Tide Wait for No Man
episodes.summary: The bone-breaking winter unleashes its fury on the Summer Bay; a rookie mistake leaves Capt. Bill short a hand; Jake hits the jackpot at sea, but forces on land cost him dearly; Sean discovers the fatal flaw in his crab count.

episodes.name: Dead or Alive
episodes.summary: Each skipper's next move determines who survives the final winter dash; winds put the Wizard on a collision course with a monster; Jake taps a Hillstrand to save the Saga; Josh and Casey hit numbers not seen since Capt. Phil.

episodes.name: Now or Never
episodes.summary: With just 10 pots to go, a crushing injury requires a Coast Guard rescue; Josh and Casey face a huge loss when the buyer cancels their offload; Sig rolls the dice on an early finish, while Monte hauls more crab than the Wizard can hold.

episodes.name: Cold War Rivals
episodes.summary: A dramatic change in the Russian crab industry rocks global markets and drives new competition between Dutch Harbor captains and their Russian adversaries; as crab prices skyrocket, legendary captains return to claim their piece of a historic payday.

episodes.name: Typhoon Hagibis
episodes.summary: Just as the fleet begins its race to beat the Russians, ferocious typhoon Hagibis turns its deadly gaze on the Bering Sea; captains must choose whether to risk life and limb for a big payday or to sit out the storm and fish another day.

episodes.name: Breaking Point
episodes.summary: Still reeling from deadly typhoon Hagibis, the fleet claws its way back into competition against the Russians; the pressure to make up ground has mounted, and it's do-or-die for the captains, even if it means danger or even war.

episodes.name: Shotguns and Fist Fights
episodes.summary: With the Russian menace looming, co-captains Johnathan and Jake blast a shotgun at their problems while a vicious fistfight breaks out on the Seabrook; Wild Bill blows an engine and Mandy bets on science to get back on crabs.

episodes.name: Double Agent
episodes.summary: The Cornelia Marie uses US satellites to spy on the Russians, Scott pioneers a dormant fishery and Wild Bill faces off with a Russian greenhorn.

episodes.name: The Bleeding Edge
episodes.summary: It's all hands on deck to finish king season strong; Johnathan goes under the knife at sea; Junior bets it all while chasing the elusive golden king crab; Wild Bill goes toe-to-toe with an unruly greenhorn.

episodes.name: Into the Red
episodes.summary: Co-captains Jake and Johnathan try to form an alliance with rival Keith Colburn; Junior risks crossing into Russian waters for golden crab; Josh bets it all on a gut feeling; Wild Bill turns to his last resort and seeks work in Russia.

episodes.name: Mayday Mayday
episodes.summary: The Coast Guard responds to a Mayday call as captains and crew brace for the loss of friends during a brutal winter storm; Sig and Monte track an Opilio hoard at the Russian line; the clock is ticking for Wild Bill and Junior during the cod derby.

episodes.name: Cold War Heating Up
episodes.summary: As the crab biomass migrates across the Russian line, Josh and Casey dump 175 pots on the border; Sig and Mandy go dark ship in towering seas; Junior attempts to steam through False Pass in a nighttime blizzard.

episodes.name: Harm's Way
episodes.summary: Facing a 500-mile wide Siberian storm, Josh takes a big risk to keep the Cornelia Marie crew safe; Junior loses control of his rudders putting his boat at the mercy of heavy seas; Jake's greenhorn problems get a lot worse when one clogs the toilet.

episodes.name: Chase Boat Rescue
episodes.summary: Listing heavily and taking on water, Junior calls on chase boat rescue for the first time in series history; Wild Bill sends Nick 20 feet off the deck in spite of his fear of heights; Josh and Casey hit a massive wave that knocks out greenhorn Maria.

episodes.name: Dutch Harbor Double Cross
episodes.summary: On the Summer Bay there's hell to pay when Bill's backup block goes missing; Cornelia Marie skippers Josh and Casey navigate a tenuous partnership at the Russian line; weighed down by three full tanks, Sig puts a heavy Northwestern in Mandy's hands.

episodes.name: Bomb Cyclone
episodes.summary: The Wizard catches fire in a violent storm known as a bomb cyclone; Josh and Casey attempt to fish in 30-foot seas; two rogue waves slam the Southern Wind; bringing himself to the brink of collapse, Wild Bill grinds his crew for 72 straight hours.

episodes.name: Bering Sea Crash
episodes.summary: Battling exhaustion, Wild Bill and his crew face the full wrath of the bomb cyclone; a snapped tendon puts the Summer Bay down a man; Josh gambles on crab-rich grounds in a costly venture north; an injured Mac fights to get Junior through the storm.

episodes.name: Gut Instinct
episodes.summary: As an injury knocks Sig out of his wheelhouse, Mandy takes the helm to face a disgruntled Northwestern crew; on the Wizard, damaged hydraulics and an umbilical hernia deal Keith a double gut punch; Josh and Casey suffer tragedy on the Cornelia Marie.

episodes.name: Bering Sea Wrecking Ball
episodes.summary: Jake scrambles to repair a slack tank before it kills his crab or capsizes his boat; Josh and Casey's rudder fails in heavy traffic; Wild Bill's new greenhorn makes an easy target for an out-of-control picking hook.

episodes.name: Danger Close
episodes.summary: Josh and Casey race to haul pots as engine failure threatens their delivery window; as seawater destroys his hydraulic motors, Junior attempts a risky high seas delivery of three new motors; Harley and his crew bang heads over his fishing strategy.

episodes.name: Like Father Like Daughter
episodes.summary: Sig and Mandy conspire to get Jake to do their prospecting, but the former deckhand seizes the moment to fill his own tanks; the Wizard crew must break through ice to rush Keith to a doctor; Junior fears the worst as a deckhand falls from the stack.

episodes.name: Rogue Wave Juggernaut
episodes.summary: A rare weather event churns up rogue waves as supermoon tides collide with a cyclonic snowstorm; Josh and Casey face a 55-foot monster; Jake risks capsizing to repair his rudder in unruly seas; Monte's big move north pays off in massive pots.

episodes.name: A Problem Like Maria
episodes.summary: As the super snow-moon storm peaks, the Cornelia Marie's deck becomes a gauntlet for Josh and Casey's greenest greenhorn; ice fog overtakes the fleet as Monte scrambles to stay afloat; Harley loses an engine and Junior fights a sea-flea infestation.

episodes.name: End of the Beginning
episodes.summary: As the fleet mounts a final winter season push, sad news rattles the Cornelia Marie wheelhouse; Lady Alaska greenhorn Gabby overcomes a painful injury to support her crew; Wild Bill's deckhands must devise a bush fix or face hauling pots by hand.

episodes.name: Blood Is Thicker Than Water
episodes.summary: Saga loses a veteran deckhand, forcing Jake to steam a greenhorn army to the Russian line; amid scuttlebutt that ports are closing due to a virus, Josh fights to get home for a reunion with his brother; paramedics rush Sig's daughter to the hospital.

episodes.name: Everything Changes
episodes.summary: The Cornelia crew fights to save its gear from sea ice; Jake risks the far north to fill his tanks before his son's birth; amid news of a looming pandemic, Russian boats mysteriously disappear and captains race to dock before crab prices crash.

episodes.name: Out of the Ashes
episodes.summary: Sig devises a plan to save the fishery from destruction; as Johnathan Hillstrand returns with the Time Bandit to help, veterans struggle to prove they can work together to defend the American dream.

episodes.name: Russian Dragger
episodes.summary: When Mandy devises a plan for partnering, Sig must rethink his own hard-won tactics; on the Time Bandit, John and Josh conspire to outmaneuver a Russian captain who tells them what to do in U.S. waters; all hell breaks loose as two vessels collide.

episodes.name: Point of No Return
episodes.summary: As hundreds of dolphins lead the Summer Bay into an approaching cyclone, Jake attempts a daring night-time rescue in high seas; Scott Campbell Jr. finds himself out of options, leaving Sig to make a controversial call to save the fishery.

episodes.name: Time Machine
episodes.summary: Driving the Time Bandit and Cornelia Marie, Josh and Casey attempt Johnathan's strategy for tracking King Crab across time and space; on the Summer Bay, "Wild Bill's" crew fights a mid-gale power outage, but their greenhorn's time is running out.

episodes.name: Force Majeure
episodes.summary: As a typhoon rocks the Bering Sea, the Summer Bay suffers a collision. Sig gambles all his pots in one spot, while Casey takes a scientific approach to finding the elusive Bairdi crab.

episodes.name: Restricted Zone
episodes.summary: Facing a global pandemic, the captains tie up half the fleet, leaving a handful of boats to catch the fleet-wide quota or face closure of the fishery.

episodes.name: What Would Phil Harris Do?
episodes.summary: With the Bairdi fishery open for the first time in years, Josh and John take a page from the Phil Harris playbook to help tank a fleetwide quota; Wild Bill bets on Nick McGlashan to turn the tide for the Summer Bay.

episodes.name: Tangled Web
episodes.summary: Time Bandit and Cornelia Marie race for the last spot at the cannery, but as word spreads of an emergency shutdown of the Bairdi fishery, they return to the grounds as Sig Hansen rallies his fellow captains with an unconventional plan.

episodes.name: Dedication
episodes.summary: In the Winter premiere, the fleet reels from the loss of Summer Bay deck boss Nick McGlashan; Wizard and Cornelia launch early into a massive Arctic storm; Johnathan can't see eye-to-eye with a friend; shocking news forces Sig to change his plans.

episodes.name: Truth Will Set You Free
episodes.summary: When Johnathan trusts his instincts more than his partners, the Time Bandit makes a surprise appearance in the Northern Grounds just as Josh and Casey need him most; Sig puts his crew exactly where it needs to be in a matter of life and death.

episodes.name: Shipbreakers
episodes.summary: As seawater floods in, Wild Bill's crew scrambles to locate a hole in the Summer Bay's hull; Johnathan faces a fire on the Time Bandit and a catastrophic hydraulic failure forces Jake to send his chief engineer 25 feet above the Saga's rolling deck.

episodes.name: Extreme Arctic
episodes.summary: As a polar vortex storm slams the Cornelia Marie in the far north, Josh navigates the biggest seas of his career while Casey performs emergency surgery.

episodes.name: Of Ice and Men
episodes.summary: Sig makes a desperate bid to save his gear from the descending ice pack while Jake dumps pots to avoid capsizing; when Wild Bill gets a line caught in his propeller far from Dutch Harbor, he enlists Jake's diver to attempt a risky underwater repair.

episodes.name: The Crush
episodes.summary: As the fast-moving ice edge crushes everything in its path, Sig and Mandy rush to rejoin the fray; on the Cornelia Marie, Josh and Casey's race to save their pots comes at a cost in blood and pain; freezing spray threatens to capsize the Wizard.

episodes.name: Run Silent Run Deep
episodes.summary: Skirting the ice line to the deepest set of their careers, Josh and Casey apply frontier medicine to a bleeding deck boss.

episodes.name: First Come First Served
episodes.summary: Jake risks a daring entry into St. Paul harbor; Johnathan seeks help from Wild Bill; Josh and Casey bet their season on a deep set at the Russian Line.

episodes.name: Quid Pro Crab
episodes.summary: Captains scramble to meet an expanded quota in the path of a violent system; a breakdown on the Wizard puts Monte in debt to the Time Bandit, and Josh and Casey exceed their own quota when it comes to injuries on deck.

episodes.name: Winter's Gambit
episodes.summary: An Arctic storm blasts the fleet as Sig ventures to deep waters he hasn't fished in 17 years. Johnathan steers the Time Bandit into 30-foot waves in a Hail Mary run toward Russia. Captain Keith attempts a risky maneuver to save the Wizard's pots.

episodes.name: Wicked Game
episodes.summary: Josh and Casey follow a blind tip from an unknown fisherman into uncharted waters; Johnathan fears for the worst when Freddy lands in the icy Bering Sea; on the Wizard, Capt. Keith tempts fate, risking thousands in crab gear right at the ice edge.

episodes.name: Over the Rail
episodes.summary: Jake battles a hurricane in the fleet's smallest boat while Keith orders crew over the rail to avoid capsizing.

episodes.name: First in Line
episodes.summary: When processors shut down due to outbreaks, Sig bets he can zero in on a rare crab highway before there's no place to deliver.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Price
episodes.summary: Keith risks pushing through jagged ice in search of the Wizard's lost pots; "Wild Bill" overturns the Summer Bay; a beloved crewman makes the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.name: Cornelia Marie's Origins
episodes.summary: Capt. Josh Harris fights to keep his father's boat afloat during the off-season; upon digging into the origins of the Cornelia Marie, Josh quickly learns that boat ownership has unforeseen consequences.

episodes.name: Succession
episodes.summary: Sig Hansen's daughter, Mandy Hansen, tests him by pressuring him to cement her spot as heir to the Hansen family legacy.

episodes.name: Collision at Sea
episodes.summary: Sig rethinks his strategy after Mandy devises a partnership plan; John and Josh plan to outmaneuver a bossy Russian captain; two vessels collide, and all hell breaks loose.

episodes.name: Long Live King Crab!
episodes.summary: Sig pursues invasive Russian king crab in Norway; Jake mortgages his beloved Saga; John chases golden kings; Josh reunites with a lost Harris brother.

episodes.name: No Sleep Till Rescue
episodes.summary: An Arctic storm slams the fleet, which is already reeling from the closure of king crab season; Johnathan sets pots deeper than ever before; Sig struggles to launch his Norwegian operation; a deckhand fights for life on the Patricia Lee.

episodes.name: One Hell of a Story to Tell
episodes.summary: With his deckhand crushed by pots, Capt. Rip charges into the Arctic storm to attempt one of the riskiest USCG helicopter rescues in recent history; John fights to save the Time Bandit at anchor; Sig takes his first Norwegian rogue wave.

episodes.name: Invasive Russian Reds
episodes.summary: Sig struggles with a Norwegian crewman who thinks he knows more than the captain; Capt. Wild Bill fights to save his boat from the rocky Norwegian coastline with a line snarled in his propeller; Keith's greenhorn faces a violent brush with death.

episodes.name: Desperate Measures
episodes.summary: When Shyanne discovers a serious breach on the Saga, Jake and his crew scramble to save it from capsizing; in Norway, Sig drops pots on Russia's western line; as canneries close their doors, Josh and Casey call in a last-minute favor from Johnathan.

episodes.name: Five Souls on Board
episodes.summary: Desperate to reach helicopter range before his deckhand dies, Capt. Rip charges into an Arctic storm to attempt the riskiest USCG rescue in recent history; Sig takes his first Norwegian rogue wave; John struggles to save the Time Bandit.

episodes.name: Follow the Rainbow
episodes.summary: Johnathan searches for a pot of golden kings at the end of a double rainbow; a medical mystery confounds Capt. Rip when his greenhorn regains consciousness on the Patricia Lee; Keith partners with Josh and Casey until John steps in.

episodes.name: Deepest Alaska
episodes.summary: Johnathan sets mile-deep pots and pulls up an unknown species; Jake faces reality when his niece, Shyanne, gets injured on the Saga; Clark takes the helm in Sig's wheelhouse to help tank the Hansen family Bairdi quota.

episodes.name: Rip Tide
episodes.summary: Mandy breaks news of a pregnancy complication, forcing Sig and Clark to reconsider their decision to keep fishing; Jake teams up with Rip Carlton in deep waters, but powerful Aleutian tidal currents unexpectedly shift Jake's string.

episodes.name: Dark Waters
episodes.summary: Jake and his niece set pots on the same waters their ancestor fished in the 1930s; Johnathan risks losing his entire live catch when the Time Bandit ventures into fresh water; Josh experiments with glow sticks to attract crabs at the darkest depths.

episodes.name: No Good Deed Unpunished
episodes.summary: With dock prices spiking, the fleet races to deliver; Jake witnesses a freighter severing his longline, forcing the Saga crew to drag the bottom for a string of pots; Rip helps Johnathan locate the mother lode, only to pay with a broken block.

episodes.name: Killer Whale
episodes.summary: A curious orca tracks the Cornelia Marie as Josh and Casey haul the season's best pots; John follows the Saga when his navigation system chokes; Clark subverts Sig's deal with Harley to get home for Mandy's baby.

episodes.name: Pot of Gold, Heart of Steel
episodes.summary: On the Time Bandit, Johnathan follows a rainbow in search of pots of golden king crab; Rip contends with a baffling medical mystery when his greenhorn regains consciousness; Josh and Casey ignore their better judgment and radio Keith for help.

episodes.name: Where Eagles Dare
episodes.summary: The Northwestern loses steering when a bald eagle lays claim to its mast; Sig and Keith develop an unusual partnership to tank Bairdi in record time; Josh and Casey place a risky bet on hard-to-find quota; casualties mount on the Patty Lee.

episodes.name: The Crush of Winter
episodes.summary: New-mother Mandy returns to Sig's wheelhouse, but as heavy ice builds on the Northwestern, she reckons with the risks the family is taking; Jake unveils a new super pot to stake his claim in the cod derby as winter weather blindsides the fleet.

episodes.name: No Turning Back
episodes.summary: A dangerous list forces Sig to jettison pots or capsize the Northwestern; one wrong move in the narrow False Pass causes Jake and the Saga to hit bottom; there's no accounting for taste when Sean Dwyer devises motivational punishments for greenhorns.

episodes.name: Operation Anvil Drop
episodes.summary: Keith recruits Johnathan to intercept a Russian trawler fishing illegally in US waters, but the situation intensifies when the Time Bandit crew spots a missile streaking across their position; Bill and Sean fight to defend their pots from rogue trawlers.

episodes.name: Curse of St. Paul Island
episodes.summary: As winter weather unleashes havoc on the crab grounds, the deadliest harbor in the Bering Sea becomes the only port open for delivery, forcing the crab fleet to make high risk entries into a harbor that has claimed the lives of many fellow fisherman.

episodes.name: Avian Apocalypse
episodes.summary: The Cornelia Marie crashes into the ice pack when the greenhorn on watch falls asleep at the wheel; Jake's crew experiences a stunning phenomenon when a flock of seabirds bombards the Saga; Wild Bill tackles an unsafe sea state on the Summer Bay.

episodes.name: Frozen
episodes.summary: After risking his crew salvaging gear from the ice pack, Sig changes tactics and uses an experimental bait from Norway; on the Time Bandit, frustration boils over as Freddy tests Johnathan; Jake encounters seas so volatile his crew must take shelter.

episodes.name: Measure of the Man
episodes.summary: Shaken by a life-threatening injury and Coast Guard rescue from his deck less than a year after tragic loss of a much-loved deckhand, Captain Rip Carlton puts the Patricia Lee in drydock for a massive renovation to safeguard his crew for the future.

episodes.name: Ghosted
episodes.summary: When Capt. Sig tempts fate fishing in the path of the approaching ice edge, he must brave the ice floes in a desperate attempt to retrieve crabs and gear; in heavy seas, Sean gets ghosted by a senior captain, but Josh and Casey come to his aid.

episodes.name: Port of Last Resort
episodes.summary: As ice blocks St. Paul Harbor, captains race to deliver their final snow crab; Sig deploys a risky tactic his father pioneered; Jake battles a slack tank to save the Saga; Keith and John scuttle a plan as the Wizard's 77-year-old hull cracks open.

episodes.name: The Viking Returns: Norwegian Blood
episodes.summary: Sig and Mandy roll the dice on convincing old-world seafood barons to buy into an unfamiliar crab species; when Jake chases Russian kings far to the north, the Hansens must add a new boat to their Norwegian fleet for a chance at tanking the biomass.

episodes.name: The Viking Returns: Hard Won Legacy
episodes.summary: Sig ventures off the beaten path in search of secrets from a fishing legend; Jake puts together pieces of his family's past and finds unexpected answers about his own late father; Clark must prove can tank the crab on his own.

episodes.name: To the End of the Earth
episodes.summary: Nautical weather slams the fleet as Josh and Casey race north in hopes of beating the coming ice pack; Sig and Keith attempt to find common ground; on the Time Bandit, Johnathan finds his co-captain a bit wobbly.

episodes.name: To the End of the Earth
episodes.summary: Josh and Casey race north hoping to beat the violent nautical weather coming their way; Sig and Keith try to find common ground; Johnathan finds his co-captain a more than just a little wobbly.

episodes.name: Wheelhouse Redemption
episodes.summary: As Captain Jake Anderson plans for his next move as a professional fisherman, he and his longtime mentor Sig Hansen open a door into his own legacy and discover how a lifetime of overcoming obstacles puts him and his family on the road to success.

episodes.name: The Viking Returns: For King and Country
episodes.summary: Sig and Jake steam far to the north to fill their tanks with Russian kings; when Clark finds uncertain depths at shore, Mandy captains a new boat with the technology to get him on the crabs.

episodes.name: Call of a New Generation
episodes.summary: A young generation ventures to the Bering Sea, forging unlikely wheelhouse alliances across the fleet; as high prices draw illegal foreign boats, captains young and old band together to defend America's crab grounds.

episodes.name: Wheelhouse Bound
episodes.summary: Sig gets tough news at sea, forcing the Hansens to make a critical decision as John and Andy lend a hand; with wheelhouse ambitions, Jacob hits a wall with Keith on the Wizard; new captain Jack crosses a line when Harley makes a deal with Jake.

episodes.name: Amazing Grace
episodes.summary: Sig buries his beloved mother and the last of his family's pioneering generation; Sean Dwyer joins forces with Rick Shelford, but the captains don't see eye to eye on rules; Jacob fights back on the Wizard and finds no safe harbor from Capt. Keith.

episodes.name: Bering Sea Superstition
episodes.summary: A new deckhand falls ill on the Time Bandit, raising questions for Andy; a bait pallet breaks loose, forcing Capt. Rick to deal with a severe crew injury; when Wild Bill's plan A fails on the Summer Bay, so Maria tries plan P.

episodes.name: In Need of Rescue
episodes.summary: Sig returns from his mother's funeral only to find his gear in harm's way; Rick and Keith forge a beneficial partnership; Jack makes his first offload as captain; The Coast Guard gets a call to extract a sailor with broken legs 200 miles out to sea.

episodes.name: Blood and Treasure
episodes.summary: When Sig and Mandy disagree on fishing strategy, Clark finds himself caught in the middle; Wild Bill comes down hard on inattentive deckhands as Linda gets too close to danger; Keith pulls the Wizard alongside the Saga and unleashes unexpected bad blood.

episodes.name: Cold Hard World
episodes.summary: On the Saga, Sean Dwyer joins Jake for a high-risk trek west to Adak Island; Rick attempts a dangerous shortcut through the treacherous tides of Unimak Pass; Sig's deckhand Lauritz takes a brutal fall; Johnathan bids farewell to a lifelong friend.

episodes.name: Anchor Management
episodes.summary: As a continent-size storm pummels the fleet, John and Andy fight to save their anchor and the boat; Rick navigates stormy seas and feuding deckhands; when an orca befriends the Northwestern, Sig sees a sign of life until it stops him from fishing.

episodes.name: Million Dollar Season
episodes.summary: With a storm threatening his record-breaking run, Johnathan allies with Keith to triangulate the crab; Jack braves treacherous tidal currents, staking his redemption on loaded pots; in 30-foot waves, chaos strikes the Wizard.

episodes.name: Between Payday and Mayday
episodes.summary: An early closure forces captains to work together to get their catch safely to port; Sig crosses a line when he repositions a rookie captain's pots; Jake and Sean race back from Adak while Linda bolsters her east coast reputation in the Bering Sea.

episodes.name: Loose Lips Sink Ships
episodes.summary: In the winter premiere, Johnathan hunts for crab in a secret location to which he's won exclusive rights; Sig tries his luck at a derby fishery; Keith risks an at-sea deckhand transfer; Bob joins a fisherman's strike for higher crab prices.

episodes.name: Maiden Voyage
episodes.summary: As a turbulent winter rages, young Capt. Bob seeks to overcome tragedy to launch her maiden voyage on her late parents' crab boat; Capt. Jack takes the reins of a storied vessel; fired from the Wizard, aspiring skipper Jacob finds a new home.

episodes.name: Victory at Sea
episodes.summary: Bob's breakout haul as a solo captain takes a turn when another vessel collides with the boat she inherited from her late parents; cascading engine failures put Sig in a tough spot as the Coast Guard makes a surprise inspection.

episodes.name: The Better Captain
episodes.summary: With $1 million in crab at stake, the Wizard battles unrelenting 30-footers; Jake faces a devil's bargain to aid another captain, but the high road may come at a cost; Sig fights to eke out a profit; the Kodiak crew assesses the damage.

episodes.name: Uncharted Grounds
episodes.summary: Winter unleashes its fury, slamming the fleet with tidal surges and waves; when Keith's winch seizes, the Wizard crew must work a double shift to retrieve pots; Wild Bill's erroneous chart leaves the Summer Bay beached on a sandbar.

episodes.name: Pain Level Ten
episodes.summary: When a deckhand suffers a possible heart attack on board, Keith attempts to save his crewman's life; an explosion rocks the Time Bandit, burning Freddy and shaking Johnathan to his core; facing capsizing, Jake must dump pots.

episodes.name: Dead Reckoning
episodes.summary: When Sig loses GPS navigation in crowded waters, Mandy must work a decades-old magnetic compass with no margin for error; OJ's replacement on the Wizard makes a misfit crew a bit more awkward; Bob's Bairdi haul earns her bragging rights.

episodes.name: Disorder on the Border
episodes.summary: On the Time Bandit, crew conflict in winter weather puts Johnathan's leadership to the test; Sig and Mandy risk a heavy fine chasing the biomass along a boundary line; Jake struggles with managing an injury-prone crew member.

episodes.name: Beware the King Tide
episodes.summary: As a monumental king tide amplifies the sea state, Johnathan drives the Time Bandit into towering waves to haul the riskiest set of his career; Jake faces a potentially unstoppable magnesium fire; Sig deploys evasive maneuvers to defend his catch.

episodes.name: Battleship
episodes.summary: Hampered by damage, Sig must outmaneuver an unknown captain to hold on to his ground; Jake allies with Wild Bill to make a critical deadline -- but when Bill calls in a favor, time runs short; Rick devises a strategy to ensure Jacob makes it home.

episodes.name: Last Stand of John Hillstrand
episodes.summary: Johnathan scrambles to save his pots from a Bering Sea grave; Sig revives a decades-old fishing computer to find a Bairdi hotspot, while Jake's manpower shortage forces him to put his niece on the hydraulics.

episodes.name: Nautical Deathtrap
episodes.summary: In the Season 19 finale, an uncharacteristic error traps Sig's family in unsurvivable seas; a wayward crane breaches Jake's wheelhouse, killing critical systems and his way home; Rick attempts to turn a tragedy into a triumph for Jacob.

episodes.name: King Crab Derby
episodes.summary: King Crab's return ignites a derby-style race; after losing the Saga, Jake joins Sig as co-captain; a serious hip injury tests Sophia; fire on the Wizard traps Keith's deckhand below deck; Bill faces his hardest test yet.

episodes.name: Bering Sea Gut Check
episodes.summary: As competition heats up on the King Crab grounds, Jake's next move puts him at odds with Capt. Sig. Wild Bill battles heavy seas and side effects; Sophia Bob Nielsen attempts to pop in a deckhand's dislocated hip to avoid a steam back to town.

episodes.name: A Titan Among Men
episodes.summary: Jake aims to prove himself on the Titan Explorer after he leaves Sig's boat; Sig and Johnathan race to get ahead of a migrating king crab hoard in an underwater canyon; Rick incurs Keith's wrath when his captain-in-training launches a rogue set.

episodes.name: Lights Out!
episodes.summary: A below-deck brawl puts Sophia Bob Nielsen's captaincy to the test on the Seabrooke; a hydro leak on the Summer Bay threatens to send Wild Bill's King Crab season into the red; Rick must make a crucial decision when Jacob's deckmate crosses the line.

episodes.name: Twice Bitten, Twice Shy
episodes.summary: When Sig's fishing information falls into the wrong hands, he deals his protégé a lesson he won't soon forget; Rick faces a gun-shy deckhand; Sophia contends with a crewman with a badly infected tooth.

episodes.name: The Purpose of Porpoises
episodes.summary: Captain Sig contends with a man overboard for the first time in his career; Johnathan comes up short on crab but sees the tide turning when thousands of porpoises guide the Time Bandit in a new direction; Jack tangles with Wild Bill.

episodes.name: Forged in Fury
episodes.summary: As the first Siberian storm slams the grounds, Sig sets into 40-knot winds, risking capsizing when his tank floods; Sophia must prove she can drive a boat and lead her crew in severe weather while Jake battles insubordination from his own new crew.

episodes.name: Seaborne Sacrifice
episodes.summary: Sig deploys tactics from the old country to zero in on the Bairdi crab mother lode; Jack earns a windfall of new quota, but it comes at the cost of drug testing his crew.

episodes.name: A Wrinkle in Time
episodes.summary: Johnathan alters time in an attempt to get to port for an anniversary he promised Heather on land; Rick battles a Bering Sea gale that knocks his deckhand out of commission; Sophia helms the Seabrooke in the roughest weather she's ever seen.

episodes.name: Under the Gun
episodes.summary: With the clock ticking on the fall season, Sig devises a way to simultaneously silence his crew and fish faster; as Wild Bill goes under the knife, he elevates Landon to captain the Summer Bay; after giving Jack fishing intel, Keith smells a rat.

episodes.name: Blow the Man Down
episodes.summary: Mother Nature blows back as the four remaining captains battle to tank their fall quotas; Landon prays for deliverance on his first solo mission; Sig persists in fishing in 20-foot seas.

episodes.name: Raw Winter
episodes.summary: Sig and Keith risk fishing far from land despite a forecast, Super El Niño season and encounter a gauntlet of Bering Sea weather; after sand fleas consume his bait, Johnathan strategically sets pots near a submarine volcano.

episodes.name: Merciless Seas
episodes.summary: As weather pounds the fleet, a 30-foot wave crushes a Titan Explorer deckhand, threatening Jake's captaincy; on the Time Bandit, Johnathan loses a generator and goes dark; the Aleutian Lady drives into the weather to reach Dutch Harbor for repairs.

episodes.name: Anchors Away
episodes.summary: Aboard the Wizard, Keith must retrieve his lost anchor in 50-knot winds; Sig attempts a risky new strategy before finding himself racing to secure the next offload slot.

episodes.name: A Bridge Too Far
episodes.summary: An Arctic storm blows Sig's Northwestern off course during its opening set of the Golden King; Jake faces the loss of his longtime engineer; Monte takes the wheel of the Wizard when Keith inexplicably collapses in the wheelhouse.

episodes.name: My Brother's Keeper
episodes.summary: After Keith suffers a cardiac event at sea, Monte races to get his brother to the nearest airstrip for medevac; as the fleet prays for Keith's safety, the Wizard crew must navigate the notoriously dangerous port entry at Saint Paul.

episodes.name: Out Cold
episodes.summary: As Keith fights for his life at Anchorage General, Sig helps his brother Monte to get back on the crab.

episodes.name: Graveyard for the Lost
episodes.summary: John risks capsizing while fishing with a slack tank; Jake hauls in a large sea; under pressure to get home for the arrival of Mandy's second child, Sig and Clark fish deeper than ever before as mechanical problems mount.

episodes.name: Nothin' but Mammals
episodes.summary: In the Season 20 finale, four boats race to beat closing canneries as conditions intensify on the water; Sig suffers a major outage with hours to port; Jake uses his only gear to back out of trouble; John doubles down on orcas.

episodes.name: The Wild West
episodes.summary: Sig and Johnathan embark on a perilous trip to the remote Adak Island, chasing rumors of giant king crab for a potentially massive payoff.

episodes.name: Abandon All but Hope
episodes.summary: After a deadly chemical leak forces Jake to abandon ship, Keith races to locate the Titan Explorer crew and save their ailing vessel; with Sig aboard the Time Bandit, Mandy takes the Northwestern's helm for her first-ever solo king crab season.

episodes.name: Typhoon Sea State
episodes.summary: A typhoon brings monstrous waves and high winds to the west; Rick and Bob attempt to stitch a head wound in turbulent seas; John risks capsize to make a harbor entrance; an emergency tests Jake between his duties as captain and man of the house.

episodes.name: Mutiny on the Confidence
episodes.summary: A brutal knife injury on the Northwestern leaves Sig scrambling; after one crewman quits, tensions explode on the Confidence until even the co-captain revolts; the Wizard faces a nightmarish mechanical failure when Keith's throttle fails in the seas.

episodes.name: The Ship's Bell Tolls
episodes.summary: In treacherous western waters, Sig and Jake gamble on a daring new fishing strategy; Rick and Sophia attempt a perilous boat-to-boat transfer to save a quarter of a million dollars of crab; the fleet mourns the loss of beloved fisherman Nick Mavar.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.summary: One of the world's deadliest jobs is that of the Alaskan crab fisherman; they brave the treacherous Bering Sea in search of valuable king crabs.

episodes.name: You're Fired, Mate!
episodes.summary: Sig must act quickly as heavy ice entombs the Northwestern; when Keith's Australian greenhorn challenges his old-school command, a culture clash erupts; hellbent on earning an ownership stake in the Titan, Jake hauls pots at a blistering pace.

episodes.name: Bering Sea Casino
episodes.summary: A cracked tank on the Titan Explorer leaves Jake's engines vulnerable to seawater; Keith fires another deckhand but struggles to get rid of him for good; Johnathan prescribes alternative cures as the norovirus overtakes the Time Bandit crew at sea.

episodes.name: Dire Straits
episodes.summary: Sig strikes gold raiding Keith's hot spot, but when a line snarls his wheel, he must call his rival for help; a rogue wave knocks out Rick's electronics, forcing Bob to take the helm; Harley breaks in a new co-captain, only to break down at sea.

episodes.name: Rage Bait
episodes.summary: When the Time Bandit loses power with a storm at its tail, Johnathan deploys a camera probe to find what's snarling his propeller; Keith sets a decoy string to lure Sig away from good fishing, but risks his own secret plan by trusting the wrong ally.

episodes.name: Fail Fast, Fail Often
episodes.summary: In the winter premiere, the snow crab fishery reopens unexpectedly after three years; Keith and Jake charge north, only to collide with an incoming Siberian storm; Sig and Rick form a wary alliance, but with big money on the line, trust fails fast.

episodes.name: Kidney Punch
episodes.summary: Winter season erupts as the fleet battles brutal seas and each other; Sig and Rick's alliance shatters as Keith fights through a debilitating injury and a short-handed crew; The Titan Explorer loses steering in heavy seas, leaving Jake dead.

episodes.name: Brute Force Fishery
episodes.summary: Six hundred miles from town, brutal cold threatens man and crab alike; Sig braves deadly icing while a tidal surge leaves Clark bloodied on deck; Keith and Jake team up to battle an aggressive trawler while Rick encounters a squall.

episodes.name: Bring Out the Monster
episodes.summary: Keith & Jake deploy guerrilla tactics when a factory trawler invades their grounds; at the Russian Line, Rick encounters temperatures so frigid that even snow crab can't survive on deck; Sig struggles against mounting breakdowns.

episodes.name: Beyond the Breaking Point
episodes.summary: After six relentless weeks at sea, man and machine push past the breaking point; Keith seeks medical care in Anchorage, the Wizard loses steering in 20-foot seas.

episodes.name: Unfathomable
episodes.summary: Pushing into their breaking point, the fleet scrambles to collect the first Opilio windfall in three years; Clark takes the skipper role after Sig's collapse; Keith returns with a vengeance; rogue waves threaten Jake's operation.

episodes.name: Kings of the Frozen North
episodes.summary: The captains find a rare strain of red king crab in the north amid ice and storms; Sig deploys an underwater drone to pinpoint the horde; Jake revives the Cornelia Marie to battle northern seas.

episodes.name: Headlong Into Halong
episodes.summary: With no port for shelter, Johnathan fights to protect his crew as Typhoon Halong pounds the northern grounds; Rick's Red King jackpot halts when a line fouls his prop; in 25-foot seas, Jake discovers the limits of the Cornelia Marie's fishing operations.

episodes.name: Stack Fire
episodes.summary: After joining forces, Sig and Jake set their boats on a collision course; crew tensions explode on the Time Bandit, leading Keith to lure Freddy back to the Wizard; when the Aleutian Lady's exhaust stack bursts into flames, Rick must fight fire with fire.

episodes.name: Hunger Game
episodes.summary: When the Time Bandit's freezer fails, John makes an emergency trip to St. George Island to feed his hungry crew. Sig and Jake lure crab to their own side of a maritime boundary. Rick battles a perplexing engine issue amid the biggest waves of the season.

episodes.name: Saltwater Runs Deep
episodes.summary: A dream leads John to a crab hotspot, but a rival trawler shares the vision for filling its own massive nets. Keith's crew races to save the Wizard as seawater breaches the engine room. On the Northwestern, an erratic crane drags Clark across the deck.

episodes.name: Rocked to the Core
episodes.summary: When a rogue wave pummels the Wizard and sidelines its crew, Keith reconsiders the risks he's taking; racing to make an offload, Sig loses a deckhand to a crushed toe; Rick finds crab but needs new tactics to fish a seafloor bristling with old crab pots.

episodes.name: Wrong Side of the Law
episodes.summary: When Monte discovers Keith set pots in an illegal zone, he and the Wizard crew must pay the price in blood and treasure; a storm reconnects Jake to the larger-than-life hero of the Cornelia Marie's past; Johnathan gambles on a million-dollar fall season.

episodes.name: Anything That Can Go Wrong
episodes.summary: When Sig's crane blows a hydraulic line, Clark ascends the rig in 20-foot seas for a critical repair; the Cornelia Marie crew battles a fire as Jake's engine room fills with smoke; Monte fights a generator outage while Rick dumps pots to avoid capsizing.

episodes.name: Nine Souls on Board
episodes.summary: In the winter season premiere, Sig teaches Sophia how to captain the Northwestern at the Russian line. Jake stacks the Cornelia Marie for a risky trip north. When a crab boat sinks near St. George, the Wizard is the only vessel close enough to reach it.

episodes.name: He's In the Water!
episodes.summary: When Wizard deckhand Lynn Guitard falls overboard in 15 foot seas, Keith and Monte scramble to rescue him before hypothermia sets in; on the Northwestern, Sig lets Sophia prove herself at the Russian line; a greenhorn joins the crew of the Aleutian Lady.

episodes.name: O Captain, My Captain
episodes.summary: On the Aleutian Lady, greenhorn Todd's abscessed tooth forces Rick to consider a costly return to Dutch Harbor. Sig hands new protégé Bob the helm for her first-ever opilio season. Johnathan performs surgery-at-sea on his favorite Time Bandit shipmate.

episodes.name: Crushing Ice
episodes.summary: As Arctic ice wreaks havoc on the fishing grounds, Rick risks losing a fortune in crab pots. Johnathan tests the Time Bandit's reinforced bow in a desperate attempt to save the gear. A health crisis on the Wizard forces Keith to make a life-or-death call.

episodes.name: Those in Peril on the Sea
episodes.summary: Captains Sig and Sophia shift their fishing strategy as back-to-back injuries plague the Northwestern deck crew. When a Time Bandit crewman suffers a concussion, John must make a perilous harbor entry. Jake loses power in heavy seas on the Cornelia Marie.

episodes.name: Deb Test
episodes.summary: Crab fishermen battle Arctic weather and brutal waves for big money.

episodes.name: Livingston

episodes.name: Adieux
episodes.summary: Meriwether Lewis shares news of his upcoming travels with his long-suffering wife; Larry presses George Washington for answers.

episodes.name: McCarthy
episodes.summary: Larry crashes a party in Boston Harbor; Joe McCarthy airs his grievances on the Senate floor.

episodes.name: Deepthroat
episodes.summary: President and Mrs. Obama want to honor America's 250th anniversary and celebrate the history of the nation on the occasion, but then Larry David calls.
