episodes.name: Classics
episodes.summary: Gourmet shack in Tarpley, Texas; eggs over-easy in Kansas.

episodes.name: Italian
episodes.summary: Meat sauce from a drive-in; 1940's New York diner, Italian sausage and peppers; stromboli.

episodes.name: Blue Plate Specials
episodes.summary: Guy goes coast to coast in search of great specials such as fried pickles, home made corn dogs, and the best Italian beef.

episodes.name: Breakfast
episodes.summary: Famous breakfast dishes from all over the country.

episodes.name: BBQ
episodes.summary: Guy looks for great tasting barbecue.

episodes.name: Local Legends
episodes.summary: Restaurants loved by the locals.

episodes.name: Triple D All Stars
episodes.summary: This trip, Guy's hittin' the road with a couple of his A-list friends: Matthew McConaughey and fellow foodie Andrew Zimmern.

episodes.name: House Specials
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri stops in for some one-of-a-kind specials, including The Red Arrow Diner in Manchester, N.H., where they're cooking homemade twinkies and have been baking 20 kinds of pie since 1922.

episodes.name: Retro
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri rolls out to some legendary joints that take you back in time: Taylor's Automatic Refresher in St. Helena, Calif., an original 1940s takeout-only burger joint.

episodes.name: Worth the Trip
episodes.summary: Diner located on Bainbridge Island in Seattle; ribs from Mo Gridders BBQ in the Bronx, N.Y.; pinto beans from Harold's Cafe in Gaffney, S.C.

episodes.name: Diners A-Plenty
episodes.summary: Kelly's Diner in Somerville, Mass.; The Bay Way Diner in Linden, N.J.; Beacon Drive-In in Spartanburg, S.C.

episodes.name: American Cookin'
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri checks out some longtime joints at the heart of their communities.

episodes.name: Evil Places
episodes.summary: Deadly forests, haunted houses, and mountains where visitors never return alive; a look at what constitutes an evil place and whether these locations are imbued with dark energy that is currently beyond understanding.

episodes.name: Mysterious Structures
episodes.summary: For centuries, archaeologists have tried to unravel the mysteries of how and why certain incredible structures like the Great Pyramid at Giza, the staircase at Loretto Chapel, and Coral Castle were built.

episodes.name: Strange Creatures
episodes.summary: Millions of people around the world claim to have had an encounter with a creature unlike any recognized by mainstream science such as the Mothman, Chupacabra, and Mongolian Death Worm.

episodes.name: Unnatural Nature
episodes.summary: Probing the Windsor Hum and Old Faithful; visiting a Venezuelan lake where lightning rains down 300 nights a year; sizing up the massive underground fire that's been burning in Centralia, Pa., since 1962.

episodes.name: Bizarre Rituals
episodes.summary: Ancient practices such as prayer, blood sports, voodoo and exorcism are often thought to be relics of bygone superstition but there is evidence they have an impact on the physical world.

episodes.name: Life Beyond Death
episodes.summary: The age-old question of what happens after death and the clues to the answer may lie in unusual cases of near-death experience, reincarnation, and how memories can be passed from organ donors to transplant recipients.

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Mind
episodes.summary: After centuries of study, the human mind remains inscrutable; examining how the brain can be more powerful than humans realize.

episodes.name: Incredible Survivors
episodes.summary: A look at how some people live through the impossible such as plane crashes, freezing temperatures, or performing superhuman feats while in danger; remarkable tales of human survival force others to reconsider what is known about the will to live.

episodes.name: The Oak Island Curse
episodes.summary: For more than 200 years, treasure hunters have been coming to Oak Island in search of a treasure that has so far eluded them all, and has even cost six men their lives, could it be, as legend suggests, the treasure is protected by a deadly curse.

episodes.name: Dark Prophecies
episodes.summary: Can humans predict the future by use of prophets and dreams, if so, can humankind harness this knowledge to avoid future deadly events.

episodes.name: Lost Civilizations
episodes.summary: A look at what could cause once-thriving groups of people to just abandon their great cities, never to return; modern scientific knowledge may be able to help answer the unsolved questions surrounding these lost civilizations.

episodes.name: Deadly Cults
episodes.summary: Many of the world's deadliest cults venture down dark, dangerous rabbit holes of twisted ideologies, with deadly dances, manipulation, mass suicides, and murder.

episodes.name: Extreme Weather Mysteries
episodes.summary: A house that narrowly dodges the path of a tornado; rain that falls from the sky like blood; lightning that follows into the home.

episodes.name: Mysterious Stones
episodes.summary: A miraculous meteorite falling from the heavens and a chunk of sandstone considered so sacred that wars have been fought to protect it; throughout history, many have insisted that simple stones can do everything from choosing a king to causing death.

episodes.name: Vampires and Werewolves
episodes.summary: Dracula, Lycaon of Arcadia, the Beast of Gévaudan; these are the names of grotesque monsters who have reared their terrifying heads throughout history, unearthly creatures that thrived on human blood and flesh.

episodes.name: Amazing Animal Abilities
episodes.summary: A dog that can detect cancer faster than doctors can do it by using sophisticated equipment; a horse that can read minds; birds that can sense disaster days before it happens.

episodes.name: The Greatest Escapes
episodes.summary: Stories of escape that defy explanation; Harry Houdini pulls off escape acts; an attempted prison break from Alcatraz Federal Penitentiary; one man receives guidance that allows him to escape the South Tower of the World Trade Center on 9/11.

episodes.name: Superhuman Senses
episodes.summary: The five senses: sight, smell, hearing, taste and touch; constructing the reality of the world around us, like a blank canvas continuously painted and repainted every day.

episodes.name: Mysterious Curses
episodes.summary: Throughout history, many have believed that certain places, things, or even people can be tainted with dark curses; ominous lakes that morph into watery graves; paintings and precious stones that bring death and destruction to their keepers.

episodes.name: The Truth About UFO's
episodes.summary: For decades, the debate has raged as to what exactly unidentified flying objects really are; theories have been put forth that attribute UFOs to everything from secret military aircraft to weather phenomena and more.

episodes.name: The Underground World
episodes.summary: Exploring the center of the Earth.

episodes.name: Leading Double Lives
episodes.summary: Stories of those who lead double lives are both daring and baffling; a look at what compels a person to attempt to become someone else and when the line between impersonation and transformation becomes blurred.

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Bible
episodes.summary: Many believe it to be the Word of God, but others claim it contains inconsistencies and contradictions that could only be manmade.

episodes.name: Mysterious Mummies
episodes.summary: Examining mankind's fascination with the dead, from ancient civilizations to 20th-century empires, and the possible reasons for that focus.

episodes.name: Secrets of America's Monuments
episodes.summary: America's monuments are inarguably impressive due to their colossal size and scope, their groundbreaking feats of engineering, and their storied histories, as well as the closely guarded secrets their implacable facades may be hiding.

episodes.name: The Search for Atlantis
episodes.summary: According to the Greek philosopher Plato, the lost continent of Atlantis was once home to an advanced civilization before it was destroyed in a cataclysm; for centuries, archaeologists have tried to uncover evidence to prove that this legend is true.

episodes.name: Extraordinary Engineering
episodes.summary: For centuries, humanity has been compelled to build remarkable structures that are much more than simple places of shelter or work.

episodes.name: The Power of Gold
episodes.summary: As one of the most valuable and coveted precious metals on the planet, gold's power over mankind harkens back thousands of years.

episodes.name: The Truth About Bigfoot
episodes.summary: For centuries, legends and eyewitness accounts have told of a massive, hairy creature that roams the forest on two legs.

episodes.name: Bizarre Vanishings
episodes.summary: Stories of mysterious disappearances are compelling and confounding; cases of bizarre happenings, such as Flight MH370 and disappearances in the Bermuda Triangle.

episodes.name: Serial Killers
episodes.summary: The contempt for life exhibited by serial killers makes people question their own safety; psychopaths and sadists rarely show regret or empathy for the lives they destroy.

episodes.name: The Mystery of Plagues
episodes.summary: Examining some of the most devastating plagues in human history, as well the scientific advances to combat these diseases, including the development of Edward Jenner's vaccine for smallpox in the 1790s.

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Moon
episodes.summary: Experts question whether the moon is just a rock floating in space, or whether it holds profound secrets and perhaps even possesses incredible powers.

episodes.name: Outrageous Robberies
episodes.summary: Examining what motivates someone to steal.

episodes.name: The Hunt for Hidden Treasures
episodes.summary: Sunken ships filled with priceless cargo; lost cities of gold; ancient temples concealing untold riches; there's something about these hidden treasures that captures the human imagination.

episodes.name: Satanic Encounters
episodes.summary: For thousands of years, people have believed in the existence of Satan, the embodiment of evil; some believe he has the power to possess souls and create mayhem amongst humanity.

episodes.name: The Search for the Ark of the Covenant
episodes.summary: Throughout history, many have sought the lost Ark of the Covenant; according to the Old Testament, God himself instructed Moses to build the Ark and it is believed that it held the power of the Almighty.

episodes.name: Apocalypse When?
episodes.summary: Since the dawn of civilization, humanity has been fixated on predicting our own demise.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Immortals
episodes.summary: Sacred waters with remarkable healing powers; ancient mystics who lived for hundreds of years; a scientific breakthrough may provide the answers to eternal life.

episodes.name: Sacred Bones
episodes.summary: The possibility of bones holding sacred power after death.

episodes.name: Mysteries of Mars
episodes.summary: As a new era of exploration of the Red Planet begins, the Red Planet's mysteries might be close to getting solved; ancient cataclysms are believed to have left Mars barren, but science continues to find clues that this red planet was once blue.

episodes.name: Mysterious Ancient Ruins
episodes.summary: Some archeological finds are so baffling, they challenge what is known about the past; learning the truth about these mysterious ruins and answering the questions they continue to present.

episodes.name: Best Of: Decoding Genius
episodes.summary: Geniuses shape history in science, music, and math. Are they born or made? Can studying brilliant minds like Einstein reveal what creates genius?

episodes.name: What Lies Below?
episodes.summary: More than 80% of the Earth's oceans remain unexplored, and in many ways, the underwater world is the final frontier; as new technology allows people to explore oceans and deep lakes more than ever before, nobody knows what they will find.

episodes.name: Secrets of Abandoned Places
episodes.summary: From the ancient Babylonians to modern-day urban explorers, mankind has always been fascinated by abandoned places; discovering the allure that draws people to post-apocalyptic landscapes.

episodes.name: Acts of God
episodes.summary: Examining various events that are said to have been directed by the hand of the Almighty, such as the Great Flood, the Plagues of Egypt, Sodom and Gomorrah, and Moses parting the Red Sea.

episodes.name: Serial Killer Creatures
episodes.summary: The animal kingdom is full of deadly predators, and some of them attack in extraordinary and inexplicable ways; some animals strike back at humans for reasons beyond normal defense and hunger.

episodes.name: Mysterious Tombs
episodes.summary: Throughout history, humans have buried their dead in caves or chambers, in pyramids or in some form of a tomb; ancient tombs were visual memorials for the dead; in China, a vast necropolis was constructed as a way to connect to the afterlife.

episodes.name: Robot Revolution
episodes.summary: For thousands of years, mankind has been fascinated by the idea of creating mechanical servants to make our lives easier.

episodes.name: Secret Societies
episodes.summary: The idea that a handful of shadowy organizations control world events has been around for centuries. Today, the Mafia, Skull & Bones, and the Freemasons are just a few of the mysterious groups said to meet behind closed doors, keeping dangerous secrets. What are the codes and rituals that define their beliefs? And is it possible that secret societies not only shaped the events that defined the 20th century, but will continue to shape the future?

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Missing Link
episodes.summary: More than 7 billion people live on Earth; human civilizations span the globe; although many around the globe believe that the divine hand of God placed humans on Earth, others question whether there were ever other kinds of human-like creatures.

episodes.name: Surviving the Impossible
episodes.summary: Humans can survive catastrophic injuries and deadly scenarios that defy the odds in ways that are inexplicable; these survivals challenge the best attempts to explain how anyone could live through such circumstances.

episodes.name: Mysterious Urban Legends
episodes.summary: From the eerie reports of spontaneous human combustion and the hunt for the Highgate Vampire, to the unsettling boogeymen known as the Men in Black appearing after UFO sightings, could these legends be more than just stories?

episodes.name: Mad Scientists
episodes.summary: Throughout history, there have been men of science who pushed the boundaries of experimentation to the edge of madness; they were renegades known for bizarre and often unethical experiments involving human-animal hybrids, mind control devices and even unimaginable torture; what led these mad scientists down a strange, dark path in their pursuit of knowledge?

episodes.name: Strange Tales From the American Frontier
episodes.summary: Bizarre, mysterious tales ran rampant and are still being told to this day; are these strange tales of the American frontier simply legend, or was the west far stranger than one could possibly imagine?

episodes.name: The Search for Extraterrestrial Life
episodes.summary: Scientists are involved in a never-ending quest to understand the vast universe the planet inhabits; it seems that for each answer science provides, even more questions arise.

episodes.name: Real Life Monsters
episodes.summary: For centuries, fantastic tales of terrifying monsters have fascinated mankind; bizarre beasts of all shapes and sizes have been portrayed in some of history's most classic stories and folklore.

episodes.name: The World's Deadliest Assassins
episodes.summary: From lone operatives to agents of powerful regimes, assassins have left a trail of disruption that echoes through time; are assassins merely footnotes in history, or have they steered the destiny of civilization all along?

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Underground
episodes.summary: Beneath our feet lie hidden ancient tunnels, sacred caves and shadowy passages into a world of darkness shaped by nature, carved by man and steeped in myth; seeing if the underground realms are mere remnants of the past, or they guard secrets.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Founding Fathers
episodes.summary: The Founding Fathers established the pillars of freedom and democracy in the United States; more than two centuries after their bold vision came to life, new information has emerged about the agendas and secrets of these important historical figures.

episodes.name: The Weird Wild West
episodes.summary: The American frontier is full of legends of cowboys, Native Americans and outlaws; but there are also many eerie stories of cursed mountains, monsters and even UFOs.

episodes.name: Devastating Disasters
episodes.summary: Examining if modern technology and scientific knowledge can help protect people from almost anything, including natural disasters, or if vulnerability remains a factor.

episodes.name: Mysterious Monoliths
episodes.summary: All over the world, there are giant monoliths that ancient ancestors carved out of solid rock.

episodes.name: Best Of: Mysterious Disappearances
episodes.summary: An exploration of the world's most fascinating, strange and inexplicable mysteries; compelling contributions from scientists, historians, and witnesses.

episodes.name: Best Of: Legends Unveiled
episodes.summary: An exploration of the world's most fascinating, strange and inexplicable mysteries; compelling contributions from scientists, historians, and witnesses.

episodes.name: Lost Cities
episodes.summary: Through records in historical texts, oral tradition and folklore, exploring how a once-thriving community becomes a lost city; what secrets found in the ruins reveal about human history.

episodes.name: Tales of the Dearly Departed
episodes.summary: Whether ancient burial practices, like graves, tombs and cremations, can preserve the soul for eternity or bring the dead back to life.

episodes.name: Curses Unleashed
episodes.summary: Many people are afraid of walking into a cursed place or touching a reportedly cursed object; they look at whether curses are real and how they are brought into existence.

episodes.name: Earth's Unsolved Mysteries
episodes.summary: The world is full of displays of natural phenomena; seeing if science can explain Earth's mysteries or if human knowledge of the Earth has only scratched the surface.

episodes.name: The Power of Prophecy
episodes.summary: A look at the visions of mystics, prophets and clairvoyants throughout history, what their prophecies reveal and predictions for the future.

episodes.name: Mysterious Monsters
episodes.summary: Around the world, people have claimed to have seen bizarre creatures that can only be described as monsters or beasts.

episodes.name: Sacred Rituals
episodes.summary: Throughout human history, many cultures have used sacred rituals to express their spiritual beliefs; there are many rituals that are thought to unlock supernatural powers.

episodes.name: UFO Hotspots
episodes.summary: Every year, thousands of people report looking up at the sky and witnessing unidentified flying objects; a vast majority of these strange incidents take place in the same locations on Earth.

episodes.name: Extraordinary Structures
episodes.summary: Throughout the world, there are ancient structures that defy explanation because even with today's technology they would be nearly impossible to duplicate.

episodes.name: Holy Relics
episodes.summary: Throughout history and across the globe, there have been many sacred relics believed to be imbued with mystical powers.

episodes.summary: An exploration of strange and inexplicable mysteries; contributions from scientists, historians and witnesses as they seek to shed light on how the impossible can happen.

episodes.name: The World Beneath Our Feet
episodes.summary: Humanity has launched satellites into outer space and submarines to the ocean floor, but the ground below Earth's surface remains shrouded in mystery.

episodes.name: The Time Travelers
episodes.summary: A look at whether time travel has already occurred, on purpose or by accident, and scientists who believe it is theoretically possible.

episodes.name: Secrets of Ancient Structures
episodes.summary: Age-old mysterious ruins stand as silent sentinels from the past, with their true history seemingly erased by time; modern archaeology attempts to unravel the enigma of how and why the ancient structures were built.

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Vikings
episodes.summary: During the Middle Ages, the Vikings were infamous for being a bloodthirsty band of seafaring warriors; historians are learning surprising new things about this Norse society.

episodes.name: Strange Stories of the Presidents
episodes.summary: There are many bizarre tales involving U.S. presidents that defy explanation and are still shrouded in mystery.

episodes.name: Tales of the Tormented
episodes.summary: From mysterious wounds that appear for no apparent reason, to a peculiar madness that compels people to dance themselves to death; looking at bizarre afflictions.

episodes.name: Strange Technology
episodes.summary: There are many puzzling artifacts from around the world that challenge everything known about the technological capabilities of distant ancestors; some ancient objects are so mysterious they've spawned endless debate and theories.

episodes.name: Unbreakable Codes
episodes.summary: There's nothing more fascinating than a code that can't be cracked. For centuries, mankind has devised ingenious ways to hide valuable information--using everything from enigmatic puzzles, to complex ciphers and secret symbols. If history's unbreakable codes can be deciphered...could we unlock answers to some of the greatest mysteries of both the past and present?

episodes.name: Strange Stories of World War II
episodes.summary: During World War II, a number of persistent mysteries were born, including unexplained stories about everything from lost gold to secret societies and highly advanced technology.

episodes.name: Monsters Among Us
episodes.summary: Since the dawn of humanity, tales of monstrous creatures lurking in the shadows have sparked both fascination and fear; discussing the potential that these stories have elements of reality to them.

episodes.name: The Golden Age of Pirates
episodes.summary: During The Golden Age of Piracy, thousands of buccaneers terrorized the high seas and became legends; their exploits spawned stories of larger-than-life characters, billion dollar heists, and buried treasure that to this day, has never been found.

episodes.name: Impossible Ancient Inventions
episodes.summary: There are stories of advanced technology from the ancient past that seem too impossible to be true; these technologies challenge everything humanity thought about the innovation of ancestors.

episodes.name: The Lost
episodes.summary: People go missing every day, but throughout history, there have been strange and eerie disappearances that continue to capture the world's attention.

episodes.name: Alien Contagion
episodes.summary: While modern science has stopped many dangerous viruses and bacteria in their tracks, there is a concern that contagious germs could be traveling through the vacuum of space.

episodes.name: Ancient Bible Relics
episodes.summary: Exploring the physical objects in museums and churches around the world that many believe are genuine holy relics from the Bible.

episodes.name: Islands of the Damned
episodes.summary: Islands riddled with dark histories, unspeakable tragedy and the belief by locals that they are cursed.

episodes.name: Impossible Ancient Structures
episodes.summary: All over the world stand ancient structures so massive, precise, and baffling that they seem impossible for not just their time, but ours as well; from colossal walls and giant stone tombs to temples carved from solid rock, how did ancient civilizations achieve feats of engineering that still defy modern understanding?

episodes.name: Nightmares and Dreams
episodes.summary: Dreams have inspired humanity for thousands of years and in all this time, we have yet to answer one fundamental question: What is the purpose of dreams? From nightmares linked to unexplained deaths and more.

episodes.name: Unnatural Disasters
episodes.summary: Throughout history, catastrophic disasters have reshaped civilizations -- yet some events defy all scientific expectations.

episodes.name: Mysteries of Ancient Africa
episodes.summary: Africa is the birthplace of humanity and remains one of the most mysterious continents on Earth. From lost cities buried beneath shifting sands, to abandoned ruins steeped in fascinating folklore, to the elusive tomb of history's most mighty queen, what secrets lie hidden throughout Africa's vast and unexplored ancient landscape?

episodes.name: Mind Over Matter
episodes.summary: The human mind is home to all our thoughts, hopes, dreams, and memories. The organ we call the brain not only keeps us alive; it allows us to interpret and experience the incredible world we live in. But are there people who are "wired" differently than most of us? Can unique circumstances permit some to tap into extra-sensory abilities that defy nature?

episodes.name: Mighty Kingdoms Unearthed
episodes.summary: Throughout civilization there are many kingdoms and mighty empires that have risen, only to one day fall. And for some of them-like the Inca that built Machu Picchu-their eventual demise remains a mystery. What can we discover from clues left behind by these once great empires? Could the Vikings, using their longships and traits as skilled navigators, have travelled farther into America than what we are led to believe?

episodes.name: Dangerous Places
episodes.summary: Every year, people risk their lives to enter places the world has marked off-limits, and in most cases, no one fully understands why. From the psychological forces that compel climbers to press on through the Death Zone of Mount Everest, to a stretch of New Mexico wilderness where at least 15 people have vanished without a trace, to a remote island in the Indian Ocean where trespassers are killed on sight - what is it about the world's most dangerous places that makes them impossible to resist?

episodes.name: Satan's Army
episodes.summary: From demonic possession and cursed homes to battlefield apparitions and ancient pacts with the Devil, history is filled with chilling accounts of supernatural forces said to be working against humanity. Are these terrifying encounters simply the product of fear and belief… or could they point to a hidden war between good and evil-one that continues to this day?

episodes.name: Top Secret Projects
episodes.summary: Throughout history, governments have carried out top secret projects that defy belief-from experimental aircraft and staged illusions to covert experiments that crossed ethical boundaries. Hidden from the public and revealed only years later, these operations raise a chilling question: if these programs were real… what else might still be happening in secret today?

episodes.name: Mystery of the Dinosaurs
episodes.summary: Dinosaurs have fascinated scientists for nearly two centuries, and in all that time, we have yet to answer even the most basic questions about how these animals lived, how they died, and what became of them. From an extinction event whose cause scientists to actively debate, to ancient dragon legends some researchers trace directly to fossil discoveries, to genetic technologies now being used to bring extinct creatures back to life.

episodes.name: The Lost World of the Aztecs
episodes.summary: Five centuries after the fall of the Aztec Empire, new discoveries are revealing that this lost civilization may have been far more sophisticated—and far stranger—than history has long suggested; what secrets remain buried beneath Mexico?

episodes.name: Objects of Power
episodes.summary: For centuries, certain objects have been deemed to heal the sick, summon spirits, legitimize kings, curse their owners, and even alter the fate of nations. Do these artifacts truly possess supernatural power, or is their force created by human belief?

episodes.name: Unnerving Nature
episodes.summary: Across the planet are places where nature behaves in ways that seem to defy explanation—forests where people vanish, deserts where signals fail, caves filled with toxic air, and mountains no one dares to climb. Are these merely extreme environments… or evidence that Earth still contains hidden realms where the rules of nature become dangerously unknown?

episodes.name: Deadly Ancient Curses
episodes.summary: Throughout history, people have feared that ancient curses can bring misfortune, madness and even death to those who defy them. Are these deadly warnings powered by supernatural forces — or by the terrifying ability of belief itself to shape reality?

episodes.name: What Happens at the Stripclub...
episodes.summary: Tehmeena busts BQ at the strip club; Yahweh Poetic and Yahweh Madi's romantic date turns left when jealousy blows up in their face; Marley faces disapproving family; the power throuple reveals big commitment plans.

episodes.name: My Wife's Fiancé
episodes.summary: The power throuple embarks on spicy solo adventures; a surprise proposal rocks a polycule; Marley and Bri's polyamorous pool party goes left; Yahweh Madi confides to her queens about her blowout with Poetic.

episodes.name: Big Swing Energy
episodes.summary: Tehmeena's bestie drops a shocking bombshell about BQ; Trent and Kami fear Nita is breaking the rules of their polycule; Jacob attempts to connect with Davis; Bri and Marley clash after an ultimatum.

episodes.name: This is Not a Wedding
episodes.summary: BQ and Tehmeena's couples therapy turns explosive; the power throuple erupts in chaos over money matters; the Yahwehs face tragedy; Davis's date takes an unexpected turn; Krystal's revelation shocks the queens.

episodes.name: I'm the Bad Guy
episodes.summary: Tehmeena reaches her breaking point with BQ; Yahweh Debash comes home, while Yahweh Krystal keeps a secret; Bri's ultimatum leaves Marley with a big decision; Becca and Davis decide to elope, but is Jacob on board?

episodes.name: Too Little, Too Late
episodes.summary: King Yahweh's arrival brings Poetic to tears; BQ's surprise for Tehmeena blows up in his face; Marley drops a bombshell; Kami and Nita clash over the terms of their commitment ceremony; Krystal's big news stuns Madi.

episodes.name: Love Bombs
episodes.summary: Yahweh Madi's decision shocks the queens; Trent gets cold feet at throuple commitment ceremony; Nita unleashes on Trent and Kami; Tehmeena stuns BQ; Bri packs her bags; Marley gets a big surprise.

episodes.name: Time to Get Wild
episodes.summary: In pursuit of finding the wildest homes around, Jack's first stop is Nebraska, where he explores a newly renovated missile silo; he tours a fairy tale cottage with a connection to Hollywood history, and then, an automotive wonderland in Las Vegas.

episodes.name: No Wild Stone Unturned
episodes.summary: Jack heads out to Palm Springs, California, where he tours the former home of Hollywood royalty; Jack discovers a unique solution for storage in Gold Rush territory and learns the meaning of natural building in Lake Tahoe.

episodes.name: Take Me Over the Rainbow
episodes.summary: Jack makes three more stops on his search for the wildest homes, including a newly-bought home that takes its cues from a musical instrument, an earth-dome compound in the desert, and a home fit for a king.

episodes.name: Horns, Domes and Turrets
episodes.summary: Jack's wild home odyssey starts in St. Louis where a Catholic church has undergone a conversion; next, it's the California desert where a color burst has recently been sold; then he arrives at a slice of history that's been repurposed into a home.

episodes.name: Wild Houses, Assemble!
episodes.summary: Jack's first stop on his wild home journey is a listing in Santa Barbara, California, that's inspired by marine biology; next, he visits a metal-and-glass marvel in Omaha, Nebraska; he finds a comic book-inspired lair in Las Vegas.

episodes.name: Then There Were Eight
episodes.summary: The final leg of Jack's journey begins in Lake Las Vegas where a European estate awaits; next, it's off to Nebraska to explore a recently purchased Googie treasure; he finds a blast from the past on the beaches of Destin, Florida.

episodes.name: Crowning the Wildest
episodes.summary: After touring 24 wonderfully wacky houses, only eight advance in the competition for the wildest of them all; the weirdest homes are narrowed down, until one victor is crowned Zillow Gone Wild Champion.

episodes.name: Stay for A-Wild
episodes.summary: Jack McBrayer hits the road to find unique homes in the U.S. and kicks things off at a home shaped like an actual shoe; he checks out an off-the-grid eco-house and stops by a hitmaker's hideaway.

episodes.name: Where the Trolls Live
episodes.summary: Jack explores more unique and wild homes including a jam-packed mansion with a 25-seat movie theater, a replica mineshaft home situated on over 300 acres and a mountain home featuring a jungle theme and hidden rooms.

episodes.name: The Good, the Bad, the Wild
episodes.summary: Jack is back on the hunt for the wildest homes, starting with a recently purchased homestead that puts the wild in Wild West; he also visits a quirky, whimsical house and a sailor's dream dwelling that are both for sale and ready for new owners.

episodes.name: We Need to Steal a Chair
episodes.summary: Jack tours a French country-inspired mansion filled with ornate details and then a pink dream home bursting with playful decor; a Spanish hacienda purchased on a whim full of colorful tiles and enchanting gardens that took 21 years to complete.

episodes.name: Fit for a King and Queen
episodes.summary: Jack continues his trip across the US and explores a grandiose castle, a reimagined church, and a sprawling ranch; an open house welcomes potential buyers, but only one can be crowned the wildest of the bunch.

episodes.name: Halo Effect
episodes.summary: Jack's search for wild homes continues with more houses for sale: an artist's Technicolor high-rise and a serene angelic retreat; he visits a newly bought round home that has no flat walls or angles.

episodes.name: Secret Stash
episodes.summary: Jack's adventure leads him to more unique homes: a former mobster's compound, a sprawling manor created by a beer mogul and an engineer's techy dream; an open house where one adventurous buyer could snatch up their new property.

episodes.name: Bottle-ottle-ottle
episodes.summary: Off to find more wild homes, Jack climbs up to a treetop oasis made from salvaged materials; then, he tours a property made out of glass bottles and visits a 19th century home that turned three structures into one unexpected residence.

episodes.name: Triple Threat
episodes.summary: Jack's wild search takes him to a triple geodesic dome home created by the owner and a suburban house designed top to bottom with marble; he visits a newly-purchased Arizona ghost town to discover how the owners plan to bring it back to life.

episodes.name: Let's Get It Tron
episodes.summary: Jack finds a Dallas home for sale inspired by sci-fi movies plus another in Taos, New Mexico, known as the Adobe Castle that doubles as an art museum; he also visits an earth home bought by a woman who drove 15 hours to make an offer on it.

episodes.name: Back to the Wild
episodes.summary: Kicking things off at a house with a 727 airplane inside; exploring a pink time capsule-esque penthouse.

episodes.name: The Bold and the Bunker
episodes.summary: Jack McBrayer is back on the hunt to find wild homes!; his journey takes him to resurrected ruins of a desert ghost town, a concrete castle in the mountains, and a home that's mostly black and white.

episodes.name: Ranch Dressing
episodes.summary: Jack McBrayer searches for wild homes and goes chugga-chuggin' down to a cozy train caboose hideaway; next, he dreams in color at a pastel-painted ranch and stops by a desert dream oasis; only one home can reign supreme!

episodes.name: Florida, Man
episodes.summary: Jack McBrayer hunts for wildness in Florida and starts with a maritime-themed property with its own shark!; next, he heads to an estate honoring military flight and sees a storybook-shaped home.

episodes.name: Bonkers Bunker
episodes.summary: Exploring a secret underground residence 26 feet below the surface that features a full house, a front and backyard, and even a pool; time stands still here and proves that wild doesn't always have to be out in the open.

episodes.name: Wildest Dreams
episodes.summary: Jack McBrayer continues his hunt for the wildest homes as he explores an off-grid abode built into a cave in the Ozarks; he visits an Alexander the Great inspired villa in the suburbs and tours an artistic sanctuary nestled among the desert rocks.

episodes.name: Worth the Wild
episodes.summary: Jack McBrayer hits the road to see which home is worth the while; he begins his search at a Bavarian themed lodge, explores a two-tower maze house filled with art and sculptures, then tours a home converted from a 19th-century church.

episodes.name: Guess Who's Coming to Tour
episodes.summary: Jack McBrayer's hunt for wild continues as he takes a peekaboo inside a Brooklyn brownstone for sale and gets an update on a previous season's Wild House; later, he travels to Reunion, Florida, to tour a themed home with special guest David Bromstad.

episodes.name: Bubbly Abode
episodes.summary: Jack continues searching for the wildest homes. He pops inside a bubble-shaped house with seven domes, visits a stone hall from 1876 that has lived many lives, and climbs high into a towering treehouse created to fulfill a father's childhood dream.

episodes.name: Choose Your Adventure
episodes.summary: Things take an unusual turn as Jack steps into the '80s and visits a home featured in a popular supernatural show. A homeowner in Denmark shows off his digs, Jack visits a resort with 20 themed dwellings: a spaceship, a castle and a wizard's lair!

episodes.name: King Pigs and Queen Bees
episodes.summary: Jack tours a home built as a labor of love and an even larger affection for murals. He also visits a maximalist Victorian mansion that takes visitors on a trip across the globe. Later on, he views a dome-shaped home with a special place for bees.

episodes.name: Sleigh All Day
episodes.summary: Jack visits an old flour mill that's been restored into a private residence. He also gets into the holiday spirit by touring a Christmas-themed log cabin and explores a replica of the Palace of Versailles.

episodes.name: Large and In Charge
episodes.summary: Jack explores an aviation-inspired home built on a lot previously leveled by wildfire. After an update about a successful wild home sale, Jack goes south to visit an incredible replica of the White House.

episodes.name: Enchanted Forest
episodes.summary: Jack sets off on a wild wanderlust adventure touring forest hideaways, and first is a family's fairytale cottage. Then, he visits a husband's dream home for his wife and a property that's an ever-evolving, livable artwork.

episodes.name: Rock Out
episodes.summary: Jack's wild adventures continue as he tours a townhome that's a love letter to Asheville, North Carolina. He visits a crisp multi-dome that can withstand a natural disaster, and tours a desert home that's carved into a mountain's natural bedrock.

episodes.name: Trial By Fire
episodes.summary: After a Fourth of July fireworks show gone wrong, a family home was written off, but investor Tommy Harr is betting that, beneath the charred remains, the bones of this house are still salvageable; with his youngest brother, project manager in training Will, taking the reins on his biggest project yet, and his mom, Katie, taking it to the next level with an extra bold design plan, the Harrs are putting it all on the line to bring this fire-damaged, mold-infested teardown back to life.

episodes.name: Smells Like Money
episodes.summary: Tommy Harr takes on a high-risk, high-reward project, picking up a cramped 1970s ranch with a crumbling foundation; the purchase price is low but turning around the dated and dangerous house will take a huge investment and help from the entire family; the margins are tight on this flip, and tensions rise as Tommy and his mom Katie, designer and real estate agent, clash over the budget for high-end finishes, putting project manager in training Will in the middle of Katie's dream design.

episodes.name: A Site to Be Mold
episodes.summary: Tommy Harr's brother Jake finds a wreck of a house on the outskirts of Columbus and brings Tommy in to partner on the deal; but on the first walkthrough, they discover major warning signs; the house is a disjointed mess, with a failed garage conversion, a broken layout, and a well system that might need to be replaced; they'll have to overcome an infestation of dangerous insects, and worst of all, a mind-boggling mess of mold and waste that rots in the basement.

episodes.name: There's Always a Catch
episodes.summary: Tommy Harr discovers a rare opportunity in Columbus's upscale Grandview Heights and calls on his inspector dad and brother to give it a closer look before he makes a move; what looks promising quickly raises red flags: mold, outdated wiring, failing plumbing and a dangerously unstable addition; despite the risks, Tommy gambles on the upside and buys the house; but once demolition begins, even bigger structural failures are uncovered, forcing a full rebuild and blowing the budget.

episodes.name: Scared Money Don't Make Money
episodes.summary: Tommy Harr bets big on a rundown rural property no other flipper would touch and calls in his family to help pull off the impossible; but once demolition begins, the surprises stack up: major structural damage, infestations, and a back addition with no foundation; what starts as a risky flip quickly turns into a full-scale rebuild; in a bold move to boost value, Tommy gambles on adding a 400-square-foot addition; the move puts even more pressure on his mom, Katie, to design and sell the home.

episodes.name: What Horrors Await Us
episodes.summary: When Tommy Harr spots a boarded-up hoarder house in Columbus' sought-after Merion Village, even his own family thinks he's gone too far; with an immense amount of personal property, century-old wiring, a barricaded room, and a basement jammed to the rafters with junk, the risk is real. Despite his father's warning, Tommy buys the house; what follows is a massive clean-out, a total layout overhaul, and a bold design gamble led by Tommy's mom, Katie.

episodes.name: 30 Day Flip
episodes.summary: Tommy Harr takes on a newer home in a great neighborhood that looks like an easy win, until the front door opens. Inside, the house is a disaster, buried in filth and neglect; with just 30 days to pull it off, the Harrs jump into a high-speed renovation; as delays, contractor issues and design curveballs threaten the timeline, pressure builds, especially from Katie, who needs this house market-ready fast; now, with the clock ticking, the family races to clean, transform and sell.

episodes.name: En-suite Dreams
episodes.summary: Tommy Harr thinks he's found an easy flip in Columbus's desirable Clintonville neighborhood. The bank claims the dated foreclosure only needs cosmetic updates, but when Tommy's dad, Chris, and brother Jake inspect the creepy "time capsule," hidden problems emerge - mold, failing mechanicals, and foundation cracks. The place is a steal, and Tommy's mom, Katie, proposes a risky and expensive redesign that will boost the ARV: deleting a main-floor bedroom to create two luxury primary ensuites.

episodes.name: A Bunch of Ick

episodes.name: The Cat House

episodes.summary: A retired Delta employee appears dead, stabbed dozens of times in her picturesque suburban home, stunning the Atlanta area; as detectives search for clues, they discover a note the victim left just before she died that leads them to her killer.

episodes.name: A Mother Murdered
episodes.summary: Twin daughters find their mother stabbed to death in their quaint suburban home, and the pressure for detectives to deliver justice is on; but when the shocking truth behind the murder comes out, the Atlanta community is left stunned and heartbroken.

episodes.name: Murder at the Mall
episodes.summary: After a naval reservist is gunned down in her car outside an Atlanta mall, detectives pour over video footage, phone records and forensic evidence; discover that the DNA sample found at the crime scene creates an unforeseen twist in the case.

episodes.name: Twice as Deadly
episodes.summary: A young mother in the quiet Atlanta hamlet of Buford is found shot to death in what detectives deem to be a staged suicide; as investigators search for leads, they uncover an eerily similar death linked to someone with close ties to both victims.

episodes.name: Dead End
episodes.summary: The police discover a body wrapped in duct tape on church grounds in the posh neighborhood of Buckhead, Atlanta; detectives must untangle a web of romance, jealousy and deceit to uncover who killed a beloved father of two.

episodes.name: Homicide on the Ranch
episodes.summary: When an Atlanta-area horse trainer abruptly vanishes from his ranch, police search for the missing father-to-be; discovering a salacious secret where untamed passions may have led to the victim's untimely demise.

episodes.name: American Nightmare
episodes.summary: An African immigrant is found tortured and murdered in his West End home; Atlanta detectives uncover a string of violent crimes tied to a terrifying criminal syndicate that the team must take down to restore peace to the Big Peach.

episodes.name: Killer in the Community
episodes.summary: An Atlanta civil rights icon is shot dead in his front yard and police must determine if his high-profile stature may have made him a target; as detectives race to find the killer, the pressure is on to bring justice to this fallen hero.

episodes.name: Search for a Monster
episodes.summary: Atlanta's tight-knit Chinatown community is devastated when a beloved mother is discovered brutally murdered in an industrial parking lot; with few leads, the team discovers a cryptic note that leads them to a surprising killer.

episodes.name: House of Horrors
episodes.summary: When a young mother of two disappears just a few weeks before Halloween, detectives scour an upscale Atlanta neighborhood for clues, only to uncover a gruesome crime scene that haunts the community to this day.

episodes.name: Murder Behind the Badge
episodes.summary: When a beloved suburban Atlanta police officer is found shot execution-style in her bed, investigators must probe both her personal life and her role in the community to uncover the identity of her killer.

episodes.name: Fatal Feud
episodes.summary: After a young mother is shot to death in a hail of gunfire at her parents' suburban Atlanta estate, investigators uncover a bitter family feud between two dominant Georgia tycoons that may have ended in murder.

episodes.name: Caught in the Crossfire
episodes.summary: When two friends are found shot to death across the street from the iconic Atlanta nightclub the Blue Flame, investigators discover the murder was part of an elaborate setup carried out by a surprising triggerman and an even more shocking accomplice.

episodes.name: Blood Betrayal
episodes.summary: When a beloved matriarch and businesswoman is found shot to death in her palatial home, investigators uncover a trail of deception and betrayal that leads to a killer whose identity stuns the community and the victim's family alike.

episodes.name: My Deadly Valentine
episodes.summary: A Valentine's Day rendezvous in an Atlanta-area park turns deadly, and investigators race to find the killer of a beloved husband and cub scout leader; when detectives reveal the mastermind behind the brutal slaying, the community is left speechless.

episodes.name: Nightmare at the Racetrack
episodes.summary: A 19-year-old Colombian immigrant vanishes during a packed car show at the Atlanta Motor Speedway; after an exhaustive search with no leads, police receive a cryptic tip that points them to the location of the victim and her surprising assailant.

episodes.name: Terror in the Suburbs
episodes.summary: An 11-year-old boy finds his mother slain in their suburban Atlanta condo; detectives begin a search to find the woman's killer, only to discover that this murder is the work of a serial killer.

episodes.name: In Cold Blood
episodes.summary: A young mother is assassinated by a disguised assailant in front of her toddler in a crowded parking lot; when detectives uncover video footage of the killer, an unlikely witness IDs the shooter as someone surprisingly close to the victim.

episodes.name: Officer Down
episodes.summary: When an officer is gunned down during a routine traffic stop, detectives work to bring justice to their fallen comrade; the team races against the clock to find the killer before he strikes again.

episodes.name: When The Music Stops
episodes.summary: When an aspiring rapper is found dead during a shootout at the Metropolitan Studios in Atlanta, detectives must follow a trail of lies, ultimately discovering a cold-blooded betrayal at the heart of the murder.

episodes.name: The Star Recruit
episodes.summary: When a 17-year-old military recruit and homecoming queen is gunned down outside her home, the community is stunned; but as detectives look closer into those around her, they uncover a complex web of relationships that may lead to her killer.

episodes.name: Makin' It Rain
episodes.summary: At La'Torria's restaurant opening, the women hold nothing back; Alaina's troubled marriage gets dissected when Chloe pushes her to come clean about her pain.

episodes.name: The Good, the Bad and the Fine
episodes.summary: Alaina shows Josh her new studio, and they discuss the next steps to heal their marriage; Muneera reconnects with Norm; Chloe's memorial for Novia is upended by a no-show.

episodes.name: Very Cutesy, Very Demure
episodes.summary: LeBrina treats some of the women to a day at her spa; Muneera confronts La'Torria; Roe seeks therapy; at LeBrina's ranch, Alaina and Josh have an awkward moment when questioned about renewing their vows.

episodes.name: Feels & Heals
episodes.summary: Chloe and Jordan argue over Neiko; the ladies bond and support each other in a healing session with La'Torria's counselor; feathers are ruffled when surprise guest Chiniqua shows up to Chloe's single ladies' night out with receipts.

episodes.name: No New Friends
episodes.summary: The ladies reel in the aftermath of the incident at MOCA; Roe's patience is tested when she agrees to meet with Chiniqua to hear her out; Chloe attempts to mend things with Neiko.

episodes.name: Back in the Saddle
episodes.summary: Roe's life takes a turn when she learns she might be pregnant; La'Torria addresses her grief and starts her search for love; Muneera opens up to Alaina about her painful childhood.

episodes.name: The End of an Era
episodes.summary: Alaina confronts Josh about couples' therapy; LeBrina and Will have a breakthrough with Pop; Chloe tries to help Neiko with his music career; La'Torria has a special announcement at her Sweet 16 PR party.

episodes.name: The Secret's Out
episodes.summary: In a raw therapy session, Alaina reveals the secret betrayal that's haunted her and Josh's marriage; LeBrina hosts a girls' trip that takes the ladies down memory lane; Muneera and Alaina clash.

episodes.name: Friends & Frenemies
episodes.summary: The ladies are back, but with the group fractured, La'Torria wonders if they will all show up for her event; Chloe uncovers a shocking revelation about her relationship, while Alaina's estranged husband shares his version of their broken marriage.

episodes.name: Lines in the Sand
episodes.summary: Alaina's estranged husband makes salacious allegations about their marriage; meanwhile, tensions are high when the women get together for the first time in months, and LeBrina confronts Chloe; Jordan tries his best to win back Chloe's trust.

episodes.name: You're Not on My Level
episodes.summary: As the ladies navigate their own personal challenges, the divide between the friend group grows too large to ignore; when LeBrina disengages and La'Torria gives up, Roe organizes a group therapy session to repair their friendships.

episodes.name: Mending Fences
episodes.summary: After an explosive group therapy session, LeBrina attempts to repair her broken friendships. Alaina and Chloe each navigate their current relationship struggles. Roe struggles emotionally with the challenges of co-parenting.

episodes.name: In a Pickle
episodes.summary: Newcomer Ashley threatens to bring drama to the group when her shady stunt at pickleball turns La'Torria sour. Roe is at a crossroads in her co-parenting journey and is forced to make a decision. Chloe's daughters disapprove of her love life.

episodes.name: My Weak Bitch Era
episodes.summary: Roe hosts a sexy dinner party for the ladies. Muneera opens old wounds as she reconnects with her father. La'Torria helps Jordan go ring shopping for Chloe, and Roe finally reaches out to Sophia's father to discuss their co-parenting issues.

episodes.name: The Bone Collector
episodes.summary: The group suspects Chloe is behind the chaos among the friends, and Chloe's upset about being considered a bone collector. Muneera's family dinner implodes when a key guest refuses to join. Roe's ex comes to town to work on co-parenting Sophia.

episodes.name: Four Sides to a Story
episodes.summary: The ladies gather to address their ongoing drama, but tensions boil over when LeBrina and Chloe clash. Meanwhile, Roe has an emotional therapy session with her ex, and Alaina receives shocking news that leaves her reeling.

episodes.name: Two Sides to Every Story
episodes.summary: Alaina confronts LeBrina over spreading her ex-husband's rumors, and Chloe faces Roe and La'Torria in a make-or-break friendervention. Meanwhile, Muneera and Norm escape for an overnight getaway in hopes of reigniting the spark in their marriage.

episodes.name: Adventures of a Normal Man
episodes.summary: Clark Kent and his best friend Jimmy Olsen start their internship at The Daily Planet; they meet an intern who pushes them to investigate stolen military robots.

episodes.name: My Interview with Superman
episodes.summary: Lois wants to interview Superman and Clark must figure out how to help her while protecting his secret identity; criminal ring INTERGANG gets their hands on unstable weapons, and a mysterious organization plots in the shadows.

episodes.name: Let's Go to Ivo Tower, You Say
episodes.summary: Clark, Lois, and Jimmy cover a glitzy gala hosted by tech-billionaire Dr. Ivo, but while Clark and Lois wonder if this counts as a date, Ivo unleashes his newest invention: a creation that can bring down Superman.

episodes.name: You Will Believe a Man Can Lie
episodes.summary: Lois uncovers a secret in Metropolis and is determined to get to the truth; Superman tracks down dangerous weapons in the city and finds himself in the crosshairs of mysterious organization Task Force X.

episodes.name: My Adventures With Mad Science
episodes.summary: When Jimmy gets kidnapped, it's up to Lois and Clark to save him, but rescuing Jimmy will lead them into danger as they deal with mad scientists, military secrets and relationship woes!

episodes.name: Kiss Kiss Fall in Portal
episodes.summary: Clark tries to plan a normal date without any Superman problems, but gets interrupted when Mr. Mxyzptlk sweeps him, Jimmy, and Lois into a high-stakes, multiverse-hopping chase.

episodes.name: Zero Day
episodes.summary: Lois meets her journalism idol, Vicki Vale, only for Vicki to make Lois question her loyalty to Superman; Superman hunts down Task Force X while dealing with a new power.

episodes.name: Zero Day
episodes.summary: Superman finally gets answers to who he is and where he came from while coming face-to-face with The General, leader of Task Force X; Lois and Jimmy must find Superman before Dr. Ivo destroys Metropolis.

episodes.name: Hearts of the Fathers
episodes.summary: Clark, Lois and Jimmy head to the Kent farm to celebrate Thanksgiving, but the holiday turns into a fight for survival as Task Force X, family and Kryptonite collide.

episodes.name: More Things in Heaven and Earth
episodes.summary: Clark agonizes over what to do for his and Lois' first Valentine's Day; Visions of his father lead him, Jimmy, and Lois to the remains of his spaceship and the new villains of Task Force X.

episodes.name: Adventures With My Girlfriend
episodes.summary: Perry saddles Jimmy with a new team to run Flamebird; Clark and Lois investigate Stryker Penitentiary and discover how far Amanda Waller will go to rid the world of Superman.

episodes.name: Fullmetal Scientist
episodes.summary: Clark's life falls apart as The General goes into hiding in his apartment; Jimmy struggles with being a leader, and Lois goes toe-to-toe with Vicki Vale as they track down missing scientists.

episodes.name: Two Lanes Diverged
episodes.summary: Jimmy gets invited to the S.T.A.R. Labs Symposium; Clark joins him for support, but Lex Luthor takes over; the General flees and Lois chases after him, struggling to reconcile experiences with the present situation.

episodes.name: Most Eligible Superman
episodes.summary: Lois and Clark's relationship comes to the breaking point when Superman receives the title of Metropolis' most eligible bachelor; Jimmy gives a girl a tour of the city; a girl is on a mission to find her long-lost cousin.

episodes.name: The Machine Who Would Be Empire
episodes.summary: Kidnapped and far from home, Superman bonds with his cousin Kara; he discovers the truth about Krypton from the last Kryptonians in existence.

episodes.name: Olsen's Eleven
episodes.summary: Lois and Jimmy recruit mercenaries and mad scientists to help them steal a spaceship out from under the nose of Task Force X.

episodes.name: The Death of Clark Kent
episodes.summary: Lois and Jimmy confront Kara and make a plan to rescue Clark; Brainiac delves into Superman's mind to figure out what makes him tick and how to tear him apart.

episodes.name: Pierce the Heavens, Superman!
episodes.summary: Jimmy and Kara race back to Metropolis to stop Brainiac's invasion of Earth; Lois tries to free Clark from Brainiac's control, only to lose herself in an alternate reality where Superman never left Krypton.

episodes.name: My Adventures with Supergirl
episodes.summary: Superman, Kara, Lois and Jimmy team up to fight Brainiac; Superman has to choose between saving Earth and saving the people he loves; it's truth, justice and a better way clashing with the might of Krypton.

episodes.name: Into the New World
episodes.summary: Lois and her dad ruin Halloween; Kara likes Jimmy; Superman makes a friend; the gang has an adventure.

episodes.name: Mobile Suit Toyman
episodes.summary: Big things happen at the Super Convention; Kara takes a friend's advice; Clark gets Whipped; Lois Chases a story; Jimmy makes a mistake.

episodes.name: All's Fair in Love and W.O.R.M.S.
episodes.summary: Jimmy is changed by a big date; Kara gets on the apps; Lois sings the blues; Superman destroys Clark's Saturday.

episodes.name: Guess Who's Slammin' to Dinner?
episodes.summary: Clark and Lois get pound cake; A stranger comes to brunch; Jimmy gets to be right; Hank shakes things up at Lexcorp.

episodes.name: The Death of Superman
episodes.summary: Superman tries to save the city; our heroes try to save Superman.

episodes.name: Party Animals
episodes.summary: The gang goes to a charity gala; Lois tries to win; Clark tries to help; Jimmy's date makes a scene; Kara cleans it up.

episodes.name: The Ex Games
episodes.summary: Lois, Jimmy, Kara and Clark play games with Lois, Jimmy, Kara and Lex; everyone hates it; a divorce ends in deception.

episodes.name: Patricia Sexton and Michael Fielding

episodes.name: Brenda Dixon and Elbert Holder

episodes.name: Crystal Brinson and Byron Boutin

episodes.name: Patricia Aldridge and Mitchell Vickers

episodes.name: Monica Diaz and Michael Naranjo

episodes.name: Maya Maxwell and Cedric Marks
episodes.summary: After two best friends are reported missing, Texas and Minnesota police team up to bring a suspected serial killer to justice; an accomplice shares her side of the story from behind bars, revealing chilling details of the crime.

episodes.name: Cynthia and Richie Wilder
episodes.summary: A North Dakota community is rocked after a beloved mother is found stabbed to death in her home.As police look to those closest to her for answers, an informant comes forward and exposes a dangerous couple's vengeful plot.

episodes.name: Alison Martin and Justin Terpstra
episodes.summary: When authorities respond to a car fire in rural Michigan, they find a charred body discarded nearby; as the investigation unfolds, the victim's phone records point to a vicious plot stemming from a dangerous infatuation.

episodes.name: Laura Martin and Robert Quinn
episodes.summary: Just months before his retirement, a missing trucker's body is found in a remote creek; as detectives run out of leads, a seemingly minute detail breathes new life into the investigation revealing two lovers with a nefarious plot.

episodes.name: Angelita Reyes and Jesus Jeronimo

episodes.name: Adrienne Simpson and Tyler Terry

episodes.name: Holly Elkins and Andrew Beard
episodes.summary: After a young mother is murdered in broad daylight, Texas authorities are on a hunt for a masked gunman; the ensuing investigation uncovers a bitter custody battle and a vicious plot born of obsession.

episodes.name: Brinlee Denison and Nicholas Johnson
episodes.summary: A welfare check confirms the worst when a woman is found brutally murdered on her couch; the ensuing investigation leads authorities from Oklahoma to Arkansas where conflicting stories of a crime motivated by greed and jealousy are uncovered.

episodes.name: Raquel Garajau and Joseph Villani
episodes.summary: When a missing man's bullet-riddled body is found off the side of a road, police must dig into his complicated past to uncover the truth; the case hits a standstill until information about the victim's car comes to light and reveals a toxic romance.

episodes.name: Ashley Coleman and Hakeem Griffin-White
episodes.summary: When a shocking crime is committed in broad daylight that leaves a young man dead on the street, the investigation uncovers a personal vendetta; in exclusive prison interviews, the killer couple each share their version of events.

episodes.name: Amanda Lothery and Rajhi T.C. Render

episodes.name: Anna Schroeder and Rachel Helm
episodes.summary: A house fire in a small town in Illinois ignites a homicide investigation after a mother's body is found in her bedroom; as police search for answers, a teenager's secret exposes a connection and a couple motivated by desperation.

episodes.name: Michelle Hetzel and Brandon Bloss
episodes.summary: After a teen girl is found dead in the backseat of her own car, detectives focus on the complicated relationships between the victim and the two girls who discovered her body; a third suspect emerges due to a suspicious injury.

episodes.name: Devonnee and Malik Wilkerson
episodes.summary: A woman's lifeless body is rushed to a hospital in New York after two strangers find her unconscious at a subway station; as detectives dig into the victim's past, they uncover a complicated polyamorous romance proving that not all is what it seems.

episodes.name: Melissa Schafer and William Baer

episodes.name: Christina Araujo and Zach Abell
episodes.summary: After a woman's beaten body is found on the side of a road, a grisly scene is uncovered at a nearby motel; as police begin to put the pieces together, a man comes forward with details of the crime, leading to a toxic throuple that ended in bloodshed.

episodes.name: Casandra Nazario and Miles Johnson
episodes.summary: When a nurse's aide disappears without a trace, detectives learn she is entangled in a complex love triangle; after a tragic discovery in the woods, the investigation points to a sordid affair and a jealous lover looking for revenge.

episodes.name: Linda Buckner and Walter Renz
episodes.summary: When authorities learn an Ohio woman has been missing for nearly half a year, all signs point to foul play; after tracking the victim's bank cards across the country, detectives zero in on a couple trying to outrun their vicious secret.

episodes.name: Elsa Segura and Lyndon Wiggins
episodes.summary: When a Minneapolis realtor is murdered after an attempt on her boyfriend's life, authorities believe the heinous crimes are connected; a voicemail on the victim's phone reveals an intricate plot fuelled by vengeance.

episodes.name: Raminder Kaur and Baldeo Taneja
episodes.summary: When a beloved woman is gunned down in the street near her home, details of a bitter divorce encompass the investigation; a convicted killer shares his version of events from prison, leading to a confession.

episodes.name: Sabrina Zunich
episodes.summary: Sabrina Zunich tells the story behind her foster mother's murder, describes the secrets that led to it, details why she snapped, and discusses how she feels about it now.

episodes.name: Misook Wang
episodes.summary: Convicted killer Misook Wang sits down to detail her mother-in-law's murder; Wang's ex-lover comes forward to discuss his daughter's death, and why he thinks Wang was involved.

episodes.name: Teresa Kotomski
episodes.summary: Serving a life sentence for a murder she claims she didn't commit, Teresa Kotomski talks on camera for the first time, sharing the intimate secrets of her rocky marriage and detailing what she now alleges caused her husband's painful poisoning death.

episodes.name: Traci Wolfe
episodes.summary: In a jailhouse interview, Traci Wolfe reveals the catalyst that sparked an uncontrollable rage and ended in her husband's gruesome death; holding nothing back, she now reflects on the crime that landed her in prison for life.

episodes.name: Taylor Marks
episodes.summary: Serving a life sentence for the brutal stabbing of her own mother, Taylor Marks discusses the murder on camera for the first time ever; she claims she wasn't the mastermind behind the crime, but she knows who is.

episodes.name: Jamie Grachek
episodes.summary: Haunted by the events leading up to her conviction, Jamie Grachek is ready to tell her story for the first time after eight years behind bars and explains her version of what happened the night a violent home invasion left her ex-husband dead.

episodes.name: Celeste Beard Johnson
episodes.summary: Featured in the first-ever episode of "Snapped," Celeste Beard Johnson returns 18 years later to reveal new details surrounding the murder of her millionaire husband and speaks out against those who support her conviction - including her daughters.

episodes.name: Pandora Zan
episodes.summary: A remorseful Pandora returns; her son Cody Henderson speaks out, revealing why he took part in a crime that landed him in prison for life and how he feels about the mother who turned on him.

episodes.name: Crystal Mangum
episodes.summary: In a new jailhouse interview, Crystal Mangum shares her side of the story, revealing what she alleges caused her then-boyfriend's death and the effect it has had on her to this day.

episodes.name: Tausha Morton
episodes.summary: Tausha Morton sits down to clarify what led to her ex-husband's death; she speaks out against the triggerman, alleging that there was never a murder conspiracy; she discusses how she feels being behind bars for life.

episodes.name: Lucille Duncan
episodes.summary: After spending 20 years in prison for a crime in which she claims no involvement, Lucille Duncan breaks her silence for the first time; she details the harrowing events that led to the shooting of her ex-boyfriend and her hopes of freedom.

episodes.name: Tabitha Messina
episodes.summary: Serving a life sentence for the murders of her father and his girlfriend, Tabitha Messina explains what happened on camera; she claims she wasn't the mastermind and shifts blame onto her convicted co-conspirator.

episodes.name: Cristina Rodriguez
episodes.summary: Cristina Rodriguez shares her experience watching her then-lover beat her boyfriend to death, and how it felt when he testified against her; a second convicted killer reveals his side of the story with new details.

episodes.name: Afton Ferris and Michael Schallert
episodes.summary: Serving life sentences for the double homicide of their former roommates, Afton Ferris and Michael Schallert give exclusive interviews about the night that changed their lives forever; each tells their side of the story with new allegations.

episodes.name: Gloria Aiken
episodes.summary: Breaking her silence for the first time, Gloria Aiken sits down for an interview to plead her case in the 2008 murder of her longtime partner; she reflects on the events that led to her arrest and hopes to clear her name.

episodes.name: Coty Martinez
episodes.summary: Eighteen years into her prison sentence, Coty Martinez opens up about the multistate killing spree that landed her behind bars; claiming to have been a victim herself, she attempts to explain how she ended up on a dark path.

episodes.name: Angelina O'Mara
episodes.summary: In her first televised interview, Angelina O'Mara attempts to explain the back-to-back 2011 murders of her ex-husband and boyfriend; she describes her state of mind at the time and discusses whether she deserves redemption from those she hurt most.

episodes.name: Cameo Clines
episodes.summary: Speaking on camera for the first time, Cameo Clines revisits the deadly Texas crime spree born from a toxic romance; from behind bars, he offers a rare look into the events that led to two murders and shares his hopes for redemption.

episodes.name: Rebecca Keller
episodes.summary: Serving a 60-year prison sentence, Rebecca Keller reveals new details about the night she stabbed her then-girlfriend's mother more than 70 times; she opens up about her regrets and why she thinks the crime has taken place.

episodes.name: Danielle Hudson and Chaz Blackshear
episodes.summary: Convicted of killing two taxi drivers, Chaz Blackshear returns nine years later to share new details in what led to a brutal double murder; his accomplice and then-girlfriend, Danielle Hudson, reveals her role in the crimes for the first time.

episodes.name: Purdie Clark
episodes.summary: Seventeen years into her prison sentence for the poisoning of her ex-husband, Purdie Clark speaks out for the first time; when faced with questions about other lovers who died under suspicious circumstances, the interview takes a dramatic turn.

episodes.name: Teeth in the Bone
episodes.summary: Meachum and Oliveras butt heads as the hunt for a DHS officer's killer leads Blythe's newly-assembled task force all over LA and ends with a startling revelation.

episodes.name: Dead Lots of Times
episodes.summary: Blythe's team heads to Mexico to pull off a daring mission for a deadly cartel in exchange for information on the shipment at the port.

episodes.name: Happy Birthday Final
episodes.summary: The team stages a high stakes prison break in an attempt to gain knowledge on the identity and whereabouts of the mysterious Volchek.

episodes.name: Bite 'Em Down
episodes.summary: Still reeling from their loss, the team tracks down Timur Novikov's uncle, Mikhail, and hatches a plan to lure Volchek out into the open.

episodes.name: Blurred Edges
episodes.summary: The team pays a visit to the Belarusian consulate in search of files that could finally reveal who Volchek is and how far he's willing to go.

episodes.name: A Needle or a Bullet
episodes.summary: The task force searches for a man named Gallagher, a suspected friend of Timur Novikov; his name was on Volchek's command room wall; the search turns into a chase that surprises everyone.

episodes.name: Nothing Else Helps
episodes.summary: As the Gallagher investigation ends with more questions than answers, Blythe's team returns to the drawing board; Finau visits the LAPD impound lot to examine the border patrol SUV Volchek escaped in; Bell and Shepherd visit the manufacturer.

episodes.name: The Nail in the Chair
episodes.summary: Following the deaths of the Belarusian consulate agents, Meachum arrives to examine the carnage and realizes that Volchek is behind the explosion.

With their leader fighting for his life and Meachum's medical condition worsening by the minute, the team finally comes face to face with the true nature of their enemy's plans as time is running out to stop him.

episodes.name: The Muzzle Pile
episodes.summary: Meachum and the task force confront Volchek and neutralize his plot; with the city of Los Angeles finally safe and the mission complete, the team disbands, but not before Oliveras convinces Meachum to enter an experimental medical trial.

episodes.name: Run
episodes.summary: Shepherd works to decipher the manifesto recovered at Cabin 6 while the rest of the team pursues a suspect on the run.

episodes.name: This is His Signature
episodes.summary: A second murder and a revelation kicks the task force's investigation into overdrive; Agent Bell follows a suspicious lead which uncovers a bread crumb that the shooter has left for them to follow.

episodes.name: Your People are in Danger
episodes.summary: When Shepherd discovers a connection between Todd's manifesto and a local radio show, Meachum and Oliveras pay a visit to the show's host; sparks fly between the two agents, causing Oliveras to question the strength of her relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The holly jolly journey continues, and Santa may have some tricks up his sleeve.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Santa's showdown is a seasonal shocker, and it leads to drama.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The final six continue their quest; one of them won't survive the dreaded candy cane rodeo.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Five remain, but only four are invited to the tournament.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Santa's elves guide the players through challenging and unpredictable competitions, each vying for the $100,000 grand prize.

episodes.name: Welcome One, Welcome Atlanta
episodes.summary: NBA wife DeShawn and her family see their custom built mansion for the first time; recently-divorced Shereé plans a birthday party at her estate to celebrate her new life.

episodes.name: It's My Party!
episodes.summary: NeNe, still angry about the birthday party, has lunch with her friend and hairdresser, Dwight; Kim is throwing her daughter, Brielle, a birthday party.

episodes.name: Who's Your Poppa?
episodes.summary: The ladies take a trip to the countryside to meet with Kim's psychic advisor; Kim pursues her dream of becoming a country singer.

episodes.name: Bring on the Bling
episodes.summary: DeShawn invites hundreds of guests into her home for "Night of a Thousand Stars" event; Kim and Sheree bond during a private spa day.

episodes.name: Out of Tune
episodes.summary: Sheree and Lisa attend a pole-dancing class; Lisa, DeShawn, NeNe and their husbands spend an evening together at a vineyard; NeNe starts a foundation for battered women.

episodes.name: Dream a Little Nightmare
episodes.summary: Sheree and Kim make the best of a boating trip on Atlanta's Lake Lanier; NeNe pursues DNA testing in order to answer questions.

episodes.name: Best of Enemies
episodes.summary: Sheree is humbled by her less-than-stellar fashion viewing; DeShawn's husband is at home with an injury; the five ladies and their families get together for dinner.

episodes.name: Reunion: Watch What Happens
episodes.summary: "The Real Housewives of Atlanta" cast members come together once more in a special reunion edition of the show.

episodes.name: The Lost Footage
episodes.summary: Never-before-seen moments from the show's first season.

episodes.name: New Attitude, Same ATL
episodes.summary: Sheree plans to celebrate her recent divorce by throwing an "Independence Day" party; Lisa and her husband consider having another baby; Kim wants to design a line of wigs.

episodes.name: Kim-tervention
episodes.summary: NeNe hopes to make amends with Kim; Lisa and Ed have their first fertility visit; Kandi works on her solo album.

episodes.name: Unbeweavable
episodes.summary: A reconciliation between Sheree, NeNe and Kim does not go as planned; Kim throws a wig party; Dwight holds a circus-themed birthday party.

episodes.name: Mummies, Mommies and Baby Mommas
episodes.summary: NeNe and Dwight visit the salon; Kandi discusses her image with her photographer and business team; Kim learns her children were left home alone without adult supervision.

episodes.name: Home Is Where the Heartbreak Is
episodes.summary: NeNe meets with photographer Derek Blanks; Lisa invites NeNe to a family celebration for her grandmother's 92nd birthday; Kim visits Kandi in the recording studio.

episodes.name: My Ego Is Bigger Than Your Ego
episodes.summary: Kim lays down the house rules with the new nanny; a tragic accident halts Kandi's plans for an engagement party; NeNe directs the ladies in a photo shoot.

episodes.name: Throwing Shade
episodes.summary: Lisa debuts her clothing line, while Sheree's fashion line is put on hold; NeNe gets tough on her college dropout son; Kandi calls in a favor; Kim throws a wig party.

episodes.name: Scrambled Egos
