episodes.name: Perilous Play
episodes.summary: Remember when childhood came with a side of danger? Think back to the toys and daredevil playground antics that once defined growing up; uncovering explosive science kits, high-flying kite tubes and more.

episodes.name: Spectacular Stunts
episodes.summary: A wild journey into the world of vintage daredevils who risked it all for a rush; from the enigmatic Human Fly to skateboard speed demons and diving horses, these stunts are as reckless as they are unforgettable.

episodes.name: Mad Medicine
episodes.summary: There was a time when any and all cures could be sold to the public indiscriminately; diving into a world where animal skin can replace your own, where doctors give coffee enemas and a world of heroin-laced cough syrup.

episodes.name: Very Extreme Sports
episodes.summary: The modern concept of extreme sports is a product of marketing, but back in the old days, the lack of rules made them truly extreme; from bone-crushing football and deadly baseball games to wild events like auto polo.

episodes.name: Treacherous Travel
episodes.summary: Exploding cars and blimp disasters to kids sent through the mail and doomed personal helicopters; the past is packed with travel tales and the misfires that paved the road to modern transportation.

episodes.name: Food Fiascos
episodes.summary: Snack on a feast of food horrors from the past; from radioactive energy drinks, to scandalous snacks made with Olestra, to the additives in your milk and bread, uncovering the things people once ate without a second thought.

episodes.name: Precarious Products
episodes.summary: The everyday products that are way more dangerous than meets the unsuspecting eye; what were the most ill-advised and risky household products?

episodes.name: Occupational Hazards
episodes.summary: Uncovering the downright dangerous gigs of the past, from mercury-poisoned hatmakers to kids crawling through chimneys and projectionists fleeing fiery blazes.

episodes.name: Killer Crazes
episodes.summary: Remember when "everybody's doing it" was the reason enough to dive in headfirst?; from gravity-defying flagpole sitting and phone booth cramming, to pet skunks and goldfish gulpers, revealing the crazes that are sweeping the nation; these obsessions are risky and impossible to resist; it is a trip back to the fads that push the limits and make hazardous history must-see mayhem.

episodes.name: Looks That Kill
episodes.summary: Remember when looking your best meant risking life and limb?; from dentures that could explode at the dinner table and stiff shirt collars that strangled people to death, to toxic hair implants and tanning pills that left them glowing orange.

episodes.name: Twisted Toys
episodes.summary: Remember when playtime meant tempting fate?; from toy belts that fire speeding projectiles, to high-powered pogo sticks that send people soaring, to dolls that try to eat people alive, these playthings are made for kids, but their risks are anything but child's play; it's a mind-blowing, bone-rattling trip through the toys of yesteryear that remind people of a time when childhood was wild, free, and hazardous.

episodes.name: Hell On Wheels
episodes.summary: Remember when hitting the road meant flirting with disaster?; from rumble seats that turn passengers into projectiles, to scorching cigarette lighters built right into the dash, to cars that have a habit of going up in flames, even a simple trip can go south; these are the bright ideas and questionable designs that turn people daily commute into a demolition derby; it's a high-speed, white-knuckle ride back to a time when the rules of the road were still being written.

episodes.name: Domestic Dangers
episodes.summary: Remember when having a modern home meant living on the edge of danger?; from backyard trash fires and waterbeds that turn bedrooms into flood zones, to electric fans that snatch fingers and garden hoses that serve up toxic sips of water, domestic life is full of hidden peril; these are the familiar fixes and convenient comforts that turn out to be far from safe; it's a hair-raising, eye-opening trip back to the homegrown hazards that can make you wonder what are we thinking?

episodes.name: Thrills & Spills
episodes.summary: Remember when people would do just about anything for an adrenaline fix? From racing cars at the "Murderdrome," to high diving on horseback, to cutting our teeth on looping water slides, revisit the ways people once chased a thrill. These death-defying stunts and gravity-pushing spectacles didn't always stick the landing, but that didn't stop anyone from trying. It's a heart-pumping jolt back to a time when a big rush was worth a little spill.

episodes.name: Hobbies Gone Haywire
episodes.summary: Remember when hobbies were more than just a way to pass the time - they were a chance to push the limits? From making model planes with glue that gets you high, to cooking up explosive rocket fuel in the backyard, to strapping ourselves to homemade kites and launching into the unknown, these hands-on pursuits often came with a dangerous edge. It's a thrilling, hair-raising trip back to the crafty obsessions that prove our hazardous history was never just a hobby.

episodes.name: Fatal Attractions
episodes.summary: Remember when popular tourist attractions came with real danger? From climbing onto the backs of live alligators, to hand-feeding hungry bears, to scoring front-row seats to atomic blasts, these heart-pounding experiences promised irresistible thrills you'd never forget - where the risk was part of the draw. It's a jaw-dropping, pulse-racing trip back to the places that prove our hazardous history wasn't just entertaining - it was a death-defying must-see!

episodes.name: Crowd Chaos
episodes.summary: Remember when being part of the crowd meant taking your chances? From packing in shoulder to shoulder for front row views of Civil War battles, to lining up to watch dead whales explode, to full-blown riots while shopping, the biggest shared moments didn't just bring people together - they stirred things up. It's a wild, edge-of-your-seat trip back to the gatherings that prove our hazardous history was anything but orderly - but always had an eager audience!

episodes.name: Anything for a Buck
episodes.summary: When earning a paycheck meant risking life and limb. From dangling off skyscrapers without safety harnesses and riding runaway logs down raging rivers, to digging up corpses for cash and selling your own blood to scrape by, people once took unbelievable risks no paycheck could truly cover. Whether racing pizzas across town at breakneck speed or pulling off death-defying Hollywood stunts, people once did whatever it took to earn a living.

episodes.name: Young & the Reckless
episodes.summary: When being young meant testing the limits of what our bodies could survive. From launching our bikes off homemade ramps and playing chicken in traffic, to using dangerous construction sites as our playground, childhood adventure was often intertwined with how far you were willing to go--and the consequences that came with it. Armed with cherry bombs, slingshots, and more confidence than caution, we pushed boundaries in ways that would make parents today shudder.

episodes.name: Insane Inventions
episodes.summary: From personal jetpacks that promised to send us sky-high, to electrified exercise machines that shocked us into shape, to firefighting hand grenades hurled straight into the flames, yesterday's boldest inventions were packed with promise - and risks nobody saw coming. These are the ambitious ideas, futuristic gadgets, and engineering marvels that aimed to revolutionize everyday life, but sometimes overshot the mark.

episodes.name: Animal Anarchy
episodes.summary: From racing atop ostriches and wrestling wild bears, to raising pet skunks at home and ordering monkeys through the mail, we once welcomed the wild into our lives in some truly staggering ways. These are the unforgettable attractions, unusual pets, and head-scratching animal encounters that blurred the line between affection and recklessness. It's a rowdy, unpredictable trip back to the critter-filled close calls that prove our hazardous history was anything but tame.

episodes.name: Dangerous Dining
episodes.summary: From chocolate eaten out of the gutter, to a single cup of ice cream shared by the entire neighborhood, to breakfast cereal that produced colorful consequences, yesterday's culinary delights weren't always as wholesome as they seemed. These are the curious food trends, questionable treats, and kitchen experiments that once captured America's appetite all without raising an eyebrow.

in_the_eye_of_the_storm.title: In the Eye of the Storm

episodes.name: Trapped in a Twister
episodes.summary: Hundreds of cameras capture a rare tornado outbreak in 2023 as it strikes Rolling Fork, Miss., and Little Rock, Ark.; when a twister hits Lewistown, Ill., a group of tornado spotters find themselves trapped in the eye of the storm.

episodes.name: Derecho Superstorm
episodes.summary: Hundreds of eyewitnesses film their attempts to escape when a derecho superstorm blasts through Nebraska and Iowa in 2020; then it happens again, only this time, the hurricane-force winds come wrapped in a dust storm.

episodes.name: Hellfire in Hawaii
episodes.summary: Maui faces the worst natural disaster in 2023, as hurricane-force winds fuel wildfires that catch residents off guard; as eyewitnesses attempt to flee the flames, they film their attempts to escape from the eye of the storm.

episodes.name: Half-Country Hurricane
episodes.summary: Showcasing how Hurricane Ida hit the Louisiana coast in 2021 and features films from eyewitnesses as tornadoes and flooding hit all the way to New York City.

episodes.name: Snowmageddon
episodes.summary: When a rare bomb cyclone rocks Buffalo in December 2022, hundreds of eyewitnesses film unprecedented blizzard conditions; but as unrelenting snowfall traps thousands, one woman must brave arctic conditions to save a man freezing to death.

episodes.name: Texas Tornado
episodes.summary: When a tornado outbreak strikes Texas and Kansas in 2022, hundreds of eyewitnesses find themselves trapped in the path; as they seek the best shelter they can find, they capture the moments when tornadoes destroy the very structures around them.

episodes.name: Texas Derecho Disaster
episodes.summary: In 2024, as a monster storm system unleashes a record-breaking derecho across Texas, eyewitnesses capture multiple destructive tornadoes on camera; when one twister targets a remote farmhouse, a weather spotter must race to save a young family.

episodes.name: Double Hurricane Disaster

episodes.name: Helene's Appalachian Hellscape

episodes.name: Nebraska Super Outbreak

episodes.name: Terrifying Twin Twisters

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.summary: After hitting Category 5, Hurricane Ian slams Florida's Gulf Coast with 150 mph winds and a storm surge that sweeps away homes. Cameras capture residents who unwisely stay behind as they combat one of the strongest storms to make landfall in U.S.

episodes.name: March Madness
episodes.summary: Firsthand accounts and compelling eyewitness footage of dangerously close calls from inside epic natural disasters, with megastorms captured by onlookers who find themselves in the wrong place at the right time.

episodes.name: Tornado Torrent 2025
episodes.summary: In March 2025, thousands of eyewitnesses capture disaster at their doorsteps as extreme atmospheric volatility unleashes a massive Texas haboob and more than 150 tornadoes across the southern states, devastating towns and homesteads in their path.

episodes.name: Category 5: Fight to Survive
episodes.summary: After hitting Category five, Hurricane Ian slams Florida's Gulf Coast with 150 mph winds and a storm surge that sweeps away homes.

episodes.name: The Mayfield Beast
episodes.summary: Cameras capture the unfolding disaster as a powerful EF-4 tornado devastates Mayfield, leveling the courthouse, police headquarters and jail where officers race to rescue trapped inmates while preventing escape.

episodes.name: Escaping the LA Fires

episodes.name: Nightmare in May
episodes.summary: In mid-May 2025, hundreds of eyewitnesses capture the power of severe weather as supercell thunderstorms unleash dozens of powerful tornadoes, tossing vehicles across highways and destroying neighborhoods and workplaces in eleven states.

episodes.name: That Car's Flying!

episodes.name: Monster in Michigan

episodes.name: The Dakota EF5
episodes.summary: Eyewitnesses capture severe weather across the Dakotas as tornadoes tear through neighborhoods and farm structures. Near Enderlin, ND, a violent twister with estimated winds exceeding 200 mph becomes the first U.S. tornado rated EF5 in more than 12 years.

He battles newcomer Tate Wilder, who brings his extreme attitude and style to LFG; the charismatic Trill London takes on Ivy League recruit Braxton Cole, but can Trill control the urge to take risks and stay off the injured list? A tag team match rounds out the competition.

episodes.summary: After a long injury hiatus, Elijah Holyfield is back!; first, Elijah tests his confidence and promo ability in front of the live crowd, then competes in his first match in over six months; Natalya challenges Kali Armstrong and Sirena Linton to bring some more aggression to their matchup; "NXT" veteran Andre Chase pays a visit to "LFG" to work with Ivy League upstart Braxton Cole as he takes on the high-flying Trill London.

episodes.name: Perception is Reality
episodes.summary: LFG newcomer Elio LeFleur battles Mike Derudder in an electrifying main event match that sends the crowd into a frenzy—and catches the eye of Shawn Michaels. Elsewhere, Elijah Holyfield looks to keep his momentum going in a match against an NXT veteran. And can the diminutive Carlee Bright handle the punishment when she goes one-on-one with the intimidating Bayley Humphrey?

episodes.name: Crews Control
episodes.summary: It's the biggest main event in LFG history, as Elijah Holyfield takes on his mentor, WWE veteran Apollo Crews, in a hard-hitting, fast-paced matchup; in a match that proves you must always expect the unexpected, Harlem Lewis battles Tate Wilder, and things take a startling turn in the ring; LFG fan-favorite PJ Vasa takes on the highly-motivated Masyn Holiday, who is looking to prove she can hang with the best; and - Shawn Michaels pays Keanu Carver a visit - to deliver some very surprising news!

episodes.name: A Brand New Zena
episodes.summary: After receiving deflating feedback last match, Chris Island puts in extra effort and looks to turn his fortunes around when he faces off against the newest member of LFG, the sensation from Madrid, Jaime Garcia; Kevin Owens helps Nathan Cranton and Mike Derudder on their character development; in the main event, Zena Sterling looks to Booker T to help add an edge as she takes on Nikkita Lyons.

episodes.name: The Apollo-Elijah Connection
episodes.summary: Elijah Holyfield continues his relationship with Apollo Crews, as they join forces in a tag team main event against Jaime Garcia and Malik Blade; Harlem Lewis looks to break from the pack while Braxton Cole receives a harsh dose of reality from Coach Bloom; Zena takes on the spicy Sirena Linton.

episodes.name: Too Strong Armstrong
episodes.summary: Booker T has very specific coaching instructions for Kali Armstrong and Layla Diggs, with all eyes laser-focused on their main event performance; with his tag team partner on the shelf due to injury, Harley Riggins ventures off in singles competition as he takes on the Belgian powerhouse, Mike Derudder, in a fast-paced physical contest; Bubba Ray lays out an opening sequence for Bayley Humphrey and Masyn Holiday, as the two lock horns and send the LFG crowd into a frenzy.

episodes.name: The Bodacious Belly Boys of LFG
episodes.summary: Paul "Triple H" Levesque and Shawn Michaels mentor a new generation in weekly matches in their quest to become the next WWE Superstars.

episodes.name: Not Taking My Spot
episodes.summary: Two massive men, with egos to match, lock horns in a hard-hitting main event, as Harlem Lewis takes on Mike Derudder; Coach Bubba tries to maximize emotional impact from Tate Wilder and Nathan Cranton when they lock horns in an intense battle; and it's an emotional family affair, when Bayley's mom is in town to watch her daughter take on Chantel Monroe in a match that has Booker T ecstatic!

episodes.name: Who Dares Win
episodes.summary: Nathan Cranton is ready to select a new ring name, but he may have jumped the gun. He's in the main event against the captivating Jaime Garcia, with Coach Bubba looking on intently. Harley Riggins clashes with Booker T over how to approach his match with Tate Wilder. Nikkita Lyons and Masyn Holiday have an intense battle, but in an attempt to impress Coach Nattie, they may have pushed themselves too far.

episodes.name: The Kam Hendrix Experience
episodes.summary: PJ Vasa steps into the ring with her mentor -- NXT Superstar Wendy Choo; tensions rise as Coach Bubba Ray has some tough love for Elijah Holyfield after a match with Chris Island; Kam Hendrix makes his explosive return to LFG in the main event against the debuting Olympian, Shady Elnahas.

episodes.name: Enter Van Dux
episodes.summary: It's a tense episode of LFG, as Harlem Lewis takes issue with Kevin Owen's feedback after a match with Harley Riggins. Nikkita Lyons shows off her Zen Den and then goes one-on-one with Layla Diggs. And in a massive main event, the newly minted Tristan Angels takes on a Belgian Powerhouse who is also debuting a new moniker - Dorian Van Dux!

episodes.name: Pressure Is a Privilege
episodes.summary: Johnny Gargano is back on LFG to coach Kali Armstrong and Chantel Monroe in a hard-hitting "heel-versus-heel" matchup. Trill London makes his return from injury to take on the newly renamed Romeo Moreno.

episodes.name: Meet Myka
episodes.summary: It's a new beginning for Bayley Humphrey, as she gets the opportunity to select her new name and compete against PJ Vasa in the main event. Olympic Judo sensation Shady Elnahas gets another chance to impress as he goes one-on-one with Ivy League standout Braxton Cole. And Malik Blade takes on Chris Island, as both of these "on the bubble" competitors look to step up and stay on track.

episodes.name: Partners Collide!
episodes.summary: Tate Wilder's wife and daughter are on hand to watch him take on Romeo Moreno. In an unexpected twist that sends the crowd into a frenzy, tag team partners collide, as Layla Diggs squares off with Masyn Holiday! And in the main event, Booker T takes the reins of the Harlem Lewis vs. Trill London matchup. Harlem is frustrated with his lack of freedom, while Coach Booker has some harsh words for Trill.

episodes.name: Lines in the Sand
episodes.summary: In the wake of the Civil War, a revolution takes place on the backs of visionary entrepreneurs of industry like Heinz, Kellogg and Post; they push the limits of ingenuity to launch businesses that will revolutionize industry.

episodes.name: Best Served Cold
episodes.summary: A new breed of innovator rises up to expand American industry and push the limits of new technology; a father-and-son duo named Mars start on a path to challenge the chocolate throne.

episodes.name: The Spoils of War
episodes.summary: WWII sees competing industrial empires joining the war effort in a united front to fuel the forces fighting for freedom abroad; in Post-War America, visionaries revolutionize the industry, and pave the way for the golden age of the American dream.

episodes.name: Extended Edition
episodes.summary: In the wake of the Civil War, a revolution is taking place on the backs of visionary entrepreneurs of industry.

episodes.name: Memorial Day Cookout Edition
episodes.summary: At the dawn of the 20th century, a new breed of innovator rises up to expand American industry; WWII sees competing industrial empires joining the war effort; post-war America, visionaries battle to revolutionize the restaurant industry.

episodes.name: Summer Cookout Edition
episodes.summary: As the Great Depression hits, the titans of food push the envelope of innovation to feed a hungry nation; World War II sees competing industrial empires joining the war effort in a united front to fuel the forces fighting for freedom abroad.

episodes.name: Summer Cookout Edition
episodes.summary: In the wake of the Civil War, a revolution is taking place on the backs of visionary entrepreneurs of industry; before they become brand names, budding innovators, like Henry Heinz, John and Will Kellogg, and C.W.Post, launched businesses.

episodes.name: Pizza Wars
episodes.summary: In the 1950's, two brothers from Wichita, Kan., aim to build their restaurant, Pizza Hut, by introducing America to Italian dish-pizza; Americans soon fall in love with their pizza, but rival, Domino's, threatens to derail their success.

episodes.name: The Chocolate Rush
episodes.summary: In 1919, Milton Hershey is king of the chocolate, but everything changes when sugar prices drop in the new post-WWI era; competitors spring up, including Hershey's former employee HB Reese, who goes on to create one of the bestselling candies ever.

episodes.name: The Kings of Burgers
episodes.summary: In the 1950s, Ray Kroc franchises McDonald's nationwide, but right behind Kroc, a wave of other entrepreneurs tries to cash in on the fast food restaurant craze; two Florida visionaries start up what will become Kroc's biggest rival.

episodes.name: American Cheese
episodes.summary: At the turn of the 20th century, James Kraft challenges thousands of years of cheese-making tradition and forever alters the dairy industry with his new cheese innovation; the Pabst brothers are desperate to keep their successful beer empire solvent.

episodes.name: Cola Wars
episodes.summary: In the 1970s, one major cola brand launches a blind taste-test marketing plan that takes direct aim at their biggest competitor.

episodes.name: Chip Dynasties
episodes.summary: Herman Lay takes regional and small-time chips business to a national scale with his cutting-edge sales techniques and world-changing packaging technology, while a rival innovator invents a new kind of snack chip that will challenge Lay's crown.

episodes.name: Cookie Wars
episodes.summary: A business partnership gone wrong leads Adolphus Green to create one of the most iconic cookie and cracker companies in history, and it revolutionizes packaging.

episodes.name: Soup of the Century
episodes.summary: When a chemist begins working at the Joseph A. Campbell preserve company, he invents a condensed soup that brings this rare luxury to the nation for the first time. It also attracts the attention of Henry Heinz, who becomes a bitter competitor.

episodes.name: Godfathers of Fast Food
episodes.summary: A short order chef invents the hamburger bun and engineers a new way of making a burger faster than ever before; Nathan Handwerker invests his life savings into a hot dog stand at Coney Island.

episodes.name: The TV Dinner
episodes.summary: Gilbert Swanson inherits his father's frozen turkey company and partners with a food chemist to innovate a revolutionary dinner that Americans can heat up at home.

episodes.name: Ice Cream Empires
episodes.summary: A young boy accidentally discovers a frozen treat on a stick; a candy store owner reinvents ice cream and launches the first ever ice cream truck; when two men own a patent on the same thing, a battle erupts.

episodes.name: A Game of Chicken
episodes.summary: In the 1970s, Ray Kroc is far ahead of the competition, but when a burger chain claiming to be king, poaches his third-highest ranking executive, Don Smith, it's war.

episodes.name: When the Chips Are Down
episodes.summary: As C.E. Doolin and Herman Lay try to control the chips business in the 1950s, their success inspires one of the biggest companies in the world to design a strong, saddle-shaped chip and a revolutionary container to ship them in.

episodes.name: The Rise of a Rival
episodes.summary: Candy company president Charles Guth buys a bankrupt cola company and goes to war with the supplier who wronged him and its new CEO, maverick businessman Robert Woodruff.

episodes.name: Gum Slingers
episodes.summary: William Wrigley stumbles upon a new product that kickstarts a revolution across industries and sparks a lifelong rivalry.

episodes.name: Breakfast Barons
episodes.summary: Dr. John Kellogg and his brother start a revolution in breakfast, while rival C.W. Post takes direct aim at an empire of his own.

episodes.name: Submarine Warfare
episodes.summary: High school friends see an alternative to fast food with the "submarine" sandwich, but they are quickly met with fierce competition from a new submarine joint that will go on to be the biggest restaurant chain in the world.

episodes.name: A Cold One
episodes.summary: In the late 1800s, German immigrants Joseph Schlitz and Capt. Frederick Pabst find themselves in a battle for beer dominance; in their fight for one-upmanship, they create the most popular alcoholic beverage on the planet.

episodes.name: Do or Donut
episodes.summary: When a commercial caterer realizes his two bestselling items are donuts and coffee, he joins forces with his brother-in-law to create a revolutionary donut chain; a rivalry starts with a beloved Southern-based donut shop.

episodes.name: A Dish Best Served... Soft
episodes.summary: When his ice cream truck breaks down, Tom Carvel discovers that half-melted ice cream is a surefire hit with customers.

episodes.name: The Best Thing Since...
episodes.summary: In a quest to dominate the growing commercial bread industry, Lee Marshall bets on a new kind of white loaf, unwittingly inspiring a homemaker named Margaret Rudkin to come up with a healthier alternative.

episodes.name: Cookie Fortunes
episodes.summary: Hollywood agent Wally Amos transforms his professional life when he decides to make and sell his own gourmet chocolate chip cookies, and opens America's first cookie store; housewife Debbi Fields opens her homestyle cookie shop in a mall.

episodes.name: The Beef Is On
episodes.summary: When Col. Sanders sells his company to investors in 1964, the new owners identify a rising star within the organization: Dave Thomas.

episodes.name: Pop Stars
episodes.summary: Small-town farmer Orville Redenbacher has a lifelong dream of creating the perfect popcorn kernel, leading to the first significant development of popcorn in thousands of years, which he sells nationwide.

episodes.name: Beyond the Burger
episodes.summary: Restaurateur Glen Bell works to create a burger alternative for the fast-food market and after several setbacks goes on to help introduce the taco to America; two brothers look to beat the burger by betting that a roast beef sandwich can compete.

episodes.name: Chain Reaction
episodes.summary: Former wrestler Rocky Aoki and a perfume salesman become the unlikely fathers of a casual dining revolution when they open different establishments in the heart of New York City: one of America's first Japanese restaurants and a swinging singles bar.

episodes.name: Let Them Eat Snack Cakes
episodes.summary: Martha Entenmann takes the reins of her late husband's baking company and grows it into a national powerhouse; a married couple bankrupt one bakery but succeed during their second time around with a revolutionary way to sell snack cakes.

episodes.name: Pasta Party
episodes.summary: Hector and Mario Boiardi open an Italian restaurant in Cleveland in 1924 and soon introduce Italian food to Americans; the brothers eventually find themselves in competition with James Kraft and his newest offering, macaroni and cheese.

episodes.name: Breakfast That Pops
episodes.summary: Two heavy-hitting cereal rivals duke it out for breakfast dominance; competition heats up when an idea is stolen; the ensuing battle transforms the breakfast landscape from a labor-intensive meal at the table to a meal of convenience on the go.

episodes.name: Holiday Treats
episodes.summary: The top-selling candy days of the year revolve around Easter, Valentine's Day and Halloween, and it all started with a few bold pioneers.

episodes.name: Flight of the Buffalo Wing
episodes.summary: As new wing-focused restaurant chains take the recipe out of Buffalo, N.Y., restaurateurs must find a way to cleverly market the new "Buffalo wings" to turn their restaurants into national icons, and chicken wings into a global phenomenon.

episodes.name: Candy Revolution
episodes.summary: A cereal executive's idea to finance the Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory movie kicks-off a candy revolution that produces some of the most iconic, imaginative confections in history.

episodes.name: Clash of the Coffee
episodes.summary: Two icons compete for America's coffee drinkers and forever change a worldwide, multi-billion-dollar industry.

episodes.name: The Chicken Coup
episodes.summary: Eventually challenging America's burger joint heavyweights, two future fast-food kingpins find themselves on a collision course in an all-out chicken sandwich war that is still raging to this day.

episodes.name: When Food Freezes Over
episodes.summary: Four intrepid food entrepreneurs race to harness emerging technologies, like the home freezer and microwave, to bring revolutionary frozen snack icons to a waiting world, and forever change everything about eating.

episodes.name: Thanksgiving Dinner
episodes.summary: A look at some staples of Thanksgiving dinner that weren't around until a few brands used technological advances to reinvent turkey, stuffing, cranberry sauce, pumpkin pie and more; food innovators made each part of the meal accessible.

episodes.name: Peanut Butter Battle
episodes.summary: When an entrepreneur creates shelf-stable peanut butter out of his garage, it leads to the birth of an iconic sandwich; as competition heats up to be America's favorite peanut butter, three famous brands battle it out to be number one.

episodes.name: American Spirits
episodes.summary: Two entrepreneurs rise from the ashes of Prohibition by staking everything on two liquors -- a bitter, bottom-shelf whisky, and a flavorless foreign moonshine -- and go on to save an industry and create two of the most popular brands in the country.

episodes.name: Where There's Smoke
episodes.summary: A century ago, most backyard grilling essentials were not yet invented; Henry Ford, a tinkerer named Kingsford, and a passionate butcher created recognizable summer brands and changed the face of American backyards.

episodes.name: Thirst Quenchers
episodes.summary: Before juice was everywhere, these innovators used brilliant ingenuity to create the most nostalgic drink products and thirst quenchers of the last century, leading the charge on a new billion dollar beverage industry.

episodes.name: Supermarket Sweep
episodes.summary: At the turn of the 20th century, Bernard Kroger and another upstart grocer come up with genius innovations that help invent the modern supermarket.

episodes.name: Bring Home the Bacon
episodes.summary: A young upstart named Oscar® Mayer creates one of the most iconic meat brands on the planet; pioneer Jay Hormel invents a meat product sold the world over, which becomes part of a $20 billion food empire.

episodes.name: Dog Eat Dog
episodes.summary: At a time when dog food is a rarity and cat food is almost nonexistent, it will take visionary innovators to invent the first dog treat, dry food, the first cat food, and many more innovations that will carve out the billion-dollar pet food industry.

episodes.name: Beer Run
episodes.summary: At a time when U.S. beer is dominated by the same lager style, one Milwaukee company experiments with something new.

episodes.name: All American Marinara
episodes.summary: Food conglomerate Campbell's kickstarts what will become an Italian American food revolution, launching SpaghettiOs and then Prego and along the way, transforming everything from home cooking to casual dining.

episodes.name: Ice Cream Revolution
episodes.summary: A cab driver turned ice cream entrepreneur comes up with the idea to mix name brand candy into high-quality ice cream to create new novel flavors; after opening an ice cream shop to share his mix-in creations, his concept skyrockets.

episodes.name: Soda Rising: Birth of Pop
episodes.summary: In the late 1800s, two pharmacists 1500 miles apart race to create healthy, non-alcoholic beverage options, kickstarting the entire soda industry with their breakout hits: Hires Root Beer and Dr. Pepper.

episodes.name: Sunshine in a Glass
episodes.summary: A scientist and businessman team up to develop a Vitamin C-rich war ration for WWII troopers, leading to orange juice concentrate; a fruit salesman develops a process of flash-pasteurizing fresh orange juice; the two companies soon compete.

episodes.name: Legends of the Mall
episodes.summary: Early American malls had no food court, until a cinnamon bun, a pretzel, and a panda all move in to create three of the world's most iconic food brands and transform the American Mall.

episodes.name: Penny Candy Craze
episodes.summary: In the early 1900s, an underestimated confectioner creates the first wrapped penny candy, the Tootsie Roll; an unemployed salesman transforms medicinal hard candy into a fruit flavored, multipack designed purely for fun with Tropical Charms.

episodes.name: Champions of Breakfast
episodes.summary: Will Kellogg is on top of the cereal industry after beating out post, but now, the king of cereal has met his match with a young flour mill executive; a decades long war for dominance ensues as Kellogg's and General Mills battle it out.

episodes.name: Planet Mars
episodes.summary: After being kicked out of the family business by his father, Forrest Mars scratches and claws his way back to create a multi-sector global empire, Mars Inc. Today that empire is worth over $47 billion dollars and a family dynasty that is the third wealthiest in America, worth nearly $100 billion.

episodes.name: Lunchbox Legends
episodes.summary: Lunchtime is one of the most enjoyable meals of every kid's day, but before the 1960s it was just another meal; then, three very different food visionaries take matters into their own hands.

episodes.name: The Colonel
episodes.summary: Kentucky gas station owner, Harland Sanders, develops a new method for making fried chicken, drawing customers from far and wide.

episodes.name: Citrus Soda Stars
episodes.summary: A small-time St. Louis soda maker, Charles Leiper Grigg, takes on Coke and Pepsi by introducing a clear, lemon-lime soda he calls 7-Up; at the same time, two brothers in Tennessee, Ali and Barney Hartman, have their own, called Mountain Dew.

episodes.name: Burger Empire: The Ray Kroc Story
episodes.summary: In the 1950s, middle-aged salesman Ray Kroc is drowning in debt when he's inspired by a roadside burger stand he wants to spread nationwide, McDonald's; he creates the modern model of franchising and ignites a fast-food gold rush.

episodes.name: Southern Charm
episodes.summary: The fascinating stories of the families behind the food that built America, those who used brains, muscle, blood, sweat and tears to get to America's heart through its stomach, those who invented new technologies and helped win wars.

episodes.name: Tortilla Takeover
episodes.summary: Bold visionaries risk bringing Mexican food to Americans, creating the top-selling condiment, famous snack chip brands and pairing chips and salsa.

episodes.name: Movie Theater Munchies
episodes.summary: A struggling chocolate maker and a young theater assistant create the movie theater concession stand and launch the world's most iconic movie candies.

episodes.name: Baking Chocolate Chip History
episodes.summary: A teacher turns restaurateur invents America's popular cookie which leads to a battle of food giants, and one of the packaged cookies.

episodes.name: Empire of Convenience
episodes.summary: The first convenience store is born; with innovations like late hours, to-go coffee and America's beloved slushy drink, it rises into a chain with more locations than any other store or restaurant in the world.

episodes.name: Coffee: A Brewed Awakening
episodes.summary: Jim Folger discovers a new way to bring coffee to the masses; then another famous coffee brand gets its big break at the Maxwell House Hotel in Nashville; the creation of then coffee machines that help make coffee a billion-dollar industry.

episodes.name: Beer Necessities
episodes.summary: A German immigrant looks to revolutionize the American beer industry when he's handed a struggling brewery; his signature beer will go on to amass sales of over 11 billion dollars a year.

episodes.name: Asian Food Invasion
episodes.summary: A down-on-his-luck Japanese businessman and a Chinese immigrant and her son change the American palette when they introduce instant noodles in a cup, Peking Duck, and a big Chinese restaurant chain in the nation.

episodes.name: You Don't Know Jack
episodes.summary: A farmhand named Jack Daniel and a distiller in Tennessee look to bring their quality bootleg whiskey out of the shadows into a larger market; a new recipe and Daniel's revolutionary branding tactics pave the way for an American whiskey.

episodes.name: Pizza Power Play
episodes.summary: Two pizza juggernauts expand their empires as a new contender turns the fight into a three-way race to become America's big pizza chain; they push the limits with promotions, creations and inventive sides, only to discover a fourth chain charging onto the battlefield.

episodes.name: Cereal Killers
episodes.summary: Rival cereal giants race to invent the next must-have bowl, sparking a sugary arms race of mascots, crunch, candy and the first ever chocolate cereal.

episodes.name: The Birth of Bubblegum
episodes.summary: A candy maker's botched experiment leads to the world's first bubble gum, its distinctive color, and a decades-long bubble gum war fueled by mascots, comic strips, baseball cards, and novelty flavors, transforming gum into a pop culture powerhouse and reshaping the candy aisle.

episodes.name: Drive-Thru Burger Revolution
episodes.summary: Three burger operators race to serve a new generation on wheels, and a primitive intercom and sliding window evolve into the drive-thru, revolutionizing fast food and kicking off an industry arms race.

episodes.name: Chocolate in a Glass
episodes.summary: A chemist unlocks a chocolate syrup that transforms milk into a magic sensation; a soda shop owner cracks the code to bottling liquid chocolate for the masses; and a dairy innovator turns wartime surplus into instant cocoa gold, launching a chocolate drink revolution that sweeps America.

episodes.name: Clash of the Cookie Giants
episodes.summary: A century ago, the cookie industry didn't exist, until a wave of innovators turns it into a $15 billion powerhouse; from the first sandwich cookie to the invention of chocolate chips, the rise of packaged cookies, and "homemade" chain staples, each breakthrough fuels the battle for America's favorite circular sweet.

episodes.name: Cheesecake Chronicles
episodes.summary: Through a series of accidents and unexpected innovations, a struggling cheesemaker, a New York restaurateur, a small-time baker, and a determined mother-son duo transform a humble cheese pie into a decadent American dessert--turning cheesecake into a grocery staple and the star of a restaurant empire.

episodes.name: Rice to Riches
episodes.summary: A keen-eyed immigrant, a candy mogul, and two pasta-making brothers reinvent rice for America's kitchens by making it faster, easier, and impossible to resist. But it'll take a massive global conflict, and a battle of innovations, to turn rice into riches.

episodes.name: Burgers, Burritos, & the Battle for Fast Food
episodes.summary: An upstart chain innovates iconic menu items and fast food staples including a value menu and free refills, while fending off a new competitor to bring Mexican inspired fast food to the masses. Until the world's top burger chain enters the fray and turns fast food on its head.

episodes.name: Icons of Ice Cream
episodes.summary: From the first ice cream bar in history to the fast-food Blizzard craze, a century of innovation turned ice cream treats into a $100 billion dollar industry and a cultural phenomenon.

episodes.name: Spilling the Tea
episodes.summary: A beverage giant is challenged for dominance by two upstart companies from Brooklyn to revolutionize the beverage market and transform iced tea from a regional drink to a multi-billion-dollar American staple.

episodes.name: Let's Get Cracker-ing
episodes.summary: As two baking powerhouses collide, scrappy upstarts and mom-and-pop players help turn crackers into a snack aisle staple. From innovations like shredded wheat, to the first mass-produced flavored cracker, these grocery store icons transform crackers into a global, multi-billion-dollar category.

episodes.name: Cereal Sensations
episodes.summary: Through happy accidents and breakthrough flavor innovations, cereal pioneers battle for control of America's breakfast table-using iconic mascots, unforgettable commercials, and bold new ideas to build a billion-dollar industry.

episodes.name: Say Yes to the Dressing
episodes.summary: When German immigrant Richard Hellmann bottles his deli's mayonnaise, he launches America's condiment revolution. But the real battle begins when a struggling restaurateur invents Italian dressing to save his Kansas City eatery, going head-to-head with an industry giant—just as an Alaskan camp cook creates a humble buttermilk sauce destined to take the crown: ranch.

episodes.name: Raw in the '90s
episodes.summary: "Monday Night Raw" airs in 1993 and instantly becomes must-see TV; skyrocketed by the popularity of Superstars like Stone Cold Steve Austin and factions like Degeneration X, this era is a fan favorite.

episodes.name: Royal Rumble: 80's & 90's
episodes.summary: The high stakes of the Royal Rumble with a chance at a championship match at WrestleMania has made it one of the most important premium live events of the year and has given unforgettable moments from WWE Superstars.

episodes.name: Smackdown: The First Decade
episodes.summary: Featuring the biggest stars in professional wrestling such as The Rock, Hulk Hogan and John Cena, WWE's SmackDown is the premiere destination for the most exciting matches and entertaining moments on network television.

episodes.name: nWo
episodes.summary: The professional wrestling world changes with the emergence of the New World Order or nWo; when the black and white group takes over, WCW reaches new heights in TV ratings and pop culture.

episodes.name: Stone Cold Steve Austin
episodes.summary: The hell-raising antics of Stone Cold Steve Austin have made him one of the most recognizable names in WWE history. In this episode, we celebrate the top moments of The Texas Rattlesnake with stories from The Rock, Kevin Owens, Bret The Hitman Hart, Jake The Snake Roberts and Steve Austin himself. Moments include the infamous stunner on the boss, his brutal I quit match with Bret The Hitman Hart, his confrontation with boxing legend Mike Tyson and his shocking return to WWE in 2022.

episodes.name: Celebrities of the 80s
episodes.summary: Featuring moments like Mr. T leaving Hollywood for the ring.

episodes.name: WCW
episodes.summary: Throughout the rich history of Professional Wrestling, few companies were able to leave a mark as huge as World Championship Wrestling; a look back at the moments that defined an entire organization.

episodes.name: CM Punk
episodes.summary: One of the most polarizing figures in the history of Sports Entertainment, CM Punk has certainly made a Hall of Fame career for himself. From his infamous promos to cashing in his Money in the Bank contract and winning his first World Heavyweight Championship to his shocking WWE return in 2023, the "Second City Saint" has left the WWE Universe in awe with some of the greatest moments of all time.

episodes.name: WrestleMania in the 80s
episodes.summary: We journey back to the beginnings of WrestleMania's rich history, the 1980s; featuring unforgettable moments like Hulk Hogan body slamming Andre the Giant.

episodes.name: Cody Rhodes
episodes.summary: As the son of Hall of Famer Dusty Rhodes, Cody Rhodes has carved a path for himself; the American Nightmare's career is packed with moments like his first singles match at WrestleMania in 2011, his steel cage match with Seth Rollins while battling an injury, Cody's return to WWE in 2022 and his victory over Roman Reigns at WrestleMania 40, when Cody finished the story.

episodes.name: The Bloodline
episodes.summary: Looking at the journey of The Bloodline from their rich Samoan heritage of the squared circle; led by Roman Reigns, each member has reached the very heights of this industry; acknowledge The Bloodline with their moments.

episodes.name: DX
episodes.summary: Counting down the top moments of the controversial Degeneration X; they pushed the envelope with their sophomoric shenanigans and lewd humor, but in doing so, they revolutionized professional wrestling.

episodes.name: Money in the Bank Cash-Ins
episodes.summary: Looking at the heritage of Money in the Bank; superstars climb a ladder and battle for the chance to retrieve a briefcase containing a contract for a championship title opportunity; reliving the very first cash-in from 2005 and subsequent moments.

episodes.name: SummerSlam in the 2000s
episodes.summary: SummerSlam has proven time and time again that anything can happen in the WWE; in the 2000s, the biggest matches and most unforgettable moments took place at this electrifying premium live event, including the match between Batista and John Cena.

episodes.name: John Cena
episodes.summary: Hustle, loyalty and respect are the three words John Cena has lived by, while carving out one of the most memorable paths in WWE history.

episodes.name: Shocking Moments of the '80s
episodes.summary: Looking back at some of the most shocking moments from the golden era; moments include the break-up of the Mega-Powers, Rowdy Roddy Piper crashing a gold record presentation, Andre the Giant dethroning Hulk Hogan for the WWE Championship, and more!

episodes.name: Booker T
episodes.summary: Celebrating the two-time Hall of Famer and five-time WCW champion Booker T, with stories from Stone Cold Steve Austin, Triple H, Goldust, Jeff Jarrett, and Booker T himself; moments include his early tag team days with his brother.

episodes.name: Tag Teams of the '90s
episodes.summary: Tag Team wrestling has always been a must-see attraction and there was perhaps no hotter time for such action than the 1990s.

episodes.name: Mic Drops of the '90s
episodes.summary: The mic drop when a Superstar makes an emphatic point and leaves audiences hanging on their every word; featuring Superstars such as The Rock, D-Generation X and "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, we look back at great wordsmiths in WWE history.

episodes.name: Kevin Owens
episodes.summary: One of the most outspoken, defiant, and versatile Superstars of all-time, Kevin Owens has certainly made a name for himself in WWE.

episodes.name: Women's Evolution
episodes.summary: The athleticism of the WWE Women's division; from the first Women's Elimination Chamber and the first all-women's premium live event to the first time that women headlined the main event of WrestleMania.

episodes.name: Goldberg
episodes.summary: Goldberg made a Hall of Fame career out of striking fear into his opponents with the dreaded Spear and awesome Jackhammer; some of the greatest moments in this icon's historic career include the first victory that ignited Goldberg's streak.

episodes.name: Saturday Night's Main Event
episodes.summary: Breaking ground as the first professional wrestling program to air on network television, "Saturday Night's Main Event" was home to many of the biggest moments, like Macho Man Randy Savage and Hulk Hogan's formation of the Mega Powers.

episodes.name: Mick Foley
episodes.summary: Otherwise, known as Cactus Jack, Mankind and Dude Love, Mick Foley is one of the most beloved superstars of all-time; for over four decades, Foley has entertained audiences worldwide as The Hardcore Legend; we look back at some of the greatest times in Mick Foley's career with such moments as the unforgettable Hell in a Cell match against the Undertaker, Cactus Jack's debut at Madison Square Garden, Foley achieving his lifelong dream of becoming WWE Champion and more!

episodes.name: Shocking Comebacks
episodes.summary: One of the most exciting aspects of WWE has always been a Superstar's return to the squared circle; the best comebacks have always been when the fans least expect it like the surprise returns of Bret "The Hitman" Hart.

episodes.name: Andre the Giant
episodes.summary: Throughout the storied history of WWE, there has never been a Superstar quite as large as "The Eighth Wonder of the World," Andre the Giant; unforgettable moments of his enormous strength include his showdown with Hulk Hogan at Shea Stadium, the body slam contest with Big John Stud, his triumph at Survivor Series, his extraordinary title win and so much more.

episodes.name: Championship Matches of the 90s
episodes.summary: The WWE Championship is the richest prize any Superstar can attain. And in the 1990s, the competition for the coveted gold was at an all-time high. Relive the greatest battles of the decade for the WWE Championship, such as "Stone Cold" Steve Austin vs. The Rock, Bret "Hitman" Hart vs. Owen Hart, Shawn Michaels vs. Mick Foley, Hulk Hogan vs. the Ultimate Warrior and more!

episodes.name: Macho Man Randy Savage
episodes.summary: Throughout time, one WWE Superstar continues to define the word charisma: "Macho Man" Randy Savage; with his flashy outfits, unmistakable voice, and signature moves, he is indeed the cream of the crop; relive some of Randy's most savage moments.

episodes.name: Survivor Series in the 2000s
episodes.summary: In the 2000s, anything could and usually did happen; some of the memorable moments of WWE's fall classic like Kane's brutal match against Shane McMahon, Team WWE vs. Team Alliance (WCW and ECW), Brock Lesnar taking on the Big Show.

episodes.name: Undertaker
episodes.summary: We look back at some of the Undertaker's gravest hits, such as the Boneyard match against AJ Styles, taking on Hulk Hogan for the WWE Championship, the WrestleMania 25 classic against the Heartbreak Kid Shawn Michaels and more.

episodes.name: Greatest WWE Moments of the 80s/90s/00s - 22
episodes.summary: One of the biggest enigmas in Sports Entertainment history is the man simply known as Goldberg. Goldberg made a Hall of Fame career out of striking fear into his opponents with the dreaded Spear and awesome Jackhammer.

episodes.name: WrestleMania in the 2000s
episodes.summary: Aptly known as "The Grandest Stage of Them All," WrestleMania is a global phenomenon which every WWE Superstar strives to be a part of. And in the decade of the 2000s, the stars certainly shined bright! Witness such WrestleMania classics as The Rock vs. "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, WrestleMania 16's Triangle Ladder Match, The Rock vs. Hollywood Hogan and so much more!

episodes.name: WrestleMania in the 2010s
episodes.summary: In the 2010s, the grandest Superstars gave the WWE Universe a lifetime of memories at WrestleMania. Featuring classics such as Shawn Michaels vs. the Undertaker, The Rise of Kofi-Mania, Seth "Freakin" Rollins' revolutionary moments at WrestleMania 31, and Ronda Rousey's debut with The Rock… this decade truly was a showcase of the immortals.

episodes.name: "Rowdy" Roddy Piper
episodes.summary: The incomparable "Rowdy" Roddy Piper stood above all when it came to antagonizing audiences worldwide. The Hot Rod is an all-time WWE Legend, and his antics will be remembered for generations to come. Relive his unforgettable boxing match with Mr. T at WrestleMania 2, his instant classic with Bret "Hitman" Hart, and the talk show that started it all, Piper's Pit!

episodes.name: Debuts of the 90s
episodes.summary: There's nothing like a first impression! And in the world of WWE, the first appearance of a Superstar means everything, especially in the unpredictable era of the 1990s; witness the greatest debuts of superstars like Mankind, Kurt Angle, Undertaker, The Rock and so many more!

episodes.name: WCW Monday Nitro
episodes.summary: Driven on a "dare to be different" attitude, WCW Monday Nitro was the premiere program for World Championship Wrestling, WWE's biggest rival; Nitro was the reigning champion of the famed Monday Night War for 83 weeks in a row; relive Nitro's notable moments like Lex Luger dethroning Hollywood Hogan, Dennis Rodman skipping practice to appear on Nitro, the chaos of the first episode from the Mall of America and more!

episodes.name: Backlash
episodes.summary: From shocking betrayals and high-risk stunts to emotional victories and defining legacies, Backlash consistently delivers incredible moments in the aftermath of WrestleMania; from the bloodbath between Randy Orton and Mick Foley and the iconic face-off between Triple H and Hulk Hogan to the highly anticipated showdown between The Rock and Goldberg and Shane McMahon's death-defying leap off the jumbotron, this live event pushed superstars to their limits.

episodes.name: Raw in the 2000s
episodes.summary: Monday Night Raw is the longest running episodic television show in history! And in the unpredictable decade of the 2000s, the program was taken to a whole new level. Witness such iconic moments such as The Rock and Hollywood Hogan's electric in-ring confrontation, Kurt Angle delivering milk to "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, Batista's WrestleMania choice, and more!

episodes.name: Jake "The Snake" Roberts
episodes.summary: Known for carrying a live snake with him to the ring, Jake Roberts was not only a vicious competitor, but a true master of the spoken word, delivering some of the most memorable promos during his famed career; relive moments like his partnership with legendary rock music icon Alice Cooper, unleashing his snake onto "Macho Man" Randy Savage, his unforgettable feud with "Ravishing" Rick Rude and so much more.

episodes.name: Chyna
episodes.summary: Aptly named the ninth wonder of the world, Chyna broke countless barriers to become one of the most recognizable superstars in WWE history; we celebrate this pioneer with stories from Triple H, Shawn Michaels, Jeff Jarrett, Mark Henry and more; moments include winning the women's championship at WrestleMania 17, her "good housekeeping match" versus Jeff Jarrett, making history as the first woman to enter the men's Royal Rumble and more.

episodes.name: Managers
episodes.summary: Throughout the history of professional wrestling, managers have been a critical element in many of the sport's most influential and controversial moments; relive some of the most famous…and infamous junctures throughout the last several decades featuring such prominent names as: Bobby "The Brain" Heenan, Mr. Fuji, Jimmy Hart, Paul Heyman and more!

episodes.name: Ladder Matches
episodes.summary: One of the most exciting, thrilling, and jaw-dropping matches in WWE history is no doubt the Ladder Match. Superstars climb rung by rung to reach their ultimate prize, and audiences are constantly left speechless; witness some of the greatest ladder matches in WWE history with such classics as Shawn Michaels vs. Razor Ramon, Cody Rhodes vs. Kevin Owens, The Hardy Boyz vs. Edge and Christian, and more!

episodes.name: Bret "The Hitman" Hart
episodes.summary: Widely regarded as one of the greatest technical wrestlers of all time, Bret Hart set the standard for excellence inside the ring; relive moments from The Hitman's legendary career, like the classic Intercontinental Championship battle with Mr. Perfect, his victory over Ric Flair in 1992 for the title, his crowning achievement as King of the Ring, his emotional return to WWE in 2010, and so much more.

episodes.name: Ultimate Warrior
episodes.summary: Ultimate Warrior's energy ran through professional wrestling like none before him and his legacy will live forever; with moments like body slamming Andre the Giant inside Madison Square Garden, the unforgettable career-ending match against Randy Savage, the iconic title for title match against Hulk Hogan at WrestleMania 6, the intensity of Warrior will always be unmistakable.

episodes.name: Royal Rumble in the 2000s
episodes.summary: The Royal Rumble is one of the wildest events on the WWE calendar; and in the intense decade of the 2000s, great Rumble moments were etched in history, featuring the unforgettable WWE Championship match between Cactus Jack and Triple H, Santino Marella breaking a record for the shortest entrant, John Cena and Batista's epic battle in 2005 and much more!

episodes.name: SmackDown: The 2nd Decade
episodes.summary: We celebrate the top moments from SmackDown's second decade; features the Steel Cage clash between Jeff Hardy and CM Punk, Edge's shocking cash-in on The Undertaker, AJ Styles capturing the WWE Championship in Britain, The Rock making his return to the house he built and more.

episodes.name: Backstage Chaos
episodes.summary: Sometimes in the unpredictable world of WWE, rivalries become too personal to be settled inside the ring and superstars sometimes find the backstage area more suitable to settle their differences; witness some of the most tumultuous backstage assaults in WWE history with moments featuring The Rock, Hollywood Hogan, The Undertaker, "The American Nightmare" Cody Rhodes and so much more!

episodes.name: Elimination Chamber
episodes.summary: The elimination chamber has struck fear into WWE superstars for over 20 years, leading to the creation of its own namesake event; relive some of the shocking moments from the premium live event, like Goldberg spearing Chris Jericho through the plexiglass in 2003, the first-ever women's elimination chamber in 2018, the debut of Kevin Owens as he takes on John Cena in 2015 and more.

episodes.name: Debuts of the 2000s
episodes.summary: Making a WWE debut is one of the most nerve-wracking moments in a superstar's career. But for the fans, it's one of the most exciting things they can witness; the 2000s certainly proved to be a time of future Hall of Famers first appearing on WWE Television screens; we look back at the decade's most memorable WWE debuts, including Brock Lesnar, CM Punk, Booker T, Rey Mysterio, John Cena and more.

episodes.name: Dusty Rhodes
episodes.summary: No one thrilled audiences quite like "The American Dream," Dusty Rhodes; whether it be on a microphone or inside the squared circle, Dusty was in a league of his own; relive some of the Dream's most iconic moments such as his legendary match against "Superstar" Billy Graham, his war against "The Nature Boy" Ric Flair, and one of the all-time greatest promos ever given in Professional Wrestling, "Hard Times."

episodes.name: Entrances of the '90s
episodes.summary: A great WWE entrance doesn't just hype the match, it can create a larger-than-life icon; witness some of the most memorable entrances of the incredible era of the 90s such as Shawn Michaels, The Undertaker, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, and much more!

episodes.name: Triple H
episodes.summary: For over three decades, Triple H decimated opponents and left the WWE Universe with some of the greatest matches and moments of all-time. From the genesis of the new D-Generation X, to the 3 Stages of Hell Match with "Stone Cold" Steve Austin, to winning the WWE Championship at the 2016 Royal Rumble, Triple H is a certifiable WWE Hall of Fame Legend.

episodes.name: Stephanie McMahon
episodes.summary: Born into the wrestling business, Stephanie McMahon has been a fixture in the WWE Universe her entire life; from leading the company as a top executive to delivering some of WWE's most compelling moments in the ring, Stephanie built a legacy unlike any other; relive her iconic rivalries with Trish Stratus, Brie Bella and Ronda Rousey, her shocking WWE Women's Championship victory, her induction into the WWE Hall of Fame and more.

episodes.name: Kane
episodes.summary: One of the most feared and iconic superstars in WWE history, Kane forged a legacy built on chaos, carnage and destruction; relive the Big Red Machine's top moments, from his shocking debut and legendary battles with The Undertaker to his unforgettable unmasking, the night he set Jim Ross on fire and his incredible World Heavyweight Championship victory after cashing in Money in the Bank the very same night in 2010!

episodes.name: King of the Ring
episodes.summary: The King of the Ring Premium Live Event has been launching WWE Superstars to greatness for decades; relive iconic moments, from a brutal No Holds Barred battle and the end of Hulkamania to the legendary Hell in a Cell match between Mankind and The Undertaker; follow the grueling tournament that crowned WWE royalty and helped shape WWE history.

episodes.name: Mic Drops of the 2000s
episodes.summary: A "Mic Drop" in WWE could mean a variety of things. A conflict escalating, emotions riding high, or a great way to let the world know exactly how it is. In the 2000s, WWE Superstars used the spoken word to cut down their opponents and used the microphone as their weapon of choice. Witness some of the greatest mic drops of the decade with moments such as "Stone Cold" Steve Austin's "What?", Triple H's verbal assault on Batista, and Shawn Michaels' memorable return to Montreal in 2005!

episodes.name: Lex Luger

episodes.name: Hulk Hogan
episodes.summary: Pop culture icon Hulk Hogan had an incredible career spanning over 5 decades and earning him 12 world championships. Over the years, he became the ultimate definition of a global superstar. We celebrate the immortal moments of the Hulkster, like his legendary match with The Iron Sheik, his Icon vs Icon match against The Rock, his shocking WCW heel turn and the breathtaking slam of Andre the Giant.

episodes.name: SummerSlam in the '90s
episodes.summary: SummerSlam has long been one of the hottest PLE's of WWE and the decade of the 90s certainly lived up to the heat! Witness ladder matches, a steel cage match and even a first-ever Boiler Room Brawl. Also, "Stone Cold" Steve Austin defends his WWE Championship against Triple H and Mankind with Jesse "The Body" Ventura as guest referee. And we're all invited to a Macho wedding that served as the main event at Madison Square Garden!

episodes.name: Episode 29
episodes.summary: Play-by-play announcer Michael Cole hosts WWE wrestlers as they share recollections and perspectives on some of the most remarkable moments in wrestling history.

episodes.name: Seth "Freakin" Rollins
episodes.summary: From glorious championship victories to jaw dropping betrayals, "The Architect" of WWE- Seth "Freakin" Rollins, has been thrilling audiences for over a decade. We celebrate Seth's top 10 moments like becoming the first-ever NXT champion, his shocking betrayal of The Shield, his epic match with AJ Styles to become the inaugural world heavyweight champion, the Money in the Bank cash-in at WrestleMania 31- aptly named "heist of the century," and so much more!

episodes.name: Connection

episodes.name: Passin' Me By

episodes.name: Kids See Ghosts

With one of the biggest games of his career around the corner, Spencer seeks guidance by revisiting his past; Layla continues to work through her mental health recovery; Olivia receives unexpected feedback from her publisher.
