episodes.name: Victory Lap
episodes.summary: As they prepare for their wedding day, Layla admits to Jordan that she's missing her mother's presence; Spencer shifts his focus from the NFL draft to Layla and Jordan's big day; Patience is conflicted after receiving an unexpected opportunity.

episodes.name: I Do
episodes.summary: Spencer and Olivia are focused on pulling off the perfect wedding weekend; Jordan considers a new job offer, and his and Layla's search for a new home takes an unexpected turn; Laura and Grace go head-to-head to see who can write the best speech.

episodes.name: I Do
episodes.summary: When an unexpected phone call leaves Liv spiraling on her wedding day, the Vortex band together to create magic; Spencer rallies help for a surprise of his own; Laura brings in her own reinforcement; Coop receives some major news about her future.

episodes.name: Reborn
episodes.summary: Jordan is caught between being a coach and a friend, which causes discord with his boss and Yasi; Kingston's world is upended when he learns the secret that his parents have been keeping from him; Khalil challenges the school system.

episodes.name: Get By
episodes.summary: Cassius and KJ struggle to find their way as they navigate their first day at Beverly and South Crenshaw High; Jordan steps in when Yasi antagonizes Khalil.

episodes.name: Ante Up
episodes.summary: When South Crenshaw's latest addition remains sidelined, Jordan and Coach Bobby clash over his next steps; the Eagles' devastating loss leads to finger-pointing from KJ; Cassius brings KJ to a South Crenshaw game.

episodes.name: Face Off
episodes.summary: After Beverlyʼs humbling loss, KJ is determined to turn things around by looking to Jordan Baker's old plays; Layla refuses to work with pop star Elle Grant over controversial social media posts she made as a teen.

episodes.name: I Got a Story to Tell
episodes.summary: Both Beverly and Crenshaw are on a hot streak in their respective games; Amina struggles with her decision to run for Stu-Co president when she discovers her campaign speech falls on a very difficult day; Coop attends a law panel.

episodes.name: Return of the Mack
episodes.summary: Khalil must choose between lying for his father and a better path for himself; Patience gets an opportunity that tests her relationship with Coop; KJ's fake relationship with Amina draws Tori's interest.

episodes.name: Boom I Got Your Boyfriend
episodes.summary: Cassius struggles to come to terms with a hard truth; Amina throws a party to celebrate her Stu-Co win, but her fake relationship with KJ gets complicated when he brings Tori with him; Khalil adjusts to his new living arrangements.

episodes.name: Squabble Up
episodes.summary: It's homecoming weekend at South Crenshaw High; as part of a new tradition, Amina is named Ms. South Crenshaw, which brings up memories of her mother; Khalil prepares to play for the first time since making the football team.

episodes.name: Shadowboxin'
episodes.summary: Spencer James and Darnell Hayes return to town, organizing a spirited night out aimed at resolving the escalating rivalry between Cassius and Jordan; Coop struggles with haunting memories from her past.

episodes.name: Just a Friend
episodes.summary: When Cassius decides to bench his starters, KJ fights for their right to play; Amina returns from Baltimore determined to save Khalil from the threats he's facing; Khalil finally turns to Coop for help; Layla helps Breonna and Coop find their way.

episodes.name: No Role Modelz
episodes.summary: KJ grapples with a new discovery about the Jeremy family; Ava finally has answers to lingering questions in her marriage to Cassius; Khalil gets an unexpected visit on his18th birthday; Amina has a tough choice to consider.

episodes.name: Don't Hate the Player
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of his attack, Jordan finds comfort in Olivia and Layla's support; KJ tries to make things up to Tori; Coop tries to help Khalil overcome his overwhelming guilt about Jordan's situation; Jordan makes a big decision.

episodes.name: Award Tour
episodes.summary: On the day of the South Crenshaw vs. Beverly game, KJ learns news that throws him off; Jordan is determined to return to the game despite outside concerns; Amina learns good news about her future; Coop is ready for the next step with Breonna.

episodes.name: Rewind
episodes.summary: Cassius and KJ begin the unexpected fight for their joint future; KJ's intensity of late takes a turn, leaving loved ones worried; Jordan and Cassius' attempts at building a family relationship outside of football hits a snag.

episodes.name: There Is No Competition
episodes.summary: Jordan struggles to reconnect with Layla; Cassius is determined to show he's the right coach for Beverly; Amina's sudden reappearance throws Khalil and KJ off balance just as they need to focus.

episodes.name: Fight for Your Right
episodes.summary: Jordan seeks help from Layla as he wrestles with a life-changing job offer; Cassius asks KJ for help as he plans to repair his fractured marriage to Ava; Amina struggles with the secret she's keeping and launches a plan to salvage her future.

episodes.name: No More Hiding
episodes.summary: Secrets are revealed that put Amina and KJ on the hot seat; Tori and Khalil grow closer; Layla seeks out her father for help, but the visit ends up very different from what either of them expected.

world_war_ii_with_tom_hanks.title: World War II With Tom Hanks

episodes.name: The Beginning
episodes.summary: In September 1939, Germany invades Poland, setting the stage for the most destructive war in history.

episodes.name: Blitz
episodes.summary: After toppling the Netherlands and Belgium, Nazi Germany pushes further west; the Allies scramble to support France as Churchill is forced to defend Britain from the skies and FDR rushes to mobilize wartime production.

episodes.name: Barbarossa
episodes.summary: Examine the story of Operation Barbarossa, Hitler's surprise invasion of the Soviet Union in 1941, the largest and costliest land offensive in human history.

episodes.name: Pearl Harbor
episodes.summary: Japan escalates their war in China, drawing increasing U.S. sanctions and widespread outrage; driven by resource shortages and military ideology, Japan attacks Pearl Harbor in a move that reshapes the course of World War II.

episodes.name: The War at Sea
episodes.summary: Examine how America's battle to control the seas against the German U-boats in the Atlantic and Japan's navy in the Pacific turns the tide of the war.

episodes.name: Guadalcanal
episodes.summary: After the attack on Pearl Harbor, Japanese forces sweep across Southeast Asia; on Guadalcanal, United States Marines are given the bloody task of stopping their relentless advance.

episodes.name: Darkness Falls
episodes.summary: As Hitler's reach extends beyond Germany and darkness descends on Europe, his hateful rhetoric leads to anti-Jewish persecution and ultimately, genocide.

episodes.name: Operation Torch
episodes.summary: The first joint U.S.-British offensive of the war, thousands of inexperienced U.S. troops and their untested leader Eisenhower, face off against the hardened German Afrika Korps and the infamous Field Marshal Erwin Rommel.

episodes.name: Secrets and Lies
episodes.summary: Behind the fierce frontline clashes of WWII, a hidden battle rages - one of espionage, deception, and codebreaking; in rural England, a group of brilliant academics work to crack Germany's unbreakable Enigma Code and change the course of the war.

episodes.name: Stalingrad
episodes.summary: In Operation Blue, the German Army fights to take Soviet oil fields and the city of Stalingrad, becoming one of the deadliest battles ever fought and a major turning point on the Eastern Front.

episodes.name: Italy
episodes.summary: The Allies hope to quickly penetrate the Nazi Reich via Italy but instead endure a months-long slog with devastating results.

episodes.name: Battle for the Skies
episodes.summary: Allied air forces engage in a fierce and costly battle with the German Luftwaffe over the skies of Europe.

episodes.name: Overlord
episodes.summary: The Allies undertake Operation Overlord, a complicated and massive military invasion, to liberate Occupied France and open a true second front in Western Europe.

episodes.name: Long Road to Tokyo
episodes.summary: The Allies and Japan clash in the jungles and plains of Asia, the "forgotten theater" of World War II, as America struggles to bring the fight to Tokyo's door.

episodes.name: Home Front
episodes.summary: As the tide begins to turn against the Axis powers, the leaders of Germany and Japan deploy opposite strategies on their home fronts.

episodes.name: Resistance
episodes.summary: Resistance to Nazi occupation and oppression is a constant throughout the war, with results both triumphant and devastating.

episodes.name: No Surrender
episodes.summary: The Pacific campaign reaches a brutal and bloody fever pitch from 1944 to 1945.

episodes.name: Last Days of the Reich
episodes.summary: The war in Europe reaches a climax as Allied armies advance towards Berlin, and Hitler orders his people to fight to the last man.

episodes.name: Endgame
episodes.summary: The most terrible weapon ever created will change the course of the war in the Pacific.

episodes.name: Fall Out
episodes.summary: The end of the second world war and the dawn of the nuclear age see its two great victors go from allies to adversaries.

episodes.name: It's All Greek to Me
episodes.summary: Chef Ben Robinson and eight new crew members undertake a charter season aboard a private luxury yacht in the Greek islands; Bryan gets an unexpected promotion; the crew scrambles to stream a live football game in the middle of the Mediterranean.

episodes.name: Game Time
episodes.summary: Things don't go as planned as the crew tries to stream a football game; Ben redeems himself after the moussaka mishap; Jen feels like she's being assigned all the tedious tasks; Hannah confronts Tiffany over unfinished duties.

episodes.name: Model Deckhands
episodes.summary: Bobby and Danny bring women back to the yacht; the crew struggles to keep up with the demands of an all-female group of guests who charter the yacht for a calendar shoot; as the crew assists with the shoot, Danny breaks the number one rule.

episodes.name: Lovesick Danny
episodes.summary: Disobeying a direct order, Danny gives a love poem to a charter guest; Bobby's feelings for Julia grow stronger; Tiffany works harder on her steward skills; Ben is shocked when he finds one of the stewards in his bunk with Bryan.

episodes.name: My Big Fat Greek Threesome
episodes.summary: The stewards are tasked with putting together a country hoedown complete with bales of hay for charter guests from Oklahoma; the guests appear to have a threesome in the hot tub, and Danny lands in hot water for overstepping his boundaries.

episodes.name: Entrée-vous
episodes.summary: While charter guests celebrate their seven-month dating anniversary, the crew strives to make their trip as romantic as possible; Ben and Hannah go on a date; the crew springs into action to help save a nearby vessel that has begun to sink.

episodes.name: Who's Got Game?
episodes.summary: Hannah feels betrayed after Ben goes to the captain about their miscommunication; Julia reminds Bobby she's in a committed relationship; in Mykonos, Danny and Bobby are tasked with finding companions for a charter group of bachelors.

episodes.name: Charter King
episodes.summary: Hannah's migraine worsens when charter guests bring back a large group of young women; the bachelors anoint Danny as the Most Valuable Player, much to the chagrin of Bobby and Bryan; Danny continues to lose the respect of his crew.

episodes.name: Fever Pitch
episodes.summary: Hannah and Ben redefine their relationship; after a flirtation with Hannah, Bobby realizes he can't turn off his feelings for Julia; Ben makes s'mores during a beach barbecue; Bryan takes the captain's orders to heart; Danny falls seriously ill.

episodes.name: Charter From Heaven, Charter From Hell?
episodes.summary: While Danny is away at the hospital, the crew revels in his absence; Jen finally stands up to Bryan; Tiffany's feelings for Ben increase; as one easy-going charter leaves, the crew is blind-sided by a new group of highly demanding guests.

episodes.name: They Hate Us Cuz They Ain't Us
episodes.summary: The demanding charter extends their stay, and Hannah puts on her best "stew" face to regain their trust; Julia and Ben engage in class warfare after a miscommunication; the captain gives Danny his phone back; Ben and Hannah's friendship deepens.

episodes.name: The Beautiful Thing About Subpar
episodes.summary: Hannah hopes for a generous tip as the guests finally prepare to leave; Captain Mark makes a big decision that will shake up the dynamic of the entire crew; Ben and Tiffany take their flirtation to the next level.

episodes.name: That Was Very Greek of Us
episodes.summary: A celebratory night out turns ugly; for the final charter, an all-male group brings its own set of demands, and an exhausted crew struggles to keep up; the women band together to confront Bryan; everyone prepares to say goodbye.

episodes.name: Who's the Boss?
episodes.summary: The crew of the luxury yacht Sirocco sets sail in the waters off of Croatia; Hannah and Bobby are joined by seven new shipmates; Bobby looks for love; Hannah finds herself at odds with Capt. Sandy, who interferes with a beach picnic.

episodes.name: Three's Company
episodes.summary: After a mishap with the anchor, Sandy realizes her new deck crew has a lot to learn; Bobby develops a crush on Malia; as the guests enjoy a unique dinner, a slip of the tongue threatens to ruin a carefully planned surprise.

episodes.name: Chefs, Lies and Facetime
episodes.summary: The rift between Bobby and Hannah grows; Bobby calls out Lauren for having an affair with one of his friends; a group of guests shed their clothes while the deck crew tries to remain professional; Bugsy must decide whether she should go home.

episodes.name: All Chained Up and No Place to Go
episodes.summary: Naked guests distract the crew; Hannah and Bobby hash out their differences; tension mounts between Lauren and Bobby; Bugsy deals with the loss of her grandmother; a twisted anchor chain leaves the crew and guests stranded at sea.

episodes.name: Double Trouble
episodes.summary: Capt. Sandy grows frustrated with the crew; Bobby springs into action using his firefighter and EMT skills; Lauren questions her future on the boat; guests argue with each other; Malia lands in the middle of a love triangle during a wild night out.

episodes.name: Don't Cry Over Cut Onions
episodes.summary: Malia, Wes and Adam find themselves in uncharted emotional territory as news of their love triangle spreads; the Oklahomans return as guests; Max misses his girlfriend; tempers flare in the galley after Adam goes against a guest's food preferences.

episodes.name: Mo' Onions, Mo' Problems
episodes.summary: Malia and Adam share a moment, but she also continues to flirt with Wes; the charter guests challenge the crew to a race; Hannah finds out Adam went against the guests' food preferences and informs Captain Sandy; Bugsy feels alienated from the stews.

episodes.name: Flirting With Disaster
episodes.summary: When a hot bachelor charters the Sirocco, a smitten Hannah attempts to remain professional; Wes struggles with his growing feelings for Malia as fireworks ignite between her and Adam; Bobby receives special attention from a charter guest.

episodes.name: Icloudy With a Chance of Secrets
episodes.summary: Wes declares his feelings for Malia, while her relationship with Adam takes a turn; Max's girlfriend pays a visit; Bugsy discovers Hannah has broken "yachtie" code; Hannah faces Captain Sandy; a group of tequila-loving guests charters Sirocco.

episodes.name: Kissing up
episodes.summary: Hannah and Adam continue to clash; Wes and Malia share an intimate moment while on the job; Max is excited to prove his worth by taking the boat off the dock for the first time; the crew is under pressure when an influential charter broker arrives.

episodes.name: The Dubrovnik Wedgie
episodes.summary: When bad weather keeps Sirocco at port, the crew scrambles to keep a charter broker and her friends happy; Wes announces his choice for lead deckhand; word sperads that Wes and Malia exchanged a kiss; in Dubrovnik, Croatia, Adam pulls a prank on Wes.

episodes.name: Swing Shift
episodes.summary: Adam's prank goes awry; Wes avoids Adam; demanding Texans turn a one-day charter into an eternity; Malia jeopardizes a routine anchor drop; Bobby and Malia clash over their responsibilities; a flirtatious friendship develops between former rivals.

episodes.name: Stew the Right Thing
episodes.summary: Bugsy's frustration with Hannah intensifies; on the final charter of the season, a returning guest is flanked by six beautiful women who test Bobby's willpower; Wes is blindsided when Adam reveals a text message exchange between him and Malia.

episodes.name: Con-text Is Everything
episodes.summary: As the charter season comes to an end, the crew members struggle to resolve their complicated relationships; Bobby finally finds romance; Hannah and Bugsy air their grievances, and Lauren must choose sides; Adam has one more shocking detail for Wes.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.summary: Andy Cohen hosts a reunion with the crew members to discuss season two.

episodes.name: Ciao, Napoli!
episodes.summary: Another season in the Mediterranean gets under way as Captain Sandy Yawn and the crew cruise the Italian coast; chef Adam returns and is ready to redeem himself; returning chief Hannah finds herself at a crossroads on whether she should settle down.

episodes.name: A Perfect Storm
episodes.summary: The crew must fend off demanding charter guests in order to keep Captain Sandy at bay after receiving complaints; a guest excursion to Capri allows Joao and Kasey to get to know each other; an intense storm strikes.

episodes.name: Bad Vibrations
episodes.summary: After arguing with Hannah and professing his attraction to Brooke, Joao must deal with the consequences of his alcohol-fueled alter ego, Jezabob; Brooke confesses that she is torn between being single and dating again; Sandy's friend comes aboard.

episodes.name: Demand & Supply
episodes.summary: Sandy comes down hard on the interior leaving Adam to defend himself; Hannah puts her feelings on the line with Conrad; Joao gets tough on Jamie after she accidentally oversleeps; a new charter begins, and the crew can barely keep up with requests.

episodes.name: Can I Get Fries With That?
episodes.summary: The primary and her guests turn up the heat on the crew; sad about missing her sister's wedding, Brooke tries to remain professional; Brooke develops a crush on Adam; as Conrad gets closer to Hannah, Capt. Sandy begins to notice he's distracted.

episodes.name: Hasta Barista, Baby!
episodes.summary: Hannah's ongoing struggle with her under-performing Third Stew comes to a head when she learns Kasey lied on her resume; Capt. Sandy is concerned by Conrad's feelings for Hannah when their romance results in distractions from Conrad's duties.

episodes.name: Walking on Broken Glass
episodes.summary: Joao continues to send mixed messages to both Brooke and Kasey, which prompts them to confront him; a night out at a Michelin-starred restaurant inspires Adam to step up his culinary game for the rest of the season.

episodes.name: Bizarre Love Triangle
episodes.summary: While the crew works hard to pull off a magical picnic for the guests on the island of Capri, Joao earns the praise of Captain Sandy for putting out all the water toys as the solo deckie; Brooke throws Hannah a fake 30th birthday dock party.

episodes.name: Panic at the Deck-o
episodes.summary: Joao solidifies the love triangle, leaving Kasey confused; Hannah feels slighted by Brooke when she pursues a relationship with Joao; Adam goes foraging for food; Hannah doesn't feel supported by Conrad, leaving her stricken with anxiety.

episodes.name: Hannah, Hannah, Sandy?
episodes.summary: With both Hannah and Jamie down, Captain Sandy steps in to support her crew; Adam feels like his chance at redemption is foiled when charter guest Kenny requests an impromptu beach picnic; Hannah crosses a line with Sandy.

episodes.name: Mo' Euros, Mo' Problems
episodes.summary: Hannah disobeys a direct order; Adam concentrates on delivering another onion-less dinner; Joao feels betrayed when he overhears Kasey warning Brooke about his flirtatious ways; an argument erupts between Hannah and Conrad.

episodes.name: Take This Job and Stew It
episodes.summary: Hannah and Conrad ask whether they will be able to coexist off the boat; Brooke and Kasey air their grievances over Hannah's work ethic; Jamie's hard work gets recognition; a group of Sandy's friends charter the yacht.

episodes.name: We Used to Be Friends
episodes.summary: Hannah and Joao's contempt for one another grows even stronger; strong winds leave the boat stuck at the dock; Hannah's leadership skills are challenged by Brooke and Kasey; Colin finally gets up the nerve to reveal his feelings for Brooke.

episodes.name: Stew Coup
episodes.summary: Hannah confronts Kasey and Brooke about the hierarchy of the interior; the primary charter guest asks the crew to participate in a trust exercise involving arrows; Colin gets a surprise visit that leaves him in tears.

episodes.name: One Million Percent
episodes.summary: Adam rises to the occasion with his crew meals; on the final charter of the season, a group of self-proclaimed "Daddy's Girls" come on board; Hannah and Conrad deal with the stages of a boat breakup; Joao makes a shocking admission to Kasey.

episodes.name: Definitely Not Prague
episodes.summary: The Talisman crew pulls out all the stops to end the season on a high note; Hannah picks a fight with Joao and Brooke, causing the mild-mannered Brooke to fight back; Adam delivers a final dinner that leaves the guests speechless.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.summary: Cast and crew members sit down with Andy Cohen to reflect on the highs and lows from season three.

episodes.name: Pardon Your French
episodes.summary: Capt. Sandy embarks on another season in the Mediterranean; Hannah returns as chief stew; Joao returns as bosun hoping to prove he can lead a deck team that includes his best friend, Colin; Cordon Bleu trained chef Mila takes control of the galley.

episodes.name: Recipe for Disaster
episodes.summary: The crew's first beach picnic gets off to a rocky start, leaving Colin shattered; chef Mila faces her biggest challenge yet; Joao continues to experience growing pains in his new leadership position; a crew member makes a shocking revelation.

episodes.name: Cannes You Cook?
episodes.summary: The crew comes to terms with Mila's controversial views; Capt. Sandy's friend, Dr. Jennifer Berman, returns with the expectation of leaving the dock this year; Joao struggles to motivate Jack; Colin wonders if the new crew is too bawdy for him.

episodes.name: Too Many Cooks in the Kitchen
episodes.summary: Joao confides in Capt. Sandy about his heartbreak; chef Mila continues to struggle; Hannah takes on double duty trying to please unhappy charter guests who teach Travis a valuable lesson -- that there are no pants in the South of France.

episodes.name: 99 Problems but a Chef Ain't One
episodes.summary: A recording artist charters Sirocco to shoot a music video and uses the crew as her production assistants; Jack begins to develop feelings for Aesha; Colin has a bout with the anchor chain that could leave Sirocco stranded.

episodes.name: Knot Today, Anchors
episodes.summary: Anastasia fills in as the temporary chef and Travis helps out as sous chef; the exhausted crew continues to work with a person down in each department; Ashley films her music video; João acts quickly in a dangerous situation involving the anchors.

episodes.name: All Hail the Queen
episodes.summary: The Sirocco braces for its most exclusive charter guest yet -- the Queen of Versailles; Joao faces old demons after a drunken night out as well as an increasingly defiant deck crew; a new third stew joins the boat.

episodes.name: What Eze the Problem?
episodes.summary: Hannah and Joao have a miscommunication over a guest excursion; Anastasia is forced to prepare foods that go against her vegan lifestyle for charter guest, the "Queen of Versailles;" June continues to struggle to impress Hannah.

episodes.name: A Whole Different Ball Game
episodes.summary: Former MLB player Johnny Damon comes on board with a group of rowdy friends; Jack and Travis fail to respond to an alarm; questions arise about Anastasia's food; Jack takes Aesha on a date; Travis and Joao must rescue the anchor.

episodes.name: Docked and Loaded
episodes.summary: Joao and Travis continue their deep dive to set the anchors free; baseball player Johnny Damon and his group go against the bad weather as well as a neighboring yacht owner; Sandy fields a complaint that makes her second-guess her decisions.

episodes.name: Monte Car-Loco
episodes.summary: The crew enjoys a day off at a resort in Monte Carlo, Monaco; Joao and Hannah have a heart-to-heart; Travis confronts Joao over his treatment of Aesha; Anastasia tries to regain her swagger after poor reviews from the previous charter.

episodes.name: Don't Cry for Me, Sirocco
episodes.summary: Capt. Sandy determines that one of the positions is redundant; Joao confronts Jack over his work ethic; an overwhelmed Anastasia is pushed to her breaking point; when Colin learns that someone will have to leave the boat, he makes a bold move.

episodes.name: It's Ben a Long Time
episodes.summary: Colin faces a tough decision; Anastasia accepts her new role; an all-female group of guests comes onboard, and they flirt with the crew; Jack and Aesha move in together making Travis feel isolated; a familiar face returns, and Hannah is on her toes.

episodes.name: Nauti Girls Need Love Too
episodes.summary: Guests aren't as impressed with Ben's first dinner as he'd hoped; Anastasia struggles to adjust back to her previous role; Travis stews over losing Jack to Aesha; a sudden burst of wind sends the deck team scrambling.

episodes.name: Holy Ship!
episodes.summary: Ben is determined to regain his sea legs, but Sirocco's faulty galley has other plans; Travis' latest drunken night has Sandy at the end of her rope; Jack writes poetry for Aesha; rough seas have everyone holding on for dear life.

episodes.name: Sweet White Glove o' Mine
episodes.summary: The charter guests request a White Party for their final dinner; Joao's ego gets him in hot water with Capt. Sandy; Jack enlists the crew to help him ask Aesha to be his girlfriend; Hannah's leadership skills are called into question.

episodes.name: Love, Love Me Stew
episodes.summary: The crew prepares for the final charter of the season; with Joao sidelined with a fever, Travis is forced to step up; bad weather rolls into the South of France; when Anastasia gets on Sandy's bad side, Hannah bears the brunt of the captain's fury.

episodes.name: Au Revoir, Sirocco
episodes.summary: A boat catches fire in port stranding Sirocco with nowhere to go; the interior team resents Sandy's harsh criticism; Jack and Aesha contemplate their future; Sandy calls out Hannah's lack of passion for yachting.

episodes.name: I Like Big Boats & I Cannot Lie
episodes.summary: Malia returns as Capt. Sandy's first female bosun, a role she hopes to grow into while commanding respect from her all-male deck team; Brazilian chef Kiko tries to make a good first impression; Hannah is challenged by an experienced Second Stew.

episodes.name: Can't Touch This!
episodes.summary: Hannah struggles to get her Second Stew in line; tensions boil when Lara refuses to take direction from Hannah; in the galley, Kiko finds himself up against guests who are less than satisfied; Malia is forced to draw the line with Pete.

episodes.name: The Italian's Job
episodes.summary: Romance is in bloom on the crew's first night out of the season, as Pete makes his move while Rob and Jess find themselves connecting on a deeper level; the second charter kicks off when guests with ties to the music industry arrive.

episodes.name: Ace of Stew Face
episodes.summary: With bad weather rolling in and down her Second Stew, Hannah scrambles to manage the interior with only Jess to rely on; Capt. Sandy and Malia draw a hard line with the deck team when they call the guys out for their questionable behavior.

episodes.name: Bringing the Thunder
episodes.summary: A blast from the past returns; a massive thunderstorm threatens to keep the Wellington docked for their next charter; Rob and Jessica deepen their connection, while Pete's attitude continues to frustrate Malia.

episodes.name: Oh Snap!

episodes.name: Perfect for Paradise

episodes.name: The Final Burn

the_mcbee_dynasty_real_american_cowboys.title: The McBee Dynasty: Real American Cowboys

episodes.name: Family Succession
episodes.summary: McBee Farm & Cattle is on the verge of becoming a billion-dollar business, with its success hinging on a venture capital deal worth over a hundred million dollars; Steve's four sons vie to take over the farming dynasty.

episodes.name: 100 Million-Dollar Love Triangle
episodes.summary: With a hundred-million-dollar deal in CFO Galyna's hands, Steve must make sure that his love triangle between her and another woman, Brooke, doesn't threaten it all; Steven Jr. and Cole's competition to run the farm heats up.

episodes.name: Busted
episodes.summary: Galyna's discovery that Steve is having an affair with Brooke could mean the end of the farm; Cole returns from Fort Worth, Texas, and hides his indiscretions from Kacie; Calah refuses to care about Steve's opinion of her.

episodes.name: An Ultimatum
episodes.summary: With the future of the farm at stake, Galyna issues Steve an ultimatum, and he must decide between Brooke and keeping Galyna as his CFO; the crops are threatened by a relentless drought, and the family faces haters at a local car race.

episodes.name: The Wild, Wild West
episodes.summary: When the McBees travel to Montana to pick up bison, they connect to the land with their Indigenous American hosts; back in Missouri, the girlfriends bond over their frustrations with Steve; Cole must decide to make it official with Kacie or lose her.

episodes.name: Power Moves and Paying Dues
episodes.summary: Galyna uses her leverage on the pending venture capital deal to move into Steve's house permanently, alarming his sons about her power within the company; Jesse and Cole confront Steven Jr. over their wage disparity.

episodes.name: Nashville Hot
episodes.summary: The McBee brothers get into hot water with their girlfriends when Steve insists on a bacchanal boys' trip to Nashville to get away from Galyna; Steve reveals he has another girlfriend.

episodes.name: The Women Strike Back
episodes.summary: While the McBee men party it up in Nashville, the women of the farm plot to have a party of their own with a surprise guest; Galyna gets alarming news about the venture capital deal; Steven makes a big decision regarding Calah.

episodes.name: Breaking Point
episodes.summary: With the venture capital deal in danger and Steve dating other women, Galyna is at her breaking point; Steve takes Cole under his wing, giving him the confidence to take over the farm; Jesse lashes out when his proposal plans are compromised.

episodes.name: Worst Case Scenario
episodes.summary: With the venture capital deal dead in the water, Steve spirals out of control at the "end of the season planting" party, worried that he has lost the farm; Galyna confronts Brooke over her affair with Steve; Calah issues an ultimatum to Steven.

episodes.name: Russian Roulette
episodes.summary: Eldest brother Steven has a plan to save the farm from financial ruin, but younger brother Cole has his own idea on what's best.

episodes.name: Ditched for Dallas
episodes.summary: The truth as to why Calah has been estranged from the family is revealed, forcing her to make a choice; Kristi, the McBee's mother and ex-wife of their father, joins her sons to help them through their time of need.

episodes.name: The Great Chicken Massacre
episodes.summary: Calah and Steven's relationship takes a surprising turn; Galyna finds out her former best friend, Masha, is on a romantic getaway in Mexico with her ex, Steve Sr.; Jesse gives Alli, his bride-to-be, an ultimatum.

episodes.name: Day Drinkin'
episodes.summary: When Steven suspects Galyna of drinking on the job, he plans a mediation with Masha in the hopes of ending their feud and getting the business back on track.

episodes.name: Hurricane Calah
episodes.summary: The family is met with nostalgia as they arrive at their favorite vacation destination, Lake of the Ozarks; a fun day of paintballing and day-drinking at the pool leads to a blow-up that threatens any future that Steven and Calah may have.

episodes.name: Never Seen a Rock So Big
episodes.summary: Cole sets out to win Kacie back after his poor behavior in the Ozarks with a surprise babymoon, but it may be at the cost of saving the farm.

episodes.name: Nashville Hot
episodes.summary: The McBee brothers get into hot water with their girlfriends when Steve insists on a bacchanal boys' trip to Nashville to get away from Galyna; Steve reveals he has another girlfriend.

episodes.name: Panic! On the Combine
episodes.summary: When out harvesting, Jesse suffers from intense panic attacks as his wedding day draws closer; Cole goes ring shopping for Kacie; Steven invites a surprise guest to the wedding.

episodes.name: Russian Invasion
episodes.summary: Galyna vies for an invitation to Jesse and Alli's wedding; claws come out when Masha invades Galyna's work event; Jesse wonders whether to ask Alli for a prenup.

episodes.name: Wedding Bells and Jail Cells
episodes.summary: Jesse and Alli's big day has arrived; Galyna throws Jesse and Alli's wedding day into a fit of chaos when she has a troubling encounter with the police; an update to the FBI's investigation is revealed; the newest member of the McBee Family arrives.

episodes.name: Judgement Day
episodes.summary: The McBee family is under pressure as they try to protect their business; the boys want Galyna Saltkovska fully committed, but she's focused on her daughter: "I'm learning how to draw boundaries."

episodes.name: Night of the Living Russians
episodes.summary: Cole McBee and Steven McBee Jr clash as business pressure reaches a breaking point; with everything on the line, tensions turn personal fast, I know where your mind is at right now, and it's on Allie.

episodes.name: Cash-Strapped Cash Cow
episodes.summary: The McBee boys head to Iowa for a cattle auction; with Steven absent, Jesse and Cole question his commitment to the farm over his new relationship; Cole and Kacie face a setback in their relationship; Masha tries to ingratiate herself with the McBee women.

episodes.name: Love and War
episodes.summary: Cole plans an epic proposal for Kacie. Alli confides in Kacie about the lack of intimacy in her marriage. Following a run-in with Steve's ex-girlfriend, Galyna attempts to hash out her issues with Masha.

episodes.name: Business Beef
episodes.summary: Steven makes waves when he tries to give his new girlfriend a cut of Kacie's beef tallow business; Alli confronts Jesse about their marital issues; Masha enlists an unlikely ally to help her with a photoshoot.

episodes.name: First Impressions and Final Farewells
episodes.summary: While the family is just days away from dropping their patriarch off at prison, Steven leaves town to meet his girlfriend's family in Texas; tension rises when Kacie refuses to give Steven's new girlfriend Allie a cut of her tallow skincare business.

episodes.name: Boiling Points
episodes.summary: A business disagreement threatens to destroy Kacie and Steven's friendship; Steven and his new girlfriend, Allie, find that there might be trouble in paradise; Kristi encourages Jesse to take a trip with Alli to work on their marriage.

episodes.name: What Happens in Vegas...
episodes.summary: McBee Farm & Cattle is on the brink of becoming a billion-dollar business, but it all depends on a decision from a venture capital investment firm of over one hundred million dollars. Steve McBee, the family patriarch and recent divorcée, started this farming and ranching company in rural Missouri, but his philandering may be its undoing. His affair with Galyna, the CFO, causes tension with his eldest son, Steven Jr., the CEO.
