episodes.name: Bye Bye Booty Bump
episodes.summary: Denise has a growth on her booty, but scarring from a previous trauma has kept her from getting it removed; Zachary's career is dragged down by his psoriasis; John would love to find a soulmate but will not date because of the huge bump on his cheek.

episodes.name: Hex Marks the Spot
episodes.summary: Rachael's arm bump interferes with helping her disabled bestie; medical student Gili assists Dr. Lee with Christian's painful back bump; Soniya hates the superstitions and judgments people have about the dark spots covering her face and torso.

episodes.name: Third Eye Blinded
episodes.summary: Allie's lifestyle is ruined by the gumball-sized bump above her eye; Andrew's psoriasis and multiple body bumps have held him back from starting a family; Dr. Lyndsey assists Dr. Lee with Cristina's concerning shoulder lipoma.

episodes.name: Beach Bump
episodes.summary: Jon's huge, 25-year-old shoulder blade bump is ruining his family beach days and risking his health. April wants the wedding of her dreams but feels hideous in gowns due to her bumpy underarm "growth". Dr. Zoe gets a front row seat to new father Rondel's frightening looking forearm bump.

episodes.name: My Unlovely Lady Lumps
episodes.summary: Tobi is having trouble re-entering the dating pool because of symmetrical bumps around her spine.

episodes.name: Lump in My Throat
episodes.summary: Jack searches for the confidence to try surgery on his throat bump, after fainting during a previous attempt; Kristan is a young, bubbly gym teacher who has given up on love after discovering a growth on her back; Dr. Tomassian helps Dr. Lee reconstruct Victoria's earlobes so she can feel confident enough to regain her pro skateboarding career.

episodes.name: A Mother's Lump
episodes.summary: Angela has a big, melon-sized growth on the back of her neck that she fears can ruin her daughter's wedding; Loretta is terrified that her painful can get in the way of making her movie.

episodes.name: Gone in CYST-Y Seconds
episodes.summary: John is a sweet guy trying to get over his bumpy past; Tami has yellow deposits on her eyelids that make it impossible for her to feel beautiful; Dr. Farhang helps Dr. Lee with a terrified patient, Lili, who has a lump on the back of her arm.

episodes.name: A Cheeky Bump
episodes.summary: Dave has 17 huge, painful head bumps; Melissa recently moved to a new town but her mysterious red, scaly lesions cover her legs; Glamorous dermatologist Dr. Shearer Seymour shadows Dr. Lee as they attempt to remove a pointy cyst from Sam's cheek.

episodes.name: The Danger Triangle
episodes.summary: Jeana has huge, spherical growths dangling from her ears; Alondra owns a flower shop but her painful, hydrangea-sized back bump prevents her from helping customers; Dr. Lee shows Dr. Lyndsay how to avoid the Danger Triangle.

episodes.name: A Bronx Bump
episodes.summary: Tana deals with an abusive past, and a forehead bump; Ernestine, a die-hard Yankees fan, has a huge, misshapen growth on her back; Dr. Lee teaches eager dermatology intern Dr. Hannah Tolson how to remove Foday's mystery bumps named Mama and Baby.

episodes.name: It's All in the Hips
episodes.summary: John is bound to a wheelchair and ready to give up after his legs have become too swollen, painful, and smelly; Chad's painful, giant hip growth; Dr. Farhang helps Dr. Lee with John's large cheek growth.

episodes.name: Backcountry Bump
episodes.summary: Veronica has a huge mango-sized growth on her back; Thomas has a deep passion for cosplay but is too embarrassed to dress up due to the large bump on their head; Dr. Lyndsey returns to help Dr. Lee shape former golf pro Ken's lumpy, bumpy nose.

episodes.name: A Pain In the Bump
episodes.summary: Candace is a singer and doula whose huge face bump is stealing her youth; Christian has ignored the terrifying growth hanging off his tush; Otito worries that the extreme, thickened skin on her hands and feet will end her dental career.

episodes.name: Life Lesions
episodes.summary: Dr. Tolson learns how to help Dr. Lee treat Mary Beth's bumpy, mysteriously-changing face lesions; Dr. Ortiz steps in to help Kathy, who has thousands of red dots on her body that keep her from confidently wearing a bathing suit.

episodes.name: Retraining the Brain
episodes.summary: Dr. Lee, occupational therapist, arrives to help re-train her body post-stroke; Justin arrives with a body-covering, angry rash; Dr. Lee can only observe as Dr. Farhang attempts to remove AJ's huge forehead bump.

episodes.name: Two Derms Are Better Than One
episodes.summary: As Dr. Lee continues to recover from her stroke, she calls in reinforcements from Montana, her old dermatology residency pal, Dr. Kristen Townley.

episodes.name: Painless Lee & Fearless Townley
episodes.summary: As she continues to recover from her stroke, Dr. Lee again enlists her Montana friend Dr. Kristen Townley to remove Paul's concerning windpipe bump; the doctors also try to help Kellie, who has a large, possibly vascular lump on the side of her head.

episodes.name: Cleared for Surgery!
episodes.summary: Dr. Lee is cleared to perform surgery; as she continues to rehab, she and Montana surgeon Dr. Kristen Townley work together to help Brandi, whose huge back bump is hurting her mobility and her relationship with her new boyfriend Phillip.

episodes.name: A Nosey Nuisance
episodes.summary: Brittany's home and career life are in shambles since her nose and cheeks erupted with bright red, oozing bumps. Dr. Sheila Farhang joins Dr. Lee for a lesson on how to remove John's painful, inflamed cysts.

episodes.name: Hand Me That Scalpel!
episodes.summary: Dr. Lee is ready to take the lead on her first surgery since her stroke, with Dr. Townley now assisting. Quentin has a cantaloupe-sized bump on his tricep that is ruining his mechanic career and making his girlfriend miserable.

episodes.name: Hiding Behind a Wig
episodes.summary: Craig fears the massive growth on his neck could prevent him from helping his sick mother. Gwen is covered in dry, itchy patches that are causing hair loss and devastating her confidence.

episodes.name: Pop Star
episodes.summary: Sevyn Streeter visits Dr. Lee with her friend Rose, who is concerned an unsightly shoulder lump is ruining her modeling career. Jamie is a family man who fears his young daughter is growing something that matches his angry, huge neck growth.

episodes.name: Looking for Love
episodes.summary: Charming Justin feels the thousands of bumps covering his face and body ruin his chance to find love. Reclusive Gene's girlfriend is frustrated that he will only leave the house to watch trains due to the gigantic lump on his head.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.summary: Dr. Sandra Lee, also known as Dr. Pimple Popper, is ready to take her practice to the next level. Dr. Lee will be providing intimate self-shot footage of her life outside the office.

episodes.name: 'Til Next Time, Partner
episodes.summary: Dr. Lee expresses appreciation to her friend Dr. Kristen Townley. Matline has a passion for horseback riding, but a painful bump on her back could end her time in the saddle. Steph Tolev is concerned about a head bump.

episodes.name: Killer on Campus
episodes.summary: A gunman kills a University of Kentucky football player at his birthday party; despite a house full of witnesses, no one saw the shooter; as police investigate, suspicion closes in on his closest friends who were there that night.

episodes.name: Your Smiles and Your Lies
episodes.summary: A mysterious killer murders the star of a community theater production of Fiddler on the Roof the day after a cast party. As the town grieves the artist, her friends grow concerned that the culprit is someone within their inner circle.

episodes.name: Devil in the Hallways
episodes.summary: When a California teen disappears, the whole town feels on edge; as suspicion turns inward, her closest friends begin to wonder if the danger has been beside them all along, hidden in the familiar faces of classmates with something dark to hide.

episodes.name: She's No Runaway
episodes.summary: When a middle schooler vanishes without a trace, suspicion quickly falls on the new circle of older friends she's been spending time with; as family and friends dig deeper, secrets unravel, and the line between loyalty and betrayal starts to blur.

episodes.name: Secrets to Reveal
episodes.summary: Best friends take a girl's trip before applying to grad school; when one of them doesn't make it home, everyone wonders, what happened in Vegas.

episodes.name: Friendship in Disguise
episodes.summary: A killer stabs UCLA student Ron Baker to death in a train tunnel known for its connection to the Manson murders; rumors begin to spread, until another missing friend redirects suspicion to Baker's inner circle.

episodes.name: Secret Life of a Private Eye
episodes.summary: When a woman disappears in Florida, her friends uncover a hidden life filled with new relationships and secrets. As investigators follow the trail, suspicion shifts toward someone in her inner circle who may know more than they admit.

episodes.name: Strike To Kill
episodes.summary: When an Auburn University graduate disappears, her tight-knit group of friends falls under suspicion; as investigators chase leads and rumors spread, distrust grows, until new evidence reveals a truth about someone close to her.

episodes.name: Murder Lasts Forever
episodes.summary: The murder of one of their own changes groups of friends forever; the tragic loss of a member of their inner circle, and their terrifying closeness to the killer, haunt them as they uncover secrets and confront the painful truth.

episodes.name: Rivalry Fueled Murder
episodes.summary: The murder of one of their own changes groups of friends forever; the tragic loss of a member of their inner circle, and their terrifying closeness to the killer, haunt them as they uncover secrets and confront the painful truth.

deadly_influence_the_social_media_murder.title: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders

episodes.name: Sin City Clickbait
episodes.summary: Self-styled Instagram sex and fitness guru Ash builds a life in the glitz, glamor, and excess of Las Vegas; but the wild ride ends when he becomes entangled with a lonely Sin City resident who he comes to believe holds a dark energy inside.

episodes.name: TikTok Terror
episodes.summary: As 28-year-old Sania battles through a divorce, her passionate and searingly honest TikToks attract tens of thousands of followers; but she soon discovers that members of her community want to silence her, and will stop at nothing to do it.

episodes.name: RIP Bianca
episodes.summary: Anime-obsessed teenager Bianca becomes an inspiring mental health advocate online and changes lives; but on forums and social media accounts, she discovers a horrifying and violent underbelly: young men primed to threaten, harm and attack.

episodes.name: Killer Content
episodes.summary: Teenage film reviewer Trey is building an online empire, attracting hundreds of thousands of views; but, it can't last, and soon, he finds himself dragged into a world of guns, abuse and revenge.

episodes.name: Hashtag Halloween Horror
episodes.summary: Stephanie is a feisty, lovable young woman from New Jersey, who is building a brand as a bespoke makeup and SFX artist online; but offline, her life becomes complicated and spirals into mystery when she vanishes into thin air on Halloween Eve.

episodes.name: Control, Alt, Delete
episodes.summary: A vibrant and inspiring group from Denver's creative community spreads messages of love and inclusion, attracting many online followers; soon they become the target of a hateful and violent member of the online manosphere with shocking consequences.

episodes.name: Waiting for the Darkness
episodes.summary: Nineteen-year-old Cooper dives into the LA lifestyle of TikTok viral videos, famous collaborations and content house parties; then Cooper sets up a Discord to talk about addiction and mental health with his followers, which exposes the dark side of fame.

episodes.name: Rags to Riches to Rage
episodes.summary: Derricka is a self-made millionaire and businesswoman who is not ashamed to celebrate her success; when aspiring entrepreneur Ashley reaches out on Facebook asking Derricka to be her mentor, she has a hard lesson to learn herself.

episodes.name: It Could Be You Tomorrow
episodes.summary: TikTok dance star Matima and clothing designer Quinton are both making it big on social media and gaining followers around the world; what these self-made young men don't know is that someone watching them is consumed with jealousy.

episodes.name: Enter the Ghost World
episodes.summary: YouTuber Randy Stair wants to be the master of his universe, but he struggles to make friends in real life; when the lines begin to blur between his supermarket day job and his online fantasies, he looks for control wherever he can find it.

episodes.name: Devil in Disguise
episodes.summary: April shines positivity, growing her TikTok through wholesome family content and manifesting a better future. Things are not always what they seem. After a tragic incident, April's mom gets on TikTok and uncovers secrets that shock everyone watching.

episodes.name: Cruel Intentions
episodes.summary: Hashim's small-town fame inspires a local soccer team 'Hashim United.' One day a friend's favor pulls him into a world he cannot escape.

episodes.name: Death Is in Your Stars
episodes.summary: Online astrologer, healer, and witch Danielle is a rising mystic influencer. When critics emerge and a man falls for her charm, their magic takes a darker turn, with curses flying and those closest to her caught in the firing line.

episodes.name: Reintroduction to Top Tonkatsu
episodes.summary: People may not know that they've been eating Tonkatsu for years; Rachel reintroduces people to her version of the dish; fried pork chops, served with an umami-rich sauce.

episodes.name: White Ragu With Papardelle
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make a white, quick cooking Ragù sauce that she serves over ribbony pappardelle pasta, cooked al dente style.

episodes.name: Spaghetti With Semi-Dried Tomato Pesto & Broccolini
episodes.summary: Rachael demonstrates how to use semi-dried tomatoes, a fairly new staple in American grocery stores, as the star in her recipe for a pesto that's paired with broccolini and served with sausage.

episodes.name: Spicy Charred Tomato Pasta With Hot Sausage or Chickpeas
episodes.summary: Rachael spices up a charred tomato sauce in pasta dinner in two ways, in minutes; in one dish, she serves the pasta over sausage and in the other dish she pairs the pasta with chickpeas that are seasoned for heat.

episodes.name: Pork Chops Pizzaiola
episodes.summary: Rachael is coming in strong with this flavorful pork chop pizzaiola recipe made with blistered tomatoes, onions and garlic cooked a la plancha style.

episodes.name: Make Your Own Pad Thai
episodes.summary: Pad Thai is a crowd favorite and less intimidating than one might think to make; this recipe literally takes minutes to make, so much so that Rachael makes the recipe twice with shrimp and chicken.

episodes.name: Impossibly Delicious Brunch
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make a brunch menu of parm frittata with tomato sauce, served with a side of sausage and a simple salad that can be served all day.

episodes.name: Greek Meatballs and Spaghetti With Feta Sauce
episodes.summary: Rachael goes on a Grecian adventure from her kitchen with a recipe for Greek-style lamb meatballs and her very own creation, feta-sghetti, a spaghetti dish served with a decadent white feta sauce.

episodes.name: Chicken Chow Fun
episodes.summary: Features Rachel demonstrating how to make takeout at home and how to stock the pantry for the recipe called Chicken Chow Fun, a Chinese-American takeout favorite with a rice-noodle base, chicken and vegetables.

episodes.name: Fastest Arroz con Pollo
episodes.summary: Arroz con pollo or chicken and rice is a traditional Latin American dish loved by millions worldwide; Rachael shows how to make it quickly and easily so that it becomes a household staple.

episodes.name: Spicy Chicken Thighs
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares a family-friendly, go-to meal of sautéed chicken thighs marinated with chili crisp, cooked with mango salsa, and served with steamed vegetables.

episodes.name: Tangy Creamy Vinegar Chicken
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to whip up a French-country inspired tangy, creamy chicken dinner with vinegar and tarragon; it is served alongside a simple salad and baguette with soft butter.

episodes.name: Khua Kling
episodes.summary: On a "Make Your Own Takeout" night, Rachael teaches how to create her version of Khua Kling, a Thai stir-fry dish; it is made with ground beef, lime leaf, red curry paste and more; it is served with short-grain rice.

episodes.name: Manila Clams
episodes.summary: Rachael demonstrates how to make flavorful Manila clams that can serve two people, a group of four, or even a large gathering of twenty guests; she also cooks up a side dish of warm zucchini and corn salad with charred ciabatta bread.

episodes.name: Charred Mediterranean Chicken Salad With Olives and Tahini Yogurt Sauce
episodes.summary: Rachael teaches how to make an Israeli inspired tahini-based yogurt sauce with harissa that she's serving over charred chicken and family-style pita.

episodes.name: Crab Nachos and Steak Tacos
episodes.summary: Surf and turf is a great combo; make that combo even better by combining it with taco night; Rachael shows how to make the ultimate date night combo of crab nachos and steak tacos.

episodes.name: Stellar Chicken With Dijon
episodes.summary: Rachael Ray prepares a sautéed chicken dinner served with sautéed vegetables and flavored with heavy cream, Dijon mustard and imported beer.

episodes.name: Crispy Fish Tacos
episodes.summary: Rachael Ray expertly prepares a crispy flake cod fish taco and serves it with a side of refried beans.

episodes.name: Sweet Onion Burgers With Blue Cheese and Special Sauce
episodes.summary: Rachael cooks plant-based burgers; sautéed onions and a blue cheese sauce top the flavorful patties.

episodes.name: Pork Cutlets With Huckleberry Sauce
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make a family favorite recipe of pork cutlets with a fruity and savory huckleberry sauce; she serves them with potato salad, Broccolini, and fresh cherry tomatoes.

episodes.name: Mediterranean Charred Chicken Salad With Scallion Pesto
episodes.summary: Rachael shows a new take on traditional pesto sauce with a base of herbs and charred onions, that pairs with a Mediterranean chicken salad.

episodes.name: Lamb and Beef Chorizo Chili
episodes.summary: Rachael reinvents chili by combining lamb and beef chorizo for a bold, hearty twist; John shakes things up with his margarita creation, the Amaro-Rita, while Maria bakes a savory scallion and black pepper cornbread to complete the meal.

episodes.name: Skirt Steaks With Roasted Vegetables
episodes.summary: Rachael turns pantry staples into a flavorful feast, starting with roasted potatoes, broccoli, garlic and tomatoes.

episodes.name: White Bean Soup With Albanian Snacks and Baklava
episodes.summary: Rachael and her sister Maria, joined by friends Leida and Vina, cook up a feast in Rachael's Tuscan kitchen.

episodes.name: Chicken Meatballs With Oatmeal
episodes.summary: Savory chicken meatballs with oatmeal, topped with raisins, pine nuts and honey.

episodes.name: Spicy Bucatini all'Amatriciana With Beans and Greens
episodes.summary: Rachael cooks up all of John's favorite dishes, starting with her spicy-sweet Bucatini all'Amatriciana, a pasta dish inspired by her mother's all-America recipe.

episodes.name: Italian Brisket With Gremolata, Polenta and Sautéed Greens
episodes.summary: Rachael shows the ultimate way to beat the winter chill with her irresistible Italian brisket.

episodes.name: Chicken Under a Brick With Herb Salsa Verde
episodes.summary: Rachael adds a delicious twist to a classic chicken dinner with her recipe for Chicken Under a Brick.

episodes.name: Beet Risotto and Arancini Balls
episodes.summary: To celebrate her wedding anniversary, Rachael prepares her well-known beet risotto that's made with roasted beets, red wine, onions and ricotta salata; she also uses the rice leftovers to make flavorful arancini balls with peas and breadcrumbs.

episodes.name: Lucca Style Pesto Pasta or Trenette Al Pesto
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares a classic pesto sauce using fresh basil, roasted pistachios and pine nuts, combined with Pecorino and Parmigiano cheeses; she then cooks it Lucca style with potatoes and green beans and serves it over large pasta.

episodes.name: Chicken Scarpariello With S.E. Cupp
episodes.summary: Political commentator and Rachael's friend S.E. Cupp joins Rachael in her upstate kitchen to learn how to prepare Chicken Scarpiello, a classic Italian-American chicken dish that is baked and sautéed alongside sausages and onions.

episodes.name: Hawaiian Style Sloppy Joes
episodes.summary: Rachael makes a new version of sloppy Joes, a quintessential family favorite dinner, by adding pineapple, peppers and garlic and serving it on Hawaiian-style sweet buns.

episodes.name: Korean Fried Chicken
episodes.summary: Korean fried chicken is one of John's favorite dishes; Rachael prepares this sweet and spicy meal at home and shows how to pair the dish with Persian cucumbers, daikon radishes and kimchi, all served on sweet hot rolls.

episodes.name: Halibut Fish Tacos
episodes.summary: Rachael cooks a flavorful Mexican-style dish of halibut fish tacos along with Pico de Gallo and John serves up a tall glass of refreshing watermelon Margaritas.

episodes.name: Beer Batter Fish Fry
episodes.summary: As a child, Rachael and her family often enjoyed fish fry dinners in Cape Cod; her mother served countless fish fry meals in her restaurant; Rachael shows how to make the dish at home with her favorite yogurt-based tartar sauce, plated with fries.

episodes.name: Chili for Maria
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to prepare her sister's favorite meal, a chili recipe made with black beans, chopped meat, spices and topped with a blend of cheeses.

episodes.name: Soy Meat Asian Tacos
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares a flavorful Korean-style taco with a spicy, soy-based recipe that combines salty and sweet ingredients.

episodes.name: Lasagna alla Bolognese
episodes.summary: Rachael shares her tips for making a delicious, authentic lasagna; she uses egg pasta and guanciale and layers it with marinara and béchamel sauce.

episodes.name: Korean Rice Cakes
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make a marinated, vegetable-infused dish of Tteokbokki, a popular Korean food made from rice cakes.

episodes.name: Dill Popcorn Shrimp
episodes.summary: Rachael incorporates her favorite flavor combinations in a recipe for dill popcorn shrimp.

episodes.name: Simple Beef Stew
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make a hearty beef stew that is both versatile and delicious and serves it with her mother's famous pucky huddle potato fries.

episodes.name: Grilled Sea Bass
episodes.summary: Rachael teams up with her friend Dr. Will Li, an author and medical scientist whose work focuses on eating for well-being and longevity; they prepare a healthy meal of grilled sea bass and sautéed baby bok choy.

episodes.name: Armenian Easter
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to prepare a traditional Armenian Easter feast of stuffed cabbage rolls, baked rainbow trout and sweet and savory glazed fruit and potatoes.

episodes.name: Poblano Nachos
episodes.summary: Rachael brings a taste of Mexico to Lake George with her twist on Chile Relleno stuffed Poblano peppers; her version is filled with tortilla chips, cheese and pinto bean dip.

episodes.name: Chicken Flautas
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make her version of Mexican Flautas using rotisserie chicken, green chiles, and a blend of three cheeses, all rolled up and fried in tortillas; John prepares a batch of Mexican Martinis.

episodes.name: More Chicken Chow Fun
episodes.summary: Rachael raids her well-stocked pantry to make Chicken Chow Fun, a fan-favorite recipe centered around wavy Chinese noodles, paired with chicken, sautéed vegetables, and traditional Chinese sauces.

episodes.name: Seafood Fra Diavolo
episodes.summary: Rachael whips up one of John's favorite meals, Seafood Fra Diavolo, a combination of shellfish and pasta tossed with a spicy, tomato-based sauce.

episodes.name: Italian Flag Pasta
episodes.summary: Rachael celebrates the Italian flag by making three different pastas in all three of its colors; She breaks down the steps to make a delicious cacio e pepe with copious amounts of cheese and a pesto pasta with toasted Sicilian.

episodes.name: Ensalada de Camarones
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares a delicious Puerto Rican-style cold shrimp salad, also known as Ensalada de Camarones, with avocado, corn, and rice that's perfect for serving as the weather warms up.

episodes.name: Reuben Hot Dogs
episodes.summary: Rachael combines her favorite Reuben sandwich with America's summer favorite, hot dogs, to create a memorable meal served with fries.

episodes.name: Panzanella Salad With Spicy Mussels
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares Panzanella, a bread salad with tomatoes, and serves it with spicy mussels.

episodes.name: Peruvian Style Chicken
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares a Peruvian-style roasted chicken dish with ají amarillo and serves it with blue potatoes.

episodes.name: Ain't Your Momma's Tater Tot Casserole
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares a new summery take on a beloved American dish, the tater tot casserole; her sister Maria rounds out the meal with a homemade, seasonal berry cobbler.

episodes.name: Honey Hot Chicken With Corn
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to cook hot honey chicken, a dish made with seasoned chicken thighs, which she serves with charred corn on the cob; Maria prepares Rachael's favorite cherry pie, and John makes an adult milkshake paired with bourbon.

episodes.name: Pasta With Guanciale and Peas
episodes.summary: Rachael makes a pasta dish with a creamy pea sauce that's layered with fresh pecorino cheese, baby greens, and sautéed Guanciale, an Italian salt-cured meat coated with sage and rosemary.

episodes.name: Beef Fajitas and Bean Dip Nachos
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make a beef fajita dinner cooked a la plancha; the beef is marinated in a spicy sauce, served on charred tortillas, and accompanied by a platter of decadent bean dip nachos.

episodes.name: Stuffed Tomatoes and Olive Leaf Pasta
episodes.summary: Rachael brings a taste of Italy to Upstate New York with her stuffed tomatoes and olive leaf pasta; the baked tomatoes are filled with a flavorful anchovy and breadcrumb mixture, while the spinach pasta is tossed in a yellow tomato sauce.

episodes.name: Between the Buns S'Mac Dogs
episodes.summary: Rachael kicks off summer with a fun and indulgent meal that will get everyone running to the table; she starts with S'mac dogs, beef hot dogs on cheesy buns topped with a special sauce inspired by a fast-food favorite.

episodes.name: Chili Crisp Hot Wings and Moo Shu Pork Lettuce Cups
episodes.summary: Rachael makes two takeout favorites at home, starting with chili crisp hot wings marinated overnight in Shaoxing wine and smoked soy sauce.

episodes.name: Beef Brutus
episodes.summary: Rachael revisits her classic Beef Brutus, a steak and Caesar salad dish she created while writing her first cookbook, this time adding crispy bacon and smoked blue cheese crumbles.

episodes.name: Speck & Saffron Carbonara With Stone Fruit Panzanella
episodes.summary: Rachael puts a spin on John's favorite Roman classic, carbonara, by layering in the flavors of speck and a hint of saffron; to balance it out, she serves a take on panzanella, the beloved Tuscan bread and tomato salad.

episodes.name: Mexican-Style Hot Brown
episodes.summary: Rachael puts a spicy twist on a hot brown sandwich by adding jalapeño bacon, shredded pepper jack cheese and Mexican flavors.

episodes.name: Bruschett-O-Rama
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make five delicious bruschettas featuring onion, puttanesca, mushroom, artichoke, and beet. Meanwhile, John keeps things cool with a light and refreshing Iced Tea Aperol Spritz made with unsweetened sangria-flavored iced tea.

episodes.name: Chicken Parm Patty Melts
episodes.summary: Rachael puts a bold Italian spin on a classic patty melt with her chicken parmesan version, loaded with Italian seasoning, topped with mozzarella and provolone, and served with fries and a red sauce for dipping. To go with it, John mixes up Roseberry Martinis made with muddled rosemary, fresh raspberries, gin, and a few extra touches.

episodes.name: Pesto Pasta & Chicken Cutlet
episodes.summary: Rachael brings the flavor with her Lemon Lover's Chicken Cutlets and Pesto Pasta. She whips up a vibrant pesto loaded with fresh basil, cheeses, hazelnuts, and roasted pine nuts, then tosses it with Italian pasta. Her signature chicken cutlets get a zesty upgrade with lemon in the breadcrumbs, finished with grilled lemons on top, turning a classic favorite into a tangy, show-stopping dish.

episodes.name: Shrimp Salad Stuffed Shells
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares sautéed red shrimp with homemade stock, served over a vibrant vegetable salad. John mixes a Pre-Prohibition Martini with a spicy kick, and Rachael's friend, Giancarla, joins her to make a tray of delicious baked large shell pasta.

episodes.name: Sloppy Joes
episodes.summary: Rachael puts a flavorful spin on the classic American favorite, Sloppy Joes, by sautéing a savory mix of ground beef and beef chorizo with fresh vegetables and bold seasonings, all piled high on brioche buns. To complement the meal, John shakes up a Calvados Sidecar, giving the classic cocktail a brandy twist with a rich, flavorful kick.

episodes.name: Saffron Pasta
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares saffron pasta paired with boneless chicken breasts sautéed with saffron, carrots, citrus, fennel and more; John mixes up a blood orange mule made with freshly squeezed blood orange juice and vodka.

episodes.name: Golden Gnocchi with Roast Beef Tenderloin and Roasted Garlic Au Jus
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares gnocchi from scratch, cooking them in butter and sage, and pairs it with a juicy roast tenderloin served alongside sautéed greens; John crafts a classic martini infused with bergamot liqueur for a citrusy twist.

episodes.name: Cinghiale Ragu With Pici
episodes.summary: Rachael creates a hearty ragù sauce using sautéed vegetables and locally-sourced Cinghiale meat, pairing it with Pici, a Tuscan pasta similar to a thicker spaghetti.

episodes.name: Dirty Martini Chicken With Olive Leaf Pasta
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares a simple yet flavorful braised Dirty Martini Chicken, paired with a rich brown butter sage pasta; to complement the dish, John puts a unique spin on the classic White Lady Cocktail, creating his own version, the La Donna Rosa.

episodes.name: Cacciucco
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to cook like an Italian local with her recipe for a rustic Tuscan fish stew, Cacciucco; to complement the meal, John is mixing up a Castaway Cocktail, a refreshing blend of limoncello, rosemary and vodka.

episodes.name: Lamb Chops with Dr. Ian
episodes.summary: Dr. Ian joins Rachael in her upstate kitchen to cook one of his mom's favorite dishes, spiced lamb chops topped with Rachael's mom's signature mint sauce; for dessert, he shares his aunt's famous sweet potato pie.

episodes.name: Fishwiches
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to recreate a world-famous fast food fish sandwich at home, complete with her signature tartar sauce and served on soft brioche buns with crispy french fries; John mixes up a strawberry gin cocktail inspired by a legendary band.

episodes.name: Curry Fried Chicken With Hot Honey
episodes.summary: Rachael takes fried chicken up a notch with a homemade curry and yogurt marinade; John makes an iced mint tea mule; Maria shares her recipe for buttery poppy seed biscuits to serve alongside the chicken.

episodes.name: Eggplant Subs
episodes.summary: Rachael turns a classic eggplant sub into a sausage-style sandwich with a punchy blend of pantry spices; John shakes up a smoky bourbon Manhattan; Maria adds a sweet finish with spumoni cookies.

episodes.name: Italian Dips
episodes.summary: Rachael puts an Italian spin on a classic French dip; marinating steak in bold Italian seasonings for a warm, comforting sandwich perfect for cooler days; John joins in with a nod to his roots.

episodes.name: Smoky Turkey Chili and Tacos
episodes.summary: Rachael cooks up a comforting, smoky turkey chili that's perfect served in a bowl or wrapped in a taco shell; she complements the dish with zesty poblano green rice, fresh pico de gallo and a creamy guacamole to make a flavorful meal for her Upstate.

episodes.name: Thai Green Curry MYOTO
episodes.summary: MYOTO is a phrase that Rachel came up with years ago; it's short for make your own takeout; Rachel's intention behind it is to encourage people to recreate restaurant meals in their own kitchens; she brings this idea to life with a Thai green curry.

episodes.name: BBQ Burgers With Bean Dip Sauce
episodes.summary: Rachel shows how to make a homemade burger with housemade barbecue sauce, American cheese, crispy bacon and a pinto-bean dip, skipping the drive-thru.

episodes.name: BLT Buffalo Chicken Clubs
episodes.summary: Rachael builds the ultimate buffalo chicken club with baked bacon, thick smoked blue cheese dressing and toasted white bread with lettuce and tomato; John serves "John Daly" cocktails, vodka versions of the Arnold Palmer, made with rooibos red tea.

episodes.name: Lemon Pepper Pasta with Chicken and Nduja Deviled Eggs
episodes.summary: A taste of Italy with a meal starting with decadent deviled eggs stuffed with nduja, a spicy Calabrian salami spread; she prepares lemon pepper pasta served alongside sautéed chicken cutlets, leeks and cheese; Green Lantern cocktail with chartreuse.

episodes.name: Steak Out
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make a restaurant-quality flank steak cooked in a skillet, topped with spinach sauce and served alongside roasted vegetables and a side salad.

episodes.name: Tray Bake Dinner
episodes.summary: Rachael seasons chicken cutlets, coats them in a creamy sour cream sauce, cheese and breadcrumbs and then bakes them; she follows with a tray of green beans, potatoes and tomatoes tossed with herbs and roasted.

episodes.name: Fried Shrimp Poppers and Deviled Popcorn
episodes.summary: Rachael brings the party to her upstate kitchen with a fun and festive spread. She serves crispy fried jumbo shrimp stuffed with jalapeño cream cheese and wrapped in bacon. Alongside, there's spicy deviled popcorn, and John mixes up Lagaritas, a refreshing cocktail that combines cold beer with a classic margarita.

episodes.name: Taco Tuesday Twist
episodes.summary: Rachael spices up Taco Tuesday with two flavorful recipes inspired by Korean cuisine. She starts with Sesame-Sriracha Chicken Tostadas bursting with bold, marinated flavors. Then she whips up beef tacos sautéed in a special sauce and served on smoky charred tortillas. Both dishes are perfectly paired with a tangy side of kimchi.

episodes.name: Skillet Shepherd's Pie with the Works
episodes.summary: Rachael makes a classic shepherd's pie with browned ground beef and sautéed vegetables, elevated by her rich mashed potato topping made from hand-milled potatoes blended with sour cream, onion, and cheddar cheese.

episodes.name: Poke Party and Rice Bowls
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how fun and easy it can be to make a homemade poke bowl, a popular Hawaiian dish featuring diced raw fish tossed in sauce and served over rice, which happens to be a favorite of her sister Maria. To complement the meal, John mixes a Maria Tai, a white rum-based twist on the classic Mai Tai, served over ice.

episodes.name: Italian Chicken Sausage with Fennel
episodes.summary: Rachael roasts Italian chicken sausages over fennel, green grapes, and garlic drizzled with balsamic vinegar, serving them alongside crisp, flavorful bruschetta. John mixes White Wine Cranberry Spritzers with muddled rosemary for a bright, refreshing finish.

episodes.name: Loaded Street Corn Nachos and Carne Asada Salad
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to bring the festive spirit of Cinco de Mayo to any day with her indulgent street corn nachos loaded with Mexican crema. She also whips up a vibrant carne asada salad featuring sautéed skirt steak, a fresh mix of lettuce, and a zesty avocado dressing. To keep the celebration going, John shakes up a tequila-based cocktail he calls the Margarita Piña Colada.

episodes.name: Harissa & Fire-Roasted Tomato Spaghetti with Speck and Toasted Almonds
episodes.summary: Speck, a smoked prosciutto coated in black pepper, is one of Rachael's favorite ingredients, and she puts it to good use in her original recipe for Harissa and Fire-Roasted Tomato Spaghetti. The bold pasta dish is finished with toasted almonds and served alongside charred artichokes. To complement the meal, John mixes up two playful adult fountain drinks made with fresh cherries and vodka.

episodes.name: Who Ya Calling Meatball?
episodes.summary: Rachael puts a fresh spin on the classic Tuscan cacciatore by making flavorful baked chicken meatballs paired with creamy ricotta mashed potatoes. This comforting, hearty meal comes together quickly and delivers a big flavor.

episodes.name: Salsa Verde Chicken Tortilla Soup
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares a hearty, protein-packed Salsa Verde Chicken Tortilla Soup that's comforting, delicious, and filling. Meanwhile, John shakes up a refreshing "White Wedding" cocktail topped with a cucumber garnish.

episodes.name: Beet Risotto
episodes.summary: Rachael demonstrates her creativity and flair from her personal home kitchen, cooking a complete meal in minutes from comfort food to sophisticated fare for entertaining.

episodes.name: MYOTO: Make Your Own Takeout Indian Food
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to bring the flavors of your favorite Indian restaurant to your kitchen with her easy and flavorful Green Tikka Masala, served alongside naan and basmati rice. To complement the meal, John crafts a refreshing Raspberry Mule.

episodes.name: Mighty Migas Frittata
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make a hearty Migas Frittata packed with eggs, chorizo, and cheese, served alongside her homemade salsa and fresh pico de gallo. While it cooks, John shakes up an adult fountain drink made with coffee liqueur and vodka.

episodes.name: Make Your Own Takeout: Thai Chicken and Basil
episodes.summary: When Rachael's Upstate New York home leaves her short on takeout options, she turns to her favorite solution: MYOTO, or Make Your Own Takeout. This time, she's cooking up a vibrant Thai Chicken and Basil stir-fry loaded with vegetables and Thai chilies, served over jasmine rice. To complete the meal, John mixes a Thai Collins, his fresh twist on the classic Tom Collins made with gin, muddled peppers, basil, and more.

episodes.name: Pork Burgers with Veggies and Mozzarella
episodes.summary: From her kitchen in Upstate New York, Rachael recreates an unforgettable Tuscan-inspired burger. Served on a fluffy kaiser roll with fresh tomatoes, this hearty pork burger is topped with melted mozzarella and provolone, layered with roasted zucchini, eggplant, and peppers, and served alongside scooped fries with a rich balsamic ketchup for dipping.

episodes.name: Have Yourself a Berry-Licious Dinner
episodes.summary: Rachael serves up a surprising spin on pasta, starring sweet, tangy strawberries macerated in rich balsamic and tossed with sautéed shallots, cheese, and perfectly cooked noodles. To keep the berry vibes going, John blends a Roman Holiday cocktail.

episodes.name: Ukrainian Cod with Spicy Tomato Sauce and Egg Noodles
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make traditional Ukrainian cod with spicy tomato sauce served over egg noodles. Meanwhile, John prepares a Fresh Pickle Martini made with freshly muddled cucumber.

episodes.name: Sliders, Skewers & Summer Sips
episodes.summary: Rachael brings the flavor outdoors with a showstopping dinner that starts with her signature deviled egg Caesar salad. Then it's on to rich and spicy deviled egg sliders, followed by sizzling shrimp and Portuguese chouriço skewers hot off the grill. To top it all off, John shakes up a color-changing margarita that's as fun as it is refreshing.

episodes.name: Popcorn Chicken with Dill-Cheddar Popcorn
episodes.summary: Rachael creates the ultimate movie night meal with her buttermilk-battered, deep-fried popcorn chicken paired with stove-popped dill-cheddar popcorn. Meanwhile, John mixes a refreshing and citrusy Yuzu Lychee Vodka Collins.

episodes.name: Two Little Piggies
episodes.summary: Rachael shares two irresistible snackable suppers for fans of pigs in a blanket that will have everyone coming back for more. She begins with her Everything Piggy, featuring mustard, scallion cream cheese, and a generous sprinkle of everything seasoning. Next, she turns up the heat with a popper-style version loaded with jalapeño, bacon, cheese, and taco sauce.

episodes.name: Pigs in a Poncho
episodes.summary: Pigs in a blanket are classic finger foods, but when you're craving a full meal, Rachael delivers with her Pigs in a Poncho. This decadent dish combines hot dogs, refried beans, cheese, and salsa for a deliciously satisfying twist. Meanwhile, John mixes two classic cocktails to create the Negron-aria, a refreshing tequila-based drink served over ice with a bright orange wedge.

episodes.name: Lemon Zucchini Pasta
episodes.summary: Rachael whips up a bright, vegetable-forward lemon pasta with garden-fresh zucchini sautéed with shallots and finished with parsley, chives, and peppers. Across the kitchen island, John stirs up a refreshing Hugo Spritz, blending muddled mint and elderflower liqueur and topping it with sparkling white wine.

episodes.name: Mafalde Capricciosa
episodes.summary: Rachael puts a spin on the classic Capricciosa pizza, known for its mix of mushrooms, ham, and artichokes, by turning it into a hearty pasta made with ruffle-edged mafalde noodles. While she cooks, John stirs up a Bronx Cocktail, a pre-Prohibition martini variation with a touch of orange juice for a bright, citrusy finish.

episodes.name: Deviled Eggs with Ham and Cheese and Burgers
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares deviled eggs with ham and cheese alongside beef and pork burgers with beets. John complements the meal with a Vodka Beet Fizz, a martini-style cocktail featuring muddled rosemary and a splash of club soda.

episodes.name: Super-Fast Saganaki
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to make Saganaki, a Greek favorite, with large shrimp, diced tomatoes, Kalamata olives and feta cheese sautéed in a large saucepan and served over toasted orzo topped with pistachios and pine nuts. John uses the feta brine from the Saganaki to craft a Dirty Greek Martini, a gin-based cocktail with dry vermouth, garnished with a feta-stuffed pepperoncini.

episodes.name: All Fired Up for Fritters and Steak
episodes.summary: Rachael prepares a delicious, flavorful meal featuring golden corn fritters with sweet chili sauce and pickles, paired with perfectly seared skirt steaks finished with a squeeze of lime. John crafts a Naked and Famous, a sweet and smoky cocktail made with mezcal, lime juice, yellow chartreuse and Aperol.

episodes.name: Mexi-Brunch, Lunch, or Dinner
episodes.summary: Rachael whips up a BLD, a meal perfect for brunch, lunch or dinner, starting with bacon and black bean tacos loaded with cheese, followed by a hearty chicken chili with roasted green chiles. John shakes up a Salsa Verde Margarita, a refreshing tequila cocktail with muddled jalapeño and cucumber.

episodes.name: Show Me Your Mussels
episodes.summary: Rachael shows how to pick and prepare mussels for one of her favorite meals, Mussels with Tomato Saffron Sauce served over a bed of linguine. While she's cooking, John mixes a frothy Saffron Gin Fizz with saffron-infused simple syrup, egg white, and club soda for a bright, sparkling cocktail that complements the dish.

episodes.name: Mushroom, Truffle, and Green Tomato Pizzas
episodes.summary: Rachael throws a homemade pizza party with Mushroom and Summer Truffle Pizzas featuring sautéed creamy mushrooms and black truffles, alongside Green Tomato Pizzas with spicy ricotta and fresh mozzarella. John stirs up a Summer Rosato Spritz, a refreshing sangria-based drink with muddled berries and a splash of seltzer.

episodes.name: Palm Desert-ed
episodes.summary: John, Steph, Sammy, JJ, and Krista-a group of friends, take the vacation of a lifetime in Palm Springs, but when a secret relationship is discovered, it threatens to tear the group, and the trip, apart.

episodes.name: Mirage a Trois
episodes.summary: John uncovers the truth about Steph and Sammy's history, but Sammy's flirting with Krista pushes tensions to the edge; when Steph invites Krista's potential love interest Anthony into the mix, jealousy erupts, ending in a blowout fight.

episodes.name: Palm Springs State of Mind Games
episodes.summary: Krista's roaring 20s birthday bash brings glamour, jealousy, and surprise guests as Sammy and Steph's messy love triangle creates new suspicions; JJ confronts her past, and Krista takes a big climb toward independence.

episodes.name: Sandals, Scandals, and Secrets
episodes.summary: Krista's birthday party sparks drama as Sammy distances himself from Steph after their kiss; Anthony pursues Krista, while JJ and John grow closer; after a night of Drag Bingo, John shares a shocking secret that leaves JJ stunned.

episodes.name: Feta-d Up in Paradise
episodes.summary: Steph and John come clean about the secret relationships complicating their lives; Steph's Greek-themed celebration spirals into chaos when Krista confronts Sammy about the messy love triangle threatening to tear the group apart.

episodes.name: Drama in the Dry Heat
episodes.summary: The fallout from Greek Night intensifies as Sammy sides with Krista, leaving Steph blindsided. When Krista overhears Steph calling her a name, tensions explode. As relationships are redefined, Krista wants the apology she feels she's owed to move forward.

episodes.name: Desert Heat and Cold Shoulders
episodes.summary: Krista's first date with Anthony is overshadowed by lingering drama — and a new crush; as tensions over chores boil over, JJ and Steph bond on a bold outing, while a night out leaves the girls questioning Krista's intentions.

episodes.name: More to Love
episodes.summary: A group of young, single little people friends takes the vacation of a lifetime, adapting to an average-height world while balancing hookups, heartbreak and challenges unique to their size.

episodes.name: Washington Parish Jail
episodes.summary: Over-capacity and on the brink, Louisiana's Washington Parish Jail is spiraling into chaos; the new sheriff struggles to bring stability and control while facing the mistakes of the past.

episodes.name: Leake County Jail
episodes.summary: In rural Leake County, Mississippi, a small jail battles a big meth problem; with repeat offenders entering the jail daily, local law enforcement works to break the cycle.

episodes.name: Clayton County Jail
episodes.summary: Behind the walls of Clayton County Jail, deteriorating infrastructure creates dangerous conditions for both inmates and staff.

episodes.name: Caddo Parish Correctional Center
episodes.summary: Caddo Parish Correctional Center is struggling with a staffing shortage, the inmates outnumber the deputies by 180 to one; to ensure the safety of both inmates and staff alike, the Emergency Response Team springs into action.

episodes.name: Virginia Beach Correctional Center
episodes.summary: Virginia Beach is a party town with a vibrant nightlife, making its Correctional Center one of the busiest city jails in the state; here, some inmates arrive to go on vacation, then leave on probation, and return on a violation.

episodes.name: Bristol County Jail
episodes.summary: In Bristol County Jail, half of the cells don't lock; as changing demographics bring in more violent, gang-affiliated criminals, staff must manage a higher-risk population without the facility slipping into chaos.

episodes.name: Butler County Jail
episodes.summary: Inside Butler County Jail, a six-term sheriff and his seasoned staff confront an opioid crisis; as drugs flood the facility, officers work to dismantle the supply ring and maintain order.

episodes.name: Washoe County Jail
episodes.summary: Inside one of Nevada's busiest jails, deputies battle a non-stop surge of arrests driven by Reno's constant crime and a major trafficking corridor; with gangs entrenched inside, keeping rival groups apart becomes a daily fight for control.

episodes.name: Clay County Detention Center
episodes.summary: In Clay County, Mississippi, where gun deaths are an epidemic and the median income sits 66% below the national average, Sheriff Scott and his team fight to keep order inside a jail where the consequences of a community in crisis arrive daily.

episodes.name: Tangipahoa Parish Jail
episodes.summary: In Bloody Tangipahoa, a new sheriff takes on a parish defined by violence, fighting to pull a crumbling, neglected jail back from the brink while inmates work to rebuild the family bonds that could keep them from coming back.

episodes.name: Suffolk County Correctional Facility
episodes.summary: As an opioid epidemic grips the county, a law-and-order sheriff uses rehabilitation to help inmates break the cycle of addiction while officers work around the clock to maintain safety, security and order inside one of New York's busiest jails.

episodes.name: Wood County Jail
episodes.summary: After nearly two decades of economic decline and a surge in methamphetamine use, Wood County, Wisconsin opened a new $93 million jail, where staff face mounting pressure to help a community searching for a way forward.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: After serving 15 years in prison, Daniel Gallagher is paroled; in the past, Dan celebrates his 40th birthday and first meets the colleague whose death would eventually lead to his incarceration.

episodes.name: The Movie in Your Mind
episodes.summary: An intensely passionate connection turns sour when Dan realizes Alex wants more from him than the impression she's been giving; in the present Dan's loved ones reel from his reappearance in their lives; Dan and Mike are reunited.

episodes.name: The Watchful Heart
episodes.summary: A look into Alex's personal and professional life outside of Dan and a retelling of the events of their affair from her perspective; Dan reconnects with Beth and hoping to find evidence to exonerate himself.

episodes.name: Beautiful Mosaics
episodes.summary: A retelling of the emotional impact of Dan's betrayal from the perspective of Dan's wife, Beth; Beth meets potential buyers for the house they are leaving and tries to ignore the gut feeling that something is not right in her marriage.

episodes.name: Medial Woman
episodes.summary: Dan decides to confess to Beth about his affair with Alex, while Alex's actions against the Gallaghers only get more severe; Dan's fate is already sealed; Ellen bonds with a new friend while Dan meets an old colleague for lunch and information.

episodes.name: The Dillingers
episodes.summary: Alex's world before she met Dan is reflected through two people whose kindness and help she was incapable of accepting; Dan's world crashes down around him after he is arrested for killing Alex, and he must enlist an unlikely source for help.

episodes.name: Best Friends
episodes.summary: In the present, Dan prepares the application for his new trial; looking into the past, Dan prepares his defense with Cabral; key moments in Alex's life shape the woman she becomes.

episodes.name: Caregiving
episodes.summary: The collision course Dan set for everyone around him plays out in both the past and present; Dan tries to move forward with regret and honesty, agreeing to continue at Jorge's firm and revealing to Ellen that the judge denied his appeal.

episodes.name: Ex Marks the Spot
episodes.summary: Jonathan Knight and his team surprise a divorced couple and their three children, who all still live together; with a transformative 72-hour kitchen remodel that turns a dysfunctional space into a true family hub.

episodes.name: Loo With a View
episodes.summary: Jon Knight and his team stun Holly and Ed, who run a blended household of seven, three businesses, and a working farm, with a 72-hour primary suite overhaul, turning their long-neglected space into the peaceful retreat they've never given themselves.

episodes.name: Crooked Kitchen
episodes.summary: Jon Knight and his team crash Nick and Nia's poorly designed, dysfunctional kitchen, transforming an outdated space that simply doesn't work for their family's needs into a sleek, functional hub where they can finally cook, gather, and connect.

episodes.name: Going Hard in the Yard
episodes.summary: Jon Knight and his team surprise Raemy and David by transforming a backyard that's pushed them to the edge of moving out into a functional outdoor space that their three kids, two dogs, and whole family can finally use.

episodes.name: Sharing is Caring
episodes.summary: Jon Knight and his team surprise newlyweds Michael and Latasha by transforming his bachelor pad man cave into a warm, welcoming lounge, turning a space that was never hers into a home that finally belongs to both of them.

episodes.name: Kitchen Size Matters
episodes.summary: Jon Knight and his team crash Carol and Lane's tiny galley kitchen, transforming a space too cramped after 38 years of family life into a wide-open, custom kitchen built for cooking, baking and finally gathering together.

episodes.name: Don't Rain on My Reno
episodes.summary: Jon Knight and his team surprise Sunni and Seth, a young family with a toddler and a baby on the way, by transforming their unsafe, crumbling backyard into a welcoming space built for their growing family and the community they pour themselves into.

episodes.name: Garage Gone Glam
episodes.summary: Jon Knight surprises an outdoorsy couple with a 72-hour transformation. This couple loves to host, so the team looks to turn their dark, unused garage into an open kitchen and living room where they can gather with friends and family.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Jon Knight and his team crash a couple's basement, where his man cave dreams clash with her family-first vision; the 72-hour transformation creates a single space built for play and hosting, all to accommodate their competing goals for the space.
