episodes.name: Play Dough
episodes.summary: Anna shows how to take pizza dough to a whole new level with her recipes for pizza montanare, a fried pizza, bubble bread and a crisp dough with a cheesy center.

episodes.name: Pastabilities
episodes.summary: Anna shows how to think of pasta in a snackable way with her version of Italian fried pasta, known as Frittatina and more.

episodes.name: Super Mom Snacks
episodes.summary: Anna elevates after-school snacks with her recipes for homemade, golden pan-fried mozzarella sticks and cheesy, saucy pizza pockets.

episodes.name: Panini 2.0
episodes.summary: Anna puts a fresh twist on everyday sandwiches by creating a hearty Neapolitan Panini, similar to an Italian version of a bacon, egg and cheese sandwich; she also makes a savory, swirled panini called Italian Girelle.

episodes.name: Italian Snacking Party
episodes.summary: Anna's throwing an Italian Snacking Party and showing how to make her guests' favorite make-ahead snacks, such as Sicilian-style Chicken Spiedini and Neapolitan Fried Eggplant Sandwiches.

episodes.name: Savory Breads
episodes.summary: Anna makes delicious baked goods that can also be savory; first up are Smacafam, hearty sausage and cheese muffins, followed by syrup-free French toast, which is also known as Italian Pane Fritto.

episodes.name: Something Sweet
episodes.summary: Anna shows how to make two of her favorite easy-lift desserts; she begins with a simple, refrigerator-friendly cannoli icebox cake, followed by crunchy hazelnut spread brownies.

episodes.name: Polpette Party
episodes.summary: Anna offers two innovative takes on classic meatball dishes; she makes tuna meatballs served with an aioli dipping sauce and eggplant meatballs paired with spicy marinara and topped with ricotta salata.

episodes.name: Dinner Party
episodes.summary: Anna shows how to put together a dinner party in no time with her recipes for antipasto stromboli, followed by sheet pan cacciatore and finished with an affogato mug cake.

episodes.name: Thinking Outside the Pizza Box
episodes.summary: Anna thinks outside the pizza box as she shows how to make her recipes for cauliflower pizza and a cheesy pizza rice.

episodes.name: Lasagna Love
episodes.summary: Anna's love language is cooking for others; she hopes we all fall in love with her recipe for Lasagna Rose, which went viral online, as well as a simple dish she calls Lazy Donna's Lasagna.

episodes.name: When Life Gives You Lemons
episodes.summary: Anna transports to the Amalfi Coast as she shows us how to make a flavorful Chicken Piccata Stir Fry and a refreshing Limoncello Sorbet.

episodes.name: Tiramisu Brownies
episodes.summary: Anna shows how to make decadent tiramisu brownies by combining hazelnut paste, melted chocolate, and a light whipped cream mixture. She layers this mixture over brownies baked from scratch and coffee liqueur-soaked ladyfingers, creating a dessert that's indulgent, Italian, and irresistibly fun.

episodes.name: Rice Reinvented
episodes.summary: Not sure what to do with leftover rice? Anna transforms it into two show-stopping dishes. She reinvents an Italian classic with arancini casserole, a cheesy, prosciutto-packed bake that tastes just like a rice ball. She then fires up the wok for carbonara fried rice, mixing rice with pork and eggs for a creamy, protein-packed dish that delivers pure comfort in every bite.

episodes.name: Cozy Casseroles
episodes.summary: Anna whips up two cozy casseroles perfect for chilly nights. She starts by layering sliced fennel with creamy béchamel, breadcrumbs, and cheese for a decadent fennel casserole. She then transforms baked polenta into a hearty casserole topped with a rich sautéed mushroom sauce. Both dishes are flavorful, comforting, and perfect for sharing.

episodes.name: Sweet Meets Savory Brunch
episodes.summary: Anna serves up two brunch showstoppers, starting with her cherry and cheese brioche bake, a hearty French-toast-style dish filled with cream cheese, cherries, and citrus. While it bakes, she makes frico morbido, Italy's irresistible take on a cheesy potato pancake, fried until golden and crisp.

episodes.name: More Cheese, Please
episodes.summary: Anna shows just how irresistible cheese can be in two dishes. She starts with hand-cut cheesy fries paired with an Italian-style spicy ketchup, then bakes cheesy frittata muffins loaded with eggs, making them perfect for a quick and satisfying breakfast on the go.

episodes.name: Midnight Pasta & Limoncello Cake
episodes.summary: Extra virgin olive oil takes center stage as Anna whips up midnight pasta, a classic spaghetti dish Italians serve to guests at the end of the night. She then transforms citrus-infused olive oil into a tender limoncello olive oil cake, dusted lightly with powdered sugar for a sweet finish.

episodes.name: No Two Meatballs Are Alike
episodes.summary: Anna proves that no two meatballs are alike as she reimagines her mother's beloved recipe into three unique dishes. A blend of beef, veal and pork forms the base for cozy meatballs in a blanket, delicate polpettini and crispy smashed meatball tacos.

episodes.name: Irresistible Vegetables
episodes.summary: Anna makes vegetables the star with two family-friendly dishes. She begins by roasting a whole cauliflower and serving it with a bright Italian salsa verde. She then turns broccoli into a creamy pesto for a pasta dish that's bold, hearty, and irresistible.

episodes.name: Chicken Wings & Cannoli Nachos
episodes.summary: No forks needed as Anna shares two playfully hands-on recipes. She starts with crispy baked chicken wings rubbed with her signature Italian spice blend, then serves a sweet surprise with cannoli nachos, a fun twist on the classic Italian dessert.

episodes.name: One-Pot Wonders
episodes.summary: Anna cooks up two quick and delicious one-pot recipes. She starts with chicken Florentine, a creamy dish with chicken, spinach and a splash of white wine. She then prepares acqua pazza, or crazy water fish, a classic Italian seafood dish simmered with tomatoes and wine.

episodes.name: Garlic Goodness
episodes.summary: Anna shows just how versatile garlic can be in two flavorful dishes. She starts with shrimp scampi meatballs, a playful twist on the Italian American favorite, then finishes with garlic bread pasta, a creamy, crunchy dish that's comfort in every bite.

episodes.name: Puff Pastry Party
episodes.summary: Anna throws a puff pastry party featuring three baked delights. She begins with a spinach and artichoke crostata filled with fresh pesto, twists up savory pizza straws, and ends on a sweet note with chocolate-hazelnut swirls.

episodes.name: Too Fast Too Furious
episodes.summary: When detectives respond to a 911 call from a lavish Miami apartment, they uncover a bloody scene with a popular social media influencer at the center; as they piece events together, soon it gets clear that a lot is going on behind closed doors.

episodes.name: The Porn Identity
episodes.summary: All-American Midwestern hunk Timothy Boham's innocent modeling career catapults him into porn industry stardom; when Tim tries to escape the vicious cycle of selling his body for money, running from his past proves to be deadly.

episodes.name: Dirty Dancing
episodes.summary: A single mother turns to exotic dancing to support her family; as she becomes successful, the temptation to make much more money leads to lies with devastating consequences; faced with an uncertain future, she stabs and kills her boyfriend.

episodes.name: The Fall of Aubrey Gold
episodes.summary: A missing person's report sends investigators on a desperate search through the seedy underbelly of the Floribama panhandle; all roads lead to a once sought-after porn star, whose fate is revealed when an informant comes forward to unearth the truth.

episodes.name: Hollywood Thriller
episodes.summary: In the 1970s, Anneka Di Lorenzo finds fame as a successful model in Penthouse Magazine and secures a part in the movie "Caligula"; however, her life eventually unravels with tragic consequences.

episodes.name: A Model Murder
episodes.summary: An aspiring model, Kimberly Pandelios, accepts an offer to pose in lingerie for a mysterious photographer, then disappears; years later, a young woman contacts the police when she begins to suspect that her boyfriend may have been the killer.

episodes.name: Killing King Cobra
episodes.summary: In 2007, a devastating house fire in Dallas Township, Pennsylvania, reveals the nearly decapitated body of a pornographic film director.

episodes.name: Fatal Escort
episodes.summary: Police find four victims in the smouldering wreckage of an Oklahoma City house fire and one of the victims starred in the hit TV series Cathouse.

episodes.name: Dressed to Kill
episodes.summary: The lure of social media fame pulls a young woman into the dark side of cosplay, and a world of sexual exploitation, online trolls, and homicide.

episodes.name: Death of a Raiderette
episodes.summary: In 1995, in Hermosa Beach, California, a blonde bombshell model and Raiders cheerleader vanishes on her way to a photo shoot; then her photographs ominously turn up at a remote Los Angeles park.

episodes.name: Bad Medicine
episodes.summary: In 2015 Texas, aspiring rapper Daeveion Mangum seeks fame through risky choices, but one decision drags him into a deadly spiral of violence.

episodes.name: Hooters Girl Gone
episodes.summary: In 2022, police find a young man murdered in his home in Texas, and an investigation snags a beautiful former Hooters waitress and OnlyFans model.

episodes.name: Burlesque and Blood
episodes.summary: When the torso of a murdered French Quarter dancer washes up on a Mississippi beach, a community is driven to panic; to catch her killer, detectives must dive into the dark side of New Orleans, uncovering a world of sex, cults and ritual sacrifice.

episodes.name: To Live and Die in Hotlanta
episodes.summary: Bridget Shiel, a 19-year-old escort and rap video dancer, meets a brutal end in 2016 when someone shoots her and leaves her naked in an Atlanta park.

episodes.name: Pepper and Spikes
episodes.summary: Troopers in Arizona engage in a high-speed vehicle pursuit with spike strips; in Florida officers use pepper balls to subdue a suspect; when officers in Missouri receive a report involving an alleged gunshot victim, they arrive on scene to find something they didn't expect.

episodes.name: Females in Flight
episodes.summary: Officers in Indiana chase a car full of women; in Illinois, police investigate a man who has allegedly taken dangerous drugs; in California, a suspected gang member barricades himself inside his car as police attempt to get him out.

episodes.name: Catch Me If You Can
episodes.summary: When officers in California attempt to pull over a vehicle suspected to be involved in a carjacking, things get out of hand when both driver and passenger attempt to flee; officers in Virginia use a dog to help detain a fleeing suspect; an officer in Arizona chases down a suspect through a parking lot.

episodes.name: Stop Sticks and Snow
episodes.summary: On a snowy road in Alaska, officers set up sticks to try and stop a vehicle on the run; in Illinois, officers help a drunk biker get home; Police in Nevada respond to a house fire where the victims claim arson.

episodes.name: No Lauging Matter
episodes.summary: An Arizona trooper encounters a man who won't stop laughing; in North Carolina, officers close in on an alleged murder suspect; Police in Florida respond to a disturbance and the suspect proves difficult to handle.

episodes.name: Riding on a Rim
episodes.summary: In Rhode Island, officers pull over a car riding on a rim and discover it's full of drugs; the canine crew in North Carolina is called into a traffic stop when it's discovered the car has fake tags; in California, officers respond to a call about shots fired.

episodes.name: In Love With the Law
episodes.summary: A Florida woman tries to flirt her way out of trouble when she's found allegedly driving with a suspended license; police in Bridgeport, Connecticut search for the suspects that may have fled the scene of a shootout; officers in Richland County, South Carolina, try to prevent a suspect from swallowing drugs during a routine traffic stop.

episodes.name: Stuck in the Mud
episodes.summary: Indiana officers chase a vehicle until it gets stuck in a muddy field; in Virginia, canine officers are called in to investigate an alligator in public but have to leave when a more pressing call comes up; police locate an allegedly wanted fugitive in Alaska who doesn't go quietly.

episodes.name: Dash and Trash
episodes.summary: Police in Louisiana help a man in need. In Alaska, officers pursue a suspect and find him hiding on a roof. A couple in Illinois has officers befuddled over a dispute involving the garbage.

episodes.name: Out of Gas
episodes.summary: Nevada police pursue an allegedly stolen vehicle until it runs out of gas. A bar fight in Rhode Island prompts police to investigate and keep the peace. In Florida, an officer pulls over a car for speeding, but the speeder takes off when asked to get out of the car.

episodes.name: Versus Celebrities
episodes.summary: A combination of trivia and the luck of where the ball drops could make contestants rich.

episodes.name: Versus Celebrities
episodes.summary: A combination of trivia and the luck of where the ball drops could make contestants rich.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: After a life-altering incident, John Nolan decides to pursue his dream of becoming a police officer; as the force's oldest rookie, John is met with skepticism from some higher-ups.

episodes.name: Crash Course
episodes.summary: Talia forces Nolan to confront his personal moral instincts after he encounters a kidnapping victim; Lucy is temporarily placed with a new training officer who tests her patience; Jackson must confront his failures.

episodes.name: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
episodes.summary: After Nolan and Talia lose control of a crime scene, they begin to debate whether people are fundamentally good or bad; Lucy worries Tim is enabling his wife's destructive behavior and not taking care of himself.

episodes.name: The Switch
episodes.summary: The rookies are temporarily paired with new training officers; when Nolan and Lopez track down an escaped criminal, they discover a little kindness goes a long way; Jackson is forced to face his fears when he is partnered with officer Bradford.

episodes.name: The Roundup
episodes.summary: Nolan, the rookies and their training officers get involved in a competition that pits them against each other; officer Lucy Chen notices officer Tim Bradford is obsessed with winning at all costs.

episodes.name: The Hawke
episodes.summary: The team must help capture a cop and his former mentor from the academy after he becomes a fugitive following an assault; Officer Tim Bradford needs Officer Lucy Chen to learn to predict the moves of criminals in order to capture them.

episodes.name: The Ride Along
episodes.summary: Sgt. Grey informs officer Nolan and officer Bishop that they are going to have a movie director as a ride-along; officer Bradford learns that his wife has been arrested for drug possession.

episodes.name: Time of Death
episodes.summary: Nolan and Bishop respond to a silent alarm call at a local convenience store where two men are attempting to rob the place; Bishop helps coordinate a drug bust.

episodes.name: Standoff
episodes.summary: Officer Bradford's wife is found shot but alive, and he vows to track down the man responsible; Officer Nolan must protect his home and the truth after a home invasion attack.

episodes.name: Flesh and Blood
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan and Sgt. Grey are paired up for the day on patrol; Officer Chen is paired up with Capt. Andersen, and Officer Bradford tells Chen to protect her at all costs.

episodes.name: Redwood
episodes.summary: An unscheduled visit by the Vice President of the United States puts the station on high alert; the Secret Service tasks Nolan and Bishop with checking out a possible threat while the rest of the team tries to keep the streets safe for his visit.

episodes.name: Heartbreak
episodes.summary: The team is on high alert during the most dangerous day of the year, Valentine's Day; officer Nolan invites everyone over for a party now that he is single.

episodes.name: Caught Stealing
episodes.summary: A large sum of money used in a drug bust goes missing; the rookies become the prime suspects, as they had previously discussed what they would do with the money.

episodes.name: Plain Clothes Day
episodes.summary: The rookies are really put to the test when they are forced to make all decisions while on patrol; officer Nolan tries to prove he has been progressing faster than the other rookies to justify his desire of becoming a detective within five years.

episodes.name: Manhunt
episodes.summary: When a prison bus crashes, some inmates face severe injuries while others seek an opportunity to flee; in the wake of the accident, officer Nolan tries to impress an FBI hostage negotiator while tracking down an escaped convict.

episodes.name: Greenlight
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan gets a lesson in respect after his arrest of a gang member leads to a free-for-all on his life; officer Chen and Bradford pull over Mario Lopez, who thinks he can talk his way out of a traffic violation.

episodes.name: The Shake Up
episodes.summary: A massive earthquake rocks the city and throws everything into chaos; Russo recommends Officer Nolan for a protective detail of Brad Hayes, a man whose dealings have put a target on his head.

episodes.name: Homefront
episodes.summary: When a cop is arrested by Internal Affairs for lying on the witness stand, it leads to the release of three felons whose cases he worked on; Officer Nolan finds out he is being sued by a man who claims he used excessive force which led to an injury.

episodes.name: The Checklist
episodes.summary: Sgt. Gray informs the rookies that they must track down a specific set of crimes in a 48-hour period to qualify for their final exam; Nolan and Bishop answer a silent alarm call at will.i.am's house.

episodes.name: Free Fall
episodes.summary: As the rookies prepare for a big exam to see who moves on to the next stage of training, Nolan and Bishop are called to the scene of a murder and learn that the victim may be tied to a potential terrorist attack on the city of Los Angeles.

episodes.name: Impact
episodes.summary: The officers grapple with the aftermath of a plotted attack on the city of Los Angeles, leaving Bradford fighting for his life.

episodes.name: The Night General
episodes.summary: Nolan teams up with new night detective Pablo Armstrong for a murder investigation case that results in an unexpected reunion with a former love interest.

episodes.name: The Bet
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan navigates his relationship with Jessica and a developing rapport with Grace while working a high-stakes criminal case involving an undercover homeland security agent; Officer Chen meddles with Officer Bradford's love life.

episodes.name: Warriors and Guardians
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan gets off to a rocky start after being introduced to his new training officer; Officer Bradford struggles to think of an appropriate birthday gift for Rachel; Officer Lopez finds herself navigating a case that triggers a personal memory.

episodes.name: Tough Love
episodes.summary: The rookies are asked to develop their first confidential informants; Officer Chen's mother complicates her home life when she comes to stay with her.

episodes.name: Fallout
episodes.summary: An emergency alert of an impending missile attack sends Los Angeles into chaos and uncertainty, while the officers each try to keep the peace and deal with their own disasters.

episodes.name: Safety
episodes.summary: John and Jessica's relationship gets a lot more complicated after she delivers some surprising news; Officer Bradford and Officer West are assigned a community policing project helping out the Watts Rams as volunteer coaches.

episodes.name: Clean Cut
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan kicks off his birthday by babysitting a crime scene at a law office; Officer Bradford and Officer West are set to receive special awards; Sgt. Grey rides patrol with Officer Harper after she requests an early annual evaluation.

episodes.name: Breaking Point
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan's trust is tested when he tries to help the previous owner of his home reconnect with his family; Officer Harper's overnight visit with her daughter is put into jeopardy when her past undercover life resurfaces again.

episodes.name: The Dark Side
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan and the team are charged with escorting a notorious female serial killer to the graves of her victims; Officer Chen meets a seemingly perfect man who sparks her interest; Officer Lopez worries about Wesley.

episodes.name: Day of Death
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan and the entire team are in a desperate search to rescue Officer Chen after her abduction; Officer Lopez discovers Wesley unconscious from a dangerous cocktail of alcohol and pills.

episodes.name: Now and Then
episodes.summary: Nolan takes his son's fiancée, Abigail, on a ride-along after she shows interest in becoming a police officer; Jackson's relationship becomes increasingly complicated.

episodes.name: Follow-Up Day
episodes.summary: Nolan is given some life-changing news and invites Grace over for a home-cooked meal in his newly remodeled kitchen; each unit is tasked with following up on dormant cases in hopes of uncovering new leads.

episodes.name: Casualties
episodes.summary: Officers Nolan and Harper investigate a murder which may have national security implications; Officer Bradford must confront his past when he crosses paths with a homeless veteran.

episodes.name: Hand-Off
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan learns his identity has been stolen and could jeopardize his position as an officer; Sgt. Grey must testify at the parole hearing of the man who shot him and murdered his partner.

episodes.name: The Overnight
episodes.summary: Officers Chen and Bradford respond to a call at the Los Angeles auditions of "American Idol" and Officer Chen ends up facing Ryan Seacrest and the judges; Chen befriends a reporter whose motives are not clear.

episodes.name: Control
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan's relationship with his first confidential informant is tested when he discovers her back on the street dealing drugs; Lucy's fear of dating following her abduction is beginning to threaten her friendship with Jackson.

episodes.name: Under the Gun
episodes.summary: Officers Nolan and Harper escort four juvenile offenders to a Scared Straight program at a correctional facility, but it quickly becomes a riotous situation; Nolan is uncertain about Grace after she fails to introduce him to her ex-husband.

episodes.name: The Q Word
episodes.summary: Officers Nolan, Chen and West are squeezed harder than ever before as their training officers evaluate whether they are truly ready for the job; one of the rookie classmates is involved in a shooting.

episodes.name: The Hunt
episodes.summary: Nolan's discovery goes much deeper than he expected and could put his life and career in jeopardy.

episodes.name: Consequences
episodes.summary: Nearing the end of his training, Nolan faces his biggest challenge as a police officer yet when he must come to terms with the choices he has made in pursuit of the truth.

episodes.name: In Justice
episodes.summary: Officer John Nolan and Officer Nyla Harper are assigned to a community policing center in an attempt to rebuild their station's reputation in the community.

episodes.name: La Fiera
episodes.summary: Officer John Nolan's mom makes an unannounced visit, which complicates his life; Sgt. Grey considers retiring.

episodes.name: Sabotage
episodes.summary: Officer Jackson West's relationship with his new training officer, Stanton, escalates, and he begins to work with Sgt. Grey to find a solution.

episodes.name: Lockdown
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan is taken hostage by a man with nothing to lose; Officer Jackson and his training officer, Officer Doug Stanton, reach a tipping point in their relationship that could end Jackson's career.

episodes.name: Revelations
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan's decision to return to school to become a training officer proves to be much harder than he expected; Officer Chen considers going into undercover work after getting a taste of the job.

episodes.name: True Crime
episodes.summary: The team gets the true crime docuseries treatment when it analyzes a recent case featuring a former child actor whose adult life has garnered him a cult following.

episodes.name: Bad Blood
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan, Officer Harper and Detective Lopez are assigned to the kidnapping of the son of a criminal court judge who has a long list of enemies who could possibly be involved.

episodes.name: Amber
episodes.summary: An Amber Alert sends the team on a race against time to find a newborn infant who was stolen from a local hospital; Officers Jackson and Chen work their last shift as rookies as Officer Nolan continues for 30 more days.

episodes.name: Man of Honor
episodes.summary: Harper and Nolan respond to a bank robbery in progress and realize the motives of the thief run much deeper than just needing money; Jackson and Chen's first day riding without training officers isn't what they thought it would be.

episodes.name: New Blood
episodes.summary: When professor Fiona Ryan's car window is smashed following a series of mysterious notes, Nolan volunteers to guard her house overnight; Lucy notices that Tim is being much nicer to his new trainee than he was with her, and she does not like it.

episodes.name: Brave Heart
episodes.summary: After rushing his son to the hospital following his collapse, Nolan is reunited with his ex-wife, and they must come together to help their son; Detective Lopez discovers La Fiera is in the same hospital and wants to find out exactly why.

episodes.name: Triple Duty
episodes.summary: Officers Nolan and Bradford hope they can de-escalate a drug war before any innocent lives are lost; Officer Harper hopes she can get Officer Chen ready to go undercover.

episodes.name: Threshold
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan mildly injures himself while chasing down a shoplifter and the local district attorney wants to charge the suspect with assault, despite Nolan's wishes; Lucy goes undercover; Lopez's wedding venue is seized by the FBI.

episodes.name: Life and Death
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan and the entire team race against the clock to locate Lopez after she is kidnapped on her wedding day, not only to save her life but her unborn child's.

episodes.name: Five Minutes
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan and Officer Chen's run-in with an infamous thief tips them off to a potentially big heist surrounding the Getty's big gala event; Nolan works up the courage to ask Bailey out on a date.

episodes.name: In the Line of Fire
episodes.summary: Officers Nolan and Chen report to a structure fire and suspect that there is more to the situation than meets the eye; after a sniper shooting, the team searches for the shooter and discovers that the perpetrator has a connection to one of its own.

episodes.name: Red Hot
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan and Officer Chen search for a missing person who may have international ties, putting everyone's lives in danger; Harper continues the search for a serial arsonist; Wesley must overcome an impossible task.

episodes.name: A.C.H.
episodes.summary: When a new designer drug hits the streets, Officer Nolan and the team have a Halloween they won't soon forget; Lucy questions whether her apartment building might be haunted.

episodes.name: Poetic Justice
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan and team are on a hunt to retrieve a buried stash of gold before any treasure seekers get hurt; Bradford is tasked with encouraging the oldest cop at the station to retire and invites him to ride with him.

episodes.name: Fire Fight
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan and Bailey discover there's more to Fred's death than meets the eye; Officer Chen and Officer Bradford demand a treasure hunt rematch and enlist Officer Grey to help set the terms to a new bet.

episodes.name: Hit and Run
episodes.summary: The team goes on a city-wide hunt for an individual who is threatening to cause a mass casualty event; Tim's sister shows up unannounced with some surprising news; Lopez continues her inner struggle over Wesley's deal with Elijah.

episodes.name: Breakdown
episodes.summary: Desperate to break free from his connection to Elijah, Wesley tries to plant a listening device in his office to incriminate him; Officer Bradford and his sister, Genny, learn an unsettling truth about their father.

episodes.name: Heart Beat
episodes.summary: Now that John Nolan knows about Bailey's past, he must decide if they still have a future; when a plane crashes in the middle of the city, the team races to find out why.

episodes.name: End Game
episodes.summary: The team must rely on a criminal for his expertise to help take down an even bigger threat; Officers Chen and Bradford investigate the murder of an unhoused teenager who used to be friends with Tamara.

episodes.name: The Knock
episodes.summary: The team responds to the report of a severed hand washing up on the beach and is on the hunt to find its owner; Tim attempts to prove he isn't a control freak to Lucy and invites her on a double date with him and Ashley.

episodes.name: Fight or Flight
episodes.summary: Officers Nolan and Chen must fulfill three quests if they want to get a stolen police helicopter back safely from a teenage thief; Officer Harper and Thorson must guard a convicted cop killer in the hospital following a prison riot.

episodes.name: Long Shot
episodes.summary: Officers Nolan and Harper help Skip Tracer Randy on his first bounty hunter case; Officer Chen and Sgt. Bradford hunt for a perpetrator on a citywide crime spree.

episodes.name: Hit List
episodes.summary: Officer Harper puts Officer Aaron through Plain Clothes Day, but the exercise is interrupted by an unsuspected visitor; after two witnesses for an upcoming grand jury case are murdered, the team must track down the killers before it's too late.

episodes.name: Real Crime
episodes.summary: Desperate to reset the way the world sees him, Officer Thorsen reluctantly decides to be a part of a reality show to help rebrand his image; the show's producer is found murdered, and the team must investigate before Aaron is made suspect number one.

episodes.name: Coding
episodes.summary: Officer John Nolan and the team feel they must negotiate with a distraught man who is holding a hospital hostage to ensure his wife receives a lifesaving surgery.

episodes.name: Backstabbers
episodes.summary: The team is called to investigate a train robbery; Officer Chen has doubts about being Sgt. Bradford's aide; Officer Harper takes matters into her own hands and makes a life-changing decision about her personal life.

episodes.name: Simone
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan and the LA division of the FBI enlist the help of FBI trainee Simone Clark when one of her former students is suspected of terrorism following an explosion at a local power station.

episodes.name: Enervo
episodes.summary: The team, alongside the LA division of the FBI, is in a race to stop bombs that have been scattered throughout the city by a suspected terrorist; the joint task force is suspicious of the CIA's involvement in the situation.

episodes.name: Mother's Day
episodes.summary: Sgt. Grey supports Officer Nolan's desire to become a training officer and offers to ride with him for the day to get him ready; Tim and Lucy decide on their plans for Mother's Day and a romantic vacation.

episodes.name: Day in the Hole
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan is forced to spend a week in solitary confinement in a quiet border town with a young local officer who is in need of some training; Sgt. Bradford and Officer Chen go undercover together in a possible drug trafficking case.

episodes.name: Double Down
episodes.summary: Officer John Nolan is once again face to face with serial killer Rosalind; officers Bradford and Chen work undercover with Detective Lopez and the Las Vegas Police Department to arrest leaders of a major criminal enterprise.

episodes.name: Labor Day
episodes.summary: Officer John Nolan moves closer to his new role as a training officer; John must uncover the truth about another officer's suicide; Lucy's successful undercover assignment earns her an invitation for specialized training.

episodes.name: Dye Hard
episodes.summary: Officer John Nolan is assigned his first rookie, Officer Celina Juarez, whose unconventional approach to police work poses a unique challenge for him.

episodes.name: The Choice
episodes.summary: Rosalind returns with a vengeance and Bailey's life is left hanging in the balance; Nolan is forced to make a deadly decision after a harrowing ultimatum.

episodes.name: The Fugitive
episodes.summary: Nolan and Juarez are on the hunt for a fugitive after a car incident goes awry; a past injury comes to haunt Tim and Lucy comes through during his time in need in more ways than one.

episodes.name: The Reckoning
episodes.summary: Nolan and Celina investigate a cash deposit linked to an old DEA case; Wesley grows increasingly concerned about his deposition and is shocked when he realizes Elijah's attorney is a familiar face from his past.

episodes.name: Crossfire
episodes.summary: Officer John Nolan and Celina witness a shooting and realize the victim is already dead; Bailey has been feeling off-center since the proposal, leaving Nolan to wonder what he can do to make her feel better.

episodes.name: The Collar
episodes.summary: Officers John Nolan and Celina Juarez are in a race against time to stop the source of an explosive rampage.

episodes.name: Take Back
episodes.summary: Officer John Nolan and the team investigate the unexpected death of a suspect in police custody; Sgt. Grey and his wife, Luna, go to New York to visit their daughter, Dominique, only to realize she never made it home from the night before.

episodes.name: The List
episodes.summary: Detective Nyla Harper and James find themselves in the middle of a bank robbery which leads the entire team on a citywide manhunt; Tim and Lucy go on their first date.

episodes.name: The Naked and the Dead
episodes.summary: The search for a missing boy leads the team into the middle of a dangerous drug war between two rival gangs.

episodes.name: Death Notice
episodes.summary: Nolan and Celina must stand guard at a hospital after a dangerous prisoner needs surgery; Aaron, Lopez and Harper look into a string of robberies; Tim and Lucy consider how their secret relationship will affect their work; Lopez gets unexpected news.

episodes.name: Daddy Cop
episodes.summary: In the midst of a heatwave and a citywide blackout, Nolan and Aaron follow increasingly large leads after they discover criminals hiding at the station; Chen makes an alarming discovery after being called to a scene with a pungent smell.

episodes.name: Death Sentence
episodes.summary: Officer John Nolan and Bailey search for a mystery gunman after a shooting hits a little too close to home; Aaron struggles to live within his means; Wesley suspects that a judge is taking bribes.

episodes.name: The Con
episodes.summary: With help from the FBI, Lopez puts everything on the line to help Elijah Stone take down a gang leader in exchange for her safety; Nolan and Bailey must deal with the secrets and shady dealings his late mother left behind.

episodes.name: Exposed
episodes.summary: The team must stop a militia from detonating a highly combustible truck in their possession; Nolan, Thorson, Juarez and Harper search for three men who may have been exposed to Ebola.

episodes.name: The Enemy Within
episodes.summary: Now that Elijah and Abril have become allies, the team must rely on Monica, Elijah's lawyer, to uncover their plans; Officers Nolan and Juarez reopen her sister's case and discover a discrepancy that leads them on a new trail.

episodes.name: Double Trouble
episodes.summary: When Dim goes missing, Officer Chen and Sgt. Bradford, along with the CIA, set out to find him and enlist the help of Juicy.

episodes.name: A Hole in the World
episodes.summary: The team investigates a pattern of kidnappings, which leads them to a discovery that hits close to home with one of their own; Lucy and Tim's relationship is put to the test as they begin to feel the hard hours of their jobs.

episodes.name: S.T.R
episodes.summary: Officer Tim Bradford's ex-wife returns and asks the team to help her save someone from her undercover past; Isabel's return also creates additional pressure in Lucy and Tim's relationship as they assist in the search.

episodes.name: Going Under
episodes.summary: Officer Lucy Chen goes undercover to infiltrate an illegal firearm operation; Detective Harper and Officer John Nolan work together to solve a mystery involving severed limbs found around the city.

episodes.name: Under Siege
episodes.summary: After one of their own is shot, the team suffers a series of close calls and realizes their division may be a target for a group of masked assailants.

episodes.name: The Rookie Season 6 - Official Trailer
episodes.summary: The Official Trailer for 'The Rookie'; Clock in for the season premiere Tue, feb 20.

episodes.name: Strike Back
episodes.summary: The team must try to understand why they were targeted and if there is a bigger plan in place; Nolan must survive his last shift before his wedding to Bailey.

episodes.name: The Hammer
episodes.summary: The team comes together to celebrate John and Bailey's wedding; Celina discovers a discrepancy in her case, leading to a new discovery; Lucy and Tim's relationship is put to the test.

episodes.name: Trouble in Paradise
episodes.summary: Nolan and Bailey's honeymoon is more of a nightmare than a dream when it turns into an active crime scene; Tim and Celina partner up and must uncover the identity of a John Doe.

episodes.name: Training Day
episodes.summary: It's Officer Aaron Thorsen's first day back since the assault, and he's tasked with a series of high-stress cases to determine whether he's ready to work; the team investigates a homicide case with a potential tie to the pentagram killer.

episodes.name: The Vow
episodes.summary: When a toddler is found at the scene of a crime, John and Bailey must decide whether to let the child go to a shelter for the night or care for her themselves; when someone from his past returns, Tim disappears and leaves Lucy in the dark.

episodes.name: Secrets and Lies
episodes.summary: Following their time as foster parents, Bailey wants to have a baby and forces John to reconsider their decision to not have children; John and Celina discover a prison escapee whom they fear is out for revenge and race to find her.

episodes.name: Crushed
episodes.summary: When two teenagers go missing, it is up to the entire team to find the girls and uncover the truth about their disappearance; Lopez and Harper search for the perfect nanny.

episodes.name: Punch Card
episodes.summary: After a mafia-related mass casualty, the team is tasked to keep the peace at the hospital; Lucy and Celina work together to investigate the suspects behind the attack; Tim and Aaron embark on a metro ops mission.

episodes.name: The Squeeze
episodes.summary: Officer Nolan and Celina take on a special case; Monica enlists help to identify her attackers; Lopez and Harper discover a connection to the trail of crimes.

episodes.name: Escape Plan
episodes.summary: Sgt. Grey helps the team prepare for their biggest mission yet; Aaron, Lopez, Celina, Tim and Smitty discover a surprising connection in their case.

episodes.name: The Shot
episodes.summary: John and the team welcome two new rookies and continue the hunt for two dangerous inmates with very personal vendettas following their prison escape.

episodes.name: The Watcher

episodes.summary: Ahead of Bailey's return home, John looks for clues to locate Jason Wyler; Tim and Lucy swap rookies; a friendly face resurfaces at the station; Wesley feels unsettled over Angela.

episodes.name: Darkness Falling
episodes.summary: Following his stint at the LAPD, Wesley returns to the DA's office where his past connects him to the team's investigation; Bailey and John have conflicting feelings over safety; Lucy grows suspicious of Seth.

episodes.summary: The team searches for a serial killer; Nyla struggles with the aftermath following the attack; Lucy's relationship with Seth takes a turn; Bailey battles her fear of Jason Wyler.

episodes.name: The Gala
episodes.summary: It's Valentine's Day, and Lt. Grey gives Tim and Lucy an unromantic assignment; John and Celina track down a missing girl; the team sharpens up for a charity gala where multiple relationships come to a head.

episodes.name: The Mickey
episodes.summary: On Celina's last day as a rookie, John gives her one final test; Bailey makes a new friend; Lucy places her faith in Seth for an undercover assignment.

episodes.name: Wildfire
episodes.summary: Nyla remains suspicious of Liam Glasser as a wildfire erupts, causing chaos in the city; James tries to help a friend; Seth makes a costly mistake, putting two of their own in danger.

episodes.name: The Kiss
episodes.summary: The team mobilizes to locate a suspect after a deadly series of events affects one of their own; Celina takes on her first case with Bailey's help.

episodes.name: Chaos Agent
episodes.summary: John, Lucy and Angela investigate the suspicious stabbing of three teenage girls; the team experiences technical difficulties while managing a group of prisoners and a wild animal.

episodes.name: Speed
episodes.summary: John and Celina find themselves in a hostage situation while undercover for a public safety initiative; while Angela and Nyla investigate the suspects, Tim challenges Lucy's decision-making skills.

episodes.name: April Fools
episodes.summary: An April Fools' prank on LAPD's social media leads to citywide chaos; John's T.O. skills are tested; Wesley is assigned a challenging case; Tim and Lucy play a joke on the team.

episodes.name: Three Billboards
episodes.summary: When anti-LAPD billboards emerge throughout the city, the team searches for who's responsible; a car bombing prompts an investigation; Miles reconnects with an old friend; John and Bailey assess their ability to adopt.

episodes.name: Mad About Murder
episodes.summary: Tim receives a strange message, launching a larger investigation into the dark web; Celina works to take down a popular podcast; Miles helps update the department's training videos.

episodes.name: A Deadly Secret
episodes.summary: Documentary filmmakers interview the LAPD on a complicated missing person's case connected to John.

episodes.name: The Return
episodes.summary: The team has mixed feelings when a familiar face returns hoping to prove himself; an influencer gets his fans to come after Wesley; Tim supports Lucy as she prepares for the sergeant's exam.

episodes.name: Mutiny and the Bounty
episodes.summary: The team helps skip tracer Randy when his new love interest is kidnapped; Angela and Nyla enlist their moms to help catch a con artist; Wesley is threatened to drop a case.

episodes.name: The Good, the Bad, and the Oscar
episodes.summary: John and Harper work together to catch Oscar; Angela investigates a bank robbery; Lucy and Tim learn to adapt to her new schedule; Miles' first date takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.name: Czech Mate
episodes.summary: The LAPD, FBI and Interpol work with Monica Stevens in Prague to target high-value terrorists operating within and outside the United States.

episodes.name: Fast Andy
episodes.summary: The president visits Los Angeles.

episodes.name: The Red Place
episodes.summary: Nolan makes a quiet arrest; Lucy and Celina race to rescue a kidnapping victim; Harper and Lopez help outsmart a killer; Miles visits a familiar face.

episodes.name: Cut and Run
episodes.summary: While out in the city, Nolan and Bailey witness a murder in public and immediately spring into action in the hopes of finding the person responsible; Angela and Wesley have a big life decision that may affect their future.

episodes.name: The Network
episodes.summary: Lt. Grey and the FBI task force enlist the help of an old colleague to uncover a criminal network; Nolan, Miles, Lucy and Celina respond to a mysterious officer-involved shooting.

episodes.name: Burn 4 Love
episodes.summary: It's Valentine's Day, and the team is on the hunt for someone who is setting more than hearts on fire; Celina thinks Miles' recent string of bad luck is the result of a curse, and she's determined to break it.

episodes.name: Baja
episodes.summary: Harper and Lucy go undercover in Baja while investigating the murder of two young women; Nolan and Bailey navigate their long-distance relationship.

episodes.name: Grand Theft Aircraft
episodes.summary: Nolan and Garza lead a high-stakes operation that quickly goes south; Lucy and Tim navigate their relationship when an unexpected visitor shows up; the team conducts a citywide search for a suspect.

episodes.name: Fun and Games
episodes.summary: Harper and Miles feel the weight of their recent mistakes, while Harper is tasked with training Miles; Nolan and Celina are dispatched to a robbery call where Nolan encounters a familiar face.

episodes.name: His Name Was Martin
episodes.summary: Nolan, Harper and Miles face a dangerous situation when a routine check takes a sudden turn; Bailey conducts a covert investigation at the Pentagon at the request of Lt. Grey.

episodes.name: Aftermath
episodes.summary: An unexpected twist hinders the Liam Glasser case; a familiar face helps the team track down a killer.

episodes.name: Spy Games
episodes.summary: The FBI and LAPD join forces on a covert sting operation to protect Bailey; Wesley and Angela face tensions in their marriage when his campaign is threatened by a public scandal.

episodes.name: The Thinker
episodes.summary: Bailey gets a new role; a ride-along with Nolan goes awry; the team looks to recruit new members.

episodes.name: Tiger Bear
episodes.summary: A troubling incident at a school draws the team into a complex case; Celina's temporary missing persons assignment leads her into a dangerous situation.

episodes.name: Survive the Streets
episodes.summary: The team works together after Nolan and Celina discover a possible suicide that spirals into conspiracy.

episodes.name: Out of Time
episodes.summary: Nolan is put to the test when he's forced to protect a man he doesn't trust; Lucy and Celina follow a promising lead; Lopez finds herself conflicted about Wesley's new position.

episodes.name: Dead Ringer
episodes.summary: Nolan and Harper try to help a desperate mother protect her child; Lt. Grey and Garza continue to work with Monica despite their misgivings.

episodes.name: The Bandit
episodes.summary: The team launches a high-stakes search to take down a notorious criminal; Lucy's leadership is tested; Wesley tests the boundaries of his friendships; Nolan tries to balance duty and family.

historys_greatest_machines_with_dolph_lu.title: History's Greatest Machines With Dolph Lundgren

episodes.name: Aerial Attackers
episodes.summary: Feel the thunderous might of the Cold War's atomic cannon, soar with the B-17 bomber that helped win WWII, and witness the cutting-edge technology of today's F-35 stealth fighter jet; guided by Dolph Lundgren, explore the sky-high innovations that gave armies the unbeatable edge in the air.

episodes.name: Mission Critical
episodes.summary: When the mission looks impossible, you call in special ops - and Dolph Lundgren. Join him as he takes you behind enemy lines to reveal the elite machines behind history's boldest operations, from the stealth helicopter that hunted Bin Laden, the silent WWII carbine that made British commandos ghosts, and an insect-sized recon drone giving troops eyes inside enemy strongholds; it's next-level tech for next-level, previously impossible missions.

episodes.name: Monster Machines
episodes.summary: If size counts, these machines rewrite all the rules; Dolph Lundgren gets up close inside legendary giants: the Antonov An-225 cargo jet history's largest aircraft; the 200-ton WWII Maus tank designed by Porsche for Hitler, the largest ever made; and Bigfoot, the original monster truck that created a global phenomenon; when small isn't enough, Dolph goes massive with these supersized beasts.

episodes.name: Devices of Deception
episodes.summary: Dolph Lundgren pulls the curtain back on the shadowy devices that won secret wars, the CIA's pigeon-mounted spy cameras, bone-conduction radios hidden inside tobacco pipes, the silent heart attack gun and the secret Enigma code that changed WWII.

episodes.name: Breakthrough Boats
episodes.summary: How do you master a planet covered by 70% water? Build history-changing machines to conquer it; Dolph Lundgren dives into the stealthy German U-boats that nearly won WWII, the ancient canoes that crossed the Pacific, James Cameron's groundbreaking Deepsea Challenger, and the nuclear-powered aircraft carrier that faced down nuclear war; welcome to Water World.

episodes.name: World's Fastest
episodes.summary: Speed is more than a number - it's human ambition in high octane. Dolph Lundgren hits overdrive with the record-breakers: the Thrust SSC jet car blasting past Mach 1, Concorde's legendary supersonic jet that halved travel times, and NASA's Parker Solar Probe, the fastest man-made object in history. Fasten your seatbelt for an adrenaline-pumping journey through machines built by speed-obsessed visionaries.

episodes.name: Rocket Science
episodes.summary: Sometimes it really is rocket science with a twist; blast through history with Dolph Lundgren as he reveals the rockets that transformed warfare, exploration and human potential, from the ancient Korean Hwacha artillery that changed battlefields forever, to the Saturn V moon rocket that captured humanity's imagination, to Martin-Baker's rocket-powered ejection seat that saved over 7,000 lives; fasten your seatbelts for a blast of history like you've never seen.

episodes.name: Change Agents
episodes.summary: Every once in a while, it's not the weapons and wars that redraw a new world order, but the ideas and inventions. With Dolph Lundgren leading the charge, witness the printing press that toppled kings, the Apple II computer dreamed up in a garage, and the iconic Model T that put the world on wheels. These revolutionary machines didn't just reshape history - they created it.

episodes.name: Bel Aire
episodes.summary: Ramsay urges two brothers to work through their emotional conflicts to save their beloved Bel Aire Diner in Astoria, New York.

episodes.name: Bask 46
episodes.summary: When a New Jersey couple's 6-month-old gastropub is in jeopardy due to their fiery head chef and dysfunctional menu, Gordon Ramsay offers his expertise and works to transform it into a successful business.

episodes.name: In the Drink
episodes.summary: Ramsay attempts to revamp a country club restaurant that struggles to find cohesiveness and revive its lackluster menu, despite an absent owner.

episodes.name: Da Mimmo
episodes.summary: Gordon Ramsay tries to transform New Jersey Italian restaurant Da Mimmo.

episodes.name: Juicy Box
episodes.summary: Gordon Ramsay steps in to transform a family-run Haitian juice bar and restaurant in Brooklyn, N.Y., that has fallen into utter chaos.

episodes.name: Love Bites
episodes.summary: Love Bites is a small restaurant in Saugerties, N.Y., run by childhood sweethearts who have trouble separating their work and personal lives; Gordon Ramsay steps in to save both the café and the couple's engagement.

episodes.name: El Cantito
episodes.summary: Gordon Ramsay tries to transform El Cantito, a Puerto Rican restaurant that is struggling to keep the business afloat with malfunctioning equipment, a small staff and pandemic-induced financial strain.

episodes.name: South Brooklyn
episodes.summary: The co-owners of South Brooklyn Foundry don't see eye-to-eye, causing communication to grow toxic while the restaurant falls into more debt; Gordon Ramsay steps in to reassess the Brooklyn eatery's priorities and straighten out the finances.

episodes.name: Max's
episodes.summary: Chef Ramsay heads to Max's Bar & Grill to help the restaurant before the divorced owners' business crumbles.

episodes.name: Diwan
episodes.summary: Gordon steps in to help transform Diwan, an established Indian restaurant that is also running a Mexican restaurant out of the same kitchen.

episodes.name: Iberville: Ramsay's Worst Nightmare
episodes.summary: Ramsay tries to help the owner of Iberville Cuisine & Oyster Bar, located in the heart of the French Quarter.

episodes.name: Iberville: The Nightmare Continues
episodes.summary: Gordon Ramsay continues to help the lost owner of Iberville Cuisine.

episodes.name: Voleos
episodes.summary: Gordon tries to revamp Voleo's Seafood Restaurant, a second-generation family-run restaurant struggling to stay afloat following the devastation caused by Hurricane Ida in 2021.

episodes.name: Kindred
episodes.summary: A vegan restaurant grappling with direction and disorganization needs help.

episodes.name: 3 Southern Girls
episodes.summary: Gordon Ramsay pays a visit to traditional southern cuisine restaurant 3 Southern Girls; the restaurant's owners hope to rebuild a successful business after being forced to close down for more than a month due to a family tragedy.

episodes.name: Kings Blu Jam
episodes.summary: Gordon tries to revamp Kings Blue Jam Café in Houston, a café specializing in all things breakfast, brunch and lunch, but the overwhelming menu and miscommunication among staff members is causing issues.

episodes.name: Verdict
episodes.summary: Gordon Ramsay offers his support to The Verdict, a restaurant known for serving traditional New Orleans cuisine with a modern and trendy twist.

episodes.name: Grumpy George
episodes.summary: Gordon Ramsay tries to help an English pub located in Georgetown, Texas, which lacks a quintessential British identity.

episodes.name: Leo's
episodes.summary: A family tragedy leaves Leo's Italian Grill on the decline; customers are met with low-quality ingredients and a lack of customer service; Gordon is determined to help the owner rediscover his dream of operating a vibrant restaurant.

episodes.name: Blake's Place
episodes.summary: Gordon Ramsay helps the owner of Blake's Place, a small neighborhood restaurant that has lost sight of the most crucial aspect of a restaurant's reputation, which is executing delicious and memorable dishes.

episodes.name: Simmer Down
episodes.summary: Gordon helps Chris establish fundamental systems and boundaries at Simmer Down Cafe.

episodes.name: Freddy's Steak House
episodes.summary: An owner buried in debt after twenty years is caught between a manager and head chef locked in a bitter power struggle; to save the restaurant, Gordon must get them to stop pointing fingers and start working together.

episodes.name: 4 Star Diner
episodes.summary: A classic American eatery with an owner whose vulgar behavior is driving away both staff and diners; Gordon must rebuild trust before the restaurant's future slips away.

episodes.name: Love on the Blu
episodes.summary: When Gordon uncovers the root of the problems at Love on the Blu, he pushes the owner to confront the changes needed to save both her business and her team.

episodes.name: Borelli's Pizzeria
episodes.summary: Slow service, an inexperienced staff and half-baked leadership have Borelli's Pizzeria crumbling; Gordon learns about the personal struggles affecting the owner and helps put both the owner's well-being and the restaurant on the path to recovery.

episodes.name: Revisited No. 4
episodes.summary: Revisited No. 4 - Chef Ramsay returns to a few restaurants to see if they took his advice. The eateries he visits include Mojito, The Junction (formerly Flamango's) and Bazzini.

episodes.summary: The cautionary tale of David Schultz, set to become a superstar until his violent run-in with reporter John Stossel saw him exiled from the business he'd sworn to protect.

episodes.name: Cocaine & Cowboy Boots: The Herb Abrams Story

episodes.name: Brian Pillman Part One

episodes.name: Brian Pillman Part Two
episodes.summary: After enduring a horrific car wreck, Brian Pillman masks his injuries while pushing his body to the edge; his untimely death leaves his young family struggling to cope.

episodes.name: The Ultra-Violence of Nick Gage
episodes.summary: Nick Gage is the self-proclaimed king of deathmatch wrestling, but his road to the top is marked with a six-year prison sentence for armed robbery and personal tragedies.

episodes.name: Collision in Korea
episodes.summary: In one of the most bizarre acts of political theatre ever conceived, professional wrestlers who were deployed to North Korea faced a terrifying ordeal that had them fighting for their lives.

episodes.name: The Many Faces of Luna Vachon

episodes.name: Extreme & Obscene: Rob Black's XPW

episodes.summary: The teenage romance of wrestling prodigy Chris Candido and Tammy Sunny Sytch, his love-to-hate manager, gets torn apart by infidelity, addiction and mutual self-destruction.

episodes.name: Bam Bam Bigelow: The Beast from the East

episodes.name: Bash at the Beach 2000

episodes.name: Buff and The Bagwells -- Extended Cut

episodes.name: Terry Gordy: Final Flight of the Freebird - Extended Cut

episodes.name: Saving Face: The Brutus Beefcake Story

episodes.name: 'Hot Stuff' Eddie Gilbert

episodes.name: Blood, Fire and the Original Sheik

episodes.name: The Scream Queen: Daffney

episodes.name: Bad Things Happen When You Dig

episodes.name: Night Visions
episodes.summary: Peril strikes during a daring investigation as the team embarks on their quest to understand what may lie beneath Skinwalker Ranch.

episodes.name: Looking Down
episodes.summary: A life-threatening incident forces the team to re-assess their methods of investigation; disturbing new evidence at homestead one has Tom and Travis on edge.

episodes.name: High Strangeness
episodes.summary: A historic moment occurs when the entire team witnesses, and documents, two UFO sightings directly over Skinwalker Ranch.

episodes.name: Dangerous Curves
episodes.summary: When advanced testing shows evidence of strange anomalies under the ranch, Brandon finally gives the team permission to dig.

episodes.name: Poking the Nest
episodes.summary: The ranch reacts in dangerous ways when the team begins to dig.

episodes.name: Surveillance
episodes.summary: When a cow suddenly and mysteriously dies, surveillance footage poses another worldly explanation.

episodes.name: Revelations
episodes.summary: The team learns their research is of great interest to the intelligence community and share their findings with hopes of moving forward.

episodes.name: Breaking Ground
episodes.summary: The team recommences its search for answers on the 512-acre property; an excavation of a mysterious pit at Homestead Two leads to a frightening encounter.

episodes.name: Carved in Stone
episodes.summary: As the mystery of a dead cow grows even stranger, a guest investigator alerts the team to a never-before-seen site that might hold the keys to unlocking the truth about Skinwalker Ranch.

episodes.name: Laser Focused
episodes.summary: After a military investigator shares his disturbing report about the phenomena on Skinwalker Ranch, the team conducts a laser experiment, which leads to startling results.

episodes.name: There's No Place Like Homestead Two
episodes.summary: When a lidar scan reveals a dark mass at Homestead Two, the team invites a Rabbi to perform an ancient ritual believed to reveal interdimensional portals, which leads to chilling results.

episodes.name: The Ranch Strikes Back
episodes.summary: A thermal experiment at Homestead Two reveals more evidence of a strange presence, the team is suddenly affected in dangerous and disturbing ways.

episodes.name: Skin Deep
episodes.summary: An investigator presents the team with evidence of a mysterious cavern system running beneath the ranch.

episodes.name: Can You Dig It?
episodes.summary: While conducting a drilling operation at the Triangle Area, the team not only detects dangerous energy spikes, but also discovers something that may have come from outer space.

episodes.name: Shocking Revelations
episodes.summary: When the team uses high-powered Tesla coils to shoot electricity into the oddly conductive soil of Skinwalker Ranch, it stimulates an otherworldly encounter.

episodes.name: Look, Up in the Sky
episodes.summary: As the team launches high-tech rockets into the mile-high zone above the Triangle, unidentified aerial phenomena suddenly appear.

episodes.name: It Follows
episodes.summary: As members of the team investigate the Triangle area nearly a mile above the ranch in Brandon's helicopter, they are shadowed by an invisible entity.

episodes.name: Above and Beyond Explanation
episodes.summary: As the team returns for its third year to investigate the high strangeness of Skinwalker Ranch, it finds new evidence of a mysterious anomaly in the sky one mile above the Triangle Area that may be connected to something deep within the Mesa.

episodes.name: Tic Tac 2
episodes.summary: The team invites former members of the U.S. military connected to the infamous "Tic Tac" UAP encounter, and are stunned when they stimulate very similar phenomena to appear above Skinwalker Ranch.

episodes.name: Inner Fear-ence
episodes.summary: As the team conducts a new aerial experiment over the Triangle Area above Skinwalker Ranch, they find shocking new evidence that the radiation and UAP phenomena they keep detecting may be connected to something deep inside the mesa.

episodes.name: Scoped Out
episodes.summary: When the team works with a group of astronomy experts to conduct a telescope and rocket experiment at the Triangle Area on Skinwalker Ranch, they have their most incredible UAP encounter yet.

episodes.name: Digging Up the Past
episodes.summary: Former NIDS employee and retired Army Col. John Alexander visits the ranch; after the Skinwalker team repeats an experiment that he indicates may have opened a portal, they receive a mysterious signal that appears to be an attempt to communicate.

episodes.name: Where There's Smoke...
episodes.summary: While uncovering evidence of a massive underground cave system said to exist beneath the ranch's mysterious mesa, the Skinwalker team also broadcasts a strange signal recorded on the property over the airwaves of a local radio station.

episodes.name: Full Metal Mesa
episodes.summary: As the team drills into the solid rock mesa on Skinwalker Ranch, they discover a mysterious void containing an impenetrable object that causes one of the most dangerous and threatening happenings they've experienced so far.

episodes.name: Dome of the Rock
episodes.summary: After recovering metal fragments from a massive, dome-shaped object buried in the mesa on Skinwalker Ranch, the team conducts a scientific test that reveals shocking results.

episodes.name: Closer Encounters
episodes.summary: When the team conducts its most ambitious experiment yet at the Triangle, it is shocked by what appears in the sky above Skinwalker Ranch.

episodes.name: Photo Finish
episodes.summary: With winter approaching and time running out, the team performs a three-dimensional scan of Skinwalker Ranch and makes an incredible discovery that may help explain some of the bizarre phenomena they have encountered on the property.

episodes.name: The Strangest Things So Far
episodes.summary: After another season of shocking discoveries, the team reviews all the strange experiences and compelling evidence of the last three years.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Neighborhood
episodes.summary: A woman is incensed by her neighbor's parking and takes revenge on her car; when a dog owner allows her pooch to poop on a neighbor's lawn and doesn't pick it up, the neighbor is watching and has a surprise in store.

episodes.summary: In Minneapolis, a dispute over a pear tree takes a shocking turn when one neighbor pulls out a weapon; in Illinois, a woman washing her car faces off with her neighbor after water splashes onto her driveway; and in Michigan, 20 years of tension between neighbors snaps when one of them chops firewood with a chainsaw.

episodes.name: Hook, Line and Sinker
episodes.summary: In New Jersey, an angry neighbor accosts two young fishermen who are trespassing on his riverbank; a Texas man provokes a family with vulgar taunts at all hours of the day and night; and at a marina in Hawaii, neighbors rush to rescue a mother and son trapped in a sinking minivan.

episodes.name: Snack Attack
episodes.summary: A mother vacationing in Florida with her family finds herself in the crosshairs of a bereaved woman who's upset about a bag of snacks left near a memorial bench; a couple in Massachusetts is at odds with their next-door neighbors over yard sales.

episodes.name: When Neighbors Snap
episodes.summary: In Knoxville, Tenn., a teen's peaceful day of fishing turns hostile when a furious neighbor storms in and snaps more than just his temper; an Oklahoma couple claims daily confrontations with their neighbors have pushed them to the brink.

episodes.name: Mother's Worst Nightmare
episodes.summary: A Minnesota woman and her newborn baby are terrified by a man who enters their home with a loaded shotgun; in Florida, a man walking his dog is confronted by an angry neighbor who doesn't want the pup's poop on his lawn; and two escaped goats wreak havoc in an Arizona neighborhood.

episodes.name: Predator on the Porch
episodes.summary: A woman in a 55+ community in Florida finds herself in a showdown with the property manager over a security camera; an Atlanta man is stunned when his downstairs neighbor complains about loud footsteps and bathroom noises.

episodes.name: Battle for the Block
episodes.summary: A Florida woman takes issue with neighbors who cone off the street for their bike-riding kids, disrupting her daily commute; in California a resident feuds with his Homeowners' Association while they claim he's a nuisance.

episodes.name: Planks for Nothing
episodes.summary: In California, a routine house move turns tense when one neighbor pushes back on cul-de-sac access; in Florida, a homeowner replacing a rotting fence is met with an unusual demand: return the old boards; and in rural North Carolina, a grieving couple's search for peace unravels into threats over noisy visitors and social media posts.

episodes.name: Fence and Sensibility
episodes.summary: In Dayton, Ohio, tensions between two families boil over as both sides accuse the other's children of bullying; in Alabama, an off-duty police officer is struck by a neighbor furious over loud music; and in Florida, a woman's frustration over backyard noise turns destructive when she punches a hole straight through her neighbor's fence.

episodes.name: Move It Or Else
episodes.summary: In Florida, a man's refusal to move his van from the middle of the road quickly lands him in handcuffs; in Pennsylvania, a Halloween party takes a terrifying turn when an angry man crashes through the front door; and in Washington state, a heated confrontation erupts when a vocal protester targets a dog owner.

episodes.name: No-Fly Zone
episodes.summary: In Oregon, a family is stunned to learn they've been living next door to a wanted felon; on a California beach, a man flying a remote-controlled plane clashes with a neighbor; and in North Carolina, a volunteer firefighter races home after his doorbell camera alerts him to a possible intruder.

episodes.name: Mailbox Mayhem
episodes.summary: In Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, a parking dispute escalates on the day a man is expecting an important delivery; in Pennsylvania, a landlord and tenant clash after a mailbox is replaced without permission; and in Brooksville, Florida, a woman's patience is in the crosshairs when her neighbor sets up a backyard shooting range.

episodes.name: Space Invaders
episodes.summary: In Michigan, a dispute over shared driveway parking puts neighbors at odds; in Ohio, a simple mail mix-up sparks an outsized reaction; and in Chicago, a routine move-out inspection turns into a heated showdown between renters and their landlord.

episodes.name: Toxic Tensions
episodes.summary: In Tennessee, a wrong-way confrontation at an apartment complex erupts into a shouting standoff with a surprising twist; in South Bend, Ind., a long-running feud over dogs, trash and surveillance turns toxic when one neighbor resorts to biological warfare; in Austin, Texas, a hallway dispute spirals from noise complaints into a battle of doorbell camera taunts.

episodes.name: Spray of Fury
episodes.summary: In California, a man threatens a couple with pepper spray over their dog's behavior; in Georgia, a construction crew faces off with a neighbor determined to shut them down; in Kentucky, a woman renting out her home gets a wake-up call from a neighbor about a loud party at the property.

episodes.name: Open Door, Big Mistake
episodes.summary: In Chesterfield, Virginia, a downstairs neighbor confrontation over moving noise quickly escalates; in Florida, a family is shocked when their doorbell camera captures a neighbor entering their home uninvited; and in Glenwood, Iowa, a man springs into action when an active shooter threatens his neighbor's home.

episodes.name: Mind Your Business
episodes.summary: In Portland, Oregon, a man standing in his own driveway is questioned by a neighbor about why he's there; in South Carolina's Blue Ridge Mountains, a tense balcony dispute escalates when a husband steps in to defend his family; and in Michigan, a mother who feels constantly watched decides to fight back, drawing plenty of attention.

episodes.name: Caught and Confronted
episodes.summary: An Oklahoma City woman loses her cool after accusing neighbors of letting their dog do its business right outside her patio; a Michigan family is shocked when a neighbor shows up at their front door with a loaded gun; and in California, a quick-thinking woman confronts suspected snack snatchers at a tennis club.

episodes.name: Badge of Chaos
episodes.summary: In Florida, neighbors call the police on a man who is blasting loud music and scattering household items in the street; construction workers in Georgia clash with a neighbor who accuses them of shoddy work; and in Nevada, a handyman is confronted by a man claiming to be with Homeland Security.

episodes.name: Half An Acre of Trouble
episodes.summary: In rural Tennessee, a property line dispute erupts when a neighbor parks her truck on land claimed by the man next door. A disagreement over speed in a shared driveway in Staten Island, New York, leads to a front porch showdown. And in Birmingham, England, a resident installs a security camera in a communal entrance, but a neighbor objects to being recorded and brings out a hammer.

episodes.name: Dirty Dealings
episodes.summary: In Salt Lake City, Utah, a man catches his neighbor red-handed, shoveling soil from his landscaping project into his truck. In Brooklyn, New York, a hallway camera has one resident convinced she's being watched - and she's not happy about it. And in Colorado Springs, a noise complaint escalates when a neighbor refuses to turn down her music.

episodes.name: All Fired Up
episodes.summary: Police in Louisiana help a man in need. In Alaska, officers pursue a suspect and find him hiding on a roof. A couple in Illinois has officers befuddled over a dispute involving the garbage.

episodes.name: Porch Pirate Payback
episodes.summary: In North Carolina, a neighbor calls the police, claiming cable repairmen are making a mess in his yard. An Ohio man confronts a neighbor he believes has been stealing his packages. And in Texas, a man and his son are blocked from a public park when neighbors insist they've rented it for the day.

episodes.name: Now It's Personal
episodes.summary: In California, a father confronts a home invader in his yard - and it quickly turns physical. In Florida, another father steps in after a neighbor yells at his young son for playing near his property. And in Georgia, a couple renting a room in a shared house draws their landlord's ire for doing too much laundry.

episodes.name: Knock Yourself Out
episodes.summary: In Canada, two neighbors are left fuming when a snow plow undoes their hard work by dumping snow in their driveway. In the Bronx, New York, a noise complaint pushes one woman over the edge and almost through her neighbor's door. And in Midvale, Utah, a neighborhood dispute turns ugly when a neighbor unleashes a racist attack on a local family.

episodes.summary: Judge Ms. Pat settles cases that include a son suing his mother, lifelong best friends disputing over rent money and a cousin who took back her bottle service birthday present.

episodes.summary: Judge Ms. Pat settles cases that include an ex-husband whose ex-wife pulled a $5k fast one for her dream car, a mother suing her daughter over tax return money and a music manager promised a payback after her artist has changed.

episodes.summary: Judge Ms. Pat settles three cases, including sisters squabbling over a stolen and wrecked car, best friends who can't agree on what treat your self means when it's on someone else's card.

episodes.summary: Cases include sisters going head-to-head over borrowed-but-never-returned clothes, friends wigging out over a hair disaster and ex-BFFs duking it out over a car note that went unpaid and unnoticed.

episodes.summary: Ms. Pat steps in to settle cases that include an ex suing her boo-thang for turning her car into a giant scratch-off ticket, sisters over unpaid rent and ex-besties throw down over a promo deal gone wrong.

episodes.summary: Ms. Pat settles three cases that include an employee chasing down back pay from their boss, cousins butting heads over a suspended driver's license and a friend who made a surprise pit stop.

episodes.summary: Ms. Pat settles three cases that include friends suing each other over whacky wheel woes, a sister suing her brother over a dog bite and a client confronting his stylist over a bad braids and a broken heart.

episodes.summary: Ms. Pat settles three cases that include an ex suing his former partner over rent, former friends feuding over a sports betting blunder and a daughter's drama with her mom over a trucking training course.

episodes.summary: Judge Ms. Pat settles three cases that include an employer suing his colleague over a model recruitment misstep, a mother suing her daughter over a house renovation and two friends beefing over a glam mishap.

episodes.summary: Ms. Pat settles three cases that include brothers beefing over a damaged door and lost key, former friends fighting over a pricey VIP fee and besties blowing up over a beach vacation turned babysitting blunder.

episodes.summary: Judge Ms. Pat settles three cases, exes beefing over bail money and shady vacations, a circus director who got played by his own contortionist, and a superfan who swiped his famous friend's card for a taco truck.

episodes.summary: Exes fighting over hidden cheating footage and a busted ride; cousins beefing after a dog turned Thanksgiving into an ER trip; an influencer calling out their hairstylist for a red-carpet disaster.

episodes.name: You Can't Pay Rent With a Kidney
episodes.summary: A friend ghosting on a floor remodel job; an aunt chasing rent from her kidney-donating niece who won't leave; a pet mom billing her ex after her dog got sick from fried chicken snagged off the kitchen table.

episodes.name: Garbage, Grudges and Grown-up Rent
episodes.summary: A neighbor demanding payback for trash duty and lawn care; an ex is accused of ditching a birthday bash over parking drama; a son dragging his money-hungry mom to court for sky-high rent.

episodes.name: Siblings, Strip Clubs, & Stacks
episodes.summary: Settling three cases, from a twerk that broke a Vegas mirror to siblings fighting over strip club debts, and a man demanding payback after his ex-bestie gambled away their catering profits.

episodes.name: Botox, Backstabs, & Busted Friendships
episodes.summary: Ms. Pat settles three cases a Botox-happy mom who spent her daughter's dog funds on her face, a sister who loses her job when her sibling quits to chase a skincare dream, and a comic who's footing the vaca bill after her bestie got hit by a car.

episodes.name: Ditched the Bday Bash for a Smash
episodes.summary: Judge Ms. Pat settles three crazy cases: a birthday tradition ruined by a bestie's secret Vegas fling with her friend's brother, a roommate who stole the couch and dog when he moved out.

episodes.name: You Sold the Show & Sold Me Out
episodes.summary: Judge Ms. Pat settles three cases: a comic fuming after her friend sold out their showcase but kept all the cash, a woman upset after her BFF wrecked her grandma's Chevy with a bad oil change, and a man ghosted after bankrolling.

episodes.name: Cousins, Clout & Crazy Glue
episodes.summary: Judge Ms. Pat settles three cases: cousins clashing over unpaid wedding catering services, a BFF who glued her friend's eye shut and left her with an ER bill, and a podcast partner claiming she built the brand but got ditched.

episodes.name: The Twin, the Ex & the Karaoke Queen
episodes.summary: Judge Ms. Pat settles three cases including a lease dispute with a wannabe karaoke star; an ex-hubby crashes the family minivan he didn't pay for; one twin sticks the other with a sky-high phone bill after her Dominican Republic girls' trip.

episodes.name: Granny's Gambling Gone Wrong
episodes.summary: A daughter sues her bingo-fanatic mama for blowing her kids' emergency fund; a publicist wants payment from her clout-chasing ex-client; a salty ex cries foul over his ex selling his camera for rent money.

episodes.name: Broke, Blocked & Busted
episodes.summary: Ms. Pat is taking her unfiltered humor, street smarts and life lessons to a seat behind the judge's bench to settle real cases.

episodes.name: Baby Beef, Blown Bucks & Backyard Booty Mayhem
episodes.summary: Three cases, zero chill; Judge Ms. Pat takes on a mom who swapped her daughter's LASIK loan for a shiny new Tesla; a best friend demanding baby-shower payback; a neighbor whose backyard hookup left more than hearts broken.
