episodes.name: Sleeping Beauties: The Tower Bedroom
episodes.summary: Daphne and Ian take on their first renovation in the castle as they plan to transform the bell tower into a luxury bedroom suite; the tower's in a ruined state and rotten roof beams and a windstorm could turn this project into a catastrophe.

episodes.name: Beauty and the Feast: The Fairytale Kitchen
episodes.summary: Daphne and Ian aim to transform a 300-year-old outbuilding into a luxury home; the kitchen needs a major overhaul; Daphne looks to create an open-plan space, but when the kitchen cabinets are canceled, the project may be doomed before it even begins.

episodes.name: Prints Charming: The Enchanted Bathroom
episodes.summary: After completing their new bedroom in the Bell Tower, Daphne and Ian look to create a much-needed bathroom; now, the couple decides to take on a water-damaged room, with no existing plumbing, and turn it into a bathing chamber worthy of royalty.

episodes.name: Happy Ever Afters: The Secret Wedding Salon
episodes.summary: Daphne and Ian plan to build on the existing wedding business her grandfather started, and the restoration of the castle depends on their bookings; they hope to gain an edge by creating an impressive office and cozy sitting room to host clients.

episodes.name: Princess and the Zzzzs: The Hunters Lodge Bedroom
episodes.summary: Daphne and Ian take on the Hunters Lodge, a cottage that her grandfather used as his home; the plan is create a bright and luxurious bedroom suite not just for themselves, but an enticing space for brides and grooms to occupy on their wedding night.

episodes.name: A Fairytale Mending: The Enchanted Castle Workshop
episodes.summary: To continue their builds for ongoing château renovations, Daphne and Ian realize they need a dedicated workspace; they aim to transform one of the 28 horse stables into a workshop, but piled high with rubbish, it can be a big and costly renovation.

episodes.name: Rafunzel: The Castle Playroom
episodes.summary: The château is the ultimate playground on 150 acres with a moat, dungeons and endless rooms, but it's not exactly kid-friendly; Daphne and Ian set out to make over the existing playroom fit for the little princes and princesses who visit the castle.

episodes.name: Dreamland: The Bedroom Fit for a King
episodes.summary: Daphne and Ian look to reinstate one of the original château bedrooms that once hosted real Kings and Queens of France.

episodes.name: The Secret Library
episodes.summary: After removing a marble bathroom that was damaging the beams below, Daphne and Ian reimagine the space into an enchanting castle library and amid the challenges, a surprise visit from Daphne's father brings a welcome boost of warmth and encouragement.

episodes.name: Granny's Gatehouse
episodes.summary: After a request from Daphne's grandmother to move back to the castle, Daphne and Ian face another challenge as they renovate a derelict building in the property: the château gatehouse.

episodes.name: The Powder Rooms: Royal Flush
episodes.summary: Daphne and Ian need to stand out from the crowd to secure wedding bookings, so they turn their restrooms into luxury powder rooms; the discovery of a hidden bridge in the forest inspires them to add Renaissance-style murals to the powder room walls.

episodes.name: Granny and the Gutted Gatehouse
episodes.summary: Granny expresses shock at the unfinished state of the gatehouse interior; Daphne and Ian install a castle view mezzanine, find a statement chandelier at Tony's in Normandy and add special touches for Charlie the cat.

episodes.name: Fairy Cakes: The Castle's Tea Room
episodes.summary: Daphne and Ian create a tearoom to help pay for a costly terrace fix; Dick and Angel visit to lend their expertise; Ian designs frescoes for the wall, and Daphne upcycles a dresser, a bar, and a dessert cart.

episodes.name: Dungeon Masters
episodes.summary: To offset the terrace repair costs, Ian plans to turn the dungeon into a medieval tavern to rent to future clients; his vision includes axe throwing and jousting, while Daphne plans an apothecary corner that's linked to the château's history.

episodes.name: Rapunzel's Enchanted Tower
episodes.summary: With a baby due in a matter of months, Daphne and Ian take on a challenge as they race to transform their historic three-story Dove Tower into a luxury bridal suite, creating the perfect wedding retreat far from the cries of a newborn.

episodes.name: A Fairytale Ending: The Enchanted Dove Tower
episodes.summary: In the season finale, it's a race to the finish line to complete the Dove Tower; but with costs spiraling and time running out, Daphne and Ian face some tough decisions in order to finish the project before their baby arrives.

episodes.name: I Have Tourette's Stupid!
episodes.summary: Baylen Dupree is a young adult living with Tourette Syndrome that impacts every aspect of her life and the lives of her parents and five siblings; ready to be an independent adult, Baylen tries to navigate a world full of triggers and danger.

episodes.name: The Airport Is a Tic Disaster
episodes.summary: Baylen learns what Colin's work relocation could mean for their relationship; Baylen is invited to be a guest panelist at a Tourette's Convention in Dallas, but airports and flying can be a recipe for disaster.

episodes.name: We All Have Tourette's
episodes.summary: Baylen travels to Texas for a Tourette convention, but her tics threaten to overpower her big moment.

episodes.name: Going for Narnia!
episodes.summary: After suffering a terrifying tic attack, questions are raised about Baylen's ability to live on her own; Baylen and Colin decide to take a big step in their relationship, but the excitement is short-lived as they begin sharing the news with family.

episodes.name: It Was Him, Chainsaws, Me
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin are excited to live together but need approval from Colin's very conservative parents first; Allen talks man-to-man with Colin; Baylen tries Botox to help with her tics; Colin drops a life-changing bomb.

episodes.name: I Have News
episodes.summary: After an eventful apartment hunting adventure, Baylen and Colin move in together, but outside forces bring everything to a halt; at Baylen's birthday party, Colin's surprise royally backfires, leaving Baylen wondering if they are on the same page.

episodes.name: What if My Dad Says No?
episodes.summary: After a fight at Baylen's birthday party, Colin works on rebuilding trust; Allen and Julie worry Baylen's tics are getting worse and wonder if Deep Brain Stimulation could work; Colin breaks the news to Julie and Allen about his true intentions.

episodes.name: You Don't Have to Stare Into My Soul
episodes.summary: Colin seeks Baylen's parents' blessing to propose to her during their family vacation; Baylen and her parents meet with a neurologist to discuss Deep Brain Stimulation; Colin realizes it's going to be a battle after a secret meeting with Allen.

episodes.name: This Is a Big Plot Twist
episodes.summary: The Duprees head to the beach for their annual family vacation where Colin secretly plans to propose, but a brewing thunderstorm threatens to ruin his proposal plans; Baylen and Colin drop one last bombshell on the entire family.

episodes.name: Obsessed With Everything
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin enjoy being fiancés but are dragging their feet on wedding planning; Baylen questions Allen about an unresolved issue; a reluctant Baylen makes a cake for Colin's birthday; her parents spring a surprising request on them.

episodes.name: The Ticcer
episodes.summary: Baylen has an unexpected reaction to the first wedding venue she and Colin tour; Baylen meets with her CBIT therapist to discuss goals for her wedding day; at their first pre-marital counseling session, Colin reveals he's been keeping a secret.

episodes.name: Addicted All Around
episodes.summary: Colin's surprising admission to Baylen throws a wrench in the wedding vision; Sammi and Burke don't hold back in sharing their opinions with Baylen; Allen concocts a master plan that he hopes Baylen will be on board with for her big day.

episodes.name: Anxiety on High Alert
episodes.summary: Baylen hosts a sleepover for her brother, Bechnir; Allen and Julie seize the rare chance to have a date night; Bechnir confides in Baylen about his severe anxiety; Allen confronts the painful history behind his fierce protectiveness.

episodes.name: It's So Inappropriate!
episodes.summary: Baylen's new tic about Colin's mom has her dreading their trip to Roanoke; Colin turns to his sister for advice on his career after the military; Julie and Allen discuss Bechnir's anxiety; Colin invites some surprising guests to a venue tour.

episodes.name: She's Gonna Lose Her Mind
episodes.summary: During counseling, the therapist throws a wrench in Colin's plan to confront Allen; Baylen and Colin fall in love with a wedding venue, but when they see the Dupree backyard transformed for the engagement party, they second guess everything.

episodes.name: Did I Mention That I Have Tourette?
episodes.summary: At their engagement party, Baylen and Colin finally announce they've chosen the wedding venue of their dreams, but it's a decision that leaves both Julie and Allen struggling to find their place in Baylen's wedding plans.

episodes.name: Saddle Up!
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin's plan to set boundaries turns upside down when Allen pressures Colin to have a back-up plan for his new real estate career; the couple gets a harsh reality check at their first meeting with their wedding planner.

episodes.name: I'm on the Struggle Bus
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin find themselves in an impossible situation with the wedding; Baylen readies herself for wedding dress shopping, but it's bittersweet without Sammi; on their drive to meet Dr. Flaherty, Colin drops a truth bomb on Baylen.

episodes.name: Get Me Out of Here!
episodes.summary: Baylen grows curious about a device for her tics but would need to leave the country to try it; a trip to the library is anything but uneventful for Baylen; Colin takes the first step in his new career and learns just how hard it can be to succeed.

episodes.name: Your Anxiety Is Giving Me Anxiety
episodes.summary: While meeting with their wedding planners, Baylen and Colin are dealt another blow to their wedding budget. The Duprees are off to London for a potential life-changing experience as Baylen will get to try a device that could reduce her tics. However, Baylen's difficulty navigating the airport and Colin's severe flight anxiety threatens to derail the journey before it begins.

episodes.name: Ticcing in a British Accent
episodes.summary: The Duprees arrive in London! And they must quickly navigate the culture shock; on a double-decker tour bus, Baylen becomes overstimulated, and her tics escalate, causing her a lot of distress.

episodes.name: My Brain Feels Different
episodes.summary: After dealing with escalating tics throughout London, Baylen finally gets to try a device that could help reduce her tics and possibly change her life forever; Baylen and Colin reconsider their future plans, leaving Allen and Julie stunned...

episodes.name: Tasting Out Loud
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin take on Washington D.C. and taste some of the city's best cuisines in hope of expanding their palates and finding inspiration for what to serve on their wedding day.

episodes.name: It's Time to Party!
episodes.summary: With less than seven months to their big day, Baylen and Colin are still struggling to make major wedding decisions; Baylen and maid of honor Sammi are at odds over the planning of Baylen and Colin's joint bachelor and bachelorette weekend.

episodes.name: Altared Plans
episodes.summary: When Sammi fails to show up to their joint Bach weekend, Baylen has an honest conversation with Sammi about her role; after Julie raises concerns about how remote the venue is, Baylen proposes a plan that might put the entire wedding day in jeopardy.

episodes.name: Unsave the Date
episodes.summary: Baylen's tics are in full swing as she and Colin embrace the holiday spirit by taking Christmas photos with Santa and the dogs; Allen plans a heartfelt surprise for his and Julie's 25th anniversary; Baylen and Colin reveal a major wedding decision.

episodes.name: Say Yes to the Stress
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin's wedding announcement sends everyone into planning overdrive; with the help of her mom and grandmothers, Baylen heads to Florida to find her perfect wedding dress; Allen receives major news that could uproot the entire family.

episodes.name: Knot on My Bingo Card
episodes.summary: Baylen's search for her dream wedding dress yields too many contenders; anxiety goes into overdrive as Baylen and Julie head to Kansas for a girls' weekend with Sammi; and Sammi's surprise outing pushes Baylen outside her comfort zone.

episodes.name: 'Til Death Do Us Part
episodes.summary: Sammi's planned surprises lead to Baylen and Julie making some permanent decisions and spending an evening at a funeral home; Baylen reveals a worrisome medical concern; then, strong opinions during wedding planning put the sisters at odds again.

episodes.name: Roses Are Red, Officiants Are Bald
episodes.summary: Baylen returns from Kansas City still hurt by Sammi's Bridezilla comment; hoping to lift Baylen's spirits, Colin plans a Valentine's Day surprise while the couple meets a wedding officiant; Colin reveals another surprise she never saw coming.

episodes.name: A Tasting of Things to Come
episodes.summary: After surprising Baylen with a wedding day change, the couple goes to their menu tasting and Colin drops another bombshell; Julie worries the mounting pressure on Sammi to pull off the perfect celebration could further strain her relationship with Baylen.

episodes.name: Showered With Opinions
episodes.summary: Baylen's bridal shower finally arrives, but the celebration takes a turn when she reveals shocking future plans; later, Baylen and Sammi confront the tension that's been lingering; Baylen and Colin's trip to Myrtle might be over before it begins.

episodes.name: To Have and To Hold...A Mortgage
episodes.summary: Baylen and Colin travel to Myrtle Beach to explore relocation, but after accidentally throwing her pills away, Baylen navigates the trip without her medication. Meanwhile, Julie and Allen are increasingly concerned about the couple's decisions.

episodes.name: Lone Star State Update
episodes.summary: After spending years living all over the world, Teresa and Jeremy find the perfect vacation home for their family in Texas.

episodes.name: A Big Wow on Alabama's Lake Wedowee
episodes.summary: After spending years renting on Lake Wedowee in Alabama, Chris and Jenny are ready to purchase a vacation home for their family.

episodes.name: Georgia Reno on Their Minds
episodes.summary: Outdoor enthusiasts John and Heather are looking for a vacation retreat for their family on Lake Oconee in Ga., and they find a fixer-upper in an ideal setting.

episodes.name: Big Reno on Apple Valley Lake
episodes.summary: Mark and Mary are looking for a lake house that can serve as a meeting place for their large family; they customize an Ohio lakefront home for their large family.

episodes.name: Getting Down in Deep Creek, Maryland
episodes.summary: A family of six looks for a vacation home on Deep Creek Lake, Md., but the lakefront property of their dreams needs some major renovations.

episodes.name: Second Generation Renovation on Georgia's Lake Arrowhead
episodes.summary: Lisa and Angela are co-workers and friends that are searching for a house with the help of their daughters Daniele and Allie, and are hoping to find the perfect vacation home to share between their two growing families.

episodes.name: Modern Farmhouse Fix-Up
episodes.summary: In Texas, Dan and Emily find a waterfront home on Cedar Creek Lake that has tons of potential but needs a lot of work.

episodes.name: Lakeside Lounging on Lake Gaston
episodes.summary: Amber and Jon are looking for a getaway near their home in Raleigh, N.C., and Lake Gaston fits the bill.

episodes.name: Northeast Texas Turnaround
episodes.summary: A Minnesota couple searches for a vacation home in Texas that reminds them of their home state, and their agent finds a lakefront property that needs quite a few repairs.

episodes.name: Big Time Brother Rebuild in Rhode Island
episodes.summary: Business partner brothers look for a vacation home in Coventry, R.I., but the to-do list is long and the brothers quickly run into structural issues.

episodes.name: Spruce Up on Alabama's Smith Lake
episodes.summary: College sweethearts are ready to find a vacation home for their family on Alabama's Smith Lake; they're shown several properties, but each will require some work.

episodes.name: Loving Life on Lake Tawakoni in Texas
episodes.summary: Water enthusiasts Matt and Heather find a vacation property close to their Dallas home on Lake Tawakoni in Texas, and they plan to open up the kitchen, remodel the bathrooms, build a multi-level deck and fix up the boat dock.

episodes.name: Alabama Lakefront Overhaul
episodes.summary: A couple with renovation know-how is looking for a fixer-upper lake house near Weiss Lake in Alabama, and find a place with hidden problems in the walls and under the floor.

episodes.name: Fix Up on Deep Creek
episodes.summary: A couple head back to their favorite spot from their college days to search for a vacation home near Deep Creek Lake, Md.; they're searching for a fixer-upper they can customize with easy lake access.

episodes.name: Next Up: Niagara
episodes.summary: Jodi and Dave are used to spending their vacations traveling in their RV with their three children, but are now looking for a getaway close to their home in Buffalo, N.Y.; they find a property along Lake Ontario in Niagara County, but it needs work.

episodes.name: Wolf Lake Escape
episodes.summary: New parents look to escape their busy New York City lives with a move to Wolf Lake, a small, rustic lake community in upstate New York; the properties they consider require significant renovations and may break the bank.

episodes.name: Rework in Wisconsin
episodes.summary: A couple finds a fixer-upper in Wisconsin that overlooks Lake Michigan, and they're doing all the renovation work themselves; he's a contractor with experience renovating properties, and she's ready to join him and get her hands dirty.

episodes.name: Deep Creek Dreaming
episodes.summary: Two couples team up to buy their dream vacation house on Deep Creek Lake, Md.; their agreed upon must-haves include water views and space for nine people but finding a property that both couples agree on may be a challenge.

episodes.name: Jackson Lake Remake
episodes.summary: An Atlanta couple fight budget restraints as they seek the perfect vacation home for their blended family in Jackson Lake, Ga.

episodes.name: Making Memories on Lake Martin
episodes.summary: A blended family of eight finds a vacation home on Lake Martin, Ala.; the property needs major renovations, but he's a contractor and is ready to get to work to help the family realize their lakeside living dreams.

episodes.name: A Family Renovation
episodes.summary: Two brothers and their wives look for the perfect vacation home in Door County, Wisconsin, for their extended family of 30.

episodes.name: Alabama Build
episodes.summary: A family looks for a vacation home on Logan Martin Lake, Alabama, in hopes of getaways filled with fishing, kayaking and relaxation.

episodes.name: Otter Tail Transformation
episodes.summary: A family with three young kids finds its forever lake home in Otter Tail County, Minn.; however, it is far from turnkey and the massive and complex renovation may derail the lakeside living dreams.

episodes.name: From LA to Lake Tuscaloosa
episodes.summary: A couple hopes to escape their busy LA lives with a quiet vacation home along Lake Tuscaloosa; they find a property with great potential and are ready to take on the renovations, but it may prove to be more work than expected.

episodes.name: Makeover in Missouri
episodes.summary: Empty nesters find a home on Lake of the Ozarks, Missouri, and leave snowy Indiana behind. He's a contractor and offers hands-on help during the renovation, but a major discovery during demolition disrupts the couple's plans.

episodes.name: Lake Country Lounging
episodes.summary: A family finds a fixer-upper in Lake Country, Wisconsin, in hopes of turning it into a lakefront retreat with a boat dock. The house's outdated style and need for major repairs may break the budget, dashing their lakeside dreams.

episodes.name: A Flip for the Family on Lake Guntersville, Alabama
episodes.summary: After years of hard work, a real estate agent uses the fruits of her labor to purchase an investment property that can be flipped for dual purposes; a new home for her daughter that will one day transition into an excellent rental property.

episodes.name: Lakefront Luxe on a Budget in Wabash Valley, Illinois
episodes.summary: The Wabash River winds its way through Indiana and Illinois; this family is looking for the perfect lakeside fixer-upper in the southwestern part of the valley; but the pitfalls of renovation may push their project over budget.

episodes.name: A Renovation for Future Generations on Skiatook Lake
episodes.summary: A married couple is on the hunt for a property on Oklahoma's Skiatook Lake, with plans to transform it into the ultimate lakeside retreat; a place to create lasting memories and eventually pass down to future generations of their family.

episodes.name: Hoping for Major Upgrades for Minimal Cost on Lake Erie
episodes.summary: After selling their lake house in Indiana, a couple from Apollo, Pennsylvania searches for a weekend getaway closer to home; Lake Erie offers the perfect mix of convenience and charm with great food and wine.

episodes.name: A Lakefront Okoboji Overhaul in Iowa
episodes.summary: An Iowa couple searches for lakefront property with potential that they can transform into the perfect picturesque getaway for them and their large family.

episodes.name: 10,000 Lakes, One Perfect Lake House
episodes.summary: Minnesota is known as the Land of 10,000 Lakes and there's no better place to find the perfect house on the perfect lake; with lakefront prices at an all-time high, this couple will need to create their dream retreat with some hands-on renovations.

episodes.name: A Lakefront Fixer Upper Near Family
episodes.summary: Wanting to be closer to the family, first-time homebuyers look for a place that won't break their budget and that's close to their favorite lakes; with houses selling for over a million dollars, they need a diamond in the rough to fix.

episodes.name: An Upstate New York Family Seeks Lakeside Sanctuary in the Finger Lakes
episodes.summary: An upstate New York couple is taking the leap in the Finger Lakes region; with their young daughter and son in tow and relatives nearby, they're excited to transform a charming fixer-upper into a place for lasting family memories.

episodes.name: Renovation Dreams on Douglas Lake, Tennessee
episodes.summary: A couple dreams of finding waterfront property with rental potential on Douglas Lake in Tennessee; they are ready to get their hands dirty and make it their own in hopes that they can host friends, family and even renters for extra income.

episodes.name: Longtime Friends Give a Lake House New Life in South Carolina
episodes.summary: A decades long friendship explores uncharted waters when an agent helps her longtime friend buy and renovate a lake home; they've made countless memories on Lake Hartwell, so it's only fitting that's where he's looking to find his forever home.

episodes.name: A Vermont Family Looks for a Waterfront Oasis on Lake Champlain
episodes.summary: A Vermont family finally finds their dream spot on Lake Champlain.

episodes.name: Living the Lake Life Dream on Lake Amon G. Carter, Texas
episodes.summary: After years of visits to the lake, the family of five is ready to find a forever home on Lake Amon G. Carter; their dream is to build a home with unlimited activities for all and unmatched views of the lake from every angle.

episodes.name: Moving Close to Family and Even Closer to the Lake
episodes.summary: A first-time homebuyer has moved back to northeast Ohio to be closer to his family; he's searching for an affordable property that he can renovate into his forever lakeside retreat.

episodes.name: A First Home Search on the Lakes of the Delaware River Region of NJ
episodes.summary: After running a flipping business with his parents, a man and his fiancée are now looking for their first home along the lakes of the Delaware River Region of New Jersey. They plan to renovate the property themselves with help from his family.

episodes.name: A New Start for Two Retirees on Michigan's Duck Lake
episodes.summary: A retired military couple wants to move from Maryland to find a forever home n Michigan's Duck Lake. They're willing to put in some sweat equity for renovations with hopes they can inspire their children and grandchildren to make frequent visits.

episodes.name: A Couple Renos a Waterfront Home in New York's Finger Lakes
episodes.summary: A Hudson Valley couple, looking for a deal on a waterfront vacation spot for their whole family only a few hours from them in the Finger Lakes of New York, will need to renovate an outdated home to get themselves the lakeside retreat of their dreams.

episodes.name: Best Buds Build Big on Deep Creek Lake Maryland
episodes.summary: Two best friends and business partners have flipped many houses together, but now they plan to renovate one for themselves. Lake property here is pricey, so these buyers will look for a bargain that they can transform into the perfect lake escape.

episodes.name: Searching for a Multifamily Home on Lake Superior, MN
episodes.summary: A young couple searches for a multifamily home on Minnesota's Lake Superior. They hope to live on one floor and also have income generating rentals. With the support of an investor and their own skills they hope to renovate for well under their budget.

episodes.name: Family Vacation Home on Indiana's Lake Lemon
episodes.summary: A couple who owns a construction company searches the shores of Lake Lemon, IN for an out-of-date home. They want to use their skills to turn it into the perfect vacation home to entertain their lake-loving teenagers, adult kids, and first grandchild.

episodes.name: A Cozy Cottage on Lake Ontario in Need of Some Hard Work and TLC
episodes.summary: Empty nesters search for a cozy cottage they can make their own along Lake Ontario's sprawling New York shoreline. With a modest budget, they aren't afraid of a fixer-upper, but they are hopeful they can find something with direct lakefront access.

episodes.name: Bringing Family Together With Lake House Dreams in Vermont
episodes.summary: A family finds the perfect lakefront location with a not-so-perfect house in Vermont. Their carpentry skills come in handy for the full gut renovation, as costly foundation repairs add up.

episodes.name: Cabinets, Paint & Floors Along the Shores of Southern Illinois
episodes.summary: After years of flipping homes, a couple is searching for an affordable lakefront property to call their own. Despite a competitive market, they're confident their skills will help them find and create a lakeside oasis to enjoy with friends and family.

episodes.name: A Vacation Home Search on Scenic Lake Barkley, Kentucky
episodes.summary: A couple expecting their first child together look for a vacation home on Kentucky's beautiful Lake Barkley. They want to do their own renovations, but they must be done before mom has to go back to work once the baby is born.

episodes.name: The Long Island Serial Killer: The Lost Girls
episodes.summary: When a vivacious young escort, Shannan Gilbert, vanishes on Long Island's south shore in 2010, her disappearance leads police to discover the bodies of 10 other victims dumped by a serial killer.

episodes.name: The Long Island Serial Killer: New Revelations
episodes.summary: The discovery of four women's bodies on Gilgo Beach is just the beginning, as investigators uncover multiple suspects and shocking theories while racing to identify the Long Island Serial Killer before he strikes again.

episodes.name: What Happened to Baby Lisa?
episodes.summary: In 2011, a 10-month-old baby girl goes missing from her home in Kansas City, Mo., and her family fears she's been kidnapped by a drifter, only to be accused by the police of being responsible for her disappearance.

episodes.name: Stranger Than Fiction
episodes.summary: Police question suspects in the inner circle of Jackie Galloway, a woman found strangled and bound with ritualistic knots; a chance encounter with a prowler leads them to the shocking discovery of a budding serial killer.

episodes.name: Cabin 28: Horror in the Woods
episodes.summary: In 1981, a woman and three teenagers are murdered in a cabin in the remote town of Keddie, Calif., and no one is ever brought to justice; now, new evidence may hold the key to finally cracking this case.

episodes.name: Hollywood Horror Story
episodes.summary: Hikers discover the severed head of Hervey Medellín in the Hollywood Hills; the suspects include former lovers, drug cartel hit men and a porn star in this tale of lust, greed and butchery.

episodes.name: In the Name of Love
episodes.summary: In Grand Prairie, Texas, a game of truth-or-dare leads to a startling confession in the 1995 shooting death of 16-year-old Adrianne Jones.

episodes.name: JonBenét: The Untold Truth
episodes.summary: Six-year-old beauty queen JonBenét Ramsey is found murdered in her Boulder, Colo., home in 1996, and investigators try to determine whether she was killed by an intruder or by a member of her own family.

episodes.name: The Grim Sleeper
episodes.summary: A lone survivor is the only witness who can help police track down a serial killer known as the Grim Sleeper preying on women in South Central Los Angeles; after decades of searching, police hone in on an unlikely suspect.

episodes.name: The Darkest of Nights
episodes.summary: In Craig, Ala., townspeople are shocked when police discover the charred body of beloved mother and wife Lauri Waterman; people have no idea who would want to kill her, then an unlikely witness reveals a sordid story of secrets and lies.

episodes.name: Jeffrey MacDonald: The Accused
episodes.summary: A brutal 1970 home invasion claims the lives of Army surgeon Jeffrey MacDonald's wife and daughters, leaving him the lone survivor; authorities doubt his story of murderous hippies and believe MacDonald committed the crime himself.

episodes.name: Golden State Killer
episodes.summary: In the 1970s, a serial rapist is on the loose in northern California; then, as his reign of terror over the community wanes, police discover he isn't just a serial rapist, he's a serial murderer, and he's been killing people all over California.

episodes.name: Where Is Baby DeOrr?
episodes.summary: A young couple's toddler vanishes while the family is enjoying an impromptu camping trip in Leadore, Idaho; investigators and private detectives work around the clock to find the missing boy, only to come back to his parents.

episodes.name: Shallow Grave
episodes.summary: When a young family vanishes from their Southern California dream home, friends and family are left with dozens of unanswered questions; authorities suspect they fled the country, until an unlikely source uncovers the truth.

episodes.name: Connecticut Horror Story
episodes.summary: One summer night in 2007, the Petit family is woken up by two strangers in their quiet Connecticut home; suddenly, these four family members find themselves being held hostage and in a fight for their lives.

episodes.name: Once Bitten
episodes.summary: Sherri Rasmussen and John Ruetten are enjoying newlywed life until one morning when Sherri calls into work sick; that night, John returns home to find his wife murdered; years later, detectives discover Sherri's killer was too close for comfort.

episodes.name: Murder at Sea
episodes.summary: A premiere fishing boat explodes into flames just offshore, stunning the small fishing town of Craig, Alaska; after fighting the flames, state troopers discover the remains of a young family and few clues as to what could have set the ship ablaze.

episodes.name: Marked for Murder
episodes.summary: In Florida, friends and family are stunned after an esteemed criminal law professor is executed in his garage; investigators follow a series of leads taking them on a statewide hunt in search of the murderous masterminds.

episodes.name: Killing Field
episodes.summary: After a young couple goes missing, detectives find a clue leading them to a strange storage container in the middle of 95 acres, and what's inside unlocks the secrets of a monster hiding in plain sight.

episodes.name: Blood in the Sand
episodes.summary: In 1984, the body of a 14-year-old girl turns up on the beach in San Diego and police think it relates to the murder of another teen; a clue yields an unbelievable suspect.

episodes.name: My Father, the Serial Killer
episodes.summary: In 1980, Tim Hack and Kelly Drew go missing from a small Wisconsin town, then their bodies are found in a field; a woman comes forward nearly 40 years later to help solve the so-called "Sweetheart Murders" of Hack and Drew.

episodes.name: Alaskan Temptress
episodes.summary: Shock sweeps through a Washington community when a suburban mother gets arrested for a murder from a decade earlier in Alaska; details of a seedy and sordid past emerge.

episodes.name: Death Before Dawn
episodes.summary: Police investigate the shooting of millionaires Brad and Andra Sachs in their home in 2014 and track a series of clues in a chase to find the couple's killer.

episodes.name: Somebody's Watching
episodes.summary: After a fire chief's wife's burned body is discovered, an autopsy reveals she died from a gunshot wound to the head, and the arson investigation turns into a hunt for her killer.

episodes.name: Terror in Philadelphia
episodes.summary: In 1998, a gifted Philadelphia graduate student is found murdered in her bed, triggering a hunt for her killer.

episodes.name: Gone in 90 Seconds
episodes.summary: When an 11-year-old Arizona girl vanishes while waiting for an ice cream truck, it's clear she's been abducted; the search for her leads to a trail of suspects, making it the largest missing child investigation in Arizona history.

episodes.name: Fallen Angels
episodes.summary: A 12-year-old girl goes missing on her way to school in Oregon City, Ore.; the police investigation offers little in the way of leads, then a second girl disappears.

episodes.name: Mystery in the Swamp
episodes.summary: The morning of his anniversary, Mike Williams goes duck hunting; when he fails to return home, an all-out search commences, but it's only the beginning of a sordid mystery that will take close to 20 years to solve.

episodes.name: Murder Among Friends
episodes.summary: In the summer of 1980, a popular teen goes for a run around her hometown in Maine and, days later, her savagely beaten body is found; what happened remains a mystery for years until her mother intervenes and forces police to re-examine the case.

episodes.name: Gone Girls
episodes.summary: Over the span of decades, three women meet their deaths or go missing under mysterious circumstances, forcing authorities to examine the one thing they had in common -- they all fell in love with the same man.

episodes.name: Fatal Family Secrets
episodes.summary: A celebratory night turns deadly for the Whitaker family as they are gunned down at home; when investigators uncover a conspiracy, it will test one man's ability to forgive as he fights to save the criminal mastermind from the death penalty.

episodes.name: Murder on Newberry St.
episodes.summary: In York, Pa., race riots claim the lives of an African-American mother and a young, white police officer; their deaths are largely forgotten until 30 years later when their cold cases are reopened, revealing the city's dark past.

episodes.name: The Unicorn Killer
episodes.summary: In Philadelphia, police make a horrific discovery 18 months after a woman goes missing; the police pursue the woman's killer, but he always manages to stay one step ahead of the law.

episodes.name: Children of Thunder
episodes.summary: In the summer of 2000, bags full of body parts start appearing all over the San Francisco Bay Area; investigators follow the trail of grisly clues to a secret cult carrying out a sinister scheme.

episodes.name: Monster in the Desert
episodes.summary: In 1992, a 19-year-old woman is brutally assaulted outside of Desert Hot Springs, Calif.; miraculously, she escapes but lives in constant fear that her assailant will find her again one day, not realizing she has survived a serial killer.

episodes.name: The Sound of Silence
episodes.summary: Gallaudet University is the premier college for the deaf in the United States, but this haven of higher learning is turned upside down after two students are murdered in their dormitory rooms.

episodes.name: Burned Alive
episodes.summary: On a Mississippi back road, a 19-year-old woman is set on fire and left to burn alive; her last words lead detectives down a road of dead ends and the case goes cold until a special agent taps into her location data and finds a suspect.

episodes.name: Who Killed Jane Doe 59?
episodes.summary: In 1969, a woman is found murdered in Los Angeles, but her identity is a mystery; for decades, police investigate hoping to put a name to the face and find her killer; the one lead that comes up over and over leads them to Charles Manson.

episodes.name: The Springfield Three
episodes.summary: On June 6, 1992, Suzie Streeter and Stacy McCall attend parties celebrating their high school graduation; by morning, the teenagers have gone missing, along with Suzie's mother, Sherrill Levitt; the case leads police on a nationwide search.

episodes.name: Vanished
episodes.summary: So-Cal surfer and tech entrepreneur Chris Smith dreams of making a tidy sum of money and surfing off into the sunset; it seems as though his dreams have come true, but all is not as it appears.

episodes.name: Without a Trace
episodes.summary: In San Francisco, Kevin Collins, 10, disappears on his way home, galvanizing the residents to find him; with few leads to go on, Kevin's case sheds light on hundreds of other children who have vanished without a trace in the United States.

episodes.name: The Freeway Phantom
episodes.summary: In the early 1970s, Washington D.C. is terrorized by a cunning killer who abducts and murders six young African American girls; police and the community are outraged by the serial killings that target young children in their own neighborhoods.

episodes.name: A Killing in Chinatown
episodes.summary: Cambodian genocide survivor Dr. Haing Ngor wins an Oscar for his role in "The Killing Fields," then he's gunned down outside his Los Angeles home, and the LAPD investigates a web of political intrigue, revenge and street gangs to uncover the truth.

episodes.name: Memphis Blues
episodes.summary: NBA basketball player Lorenzen Wright goes missing outside of Memphis, Tenn., then his body is discovered in the woods, and investigators find out this case is far from a slam dunk.

episodes.name: Law & Murder
episodes.summary: A double murder involving the family of a federal judge prompts an investigation of epic proportions by the FBI, U.S. Marshals and Chicago Police Department; at the end of the trail, law enforcement personnel learn the death count may climb higher.

episodes.name: Nine Years in the Shadows
episodes.summary: In 1988, a young woman is found murdered in her Modesto, Calif., home, leading police to investigate the strife and infidelity in her marriage; a surprising witness eventually comes forward.

episodes.name: The Cheerleader and The Hitman
episodes.summary: When a widower and father of three is found murdered outside his Long Island home, police have reason to look into shady business dealings as a possible motive; then, a tip leads to three unlikely suspects, exposing dark family secrets.

episodes.name: Oklahoma Horror Story
episodes.summary: Right before Thanksgiving, two masked gunmen reportedly invade a couple's home and kill the husband; with few leads, police use ballistics, forensics and neighborhood gossip to solve this cold-blooded murder.

episodes.name: Suburban Secrets
episodes.summary: After doting mother Cheryl Coker vanishes from Riverside, Ohio, numerous searches turn up nothing; as police take a closer look at the case, they uncover some disturbing information.

episodes.name: Motor City Murder
episodes.summary: A senseless murder rocks an African-American neighborhood in the 1970s Detroit; police arrest suspects who are ultimately convicted of murder, but 47 years later, the truth finally emerges to right history's wrongs.

episodes.name: Highway of Horrors
episodes.summary: In 1992, a college student disappears after her car breaks down on the highway; family and friends join police in a frantic search that hits one setback after another; it may take new advances in DNA technology to finally crack this stubborn case.

episodes.name: Jenner Beach Murders
episodes.summary: A Christian couple's weekend getaway takes a tragic turn when they are found murdered on a northern California beach; satanic imagery found nearby leads local sheriff's deputies on a manhunt.

episodes.name: Flight Risk
episodes.summary: In the mountains of Colorado on Thanksgiving Day 2018, a young pilot goes missing without a trace, leaving behind her baby; police follow the few clues they have and unravel a story far more bizarre and horrifying than anyone could have imagined.

episodes.name: The Delphi Killers
episodes.summary: A quiet rural town is rocked when two middle school girls go on a hike and are later found murdered; when police discover one of the girls may have recorded her killer with her cellphone, the race is on to find the mysterious man.

episodes.name: Blood Ties
episodes.summary: A college student who is working as a radio station intern is murdered, launching a long and frustrating investigation that leaves family and police on the brink of hopelessness; forensic genealogy leads to a man who has been on the run for decades.

episodes.name: The Hollywood Ripper
episodes.summary: A woman is murdered the same night she's supposed to go out with rising star Ashton Kutcher, and police believe the clues point to a serial killer; as the number of victims climbs, one brave woman manages to survive.

episodes.name: Little Girl Gone
episodes.summary: In June 2003, a 5-year-old girl walks around the corner to her friend's house and vanishes into thin air; as police investigate, they realize this quaint Midwest community is hiding some disturbing secrets that may never be fully uncovered.

episodes.name: The Price of Fame
episodes.summary: In 2001, actor Robert Blake finds his new wife, Bonny Lee Bakley, shot in the head in the couple's car; the largest homicide investigation in LAPD history uncovers a story of blind ambition and betrayal.

episodes.name: A Crimson End
episodes.summary: Two members of a prominent family are murdered in Arkansas, and a teenager is arrested; for 24 years, one woman believes the teen is innocent.

episodes.name: Is Rodney Reed Innocent?
episodes.summary: A Texas woman is raped and murdered; a trial sparks a racially charged debate over whether an innocent man was condemned to death; new evidence comes to light; the truth about who killed Stacy Stites.

episodes.name: Red Christmas
episodes.summary: In December 2003, police respond to a mysterious 911 call at a home in Mansfield, Texas; when authorities enter, they discover two bodies; the key to finding the killer is within one of the victim's grasp.

episodes.name: Bible Belt Massacre
episodes.summary: Two days before the new millennium, the Freeman family trailer is burned to the ground; the couple's remains are found, but their teenage daughter and her friend are missing.

episodes.name: Groene Family Massacre
episodes.summary: A savage killer goes on a homicidal rampage and then abducts two young siblings from their home in the middle of the night; the children quickly decide they will do whatever is necessary to survive.

episodes.name: My Mother's Soldier
episodes.summary: A mother's bond to her daughter is put to the ultimate test when one of them shoots a man dead.

episodes.name: Alibi
episodes.summary: During an armed robbery, a father of three is fatally shot, but for 23 years, another family questions if the wrong man is behind bars.

episodes.name: Valley of Death
episodes.summary: Investigators search for links to the mysterious cases of five young people who disappear over a span of four years in the rural area of Lewis-Clark Valley along the Idaho-Washington border.

episodes.name: The Colorado Hammer Killer
episodes.summary: The 2018 murder of the Colorado mom who disappeared amid an alleged breakup with her fiancé.

episodes.name: Evil Comes to Jasper
episodes.summary: The murder of James Byrd, Jr. throws his family into turmoil as law enforcement investigates one of the most gruesome hate crimes in U.S. history.

episodes.name: American Nightmare
episodes.summary: One family's American dream goes up in flames; as they try to rebuild what's left, they vow to search for justice.

episodes.name: The Grudge
episodes.summary: Detectives must get creative to find their suspect when a Mennonite woman goes missing in January 2020 and forensic evidence from her body leads them to a dead end.

episodes.name: Gone in the Night
episodes.summary: When a young woman goes missing, a rookie police officer's intuition leads to an intense investigation, as they race against the clock to find her.

episodes.name: Darkness in the Desert
episodes.summary: A 19-year-old coed leaves her apartment and never returns; when her body is found in a desert river basin, police and internet sleuths wonder if she was a victim of an alleged killer known as the Zombie Hunter.

episodes.name: Natural Born Killers
episodes.summary: In May 2002, a couple goes missing in Ocean City, Maryland, almost as if they vanished into thin air, until a random, late-night burglary leads police to discover a tale of deception, brutality and savagery.

episodes.name: Infamous Pam Hupp
episodes.summary: In 2011, a husband returns home to find his wife dead on the living room floor; he tells first responders she committed suicide, but it was murder; police zero in on the husband and what unfolds is one of the most outrageous tales in recent history.

episodes.name: Candy and Betty
episodes.summary: When neighbors find a young teacher axed to death on Friday the 13th, a sleepy suburb fears a psychopath is loose; the bloody crime scene leads police to a most unlikely suspect, unfolding a story people still have to see to believe 40 years later.

episodes.name: Girl Scout Murders
episodes.summary: In June 1977, three little girls are at summer camp when a vicious predator sneaks into their tent in the middle of the night; as day breaks, a camp counselor uncovers what will become a notorious crime in Oklahoma history.

episodes.name: The I-70 Killer
episodes.summary: In 1992, store clerks across the Midwest are being shot dead in the middle of the day, and it's not long before police connect the dots and realize it's the work of one killer; the race is on as he threatens to strike anywhere at any time.

episodes.name: Where Is Mark Himebaugh?
episodes.summary: In November 1991, 11-year-old Mark Himebaugh leaves home to check out a nearby brushfire and disappears without a trace; as police investigate, they discover that both his family and the town may be hiding some disturbing secrets.

episodes.name: Final Rodeo
episodes.summary: After witnessed with a mysterious stranger, a beautiful teen girl completely vanishes from her small town, turning up brutally slain days later in the Nevada desert; the search for her killer envelops the entire community, and fear abounds.

episodes.name: The Strange Disappearance of Karlie Guse
episodes.summary: A teen mysteriously vanishes after a strange night with friends.

episodes.name: Brighton Ax Murder
episodes.summary: In 1982, a young mother's husband discovers her murdered at home with an ax in her head; everyone thinks a psychopath is on the loose, but police never make an arrest; the authorities find that their killer is someone very close to home.

episodes.name: Who Killed Our Girls?
episodes.summary: Four teenage girls are gunned down at an Austin yogurt shop.

episodes.name: Held Captive: The Disappearance of Tanya Kach
episodes.summary: After moving to a new city following her parents' divorce, a 14-year-old girl is dissatisfied with her new surroundings; she starts running away from home until one time, she never returns; it takes 10 years before dark secrets are revealed.

episodes.name: Dead in Bed
episodes.summary: In 2007, a 19-year-old woman is brutally murdered in the small town of Winnsboro, Texas; the ensuing investigation reveals the small town has a few wolves masquerading in sheep's clothing; some secrets come to light, but others may be buried forever.

episodes.name: Star Crossed Killers
episodes.summary: After a single mother fails to show up for work, police find her brutally stabbed and her daughter missing from their home in an affluent gated community; everyone fears she's in danger, but what they uncover is darker than they could have imagined.

episodes.name: The Times Square Killer
episodes.summary: In the '60s and '70s, a serial killer stalks young women in New Jersey; at the same time, three women in New York City are sadistically murdered; no one expects that one man is causing the mayhem, let alone a seemingly ordinary father of three.

episodes.name: Manhunt
episodes.summary: In 2003, a bank heist escalates into a robbery-homicide, shattering the lives of those left behind; federal and local law enforcement have his picture and DNA, but they can't find the cold-blooded killer until they learn he hides in plain sight.

episodes.name: Long Island Serial Killer: Mystery at Oak Beach
episodes.summary: A terrified young escort calls 911 as she flees into the night and vanishes; her family pressures police to take up the search, and investigators uncover a strange cast of characters - plus 10 other bodies spread along a remote stretch of beach.

episodes.name: Long Island Serial Killer: Caught
episodes.summary: When police discover 10 bodies strewn along a remote beach, there are few answers and even fewer suspects; over a decade later, a new investigation uncovers old leads, and police finally think they've found their man.

episodes.name: The Boogeyman
episodes.summary: The Lunsford family's lives turn upside down when someone snatches nine-year-old Jessie from her bed in the middle of the night; authorities scour the area looking for her when they discover a dark truth, she is closer than they ever realized.

episodes.name: A Story to Die For
episodes.summary: Firefighters discover a body with two gunshot wounds; the fire destroys any hope for evidence and the police look at the victim's social media for clues.

episodes.name: Sex. Clowns. Murder.
episodes.summary: In 1990, a clown delivering flowers and balloons guns down a woman at home; with scant evidence and no clear motive, detectives set out to track down the killer clown, but the culprit eludes justice for thirty years before being fully unmasked.

episodes.name: The Soccer Mom Murder
episodes.summary: In 2001, a mother of five is found shot in the head in her own minivan; investigators have little physical evidence and struggle to make an arrest; as the children grow up, the family becomes divided over who killed the beloved soccer mom.

episodes.name: Where Is Kristin Smart?
episodes.summary: In 1996, a college co-ed vanishes over Memorial Day weekend and is presumed dead; the Sheriffs have their sights on a prime suspect but lack the evidence to prove it; decades later, a discovery found six feet under turns this case upside down.

episodes.name: The Serial Killer's Playbook
episodes.summary: Dallas Police discover a serial killer targeting vulnerable retirees.

episodes.name: The Aloha Murder
episodes.summary: In 1972, police find a young woman fatally stabbed in her room; police hunt for her killer, but he seemingly vanishes, and the case goes cold; decades later, a new investigative technique emerges, and the killer's name turns up.

episodes.name: Teenage Assassins
episodes.summary: A mysterious shooter attacks a loving father.

episodes.name: Knives Out
episodes.summary: In 2021, police find a retired couple stabbed repeatedly in their home; they witness a mysterious figure coming and going on security footage, which leads them to a suspect who is very close to home with a desire for revenge.

episodes.name: My Father Was a Mass Murderer
episodes.summary: Retired drama teacher Kathy Gilchrist embarks on a journey to find her biological parents; her worst fears come to fruition when she discovers police want her father for one of the most infamous mass murders in Maryland state history.

episodes.name: Inferno of Lies
episodes.summary: A deadly fire in a small Illinois town raises questions whether it was a tragic accident or murder; the ensuing investigation uncovers a web of lies and deceit that results in one woman and her unborn child's life coming to a violent end.

episodes.name: The Indiana Slasher
episodes.summary: In 1975, someone abducts three young girls, stabbing them and leaving them for dead in a field; the Indiana Slasher evades capture, leaving his victims haunted for decades until new technology uncovers his true identity.

episodes.name: Vanished in the Heartland
episodes.summary: Questions and accusations fly after savvy entrepreneur and mother of five, 52-year-old Dee Warner, vanishes from her rural Michigan home. Authorities struggle for answers, until one day they find her, closer to home than anyone could have imagined.

episodes.name: Death in Hell's Kitchen
episodes.summary: As Pride Month kicks off in 2022, the deaths of two gay men in New York City shatter their families and the gay community, leading the NYPD to uncover a ruthless gang that stalks, drugs, and murders their victims before draining their bank accounts.

episodes.name: Sex House Homicide
episodes.summary: In Ocala, Fla., the local sheriff's office responds to a wellness check only to find the body of a man in what looks like a sexual pleasure palace; it could be a homosexual hate crime, revenge or a killer much closer to home.

episodes.name: Playing With Fire
episodes.summary: In 2001, someone murders a father, sets his Florida home ablaze and his sons disappear; as prayers rise for their safe return, a so-called family friend steps forward, shifting the case; an interview finally uncovers the truth.

episodes.name: The Serial Killer Who Only Killed Once
episodes.summary: The weekend before Thanksgiving 1994, a killer savagely slays Robin Lawrence at home while her child is asleep; a relentless investigation circles her husband, until a drop of blood unlocks the mystery of Robin's murder and leads to a confession.

episodes.name: Looking for Angela
episodes.summary: In Prairie Village, Kan., a reclusive mother goes missing in 2019; when her teenage daughter and the police go looking for answers, they are gaslit at every turn; without a digital footprint or even a friend who knows her, leads are running out fast.

episodes.name: The Girl on the Bike
episodes.summary: In 1972, 20-year-old Jody Loomis takes a late afternoon bike ride to visit her horse and never returns home. She turns up murdered in the woods, and her case baffles the local authorities. For decades, everyone in the small town of Bothell is a suspect.

episodes.name: The Final Cut
episodes.summary: Fame, passion, and greed collide in a Hollywood hairstylist's murder.

episodes.name: Love, Lies and Lust
episodes.summary: Outside of Orlando, life is no longer a fairytale for childhood sweethearts Mike and Laurie Shaver; fighting and infidelities lead to shattered vases and broken dreams; when police search their backyard in 2018, what they find scars the family.

episodes.name: Deadly Ride
episodes.summary: In 2022, Austin police discover the body of 25-year-old up-and-coming cyclist Mo Wilson; someone shot Mo execution style while she was visiting a friend for the weekend; homicide detectives discover a story of jealousy, betrayal, and total obsession.

episodes.name: The Truth About Blair
episodes.summary: Jennifer Brown, vanishes from her Limerick home and detectives race against the clock to find her. With her eight-year-old son asking where his mother is, investigators must confront a web of lies woven by the people she trusts the most.

episodes.name: Where is Judith?
episodes.summary: A home intruder abducts a 60-year-old woman in the night; local sheriffs search relentlessly until they discover another horrifying attack just ten miles away that fits the same profile; is there a serial predator haunting Florida's Gulf Coast?

episodes.name: No ID, No Entry
episodes.summary: At the chaotic and barely functional Imani Studios, a group of overconfident security guards attempt to prove they're more than just badge-wearing nobodies.

episodes.name: Show Your ID
episodes.summary: At Imani Studios, the already fragile authority of the security team is pushed to its limits when an A-list action star shows up without ID and refuses to back down.

episodes.name: The Naked Intruder
episodes.summary: Chaos reaches new heights at Imani Studios when the security team faces their strangest threat yet: a mysterious, fast-moving intruder, who may or may not be completely naked.

episodes.name: Chocolate Protocol
episodes.summary: At Imani Studios, professionalism officially hits rock bottom when the security team faces the aftermath of a bizarre night involving contraband snacks, hallucinations, and a very real (and very naked) intruder.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.summary: At Imani Studios, the security team is given their biggest responsibility yet—handling an ultra-exclusive, A-list industry party where everybody who's anybody is supposed to be on the VIP list… and nobody seems to actually be on it.

episodes.name: Bones and Brides
episodes.summary: Jay and Pamela may have bitten off more than they can chew; they've decided they want to prioritize their health, plan a wedding and move out of their parent's basement apartment in the next three months.

episodes.name: Breakthroughs & Breakdowns
episodes.summary: Pamela has been living in the same house with Jay's parents for the last years; she and his dad have never bonded; when he invites Pamela to a cooking lesson, it's time to clear the air; Jay and Pamela's first meeting with a realtor is thwarted.

episodes.name: Love & Limitations
episodes.summary: Jay and Pamela finally make a move toward finding a new apartment; their search is cut short when Jay gets rushed to the hospital; with no idea of how long he'll be admitted, Pamela questions if they'll have to postpone the wedding.

episodes.name: Engaged & Enraged
episodes.summary: Jay is finally out of the hospital, and there's so much to do to prepare for the wedding; Jay and Pamela get angry when Jay's parents question the expense and purpose of the wedding.

episodes.name: Sweet & Salty
episodes.summary: Jay and Pamela give a candid talk on sex and disability; Pamela shares her thorny dating history; with the wedding coming up, estranged parents and Jay posting pics with a hot personal trainer, Pamela's trust issues get the best of her.

episodes.name: Setbacks & Seatbelts
episodes.summary: Jay and Pamela are determined to find a place to live by their wedding day, but the search is proving to be even harder than they expected; Pamela surprises everyone, including Jay, when she announces that she's going to learn to drive.

episodes.name: Bonding & Baggage
episodes.summary: Pamela's brother says he's coming to the wedding, but Jay is skeptical and worries about Pamela getting her hopes up; Raphael and Rene have big questions about Jay and Pamela's apartment announcement.

episodes.name: Husband & Wife
episodes.summary: The day they once thought was impossible has finally arrived; Jay and Pamela are getting married, but the question of who will take Pamela down the aisle remains up in the air.

episodes.name: Can You Work It, Can You Twerk It?
episodes.summary: Jay and Pamela brave New York City to make their runway debut during fashion week; they also want to take in all that NYC has to offer, but sightseeing has its challenges; Raphael and Rene are overwhelmed helping Jay and Pamela shop for a new bed.

episodes.name: Risk It for a Biscuit
episodes.summary: With Jay turning 30, Pamela plans to celebrate this milestone birthday by giving him the party he always dreamt of as a child. And she has some surprises for him including one that makes him blush!

episodes.name: We're We Waiting for a Funeral?
episodes.summary: Pamela braces for family drama when she and Jay head to Kansas City for her grandmother's funeral; Rene and Raphael are caught completely off guard when Jay and Pamela reveal plans for the future; a visit to a fertility clinic has Pamela on edge.

episodes.name: Surprise, You're a Daddy!
episodes.summary: Jay is shocked when he sees what Pamela has ordered...and he realizes parenthood begins now! Raphael and Rene question Jay and Pamela's choice to have a baby, and concerns about the future cause Pamela to wrestle with her difficult childhood.

episodes.name: Everything Must Go
episodes.summary: A woman vandalizes a New Jersey convenience store by randomly sweeping items off the shelves; a rideshare driver in Florida is pushed to the brink by a rude and unsanitary rider.

episodes.name: Extra Special Delivery
episodes.summary: Customers brawl over an all-you-can-eat crab legs buffet in Queens, NY; trash talking between two groups of diners at a pancake house in Texas comes to blows.

episodes.name: The Last Straw
episodes.summary: A customer gets riled up over a shortage of straws; a rude passenger suffers the consequences of misbehaving with an airline employee; a grocery store manager runs into trouble; a fight breaks out at a gas station.

episodes.name: Commuter Combat

episodes.name: Birthday Blowup
episodes.summary: In Enfield, Connecticut, a checkout line mess sparks a confrontation between customers. In Naples, Florida, police question a woman celebrating her birthday after she's asked to leave a restaurant following an alleged incident with an employee. A late-night fast-food order mix-up in Benton Harbor, Michigan, erupts into multiple brawls between diners. And in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, a dispute over allegedly botched braces escalates into a violent clash at a dental office.

episodes.name: Camp Confrontation
episodes.summary: At an Oregon summer camp, an employee confronts a delivery driver, and simple questions quickly turn into a heated clash. On the Los Angeles Metro, a mysterious argument between two riders erupts into a physical brawl. At a French Airport, armed forces storm a plane to forcibly remove an allegedly out-of-control bachelor party. In a Columbus parking lot, officers surround three individuals suspected of firing guns near a community pool.

episodes.name: Noise Nonsense
episodes.summary: In Chappell Hill, Texas, a fast-food employee is confronted after a customer believes he was commenting on her weight. In Joliet, Illinois, an early-morning noise complaint at a gym escalates into a clash with police. In Okotoks, Canada, a quiet day at a phone repair shop is shattered when a car crashes through the storefront. And in Botswana, a couple's safari celebration takes a terrifying turn when an elephant charges.

episodes.name: Pizza Police
episodes.summary: In a Florida neighborhood, police answering a call about an alligator loose in a neighborhood intercept a woman trying to deliver pizza to a customer. At a pro football game in L.A., trash talking between two women from opposite teams quickly turns into a massive brawl. Off the coast of a Colombian island, a couple of parasailing tourists are enjoying the view high above the ocean, when threatening winds send them on a terrifying ride.

episodes.name: Supermarket Showdown
episodes.summary: In California, a customer confronts her food delivery driver after an issue with her order. In Flagler Beach, Florida, a belligerent bar patron squanders multiple opportunities to avoid arrest. A shoplifting accusation at a supermarket in London, England, spirals into a violent clash. And on a flight in California, passengers face an emergency evacuation when the cabin begins filling with smoke.

episodes.name: Exit Denied
episodes.summary: At a Texas superstore, a customer gets irate after an employee asks to check her receipt before she leaves; in Florida, a man allegedly attacks a couple in a restaurant; a server who joins the brawl may know more than she admits; a simple trip to the store turns into a heated confrontation in a Michigan parking lot when one customer accuses another of illegally parking in a handicap space; in Thailand, a soccer player for a local team who refuses to pay his bar tab is confronted.

episodes.name: Turning Tables
episodes.summary: On a flight in Florida, passengers turn on a woman who rushes to the front of the line waiting to deboard; in Punta Gorda, Florida, a fishing dispute explodes when an enraged captain boards another boater's vessel; in San Francisco, California, a couple denied service erupts inside a restaurant and has to be removed as the chaos spills into the street; at a late-night diner in Englewood, Colorado, a dispute between tables ignites a massive brawl, turning the establishment into a battleground.

episodes.name: Gate Clash
episodes.summary: At a hotel in Georgia, a guest causes a scene while demanding staff remove his visitor. At a Florida airport, police are called over a suspected confrontation involving two sisters and a gate agent on the jet bridge. At a Nevada ski resort, when a skier confronts a snowboarder, the altercation quickly escalates into violence. At an Australian mall, a mother visiting with her daughter is accused of shoplifting, which triggers a chaotic brawl.

episodes.name: Last Call
episodes.summary: In a Tampa, Florida, discount store, a heated argument erupts between a customer, another patron and staff, as employees struggle to stay composed in the face of escalating tension. In Hyannis, Massachusetts, a fast-food restaurant's closing time leads to chaos when a delivery driver refuses to leave without his order. In Phoenix, Arizona, a couple in a rideshare are terrified as their driver appears to speed and swerve through traffic.

episodes.name: Guard Down
episodes.summary: In a restaurant in Georgia, a mother confronts a male customer who she claims complained about her child's volume. At a Florida bar, an allegedly intoxicated woman who is being escorted out by police answers a call from her dad. In a California auto parts store, after a customer accuses another man of taking a rearview mirror and hiding it in his pants, the situation escalates. In Vietnam, a store security guard is violently attacked with an iron rod by a man who then fills his backpack.

episodes.name: Check Please
episodes.summary: At a fast-food restaurant in Florissant, Missouri, tensions rise when the husband of a customer accused of a bad parking job confronts her accuser. In Ft. Lauderdale, Florida, officers are called to a restaurant after a woman reportedly has issues settling her sizable tab. In Kazakhstan, a terrifying scene unfolds at an airport when a blade-wielding man takes an employee hostage inside the terminal.

episodes.name: Line Fail
episodes.summary: In a New Jersey coffeehouse, a customer hoping to purchase a sought-after limited edition coffee mug apparently lines up at the wrong door. At an airport in Florida, police respond to an allegedly intoxicated passenger who refuses to leave the plane after being asked to depart. At an Ohio gas station, a dispute apparently over a simple food purchase quickly turns violent. On an Island near Bali, an American tourist's getaway turns terrifying when their ferry home starts to take on water.

episodes.name: Return Rebellion
episodes.summary: In Estes Park, Colorado, two customers attempt to return their purchases after the store owner allegedly makes an offensive remark about them to another shopper. At a fast food restaurant in Rockledge, Florida, police are called to remove a disgruntled customer who refuses to leave. In a Richmond, Canada supermarket parking lot, a bystander films a heated brawl that erupts when two elderly women vie for a handicap spot.

episodes.summary: Three pairs of twins team up to show that two head chefs are better than one; chefs have to turn birthday cake ingredients into a delicious dinner; the remaining duos roll a pair of dice to determine the restrictions for their classic duo dish.

episodes.name: Carnival Games
episodes.summary: Carnival food chefs try their luck spinning a wheel of chance for the ingredients in their fried classic; chefs play Spree Ball to determine their budget; final two chefs use darts to pop the balloons that determine which aisles they can shop.

episodes.name: All in the Family
episodes.summary: A family of chefs make a hot lunch using only five pounds of ingredients; family members serve up their best noodle dish using ingredients from a gumball machine; making their family favorite dish.

episodes.name: American Heroes
episodes.summary: Four American heroes -- a cop, a firefighter, an EMT and an Air Force vet -- test their culinary might in a battle worth up to $20,000.

episodes.name: Cheesier
episodes.summary: Chefs shop for ingredients using kiddie carts; chefs flip mac n' cheese into an elegant cheese dish; final two chefs try to melt the judges' hearts with their signature cheese dish featuring pork rinds.

episodes.name: Blogger Battle
episodes.summary: Making something using a list of top-searched ingredients on the web; best taco platter without traditional taco ingredients; making a trending dinner featuring hot and not-so-hot ingredients chosen by Guy Fieri's dreaded Food Wheel.

episodes.name: Grill Masters
episodes.summary: Contestants must fit all the ingredients for their hometown grilled special into ultra-tiny grocery bags and play a game of Grocery Golf to find out which wild ingredients they must feature in their best grilled sandwich.

episodes.name: GGG Jrs.
episodes.summary: Kids use items from Flavortown's sample tables to make a school lunch remix; the young chefs weigh their options of ingredients in international dishes.

episodes.name: Superstars Tournament
episodes.summary: Eight of America's best celebrity chefs compete against each other in a no-holds-barred $40,000 tournament; taking on the express lane; four ingredients or less to make the best Italian dish.

episodes.name: Superstars Tournament
episodes.summary: The theme is budget battle royale; seven remaining celebrity chefs are each given $36.01 to buy their groceries.

episodes.name: Superstars Tournament
episodes.summary: Remaining six chefs are given the same grocery list, but must compete in three one-on-one battles to see who makes the best breakfast, lunch or dinner.

episodes.name: Superstars Tournament
episodes.summary: Two shocking shopping cart games; chefs search the store to discover where Guy has hidden their personal carts, only to find that they must make their best burger and fries with a bizarre ingredient that he left in each one.

episodes.name: Superstars Tournament Finale
episodes.summary: Chefs play not one, but two extreme grocery games in each round as they attempt to prepare their best fried dish and a high-end dish; the final two culinary giants must then make their signature dish during two more treacherous games.

episodes.name: GGG Superfans
episodes.summary: Three of GGG's biggest superfans get to play their favorite Flavortown games; favorite judges Beau MacMillan, Damaris Phillips and Aarti Sequeira mentor them as they shop for a diner dish using kiddie carts; best seafood dinner on a budget.

episodes.name: Guy's Ghostly Games
episodes.summary: Including Guy Fieri's red fright special in their creepy comfort food dish; making a midnight snack using only ingredients they can fit in a tiny trick or treat bucket; featuring spooky ingredients in a haunted high-end dinner.

episodes.name: Spice City
episodes.summary: The chefs must flip the ingredients of bread pudding into a spicy high-end dinner; determining which pepper they must feature in their signature spicy dish; making a spicy guilty pleasure using four ingredients with pepper in their name.

episodes.name: One Shop Showdown
episodes.summary: Four thrifty chefs are given only one five-minute shop and $60 to buy all the groceries to last them the entire competition; the chefs must make a comfort classic breakfast, a spicy lunch and a fried dinner.

episodes.name: Pizza Masters
episodes.summary: Four dough throwers compete in a pizza playoff; cooking decadent pizzas featuring high-priced topping and low-priced cheese; making a guilty pleasure pizza with bare hands.

episodes.name: GGG Gives Thanks
episodes.summary: Up-and-coming chefs make a Thanksgiving feast using only the ingredients they can fit in a traditional cornucopia basket; prepare a fall staple using a list of the Fieri family's favorite ingredients.

episodes.name: DDD Holiday Showdown
episodes.summary: Guy gives the chefs gift boxes containing ingredients they must use in their holiday ham dish; they receive stockings filled with sweets and treats that must be included in their family holiday dinner.

episodes.name: Last Judge Standing Tournament
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri spins a wheel featuring all the judges' faces to determine whose least favorite ingredients will wind up in their steak house dinner; the two judges that land at the bottom fight for survival in the redemption round.

episodes.name: Last Judge Standing Tournament
episodes.summary: Seven Triple G judges return to Flavortown to continue the tournament that will earn the Last Judge Standing $40,000 for charity; first, they must combine numbers and letters while making their best pasta dish by using only up to eight ingredients.

episodes.name: Last Judge Standing Tournament
episodes.summary: The six remaining Flavortown judges form teams of two to prepare a regional seafood dish on limited funds in a Budget Battle with an unprecedented twist; the bottom two teams break up in an every-chef-for-themselves cook-off in the Redemption Round.

episodes.name: Last Judge Standing Tournament
episodes.summary: It's the semi-finals of the Last Judge Standing Tournament, and the remaining five Triple G judges prepare their best cheese dish while playing three of Flavortown's hardest games.

episodes.name: Last Judge Standing Tournament Finale: Judgment Day
episodes.summary: Judgment Day is here and it's time to find out which Flavortown judge will be crowned the tournament champ; the final four begin with a chicken dinner featuring a grocery list of the panelists' least favorite ingredients.

episodes.name: Clash Of The Classics
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri turns back the clocks in Flavortown and throws back to the dishes we all grew up on; first, he asks the chefs to update a classic dish in a retro redux using limited ingredients.

episodes.name: Grocery Rush
episodes.summary: On a GGG first, Guy Fieri gives the chefs three turbo-charged games with only 15 to 20 minutes to shop, cook and plate.

episodes.name: Full-On Fried
episodes.summary: Four fried-food fanatics enter Flavortown to take on Guy Fieri's deep-fried games; first, Guy hooks them up with a special ingredient they must use in their fried food dish.

episodes.name: GGG vs. DDD
episodes.summary: Two of Guy Fieri's worlds collide as chefs from both "Diners, Drive-ins and Dives" and "Guy's Grocery Games" are pitted against each other in some serious culinary combat.

episodes.name: Spiciest!
episodes.summary: The heat is on in Flavortown with Guy Fieri's spiciest games yet; first, Guy hands out a list with some must-have ingredients for their spicy chicken dish.

episodes.name: GGG International All Stars
episodes.summary: It's an international culinary showdown when four returning GGG chefs representing Latin, French, Italian and Korean cuisines battle it out to see who will take home the title.

episodes.name: Full Meal Madness
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri gives the chefs 45 minutes to make three courses in each round; they must shop for their full diner meal using miniature-sized carts, then they take on Guy's ruthless Pyramid game to choose the courses for their dinner party meal.

episodes.name: Sweet and Savory Duos
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites three teams of sweet and savory duos to put their chemistry to the test; they must make an all-American comfort dinner and dessert; the two remaining teams must make a steakhouse entree and dessert on a tight budget.

episodes.name: GGG Judges and Their Spouses
episodes.summary: Three of the show's most beloved judges bring their significant others to Flavortown for some friendly competition.

episodes.name: No-Shop Showdown
episodes.summary: For the first time, none of the competing chefs get to shop for their ingredients; instead, Guy Fieri gives them each a cart full of groceries that has to last all three rounds, and he decides what they make in each round by spinning his dish wheel.

episodes.name: Five-Star Showdown
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri transforms Flavortown into a high-end restaurant and invites four chefs for three rounds of five-star cooking.

episodes.name: Budget War
episodes.summary: The chefs must pinch pennies as Guy Fieri challenges them to budget wisely with $40 and two grueling rounds of shopping and cooking.

episodes.name: Frozen Food Fight
episodes.summary: Flavortown freezes over; Guy Fieri puts four talented chefs through three rounds of shopping and cooking from the frozen foods section.

episodes.name: Sandwich Showdown
episodes.summary: Four top sandwich makers must prepare their signature sandwich using only six pounds of ingredients; the creation of an outside-the-box sandwich using some twisted bread and cheese substitutes forces the judges to make a tough decision.

episodes.name: Flavortown Honors Firefighters
episodes.summary: Four firefighter chefs put their culinary chops to the test in a night of competitive camaraderie; the chefs make a five-alarm spicy dish with an ingredient chosen by one of Guy's toughest games.

episodes.name: Noodle Games
episodes.summary: Chefs must make a signature noodle dish using limited ingredients, make a classic noodle dish featuring a wildcard ingredient, then have to use a list of mandatory items to make a refined noodle dish.

episodes.name: Judge vs. Judge
episodes.summary: Food Network star Justin Warner faces off against celebrity chef Rocco DiSpirito; grilled cheese master Eric Greenspan goes up against chef Aaron May; chef Carl Ruiz and restaurateur Antonia Lofaso show off their regional cooking chops.

episodes.name: Bacon to the Max
