episodes.summary: Guy asks the chefs to create an over-the-top bacon dish; next, the chefs must create gourmet swine dining on a bare-bones budget; the two remaining chefs must transform the ingredients from a bacon and egg sandwich into a high-end dinner.

episodes.name: Cheesiest
episodes.summary: Four cheese experts create a signature cheese dish with a wild card decided by the luck of the draw; the chefs make a cheesy international dish using nine ingredients or less, then must transform jalapeno poppers into a high-end cheesy dinner.

episodes.name: DDD All-Star Tournament
episodes.summary: Favorite chefs from "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" who previously participated in the games return to Flavortown to compete in a four-episode tournament, where their shopping and cooking skills get put to the test.

episodes.name: Pizza Play-Offs
episodes.summary: Four pie pros compete as Guy Fieri challenges the chefs to make two pizzas using only what they can fit into an empty pizza box; the chefs must make a sweet pizza and a savory one, both featuring a special ingredient.

episodes.name: DDD All-Star Tournament
episodes.summary: The returning chefs get called upon to make their best street food on a tight budget; a roll of the dice determines what ingredients the chefs must use in their deluxe dish.

episodes.name: April Fools' Games
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri pulls the biggest prank in show history when he fools three judges into competing in a two-game contest by bringing out his most devious game yet -- the Guy Face Wheel; Guy throws down a challenge that leaves the judges terrified.

episodes.name: DDD All-Star Tournament
episodes.summary: Guy asks the chefs to create a regional favorite using limited ingredients; next, the chefs have to make a guilty pleasure with ingredients decided by an arcade-inspired game.

episodes.name: DDD All-Star Tournament Finale
episodes.summary: The finalists of the DDD All-Star Tournament return to compete for the championship; the chefs play a game of stop-and-go, then make a lunch combo on a budget; the remaining chefs make a deluxe diner dish with whammy ingredients.

episodes.name: Single Shop Showdown
episodes.summary: Four chefs are given one chance to shop for all three rounds, with no idea what they will be asked to create; after making their best lunch; the chefs use their remaining ingredients to make an international dish featuring a surprise ingredient.

episodes.name: Over-the-Top Food Fest
episodes.summary: Creative chefs make outrageous dishes using only the ingredients they can fit in undersized bags, then create a stacked-and-jacked dish using a variety of restrictions chosen by Guy's dice; the remaining chefs make a decadent late-night dish.

episodes.name: GGG Kids
episodes.summary: Guy invites four bite-sized chefs to play two huge games; the children make their signature dish using size-appropriate shopping carts, then create their weekend treat using a list decided by Guy's eldest son, Hunter.

episodes.name: Team Games
episodes.summary: Dynamic duos must demonstrate teamwork skills; first, Guy gives them a list of must-have ingredients for a classic duo dish; then, he asks the chefs to make an unforgettable dish after an unforgettable game of grocery bowling.

episodes.name: GGG All-Stars And Their Moms
episodes.summary: Three contestants return to compete in teams with their mothers; they have two rounds to prove they have chemistry in the kitchen; they must update a favorite childhood food; then, the teams must make mother's dream meal on a budget of less than $14.

episodes.name: GGG List Games
episodes.summary: Guy has three list-themed games prepared for the chefs; first, he gives them a list of ingredients they must use in their childhood favorite dish, followed by a list of ingredients they can't use when making spaghetti and meatballs.

episodes.name: Bigger Better Burgers
episodes.summary: Four winners return for a big burger battle; Guy requires the chefs to squeeze all of their ingredients into tiny shopping bags; then, in a burger-themed game of shuffleboard, the chefs pick unusual items to use in their unconventional burgers.

episodes.name: All-Star Grocery Rush
episodes.summary: Four culinary all-stars must make a fried feast in just 15 minutes, then make an international dinner in less than 20 minutes; the two remaining chefs are challenged to create a guilty pleasure in just 20 minutes.

episodes.name: Food Network Star Duos
episodes.summary: The teams must create a fusion of their cooking styles featuring a special ingredient delivered by Guy; the remaining teams must create a classic duo while several crucial aisles are shut down.

episodes.name: DDD Dads and Their Kids
episodes.summary: Three chef dads from "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" team up with their children to take on some of Guy Fieri's most brain-twisting games; the teams have to make a big grilled feast using only ingredients that start with the letter S.

episodes.name: Express Lane Extreme
episodes.summary: The chefs make their best chicken dish using only eight ingredients; Guy asks for a regional comfort dish with a seven-ingredient limit; finally, the chefs can only choose six ingredients to make a late-night guilty pleasure.

episodes.name: GGG's Salute to Summer
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four chef veterans from different branches of the military to compete in two summer-themed games in front of an audience of veterans; the chefs make a summer seafood feast using what they can fit into a shockingly small mini-cooler.

episodes.name: Culinary Idols
episodes.summary: Three young chefs and their culinary idols are challenged to elevate a cafeteria lunch on a limited budget; Guy then gives them a special ingredient that they have to use in their unforgettable dinner.

episodes.name: Sibling Duos
episodes.summary: Teams of chef-siblings compete in two games designed to push their sibling bonds to the limit; the teams must decide which items from Guy's sample tables they want to feature in their family dinner, then must prepare a decadent dish with a twist.

episodes.name: Guy's Italian Games
episodes.summary: Three chefs put their cooking skills to the test in Italian-themed games; the chefs must make a pasta dish using eight ingredients or fewer, then are challenged to make a pizza and a side dish using items found on Flavortown's sample tables.

episodes.name: Family Food Feud
episodes.summary: Two restaurant-owning families compete for a chance at a $20,000 shopping spree; each round, the families must choose one member to compete in a challenge that will earn a key advantage in the next round.

episodes.name: Family Food Feud: Part 2
episodes.summary: Two restaurant-owning families compete for a chance at a $20,000 shopping spree; each round, the families must choose one member to compete in a challenge that will earn a key advantage in the next round.

episodes.name: Heavyweight Teams
episodes.summary: Two show juggernauts, Alex Guarnaschelli and Rocco DiSpirito, return to compete with their teams of Flavortown regulars in Guy Fieri's most hard-hitting games to be crowned Supermarket Heavyweight champions.

episodes.name: Supermarket Rematches
episodes.summary: Competitors return to settle the score in three rounds of head-to-head rematches; two sandwich masters compete; a vegan and a meat lover face off to make a high-end dinner; two families battle it out to see who can make the best Sunday supper.

episodes.name: Food Scientists
episodes.summary: Four food scientists showcase their molecular gastronomy skills; in the first round, the chefs must flip the basic ingredients of a hamburger into a modern dinner; making a twist on an American classic with restrictions dictated by the Food Pyramid.

episodes.name: Comfort Food Cook-Off
episodes.summary: Four comfort food experts compete; chefs must make their signature dish while incorporating a list of mandatory ingredients; preparing an elevated comfort classic using a mystery canned ingredient; making a regional comfort dish on a tight budget.

episodes.name: Meals From the Middle Madness
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri tests the limits of four chefs by allowing them to shop only in the middle aisles of the store; the chefs face the challenge of making meals with no fresh produce, no fresh meat and no fresh dairy.

episodes.name: Everything from Scratch
episodes.summary: Four chefs who specialize in scratch cooking take on two grueling rounds, making everything from the bottom up.

episodes.name: Global Grocery Games
episodes.summary: Four chefs representing cuisines from around the world take on Guy Fieri's global-themed games; first, the chefs make their childhood favorite featuring a handpicked ingredient from Guy.

episodes.name: GGG Winners vs. Judges
episodes.summary: Three GGG winners team up to take on a trio of Flavortown's finest judges to see who comes out on top of Guy's devious games.

episodes.name: Flavortown Fright Night
episodes.summary: Four fearless chefs play Guy's scary games for a stab at a $20,000 shopping spree; Guy gives chefs a frightening ingredient that they must feature in a spicy dish; remaining chefs must choose what to cook using spooky menu-item refrigerator magnets.

episodes.name: First Round Redemption
episodes.summary: Four GGG competitors who previously checked out early return to Flavortown to try their luck again; in each round, Guy Fieri hits them with his Wheel of Redemption, which features the games that the chefs went out on.

episodes.name: GGG Judges and Their Siblings
episodes.summary: The Flavortown family gets a little bigger as some of GGG's most beloved judges bring their siblings to compete alongside them; the teams must shop blindfolded; teams must use a required ingredient in their decadent dish.

episodes.name: Ultimate Chicken Challenge
episodes.summary: Chefs come to Flavortown to compete in three chicken-themed rounds to prove their poultry prowess; Guy challenges the chefs with making a fried chicken combo on a $17 budget; chefs face a list of must-use ingredients; Guy's triangle of terror.

episodes.name: Super Spicy Superstars
episodes.summary: Chefs face a modified food pyramid during an "International Heat" round; chefs shop for "Spicy Chicken Dishes" with tiny shopping bags; the remaining chefs brave a brand new game for a "Spicy Fried Dinner" round.

episodes.name: Pork-a-Palooza
episodes.summary: Four chefs are challenged to make pork-inspired dishes; chefs must shop for ingredients with piggy-faced backpacks; chefs have to pick key ingredients using Guy's unpredictable deck of cards; Guy challenges the chefs to make dinner on a $20 budget.

episodes.name: Family Food Feud Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: Two families return for a Thanksgiving family showdown; Guy has a member of each family pick from unidentified cans for the featured ingredient in their first meal; a family member must make a fall favorite using five pounds of ingredients.

episodes.name: Teen Chefs
episodes.summary: Four talented teen chefs are taking over Flavortown; Guy gets things started by having them flip a chicken pot pie into a high-end dinner; a roll of the dice decides their international dishes; one future superstar chef will win a shopping spree.

episodes.name: Judges' Thanksgiving Throwdown
episodes.summary: Four all-star chefs are ready to prove that it's possible to make Thanksgiving dinner with limited ingredients and then use the leftovers to make a different meal the next day; one chef will claim the title of All-Star Thanksgiving Throwdown champ.

episodes.name: All-Seafood Battle
episodes.summary: Seafood specialists battle it out in Flavortown; chefs are limited to ten ingredients in the first round; ingredients for the second dish must start with the same random letter; a new game lays out icy parameters for the chefs' upscale fish dish.

episodes.name: GGG Winners' Holiday Extravaganza
episodes.summary: Four previous winners return for the holidays to take on more of Guy Fieri's games; chefs must shop for ingredients using nothing but oversized stockings; chefs are given a gingerbread house that they must flip into a fine dining holiday dinner.

episodes.name: Ultimate Beef Battle
episodes.summary: Chefs compete in three beef-inspired rounds; Guy asks them to shop for, prepare and plate their best beef burger; chefs receive scratch-off budget cards with the amount they can spend on their dish; chefs roll dice to determine their dinner details.

episodes.name: $12 Meal Showdown
episodes.summary: Guy pushes the culinary limits of four Flavortown rookies by challenging them to cook a day's worth of meals with a budget of just $12 for each round; one chef's budgeting skills outshine the others and earn them a shopping spree.

episodes.name: DDD Family Tournament
episodes.summary: Food and family collide as Guy Fieri brings three DDD family duos to Flavortown to compete.

episodes.name: DDD Family Tournament
episodes.summary: The tournament continues with families from "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives"; Guy Fieri is challenging these dynamic family duos to make classic culinary duos, starting with a list of key ingredients they must feature in their burgers and fries.

episodes.name: DDD Family Tournament
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings three DDD family duos to compete in Flavortown for the last spot in the tournament finale.

episodes.name: DDD Family Tournament Finale
episodes.summary: Three families compete in two games that will decide who wins the DDD Family Tournament and the $20,000 prize; Guy Fieri has two diner-style order wheels picking out which dishes the chefs must make and which games they must play in both rounds.

episodes.name: Big Game Day
episodes.summary: Four sports-loving chefs gear up for some tailgating, Flavortown-style.

episodes.name: GGG Iron Chef Challenge
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings three GGG winners back to compete against one another for a chance to go up against GGG's most feared competitor and judge, Iron Chef Alex Guarnaschelli.

episodes.name: DDD Family Redemption
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges the chefs to flip coffee and doughnuts into dinner; he gives the remaining DDD family duos a $22 budget to make their surf and turf dishes; only one family will redeem itself and shop Flavortown for up to $20,000.

episodes.name: GGG Winner Summer Games
episodes.summary: Four winners return to test their skills on some tough summer-themed games; a never-before-seen game forces the chefs to shop for a dwindling amount of usable ingredients as quickly as possible.

episodes.name: Clash of the Vegetarians!
episodes.summary: Four veggie masters compete in three veggie-inspired rounds; Guy gives them a list of key ingredients they must feature; a diner-style order wheel determines the classic meat dishes the chefs must make vegetarian; Guy takes away the chefs' carts.

episodes.name: Cookin' Couples
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri is welcoming three couples to Flavortown to prove how much culinary knowledge they really have.

episodes.name: Ultimate Protein Battle
episodes.summary: Five masters of their own protein -- beef, chicken, pork, seafood and veggies -- collide in a battle for protein supremacy and the $20,000 prize.

episodes.name: Big Cheese
episodes.summary: Three cheese pros return to Flavortown to test their talents; Guy Fieri puts the competitors through two rounds of cheesy combat and the last chef standing faces off against Flavortown Cheese Champ Chef Eric Greenspan for a shot at $20,000.

episodes.name: All Budget Wheel Games
episodes.summary: Before each game, Guy Fieri spins a budget wheel that determines how much the chefs get when purchasing groceries for a specific dish and a second wheel that adds a crazy twist.

episodes.name: Five-Dollar Dishes
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges the chefs to make full-blown meals for four on only five dollars a plate.

episodes.name: Wild and Crazy Budget Games
episodes.summary: Things get wild in Flavortown when Guy Fieri challenges four talented chefs with budget games that might be too crazy for their own good.

episodes.name: Five-Dollar Price Check
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four talented chefs to Flavortown and tells them they can only shop for ingredients under five dollars; Guy reveals an additional challenge in each round, and it's a GGG budget battle like never before.

episodes.name: Big Budget Bonanza
episodes.summary: Four penny-pinching pros who have braved some of Flavortown's toughest budget battles are back for a brutal budget bonanza.

episodes.name: GGG Winning Teams
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings back the winning teams of previous competitions for another battle of team supremacy.

episodes.name: Pro Athletes and Judges
episodes.summary: Sports and great food are a natural combination, and that's what's on Guy Fieri's mind when he invites three professional athletes to team up with some of Flavortown's finest judges in a two-round, winner-take-all face-off for culinary supremacy.

episodes.name: Ultimate Grocery List
episodes.summary: Chefs tackle Guy's worst grocery list yet, containing ingredients they'd never dream of putting in the same dish; the chefs must use every item on the list during the three rounds of competition or face elimination, but Guy adds lots of extra twists.

episodes.name: Restaurant Teams
episodes.summary: Guy knows there's nothing like the teamwork in a busy restaurant's kitchen, so he invites three teams of phenomenal chefs to represent their restaurants in Flavortown in two action-packed rounds of games involving prix fixe menus and bestsellers.

episodes.name: DDD Chefs and Their Moms
episodes.summary: Guy welcomes "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" chefs and their moms to Flavortown for a Mother's Day competition; chefs must watch as their mothers shop from the chefs' lists; the store closes in the middle of the chef's shopping time.

episodes.name: Best Sandwiches!
episodes.summary: Guy brings four sandwich-making savants to Flavortown Market to test their skills; delicious deli meats, fancy condiments and artisan breads go flying as these sandwich superheroes make fried, international and stacked sandwich masterpieces.

episodes.name: All-Star Burgers
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings together four all-star chefs to test their burger-making prowess; they must make an over-the-top burger and fries combo.

episodes.name: Island Eats
episodes.summary: Chefs must shop with tiny bags and make signature seafood dishes; a blind choice determines which canned ingredient they must feature in their comfort dishes; a roll of the dice determines the parameters for the chefs' spicy chicken dinners.

episodes.name: Home Cooks!
episodes.summary: Guy brings four confident home cooks to Flavortown to prove they can actually cook like GGG's finest chefs; he tests their shopping, cooking and presentation skills in three classic games, and in the end, only one home cook wins.

episodes.name: GGG Winners & Their Dads
episodes.summary: For Father's Day, Guy Fieri brings three GGG winners back to compete against each other, and they're teaming up with their dads; the teams must make childhood favorites; a classic game of bowling determines ingredients for a favorite dish for dad.

episodes.name: All-Stars' Full Meal
episodes.summary: When celebrity chefs come to Flavortown, Guy gets to try out his most twisted games, and this time he's really putting them to the test with full, three-course meals; chefs face a special ingredient of Guy's choosing; chefs play a game of chance.

episodes.name: Kitchen Heroes
episodes.summary: Charity is important at Flavortown Market, where most of the unused food is donated to local food shelters after each competition; with that in mind, Guy decides to showcase chefs who are giving back to their own communities every day.

episodes.name: Southern Chef Showdown
episodes.summary: A never-before-seen game has the chefs shopping in the southern half of the store for their signature sandwiches, and weight is a factor as the chefs prepare seafood dishes with only 6 pounds of ingredients.

episodes.name: All ABC Games
episodes.summary: The chefs have to prove their skills in three rounds as they make comfort classics and dinners with seafood and fried ingredients; only one chef will come out on top and win a chance at a $20,000 shopping spree.

episodes.name: GGG Kids All-Stars
episodes.summary: Guy sets up sample tables around the store with ingredients the kids must feature; a friendly game of bowling challenges the youngsters to work together to knock down the aisles they're allowed to shop in for their dinners.

episodes.name: Ultimate Asian Food Showdown
episodes.summary: Asian cuisine takes over and Guy gives the chefs a list of ingredients for their noodle dishes and makes them use tiny shopping carts to shop for their rice dishes; the final challenge involves a featured special ingredient for a beef dinner.

episodes.name: Grandma Grocery Games
episodes.summary: The grandmas cook their most requested family dish while sticking to the limitations that a typical family member might complain about; the grandmas cook their celebratory dinners using two of the samples Guy has featured around the market.

episodes.name: Single-Aisle Showdowns
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri uses his newest game, the Aisle Wheel, to restrict the chefs to just one aisle in each round; Guy throws in some of his own twists and turns along the way as the chefs are challenged to make a hot lunch, comfort food and dinner spread.

episodes.name: Express Lane Extreme: Name Your Number
episodes.summary: Four competing chefs must decide whether to use six, eight or 10 ingredients before knowing what kind of dish they're making; one chef will pick the right limits and go on to win a shopping spree worth up to $20,000.

episodes.name: Bacon Masters
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri welcomes four of the best bacon chefs to make their best bacon sandwich; they have to stay under an ingredient weight limit when making their second dish; finally, the chefs are surprised with a misleading pig chart.

episodes.name: Fast Food Face-Off
episodes.summary: The chefs battle with their budgets to make their best burger and side and race the clock to make an Asian takeout staple; the final challenge is a Mexican takeout-style dinner.

episodes.name: 12 Ingredients All Day
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges four chefs to make a dozen ingredients last through all three meals; the chefs shop for the only 12 ingredients they can use throughout the competition and are challenged to make specific styles of lunch and dinner.

episodes.name: Ultimate Spicy Games
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri welcomes back the winners of previous GGG spicy competitions and pits them against one another; the remaining chef wins $10,000 and gets a chance at another $10,000 if they can beat Flavortown's resident Spicy Queen, chef Antonia Lofaso.

episodes.name: Guy's Guys
episodes.summary: Four chefs from four of Guy Fieri's own restaurants face off in two rounds of culinary combat; Guy challenges his guys to make their best burger without any key ingredients; he forces them to shop for their ingredients using teeny-tiny little bags.

episodes.name: Battle America
episodes.summary: Chefs cook their best regional sandwich, but on a budget; creating seafood dishes using ingredients from around the market; Guy's food wheel decides where the remaining two chefs get to shop for their regional comfort food dishes.

episodes.name: Guy's Carnival Games
episodes.summary: Four carnival food-loving chefs play carnival classics; Guy turns a popular strength test game into a finesse challenge; a simple game of ring toss determines the main protein for the chefs' best dish on a stick.

episodes.name: California Firefighters
episodes.summary: Firefighting first responders from California head to Flavortown for a friendly culinary competition, where they must make a firehouse favorite in the first round and a spicy family meal in the second round.

episodes.name: Ghosts of GGG Past
episodes.summary: Guy wheels out a vat of goo containing mysterious canned foods that the chefs must grab and use in a fried dish; a scary version of musical carts to determine ingredients for a redemption dinner.

episodes.name: Rematch Mania
episodes.summary: Two budget-brawlers settle the score in a round that has them shopping for ingredients under $5 for their family dinners; a couple of food scientists face off in a game that forces them to shop for their dishes in either the odd or even aisles.

episodes.name: Food Truck Teams
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings in three teams of food truck chefs to battle it out for superiority; the teams split up to shop separate halves of the store for their bestselling dish; the chefs must shop for their best handheld duo using only their bare hands.

episodes.name: Cheat Day
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four chefs to participate in the first cheat day, challenging them to make dishes worth splurging on after a week of eating healthy; the chefs count pounds and use specific ingredients in their deep-fried and mega-melty dishes.

episodes.name: DDD Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: Guy kicks things off by having the DDD chefs make their ultimate Thanksgiving sandwich without shopping in a crucial aisle; the chefs must make a dish under Guy's designated weight limit.

episodes.name: Guy's Thanksgiving Games
episodes.summary: Guy gives the chefs an empty cornucopia to use while shopping for their two signature Thanksgiving sides; the chefs have to make a classic Thanksgiving meal on a budget while also featuring a special ingredient determined by Guy's wheel of chance.

episodes.name: Guy's Holiday Dessert Games
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri has the chefs turn a savory classic, ravioli, into a holiday favorite, before challenging the remaining chefs to make a decadent chocolate dessert using sample ingredients stationed around the market.

episodes.name: Judges' Holiday: Ultimate Naughty List
episodes.summary: The series' most beloved judges compete against each other using not-so-nice ingredients from Guy's naughty list.

episodes.name: GGG Holiday Cook-Off
episodes.summary: Four charitable chefs compete in a holiday cook-off; Guy hands out gifts of special ingredients that the chefs must feature in their holiday pork dish; he uses a dreidel to give the chefs their budgets for a festive family favorite.

episodes.name: New School vs. Old School
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri yearns to know which culinary form is better, tried-and-true classical techniques or molecular gastronomy; he invites two old-school and two new-school chefs to test their skills against each other.

episodes.name: Resolution Royale
episodes.summary: Four chefs arrive in Flavortown ready to prove that traditionally unhealthy dishes can be made healthier and even more delicious.

episodes.name: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Tournament: GGG Super Teams
episodes.summary: Guy spins the DDD Wheel which determines what classic diner dish the competitors have to make, while a spin of the GGG Wheel determines which game they have to play while making it.

episodes.name: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Tournament: GGG Super Teams
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri's two worlds continue to collide as six more chefs pair up to create talented Super Teams; Guy brings back his DDD Dish Wheel and GGG Game Wheel, plus a never-before-seen Wheel-y Small Wheel to give these duos a real run for their money.

episodes.name: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Tournament: GGG Super Teams
episodes.summary: Guy spins his DDD Dish Wheel and GGG Game Wheel to nail down all the variables for the competition, and these duos face some of the funniest and toughest Grocery Games ever while making classic DDD dishes.

episodes.name: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Tournament: GGG Super Teams Finale
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri has narrowed nine pairs of baller chefs down to the final three Super Teams, since they're super duos, they have to cook classic food duos while playing Grocery Games that pack a big twist.

episodes.name: Game Day Super Teams
episodes.summary: In the finals, Guy tests the remaining teams' throwing skills by having them toss footballs into ice buckets to earn key ingredients for their 6-foot sub.

episodes.name: Wicked Aisle Games
episodes.summary: Guy brings the culinary combat to Flavortown Market's aisles; a flip of a coin determines whether the chefs can shop the odd or even aisles; in the final round, the chefs must make their steakhouse dinner using one ingredient per aisle.

episodes.name: Winner Winter Games
episodes.summary: Three previous winners have to outlast each other over three rounds of ice-cold, brand-new games to create lunch, dinner and an international favorite; ultimately, only one chef will go on a Flavortown shopping spree worth up to $20,000.

episodes.name: World Fusion
episodes.summary: Guy brings in chefs representing cuisines from all around the world to team up and fuse their cultures' flavors in delicious dishes; the teams pit their cuisines against the others to find out which combination is the tastiest.

episodes.name: Married With Kitchen
episodes.summary: Most married couples consider their kids their babies, but these couples also consider their restaurants their babies.

episodes.name: All Un-gredients
episodes.summary: Guy challenges four chefs to improvise as they make family favorites without any of the key ingredients; saucy spaghetti and meatballs, tasty tacos and a comfort food classic are all determined by Guy's wheel.

episodes.name: Scratch Chef Showdown
episodes.summary: In a world of convenience food, four scratch chefs show Guy Fieri what happens when convenience goes out the window.

episodes.name: High-Roller Games
episodes.summary: Guy turns the GGG classic budget battle on its head by making the chefs spend over $60 when creating their signature high-end dinner.

episodes.name: Pizza Pro Playoffs
episodes.summary: Four pro pizza makers rise to the occasion in three pizza-themed Grocery Games that dictate who gets to take home all the dough.

episodes.name: Guy's Trivia Games
episodes.summary: The four competitors are hit with a blast of international food questions they must answer correctly to earn enough cash to shop for their fancy dinner.

episodes.name: America's Next Chefs
episodes.summary: Guy has the chefs turn the ingredients from an old-fashioned Waldorf salad into a modern meal; to help the rising chefs reach the pinnacle of success, the towering Food Pyramid determines the details of its best international dinner.

episodes.name: April Fools' Day
episodes.summary: In honor of Carl's love for hijinks, Guy Fieri has invited six of his closest Flavortown judges to join him for April Fools' Day pranks; they make spicy dishes that drive Carl nuts.

episodes.name: Big League Teams
episodes.summary: America's favorite pastime goes to Flavortown when Guy invites three former baseball players to team up with GGG all-star judges to hit a culinary home run.

episodes.name: Clearance Wars
episodes.summary: Guy gives four chefs a list of sale items they have to use over the course of the competition, with all of the required ingredients while making a high-end dinner in the first round.

episodes.name: DDD-Licious Burgers
episodes.summary: Guy makes the chefs shop for ingredients in their signature burger and loaded fries combo using just tongs and a grill lid.

episodes.name: Guy's Egg-treme Games
episodes.summary: Guy isn't a fan of eggs, but that might change when he takes four chefs to Flavortown for a culinary competition about eggs.

episodes.name: Mother of All Shows
episodes.summary: Guy enlists the help of his mom, Penny, and his wife, Lori, in his Mother's Day Games featuring mom/kid teams who run family restaurants together; four unique sample ingredients to feature in their top seller, a "Prized Family Recipe" ingredients.

episodes.name: Dessert Games
episodes.summary: Buddy Valastro convinces Guy to declare it Dessert Day in Flavortown Market; four dessert chefs from across North America sculpt works of art and bake their buns off for a shot at the dough.

episodes.name: Salute the Troops
episodes.summary: Guy honors America's men and women in uniform by inviting four military vets with a culinary second-calling; they'll be joining forces with the Messlords, a group of DDD chefs who travel the world cooking for our troops; a Flavortown obstacle course.

episodes.name: Choose Your Budget
episodes.summary: Guy's letting four chefs choose between three different budgets over three rounds; they quickly realize it's much harder than it looks, with one budget allowing for only four dollars a plate.

episodes.name: One-Time Aisle Games
episodes.summary: In Flavortown, chefs usually have free reign of the entire market -- but that all changes when Guy has the chefs cook meals all night long after shopping in each aisle one time; Guy is throwing them an additional game each and every round.

episodes.name: Like Father, Like Chef
episodes.summary: A round of Flavortown golf gets the dads in their comfort zone and determines which key ingredient they must feature in their steakhouse dinner.

episodes.name: Sweet and Savory Teams
episodes.summary: Guy invites three sweet and savory duos to cook and bake for a shot at $20,000; first, Guy splits the store in half and has the teams divide and shop their respective side of the store.

episodes.name: GGG RAW
episodes.summary: Four superstar chefs compete in a one-game showdown that incorporates three of Guy Fieri's craziest challenges; Guy reveals an in-depth look at how each over-the-top comfort food dish comes together and shares behind-the-scenes secrets of the show.

episodes.name: Guy's Global Games
episodes.summary: With appearances from Indian, Chinese, Mexican and French cuisines; Guy's goal to go global has been fully realized; after three rounds of deliciously diverse dishes, one international chef will claim Flavortown victory and shop the market.

episodes.name: Summer Grillin' Games Part 1
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites eight winners to return to Flavortown Market for a summer grilling tournament; each week, one chef will be awarded Best Dish, win $5,000 and move on to the next week's competition while the remaining chefs duke it out.

episodes.name: Summer Grillin' Games Part 2
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri's summer grilling tournament continues with only seven winners remaining; it's all about the boardwalk as the chefs make summer seafood dishes and spicy seaside sandwiches.

episodes.name: Summer Grillin' Games Part 3
episodes.summary: Guy's grilling games continue, this time with carnival-themed games and dishes; Guy gives the chefs a funnel cake-sized twist by putting them in pairs to make a fried sweet-and-savory duo and a cheesy carnival classic.

episodes.name: Summer Grillin' Games Part 4
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri treats the remaining five chefs to a Flavortown vacation; one chef's destination dinner has a chance to earn best dish, an instant $5,000 and a spot in the finale.

episodes.name: Summer Grillin' Games Finale
episodes.summary: Four chefs in Guy Fieri's summer bash finale throw a beach ball to determine which aisles they get to shop in for their summertime guilty pleasure.

episodes.name: X-treme ABC Games
episodes.summary: Four chefs cook under extreme conditions and must deliver if they want to cash in a $20,000 shopping spree.

episodes.name: All-Star Vegetarian Games
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges four all-star chefs to create meatless dishes in a full-on veggie showdown that is worth up to $20,000.

episodes.name: All-Star Budget
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four superstar chefs to duke it out in a budget battle.

episodes.name: Nothin' but Noodles
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings in four noodle-savvy chefs from across the U.S. for two rounds of noodle action.

episodes.name: Battle of the Bacon
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four swine-dining chefs for a shot at $20,000; over two rounds and a plethora of pork plates, competitors will have to show up and show snout if they want to win the all-bacon battle.

episodes.name: Delivery: GGG at Home
episodes.summary: Guy and Hunter Fieri send mystery ingredients to their favorite chefs, who have to use them in burgers and seafood dinners; Guy and Hunter play some of Flavortown's classic games to add to the chefs' culinary difficulties.

episodes.name: Delivery: Budget Games
episodes.summary: Guy and Hunter Fieri send inexpensive ingredients to their favorite chefs; budget-conscious high-end dinners and family meals; Guy and Hunter play Flavortown's classic budget games.

episodes.name: Delivery: Limitations
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri and his son Hunter enlist some of their favorite chefs to play grocery delivery games; chicken dinners and Mexican feasts; classic limitation games.

episodes.name: Delivery: Delivery Mix-up
episodes.summary: Guy and Hunter send the wrong ingredients to their favorite chefs for lasagna and dinner challenges in the way of delivery mix-ups; some ingredients were out of stock, and others are only available in their frozen versions.

episodes.name: Delivery: Grillin' at Home
episodes.summary: Some of Guy and Hunter's favorite chefs grill up backyard burgers and steak dinners with surprise ingredients that Guy and Hunter send to them; Guy and Hunter play some of their favorite Flavortown games.

episodes.name: Delivery: All-Star Thanksgiving
episodes.summary: The challenge is to make the best Thanksgiving dinner and leftover pie revival; Guy and Hunter also make the chefs play some Thanksgiving-inspired games.

episodes.name: Delivery: Home Sweet Home
episodes.summary: To make the best sweet-and-savory desserts and Napoleon cakes, Guy and Hunter ship sweet and some not-so-sweet treats to their chef friends.

episodes.name: Delivery: Double Trouble
episodes.summary: Guy and Hunter Fieri send three all-star chefs two boxes of groceries and GGG games and challenge them to reinvent classic food duos. First, the chefs make surf-and-turf dishes. Then food magnets determine their ingredients for a fried sandwich.

episodes.name: Delivery: All-Star Holiday
episodes.summary: Guy and Hunter Fieri recruit three all-star chefs to play holiday games in their home kitchens. The Fieris send groceries and an oversized stocking filled with holiday sweets that the chefs must incorporate into two different seasonal dishes.

episodes.name: Delivery: All-Star Hanukkah
episodes.summary: Duff Goldman takes on two all-star chefs in GGG's first Hanukkah competition at home. Guy and Hunter Fieri challenge the chefs to make potato latkes with ingredients decided by dreidels. Then they have to turn eight leftover ingredients into a meal.

episodes.name: Delivery: One Box Only
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri and his son Hunter send one box of groceries instead of the usual two to three chefs who have already won big in Flavortown Market. Cooking in their home kitchens, the chefs must use the same 15 ingredients in a hot lunch and Sunday supper.

episodes.name: Delivery: Pantry-Palooza
episodes.summary: Guy and Hunter Fieri turn three "GGG" judges into competitors in their own kitchens; they send each one a box of ingredients for a lumberjack breakfast and a grocery list of extra items to shop for in their own cupboards.

episodes.name: Delivery: All-Star Noodles
episodes.summary: Guy and Hunter recruit three all-star chefs and send them boxes of ingredients for a family-favorite noodle dish and a spicy noodle dish.

episodes.name: Delivery: DDD Guilty Pleasures
episodes.summary: Three chefs have to transform a frozen dinner diner classic and turn Hunter's favorite snacks into a sandwich.

episodes.name: Delivery: High-End at Home
episodes.summary: Guy and Hunter send three chefs boxes of the market's finest foods and a scale to weigh the mere seven pounds of ingredients; combining high-end and bargain-basement flavors.

episodes.name: Guy Cooks the Games: GGG Raw
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri gets a taste of the "GGG" experience when his son Hunter makes him watch and cook along to a special behind-the-scenes episode of "Guy's Grocery Games"; Guy tries to keep up with all the challenges and his food is judged by Antonia Lofaso.

episodes.name: Guy Cooks the Games: All-Star Burgers
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri's son Hunter and chef Antonia Lofaso turn the tables on Guy at home by challenging him to cook along with a burger-based episode, and he must overcome the same ingredient restrictions as the chefs.

episodes.name: Delivery: Frozen Fiasco
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri sends three competing all-star chefs two boxes of frozen food that they must convert into dishes that the judges deem delicious, daring, hot and ready-to-eat.

episodes.name: Delivery: Guilty Pleasures
episodes.summary: Three all-star chefs must make guilty pleasure dishes using whatever ingredients they have in their home pantries.

episodes.name: Delivery: Tournament of Champions Special
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri turns the tables on three "Tournament of Champions judges," sending them games to compete in two rounds of intense culinary competition at home.

episodes.name: Delivery: Big Bacon Blowout
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri sends two boxes filled with piggy goodness to the houses of three of his chef friends; using a combination of items from the box and ingredients from their own homes, the chefs must compose dishes that hype, highlight and honor bacon.

episodes.name: Delivery: Sandwich Showdown
episodes.summary: In round one, the chefs must flip the ingredients of a diner classic into a tasty sandwich; the chefs start round two with a sandwich draft pick, where they choose which bread and cheese to use in their sandwich.

episodes.name: Delivery: April Fools'
episodes.summary: In the second annual Carl Ruiz April Fools' Day special, Guy and Hunter Fieri pay tribute to their late friend by cranking up the pranks on three unsuspecting chefs for a chance to win $20,000.

episodes.name: Delivery: All-star Family Face-off, Part 1
episodes.summary: In Triple G's first at-home tournament, two all-star family teams go head-to-head for a chance at the family crown; Guy and Hunter play along from their own kitchen.

episodes.name: Delivery: All-star Family Face-off, Part 2
episodes.summary: In the second installment of Guy Fieri's All-Star Family Face-Off, the chef teams have to work together to make a sandwich and side using ingredients that weigh evenly on a scale; Guy and Hunter join in on the cooking action.

episodes.name: Delivery: All-star Family Face-off, Part 3
episodes.summary: In the third installment of Guy Fieri's Family Face-Off, each team has to combine their favorite dishes into a cohesive meal; Guy puts the teams' relationships to the test in the Newlyfed Game.

episodes.name: Delivery: All-Star Family Face-Off Finale
episodes.summary: An epic two-round battle with three families competing at home; in round one, the teams have to cook a family noodle dish while handcuffed to one another.

episodes.name: Guy Cooks the Games: Nothin' but Noodles
episodes.summary: The heat is on when Guy Fieri's son Hunter challenges Guy to cook along to a "GGG" episode centered around noodles; when chef Beau MacMillan drops in for a visit, Guy decides to pull an unexpected twist on his guest.

episodes.name: Delivery: Backyard Burgers
episodes.summary: Three all-star chefs take Guy Fieri's battle to their backyards for two rounds of burger games; Guy and his son, Hunter, determine which mandatory ingredients will be used in the competitors' burgers by throwing basketballs into hoops.

episodes.name: Delivery: Takeout Takedown
episodes.summary: Inspired by his own Flavortown Kitchen takeout service, Guy Fieri sends three all-star competitors his takeout food, which they have to incorporate in two rounds of games; first, the chefs must use the ingredients in a breakfast dish.

episodes.name: Delivery: All-Stars Shop and Cook
episodes.summary: Guy and Hunter Fieri send three competitors $50 to shop for their own ingredients at their own grocery stores, but the chefs have no idea what dishes they're going to be making; Guy asks the chefs to make brunch, but with restrictions.

episodes.name: Delivery: Exotic Meats
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri sends three chefs on an adventure in their own homes with an outrageous "Flavortown" delivery box filled with exotic meats; in round one, the chefs choose their wild game with a risky game of "Wild Cards."

episodes.name: Grand Reopening, Part 1
episodes.summary: The chefs have one hour to create two courses, and they must use a grocery list highlighting all the new store sections; the judges score the chefs' appetizers using the all-new Flavortown Scoreboard.

episodes.name: Grand Reopening, Part 2
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges the chefs to make a comfort classic appetizer and a high-end entree using nine ingredients plus a mystery protein from Guy's son, Hunter, at the butcher counter.

episodes.name: DDD Summer Games, Part 1: Backyard Bash
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri kicks off summer with a four-part tournament full of summer rituals, games and grilled foods; three of Guy's favorite "DDD" chefs join him for a backyard bash, turning classic diner dishes into backyard burgers and sides.

episodes.name: DDD Summer Games, Part 2: Extreme Tailgating
episodes.summary: Three "DDD" chefs participate in a Flavortown 500 race with remote control cars; the chef who crosses the finish line gets first pick of proteins to use in two tailgating bites.

episodes.name: DDD Summer Games, Part 3: Camp Cook-Off
episodes.summary: Three "DDD" chefs compete in camping-themed games; the chefs must use Hunter Fieri's slingshot to knock down the canned items they don't want to feature in their grilled fish feast.

episodes.name: DDD Summer Games Finale
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri sends the finalists on a virtual summer road trip.

episodes.name: Food Network Star Favorites
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings in four favorites from Food Network Star to compete in his games.

episodes.name: All-star Egg-stravaganza
episodes.summary: Chef Antonia Lofaso and Guy Fieri's son Hunter pull a prank on Guy by turning this all-star competition into a full-on egg episode.

episodes.name: Rush to Redemption
episodes.summary: Four chefs who lost GGG in their final cook the last time around return for a second chance at proving themselves.

episodes.name: Firefighter Face-off
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri sounds the alarm as four talented firehouse cooks compete in Flavortown Market.

episodes.name: Snack Attack
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri's teenage son, Ryder, accidentally leaves behind a cart full of his favorite after-school snacks, so Guy makes four talented, up-and-coming chefs incorporate the snacks into two rounds of GGG hijinks.

episodes.name: Fried Feud
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings four chefs together to fight fryer with fryer in a fried food feud; first, they must make a sweet and savory fried feast using only what they can carry in a small fryer basket; they prepare fried fish dinners with card game picks.

episodes.name: Bigger, Badder Budget Battle
episodes.summary: Four chefs with a knack for cooking on a budget take on two of Guy Fieri's all-new budget games; the chefs must make a hearty lunch with ingredients that satisfy Guy's price-based grocery list.

episodes.name: All-Star Delivery Nightmare
episodes.summary: Back in Flavortown Market, Guy Fieri pranks three all-star chefs who endured the at-home games of GGG Delivery by having them compete using the contents of the dreaded delivery boxes.

episodes.name: All-Star Vegetarian
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri hands four chefs a challenge to make two vegetarian dishes in one hour using no more than 15 ingredients.

episodes.name: Delivery: Cheese Mania
episodes.summary: Three cheese experts battle it out from their home kitchens to prove which chef does cheese best; first, Guy Fieri only lets them use seven pounds of ingredients to construct the perfect cheesy comfort meal.

episodes.name: Flavortown's Big Move
episodes.summary: After countless games, dishes and millions in prizes, GGG has outgrown Flavortown Market; before moving to a bigger location, Guy Fieri throws one final bash with a twisted game.

episodes.name: Flavortown 2.0
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri marks the grand opening of the new Flavortown Market 2.0 by giving four GGG legends one hour to cook a dinner complete with an appetizer and entree; besides the butcher counter, the chefs can shop for just one ingredient per aisle.

episodes.name: ABC Mania
episodes.summary: Guy lays out what may be the hardest challenge in Flavortown history: three chefs can only use 26 ingredients -- one for each letter of the alphabet -- over the course of the two rounds as they make chicken dinners and go-to seafood dishes.

episodes.name: Extreme Frozen Games
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four chefs to play cool games by preparing hot dishes using nothing but frozen food; after a hot sandwich and a side in round one, the chefs may use one non-frozen ingredient in the final round if they can score a goal.

episodes.name: Thankful for Flavortown
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri welcomes four winning chefs back to make both a Thanksgiving hors d'oeuvre and dinner in just one hour; the competitors spin a wheel to determine what ingredient they'll have to incorporate into their Thanksgiving dinner.

episodes.name: Fruit Fest
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges four chefs to make a fruit-forward feast using a grocery list given by Guy's son Hunter; the three remaining chefs must then make a fine-dining fruit dinner featuring fruit they don't knock over in a game of bowling.

episodes.name: Fieri Family Holiday Showdown
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri's two sons and nephew face off; Guy pairs each family member with their very own all-star chef partner, but he also gives each team a Secret Santa box full of weird ingredients to use.

episodes.name: Guy Cooks the Games: X-treme ABC
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri's son Hunter has Guy cook along to a challenging GGG episode where the contestants can only cook with ingredients that start with one letter of the alphabet; chef Michael Voltaggio pays a visit and finds the tables turn in Guy's kitchen.

episodes.name: Winner Winner Chicken Dinner
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four chefs from his show to put their poultry skills to the test in two rounds of chicken dishes at Flavortown Market.

episodes.name: Anti-Resolution Games
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri and his son Hunter are tired of people making resolutions to give up all the food they enjoy; Guy invites home cooks to Flavortown Market to make comfort dishes people crave.

episodes.name: Global Food Fanatics
episodes.summary: Some of the best world cuisine is served in homes; Guy Fieri and his son Hunter invite three home cooks to share the international flavors they grew up on.

episodes.name: Sinful Sandwiches
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri and his son Hunter throw challenging games at three food fanatics who are out to prove that their sandwiches stack up against anything found in a restaurant.

episodes.name: Host With the Most
episodes.summary: Three food-loving winners who have already proven they can cook like pros are back for the title of Host with the Most; Guy Fieri challenges them to show that they can make championship game day bites without taking a bite out of their wallets.

episodes.name: DDD Champs
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four champion DDD chefs to prove who's the best; after a pair of one-on-one sudden death matches to make elevated comfort food, the final two chefs face the Food Pyramid's random restrictions to make the best high-end dinner.

episodes.name: Food Network Champs
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri welcomes four chefs who've won virtually every Food Network competition; after a dual one-on-one pork dish battle, the final two chefs face off in a culinary confrontation to make the best Champion's Dinner to win $15,000.

episodes.name: Craziest Day in Flavortown
episodes.summary: Proving that anything can happen in Flavortown, four all-star chefs wear body cams for Guy Fieri's craziest competition ever; with appearances from rocker Bret Michaels and actor Lee Majors, the Six Million Dollar Man.

episodes.name: DDD International
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings the international flavors he's discovered back home by inviting four DDD chefs to cook their world cuisine in Flavortown Market; their first challenge is injecting their global flavor into a diner classic.

episodes.name: April Fools' Rules
episodes.summary: In honor of legendary chef and prankster Carl "The Cuban" Ruiz, Guy Fieri invites Carl's all-star friends to Flavortown Market for a night of epic food and twisted pranks; the chefs prepare a spicy appetizer and an even spicier entree.

episodes.name: Comedy Couples Cookoff
episodes.summary: Guy and Hunter force celebrity couples to shop in separate halves of the store to make breakfast in bed.

episodes.name: Night on the Flavortown
episodes.summary: Guy invites four new all-star chefs to Flavortown Market and gives them one hour to make a fancy three-course dinner using a mystery ingredient; to make things even more high-end, Guy asks the chefs to buy an extra-expensive ingredient mid-cook.

episodes.name: Supermoms
episodes.summary: Guy welcomes four supermoms to Flavortown Market to prove their culinary chops and serve up real deal home-cooked flavors; the moms must shop using an alphabet list of ingredients and then earn shopping money by answering kids' homework questions.

episodes.name: Winner's World Cup
episodes.summary: Guy invites three chefs with previous wins to go head-to-head in a showdown of international flavors; the competitors must shop in Flavortown Market's new international section, where all the labels are in different languages.

episodes.name: Burgers or Bust
episodes.summary: Four chefs who specialize in making burgers go head-to-head; Guy Fieri has the chefs make a double burger, but all the burger buns are out of stock.

episodes.name: DDD Dads
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four chefs and dads from DDD to show off their skills; they shop for ingredients for a family favorite, but their kids call in with some strange requests.

episodes.name: Food Truck Teams
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges three food truck teams to show off the food that made their trucks a hit.

episodes.name: Pizza Masters
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites chef Christian Petroni to help officiate a throwdown between three pizza-making pros; after a special delivery of pizza ingredients, Guy and Christian put in an order for the competitors' signature pizzas.

episodes.name: Guy's Summer Games 1
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites eight winners back for an epic five-week tournament featuring cool new games and bold summer flavors; one chef will be eliminated, and the remaining chefs will stay in the running to become the ultimate summer champ and win $25,000.

episodes.name: Guy's Summer Games 2
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges the seven remaining summer tournament chefs to make seafood sandwiches; the top-ranked sandwich wins an instant $5,000, and the bottom two chefs battle to see whose smoothie-inspired dish will save them from elimination.

episodes.name: Guy's Summer Games 3
episodes.summary: It's fun in the park for the six remaining chefs; the chefs partner up to create team picnic plates, with each teammate first shopping a different half of the store using picnic baskets; one chef will be eliminated.

episodes.name: Guy's Summer Games 4
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges the five remaining chefs to use flavors from around the world to make the best grilled meat dish for a $5,000 prize; in round two, the bottom two chefs play fun midway games that handicap their handheld dishes.

episodes.name: Guy's Summer Games Finale
episodes.summary: The tournament ends with a trip to summer camp as Guy Fieri asks the final four chefs to net the fish to use in their fish dinner; they show off their archery skills to pick a whammy for their grilled winner's feast.

episodes.name: Cooking the Books
episodes.summary: Chef Antonia Lofaso gives four of Guy Fieri's superfans the chance to cook their favorite chef's recipes on his home turf, but Guy and Antonia don't go easy on the fans, serving up twisted games like a burger recipe with blanked-out instructions.

episodes.name: GGG Meets Chopped
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri is joined by "Chopped" host Ted Allen in the first-ever "Guy's Grocery Games" and "Chopped" mashup; Ted presents four "Chopped" champions with baskets full of wild ingredients he selected himself, and Guy serves up diabolical games.

episodes.name: Supermarket of Mischief
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four superfans to Flavortown Market for a night of twisted games and shenanigans; for the first round, Guy serves up a whole grocery list of games for the chefs to play while they cook up their signature dishes.

episodes.name: Fieri Thanksgiving Party
episodes.summary: The three youngest members of the Fieri family are paired up with all-star chefs to prepare a one-hour Thanksgiving feast; Guy Fieri gives them a two-for-one special of pie and turkey that they must use in both their appetizer and entrée.

episodes.name: DDD Redemption
episodes.summary: Three returning DDD chefs who have never tasted victory in Flavortown Market are ready for redemption, and Guy Fieri welcomes them back by giving them the ingredients that caused them to lose the first time around.

episodes.name: Dessert Games
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri opens Flavortown's doors to four dessert chefs for a night of sweet treat showdowns; they hit the ground running to make a handheld fried dessert out of only ingredients they can carry and craft their signature sweets using vegetables.

episodes.name: Holiday Hustle
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri divides his all-star chefs into teams of three for a wild culinary relay challenge; without being able to communicate with their teammates, they'll have to shop, cook and present a cohesive holiday meal to win the $20,000 shopping spree.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Bacon
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges three chefs to prove their pork chops by making a bacon dish, and the winner goes head-to-head with an all-star judge to see who can bring home the bacon.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Vegetarian
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri wants three produce-loving pros to let the world know how delicious vegetarian cuisine can be, so they make a comfort classic using only plant-based foods, and the winner takes on an all-star judge.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Sandwiches
episodes.summary: Three sandwich fanatics show Guy Fieri their stacked skills in Flavortown Market by making a decadent sandwich with their fantasy food draft picks, and the winner battles an all-star judge.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Cheesy
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites three cheese-loving chefs to the Flavortown Market; whichever chef creates the tastiest cheese dinner wins $10,000 and faces off against the all-star judge of their choice for the cheese championship.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Spicy
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites three spice experts to prove how heated things can get, but all the chile peppers are out of stock; the round one winner receives an automatic $10,000 before taking on an all-star judge in the ultimate spicy showdown.

episodes.name: DDD Call-Outs
episodes.summary: Two worthy competitors are back to call out the opponents they lost to in a pair of highly-anticipated rematches.

episodes.name: GGG Winners' Face-Off
episodes.summary: Four returning winners vie for the title of Ultimate Guy's Grocery Games Champ; the chefs compete in a pair of one-on-one matches featuring the game Wild Cards; two chefs enter a culinary showdown and determine their final dish using fridge magnets.

episodes.name: Flavortown Food Network Champs
episodes.summary: Four competition-winning chefs battle it out for the title of Flavortown Food Network Champ and a $15,000 prize; they compete in a pair of sudden-death matches and make a seafood dinner using the food pyramid.

episodes.name: Super Seafood Showdown
episodes.summary: Four seafood masters play Go Fish to determine what they'll cook for dinner, and they make a shellfish feast using sample items from the store.

episodes.name: All-Stars ABC
episodes.summary: Using favorite and drafted letters of the alphabet, the chefs spell their way through the ingredients needed to make their cozy comfort dish and a seafood classic.

episodes.name: All-Star Rush
episodes.summary: Four chefs who feel the need for speed compete in Grocery Rush; in a race against the clock, they'll serve a brunch in only 20 minutes and make their favorite noodle dish using 10 ingredients or fewer.

episodes.name: Family Teams
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites three families to show off their home cooking and shopping skills in Flavortown Market; they'll cook a family favorite using items on the F is for Family grocery list.

episodes.name: Wine Country Chefs
episodes.summary: Three top chefs from Northern California's wine country compete to show off their vintage; Guy Fieri welcomes them to the market with a gift basket full of local artisanal goods that they must feature in their signature dish.

episodes.name: GGG Eggs-travaganza
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri discovers Hunter and Antonia Lofaso holding an all-star competition featuring his least favorite food; the chefs try to get Guy to take bites of egg-heavy dishes for points and entice the judges with meals made from unpopular ingredients.

episodes.name: Mother of All Winners
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings back four GGG winners who are also proud mothers to prove that Mom cooks best; they'll make a weeknight favorite using nothing but packaged pantry items before transforming apple pie ingredients into an innovative family dinner.

episodes.name: GGG Redemption
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings back four chefs who came close to victory in their first time in Flavortown Market to prove that the second time's a charm; the chefs make a redemption dinner using the ingredients that previously took them down.

episodes.name: Burger Ballers
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four burger meisters who think outside of the bun to pound out four heavy-hitting burgers using six pounds of ingredients; they slide sliders to select the unusual ingredient they must add to both their cheeseburger and side.

episodes.name: DDD Guilty Pleasures
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four chefs from "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" to cook their creations; they make their favorite guilty pleasure using no more than 6.5 pounds of ingredients and feature whammy items in their diner dinner.

episodes.name: Home Cook Dads
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings in four home-cook dads to take part in the DIY project of making family meals; they tell groan-worthy dad jokes to rack up ingredients for a family favorite meal and go bowling to strike out snacks.

episodes.name: Sweet Deception All-Stars
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri surprises three of his all-star friends by turning a savory showdown into a dessert battle; they'll have to transform diner classics into sweet treats before making a fried dessert using mystery ingredients from Crazy Can Roulette.

episodes.name: Flavortown Auction
episodes.summary: Four chefs try to outbid each other in Guy Fieri's Flavortown auction event; they'll fight for exclusive rights to the aisle they want to shop for their brunch and get into a bidding war over the best protein for their upscale seafood dinner.

episodes.name: All-Star Frozen Freak-Out
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites all-star chefs to throw down in one of the coldest competitions ever; the chefs are given just one hour to make a hot appetizer and dinner party plate using only frozen ingredients and with a different ice cream flavor in each dish.

episodes.name: Teaching Teams
episodes.summary: Teachers who love to cook partner up with all-star chefs to school the competition; the duos solve math and geography clues to discover the ingredients for their elevated school lunch and make a graduation dinner using foods that begin with B and C.

episodes.name: The GGG Experience
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri gives an unfiltered behind-the-scenes view of the Flavortown Market experience; from the chefs' arrival to the market tour and Guy's pre-show pep talk -- all will be revealed for the first time.

episodes.name: All-Star Double Whammy
episodes.summary: In a prank-filled competition, Guy Fieri declares a chef swap, and the judges find themselves cooking with ingredients they chose for the competitors.

episodes.name: DDD All Day
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges chefs from "Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives" to make their bestselling brunch using only ingredients they can fit in a small shopping bag; they must serve an updated diner dinner featuring some retro diner ingredients.

episodes.name: Winner, Winner, One Big Dinner
episodes.summary: Four GGG winners return to Guy Fieri's Flavortown for a chance to take another crown in one big round; they must make a winner's dinner complete with an appetizer and entrée in an hourlong battle to shop the market for up to $20,000.

episodes.name: Meatless Marvels
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges four chefs to make a meat-free steakhouse dinner and appetizer in one hour using only ingredients that will fit into the smallest produce case; things get tougher when Hunter Fieri makes a mid-cook delivery of mushroom jerky.

episodes.name: GGG Tiebreakers
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri welcomes opponents who previously tied as they return for tiebreaker rematches; two home cooks fight for their right to make the best party plate, and two supermoms compete in a budget battle to make the most comforting comfort food.

episodes.name: Firefighters in Flavortown
episodes.summary: Fire station cooks commandeer Flavortown Market, and they'll have to stand the heat when Guy Fieri hits them with his alarming games; they smoke the competition with spicy firehouse favorites and captain-worthy meals for a chance to win $20,000.

episodes.name: All-Star Teaching Teams
episodes.summary: Three all-star chefs team up with a teacher who has made a difference in their lives; Guy Fieri challenges these duos to make an elevated lunchbox meal and a strictly budgeted teacher appreciation dinner for a chance to win their educator $20,000.

episodes.name: Wilderness Chefs
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites three of the best wilderness chefs he's met on his outdoor adventures to hunt the aisles of Flavortown Market and prepare dishes featuring wild game, all while playing GGG's wild games! First, the chefs must make a fireside favorite using the wild game and wild whammy ingredient they picked up as a two-for-one special at the butcher counter; then, they'll have to make an elevated backcountry dinner using the number of ingredients they score in a real deal game of archery.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: International
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges three chefs representing international cuisines to make their signature seafood dish for $10,000; the winner then takes on the world-class GGG judge of their choice in the ultimate international showdown for another $10,000.

episodes.name: All-Star Game Day Relay
episodes.summary: It's Fieri vs. Fieri as Guy and Hunter divide up six of their favorite all-star chefs to see whose team makes the best game day platter; in this tag-team challenge, only the chefs who do the initial shopping know what game day dishes they're making.

episodes.name: Flavortown Academy: Antonia vs. Jet, Part 1
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites seven home cooks from across the country to an intensive five-week cooking competition for a chance to win $35,000; they'll be taught by all-star culinary "professors" Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso.

episodes.name: Flavortown Academy: Antonia vs. Jet, Part 2
episodes.summary: During freshman week, Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso teach their teams how to budget with party platters; the winning team gets a free pass to the sophomore class, while the losing team takes on a chicken dinner challenge.

episodes.name: Flavortown Academy: Antonia vs. Jet, Part 3
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri introduces the students to their sophomore course, which is about elevating food; under the guidance of Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso, the students must make an elevated version of a classic weeknight dinner using nine ingredients or fewer.

episodes.name: Flavortown Academy: Antonia vs. Jet, Part 4
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri sends the top 4 students to Flavortown Academy's junior course devoted to world cuisines; the students use what they've learned from Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso to create a comfort classic featuring two unique international ingredients.

episodes.name: Flavortown Academy: Antonia vs. Jet Finals
episodes.summary: Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso's top students make an upscale entrée using ingredients determined by a roll of the dice; the two most successful students serve up an impressive graduation dinner for a chance to win $35,000.

episodes.name: GGG Best Buddies Holiday Special
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri teams up some of his friends from the Best Buddies volunteer organization with some all-star chefs for a holiday cook-off; the teams have one hour to make a holiday entrée and dessert for a chance to earn $15,000 for their teammate.

episodes.name: One-Stop Speed Shop
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri sends talented chefs running through the aisles of Flavortown Market for the chance to make some serious dough; they face real-world challenges as they compete to be the last chef standing in this high-stakes cooking competition.

episodes.name: Relay: Winners vs. Judges
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri hosts a team competition between three previous winners and three judges; working one at a time, only the first chef is told that they're making a seafood platter, while the remaining chefs will have to guess what they're preparing.

episodes.name: All-Star Alphabet Auction
episodes.summary: Three all-star chefs take on the most extreme ABC game yet as Guy Fieri gives them a whopping $100 each to score ingredients for their comfort classic at the alphabet auction; then, the chefs bid for crazy canned items for an international dinner.

episodes.name: DDD Seafood
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four favorite Diners, Drive-ins and Dives seafood chefs to make some waves in Flavortown Market; they create a regional fish dish using the catch in their fly-fishing net and dig for canned seafood to feature in a shellfish dish.

episodes.name: 10 Pounds, Two Rounds
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges four chefs to prepare two complete meals using no more than 10 lbs. of ingredients; after the chefs use half their weighted groceries to make a hearty hot lunch, they grab two items from the clearance rack to make a dinner.

episodes.name: Food Truck Families
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri gives food truck families the ultimate road test by challenging each member to shop in a grocery relay race; the remaining two teams make their food truck favorite with the dish style and condiment determined by two spinning truck wheels.

episodes.name: Relay: All-Star Moms vs. Dads
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites three all-star chef moms and three all-star chef dads to a team relay showdown; the teammates work on their dish one at a time in shifts.

episodes.name: DDD Vegan
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four DDD chefs with vegan joints to compete in Flavortown Market; they make their vegan best seller using only nine pounds of groceries before serving up a meat-free steakhouse dinner.

episodes.name: Guilty Pleasure Wheels
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four chefs to compete in two rounds of the guiltiest GGG games ever; he kicks things off with three guilty-pleasure wheels to determine the ooey gooey details of the chefs' first dish.

episodes.name: Winners' Whammy Auction
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri welcomes four previous winners back to Flavortown Market for a nonstop super battle; he gives them each $100 to make a complete steakhouse feast in 60 minutes, but first, they have to participate in a dreaded Flavortown whammy auction.

episodes.name: Relay: Ultimate Face-Off
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri sets up the ultimate face-off with a relay between two teams to create a spicy champion's dinner; working blind, the chefs in the later shifts cook and present dishes based on their best guess of what the teammate before them was making.

episodes.name: Red Light Special Extravaganza
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri has plenty of deals to welcome four chefs to Flavortown Market, with red light specials in all 10 aisles; using the red light specials, the chefs must create a fried feast before making a pork dish that's limited to 11 ingredients or fewer.

episodes.name: Best Burgers
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri brings in four baller burgermeisters for a bodacious burger battle; they must make an excellent cheeseburger using 10 items or fewer before incorporating an alternate ground meat and unusual produce item in their winning burger and fries.

episodes.name: DDD Budget Battle
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four chefs from diners, drive-ins, and dives to prove their budgeting skills while making their restaurant's best selling dish; the remaining three competitors make their personal seafood favorites while working with a $25 budget.

episodes.name: Hunter's Whammy Cart
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri's son Hunter has run out of time to restock the store, so he puts six returned items in each chef's cart; the chefs must use all six ingredients over the course of both rounds, starting with a hometown favorite dish.

episodes.name: All-Star Relay Rumble
episodes.summary: In a Tournament of Champions Winners vs. Culinary Giant Slayers showdown, the teammates work alone in 10-minute tag-team shifts to create a sweet and savory duo with a few mandatory items.

episodes.name: All-Star Relay Rumble
episodes.summary: In the second heat of Guy Fieri's wild team tournament, Culinary Award Winners take on Competition All-Stars; each tag team must make a vegetarian version of a classic food duo.

episodes.name: All-Star Relay Rumble
episodes.summary: In the final qualifying heat, judges take on Team Next Gen; the chefs search the market for a shopping cart containing a combination of global ingredients and a food adjective they can turn into a winning dish.

episodes.name: All-Star Relay Rumble
episodes.summary: The qualifying teams create a party platter featuring something raw, something fried and something cheesy; with only eight pounds of ingredients and some swapped selections, the tag teams race for the chance to move on to the big $60,000 finale.

episodes.name: All-Star Relay Rumble: Finale
episodes.summary: It's the finale as the two highest-scoring all-star teams face off in the ultimate relay rumble; each team is given $40 to make a high-end dinner on a budget for the Relay Rumble Championship trophies and the $60,000 prize.

episodes.name: Discount Dinners: Beat the Judges
episodes.summary: A budget battle is taken up by three cost-saving chefs; Guy Fieri challenges them to prepare a four-plate dinner with only $25; the winner earns an automatic $10,000 before facing the all-star judge of their choice.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Express Lane
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges three experienced chefs to prepare their best pork dish using only 10 items; the winner earns an automatic $15,000 and can wager up to $5,000 in an express lane seafood battle against the all-star judge of their choice.

episodes.name: Bad to the Bacon
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites four chefs with a passion for pork to smoke the competition with bacon dishes; they prepare a signature bacon dish.

episodes.name: Five Star Dinner Rush
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri pits four talented chefs against each other in three elimination challenges that put their culinary skills to the test as they compete for a cash prize.

episodes.name: Dinner for Dollars
episodes.summary: Flavortown Market is overflowing with whammy ingredients, so Guy Fieri declares that the chefs will bank $2,500 for each whammy item they use.

episodes.name: DDD-elicious
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites some of the newest chefs from "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" to compete in Flavortown Market, where they make their best seller; the chefs roll the GGG dice to see what mandatory items they must use in an elevated comfort classic.

episodes.name: GGG New Stars
episodes.summary: Four first-timer chefs have to play two of GGG's oldest games -- frozen food can-can and menu magnet madness, before they can prepare their winning dishes.

episodes.name: Masters of Cheese
episodes.summary: Four cheese-obsessed chefs go head-to-head in two challenges; Guy Fieri rolls a cheese die to determine how many different types of cheese the chefs must use before they shop the sample tables for their cheesy winner's dinner.

episodes.name: All-Star All Swap
episodes.summary: Alex Guarnaschelli makes her return to Flavortown Market by taking on Rocco DiSpirito and Brian Malarkey; Guy Fieri hits them with his new swap wheel.

episodes.name: Game Day Bite Fight
episodes.summary: Guy divides six acclaimed chefs into teams of three to compete in a game day food battle, fought relay-style in 10-minute shifts; after each shift, Guy gives the chefs a chance to communicate non-verbally through big letters and physical charades.

episodes.name: City Food Fight: Los Angeles vs. San Francisco
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites culinary duos from Los Angeles and San Francisco to each prepare three-course feasts designed to prove which city's food is best; they use ingredients from both cities in hopes of winning $15,000 and Golden State bragging rights.

episodes.name: City Food Fight: Chicago vs. NYC
episodes.summary: Guy brings in chef duos from Chicago and New York to prepare a feast that proves their city's food is world-class; they use ingredients that celebrate The Big Apple and Chicago's The Bean in hopes of scoring $15,000 and big city bragging rights.

episodes.name: Ultimate City Food Fight
episodes.summary: The winners of the first two City Food Fights face off to prove their city's culinary supremacy; Guy Fieri sets up games inspired by their city's basketball teams; the winning team takes home $15,000 and the GGG City Food Fight champion trophy!

episodes.name: Culinary Call-Outs
episodes.summary: Returning chefs call out their market rivals for a $10,000 showdown to settle the score; a Seoul food chef challenges the opponent who beat her by one point, and a five-time GGG winner calls out the judge who defeated her in a cheesy battle.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Frozen Food Feast
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites three chefs to prove they're the King of the Chill by outcooking each other in a frozen food fight; they make their best seafood dinner using just frozen items before the winner gets a shot at taking on the judge of their choice.

episodes.name: Three Course Couples
episodes.summary: Three chefs join forces with their spouses in a three-course competition where Guy Fieri tests their cooking chops and communication skills; the couples have one hour to make a date-night dinner with an on-the-fly dessert.

episodes.name: Guy's Favorites
