episodes.summary: Three of Guy Fieri's favorite DDD chefs and three GGG winners compete in a tag-team relay to create a pork dinner; the first shift chef shops for a favorite snack food and piece of equipment selected by a roll of the old culinary dice.

episodes.name: Baseball Stadium Food Fight
episodes.summary: The bases are loaded and so is the food as four chefs try to hit a culinary home-run; Guy Fieri spins the food wheels to determine what two stadium classics the chefs must mash up before they take on a VIP dish using only what fits in a helmet.

episodes.name: Meatless Masters
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri welcomes back former GGG winners who use their meatless dishes to show the meat eaters how it's done; they make a dish without any carts before shopping each aisle to make a 10-item winner's dinner.

episodes.name: All-Star Fruit!
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites three chefs to take on a 60-minute multi-course fruit showdown; before they can cook their dishes, the chefs must compete in an auction and outbid each other for exclusive rights to the fruit they'll feature.

episodes.name: DDD Sandwiches
episodes.summary: Three of Guy Fieri's favorite DDD chefs and three outstanding GGG winners compete in a tag-team relay to create a pork dinner; the first shift chef shops for a favorite snack food and piece of equipment.

episodes.name: Friend to Foe
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri pairs the four chefs in teams of two to create an elevated weeknight dinner; the winning teammates must face off in a head-to-head battle, creating their most impressive entrée using only 10 ingredients.

episodes.name: GGG G.O.A.T.
episodes.summary: Fieri invites eight chefs to compete in a five-part tournament for a $70,000 prize; after the first round, the bottom three chefs are given 20 minutes to make a full Sunday supper in a sudden-death elimination round.

episodes.name: GGG G.O.A.T.
episodes.summary: Fieri surprises the six remaining chefs with double wheels that pick their dish and game at random; first, the competitors must make a vegetarian dinner with limited ingredients; then, the bottom two chefs make noodle dishes in the elimination round.

episodes.name: The G.O.A.T. Tournament Pt 3
episodes.summary: A double spin of Fieri's dish and game wheels determines that the five remaining chefs must make a champagne brunch using only 8 lbs. of ingredients; the bottom two chefs fight for their survival in the elimination round by creating a seafood feast.

episodes.name: The G.O.A.T. Tournament Pt. 4
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri pairs the four remaining chefs into teams to make their best pork dish with only frozen ingredients; the losing teammates face off in the elimination round by making a comfort classic using one ingredient from each aisle.

episodes.name: GGG G.O.A.T. Finale
episodes.summary: Three finalists make their best chicken dinner; Guy Fieri surprises the final two chefs with a cart swap, and the chef who makes the best celebration dinner using their opponent's groceries earns the GGG Greatest of All Time trophy and $70,000.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Non-Stop Noodles
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri welcomes three chefs who won in the past to take on each other in a non-stop noodle event; the winner gets a shot at turning their prize money into $20,000 if they can beat a GGG judge in a noodle cook-off.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Burger Masters
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites three burger chefs to outcook each other before taking on a judge; the chefs begin by making their signature burger and side featuring a surprise special of canned corn.

episodes.name: Super Spicy Games
episodes.summary: Four spice-obsessed chefs are bringing the heat in a spicy competition; the chefs make a hometown spicy dish; Guy Fieri challenges the competitors to create an upscale spicy dinner.

episodes.name: Dessert Deception
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri divides six chefs up into teams as they work alone in 10-minute shifts to create a winning plate; the chefs are surprised to learn that their grocery list featuring breakfast sandwich ingredients must be used to make a dessert.

episodes.name: Two Ingredients Per Aisle All Day
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges three chefs with one five-minute shop for the whole competition; they can only grab two ingredients per aisle to make a family friendly brunch; they must make an upscale dinner using leftover ingredients.

episodes.name: One Dish Redemption
episodes.summary: Four chefs who fell short of victory their first time around are back to cook a redemption dinner; Guy Fieri goes behind the scenes to reveal Flavortown secrets, including the workings of this real deal grocery store inside a sound stage.

episodes.name: Sweet & Savory Superstars
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites three savory winners and three dessert winners to pair up into super teams; the randomly selected teams have just one hour to make a sweet and savory appetizer, an upscale dinner and dessert using only a single basket of groceries.

episodes.name: All-Star Pizza
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites all-star chefs Maneet Chauhan, Christian Petroni, Adam Sobel and Stephanie Izard for a pizza showdown; the pie makers must serve up a pizzeria combo plate using only the grocery items they can carry on a pizza paddle.

episodes.name: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Legends Tournament, Part 1
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri invites eight chefs to compete in a five-part racecourse for a $30,000 grand prize; the bottom ranking chefs must create a second guilty pleasure dish to avoid elimination.

episodes.name: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Legends Tournament, Part 2
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri sends talented chefs running through the aisles of Flavortown Market for the chance to make some serious dough; they face real-world challenges as they compete to be the last chef standing in this high-stakes cooking competition.

episodes.name: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Legends Tournament, Part 3
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri pairs the remaining six DDD chefs into teams and gives each duo under $20 to create a classic food duo; the top two teams continue their race for the $30,000 grand prize, while the bottom duo faces off in a seafood dinner budget battle.

episodes.name: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Legends Tournament, Part 4
episodes.summary: Guy Fieri challenges the five remaining DDD chefs to make a burger and side using only nine ingredients; the bottom two chefs must shop fast and furious for ingredients to make takeout noodles to earn the last spot in the finale worth $30,000.

episodes.name: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives Legends Tournament, Part 5: Finale

episodes.name: GGG Global Games Finale

episodes.name: Back to School
episodes.summary: Twelve celebrities report for their first day of class, tackling a logic challenge, a nostalgic quiz on grade-school subjects, and interactive zoology and geography tests as they work their way toward the high-stakes final exam.

episodes.name: Airhead-to-Head
episodes.summary: The all-star students face a mind-boggling lightbulb game, race to answer questions before a balloon bursts and team up in a spelling bee as they work toward the high-stakes final exam.

episodes.name: Duel of Fools
episodes.summary: After a deceptive challenge, the class receives its first rankings; the all-star students take on an intense chess-themed trivia game and a school picture day challenge as they work toward the high-stakes final exam.

episodes.name: Feud for Thought
episodes.summary: With only nine contestants remaining, tensions rise and rivalries start to form as the celebrities push themselves to their limits, tackling everything from general knowledge trivia to a game of life-sized human labyrinth.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A celebrity competition where contestants face school-themed challenges, but the goal is to avoid last place and the unwanted title of "Nation's Dumbest."

episodes.name: Fowl and Eggsplosive
episodes.summary: Chefs Adrienne Cheatham, Ayesha Nurdjaja and Zac Young weigh in on collapsing baked goods, painful kitchen wipeouts and an exploding egg prank; in the game Pause and Effect, chefs try to predict exactly what culinary disaster is about to unfold.

episodes.name: High Risk Peppers and Robotic Wreckers
episodes.summary: Esther Choi, Joe Sasto and Kalen Allen react to kitchen robots attempting to cook, spicy pepper challenges and more outrageous food moments while sharing hilarious commentary, culinary insight and plenty of strong opinions along the way.

episodes.name: Barks and Wrecks
episodes.summary: Blowtorches spark dangerous kitchen chaos, terrible recipe ideas go horribly wrong, and dogs and other animals steal food at the worst possible times. Esther Choi, Joe Sasto, and Kalen Allen react to the madness with expert insight and strong opinions.

episodes.name: Fiery Fails and Furry Tales
episodes.summary: Chefs Adrienne Cheatham, Ayesha Nurdjaja and Zac Young react to exploding cocktails, destructive microwaves and unexpected animal invasions as they break down the risky cooking mistakes and surprising kitchen hacks behind these outrageous food moments.

episodes.name: Warning: Contents Under Pressure
episodes.summary: Pressure cookers explode, food deliveries take bizarre turns, and babies create unexpected kitchen chaos as Esther Choi, Joe Sasto, and Kalen Allen react with hilarious commentary, strong opinions, and expert insight.

episodes.name: Crispy, Creamy, and Caffeinated
episodes.summary: Chefs Tiffani Faison, Brian Malarkey and Gabe Bertaccini provide commentary and professional insight on viral videos featuring kitchen accidents, unusual deep-fried food and serving mishaps; the segment includes a game where viewers guess the outcome of impending culinary disasters.

episodes.name: Cooking and Screaming
episodes.summary: Chefs react to hibachi tricks gone wrong, ice cream pranks, and more.

episodes.name: Too Hot to Handle
episodes.summary: Seafood feasts, breakfast favorites, and bartending tricks all take unexpected turns as chefs Tiffani Faison, Brian Malarkey and Gabe Bertaccini react with hilarious commentary, professional insight and expert advice.

episodes.name: The Great Outdoors and I Do Disasters
episodes.summary: Campfire cooking adventures heat up, wedding cakes collapse, and drive-thru encounters take turns as Tiffani Faison, Brian Malarkey, Gabe Bertaccini, Adrienne Cheatham, and Zac Young weigh in with hilarious reactions and culinary expertise.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Professional chefs deliver reactions and commentary on the internet's viral food clips, from cooking fails to jaw-dropping culinary wins, while providing practical tips along the way.

episodes.name: First Class Food Fails
episodes.summary: Flambé flames rise high, taste test tricks fool unsuspecting family and friends, and airplane meals come under the spotlight as Damaris Phillips, Joe Isidori, and Arnold Myint react with hilarious commentary and culinary expertise.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Professional chefs deliver reactions and commentary on the internet's viral food clips, from cooking fails to jaw-dropping culinary wins, while providing practical tips along the way.

episodes.name: Braving the Bayou
episodes.summary: A deputy and his K9 wade through the murky waters of a Georgia swamp to catch a submerged felon; in Louisiana's Cajun country, a suspect escapes into a gator-filled bayou; a man accused of armed robbery takes the plunge, and a deputy dons his heroic cape to save a drowning pup.

episodes.name: Wanted in the Wetlands
episodes.summary: In Florida, troopers risk life and limb wading through gator-infested swamps to track a suspect; a thief in Georgia is close to becoming gator feed to evade capture; a man acting erratically makes a surprising getaway and a gator comes between a woman and her pizza.

episodes.name: Manhunt in the Marshes
episodes.summary: Deep in the swamps of the southern USA, a suspect swings through the trees in a desperate bid to avoid capture; a man crashes into marshland, sparking a grueling 14-hour manhunt; and in Texas, officers face an even bigger threat, as a 10-foot alligator requires some serious wrangling.

episodes.name: Bullets in the Bayou
episodes.summary: A K9 unit tracks a copper thief through punishing wetlands; a deputy gets a lucky escape after a gunman triggers a tense standoff; a suspect tries to make a watery getaway, and a dramatic car chase in Georgia leads to a surprising discovery.

episodes.name: Deputies in the Deep
episodes.summary: In Georgia, a crazed driver slams into a patrol car before escaping into swamp woods; deputies brave Florida's treacherous wetlands at night to track down an invisible fugitive; patrol officers chase a kayaker living on a derelict houseboat among the mangroves and in Louisiana, there's a snake alert!

episodes.name: Mayhem in the Mangroves
episodes.summary: A suspect dives into open water and vanishes into the mangroves; in Texas, a chase ends in a swampy manhunt as officers call in reinforcements after suspects bail and disappear into the swampland; an armed arson suspect sparks an 11-hour standoff… high up in a tree.

episodes.name: Catch of the Day
episodes.summary: A license check spirals when a suspect refuses to surrender; in Louisiana, a fugitive vanishes into thin air; a Georgia traffic stop almost costs a deputy his life, and a plane crash sends deputies deep into the swamp to rescue a father and daughter.

episodes.name: Out of Sight
episodes.summary: A car thief flees arrest, sparking a two-day manhunt; a drone helps a rookie K9 make his first arrest, while in Florida, two suspects take to the water in a bid to escape justice and in Louisiana, a routine traffic stop reveals a dark tragedy.

episodes.name: Fugitives, Flames and Feathers
episodes.summary: Night falls in Louisiana as officers disturb a prolific burglar who escapes into gator-infested waters. Meanwhile, undercover detectives take to the Florida swamps to hunt down a wanted felon and police responding to a welfare call are taken by surprise. Later, a car chase in Arkansas ends up in flames and a deputy makes a big bird arrest.

episodes.name: Marsh After Midnight
episodes.summary: A berry heist sparks a manhunt into dense scrub while in Louisiana, a fugitive vanishes into the marsh at night; a stolen car chase crashes out, a K9 delivers a painful lesson, and officers race to save a mother trapped in a submerged car.

episodes.name: Takedown in the Thicket
episodes.summary: In Arkansas, multiple units search for a suspect in thick woodland and elsewhere, a brave police dog jumps off a 60-foot bridge. A man hiding in swamp mud gets stuck, a car crashes into a lake with a child reportedly inside and deputies are called to a school to deal with a scaly intruder.

episodes.name: Robbery in the Reeds.
episodes.summary: SWAT are called to chase down a stolen multi-million-dollar yacht among the mangroves. Burglars hide in a gator's canal to avoid capture, a suspect uses his nudity as an excuse not to surrender, and in a Georgia swamp, a fleeing suspect finds an unusual hiding place.

episodes.name: Crooks, Creeks and Cuffs
episodes.summary: An armed fugitive sparks a 2-day manhunt in gator swampland while a Louisiana car thief risks his life jumping 30 feet into a treacherous lake to escape the law. Officers in Arkansas pursue a shoplifter as he forges his SUV through a creek and a brave officer tackles a gator who's strayed into suburbia.

episodes.name: Cornered in the Current
episodes.summary: In Arkansas, deputies stake out a murder suspect who's fallen asleep in his swamp hideout. In Florida, officers wade knee-deep through the marsh after a fleeing suspect, and a botched jet ski theft leaves another suspect stranded, with deputies forced to bring in a boat.

episodes.name: Lost in the Lowlands
episodes.summary: An armed robber's backpack leads police to a hideout in Arkansas. Twins are stopped at a traffic stop and one of them flees, sparking an all night swamp search. A K9 unit tracks a suspect who crashed an ATV into a canal, and a seemingly empty boat spirals out of control.

episodes.name: Nowhere to Hide
episodes.summary: In Tennessee, deputies hunt for a fugitive who's vanished into the woods. A burglary suspect sparks a K9 search through the swamps. A carjacker makes a desperate escape through the mangroves and deputies come face-to-face with an unexpected trespasser.

episodes.name: Japanese Katana
episodes.summary: Bladesmiths have to forge one of the most iconic weapons from history, the Japanese Katana; their swords will be pushed to the absolute limit with the final test determining which is stronger.

episodes.name: Chakram
episodes.summary: The finalists go to their home forges to create an ancient Indian Chakram, and they return with two very different interpretations of that deadly, circular throwing weapon; only one stands up to the judges' dynamic battery of tests.

episodes.name: Viking Battle Axe
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths have to turn a steel train spring into a weapon of their choosing; only two competitors will move on and are given only five days to forge a legendary Viking Battle Axe.

episodes.name: Katar
episodes.summary: Competitors make their signature blade by using the Hada technique, a traditional process that involves forging multiple layers of steel together.

episodes.name: Crusader Sword
episodes.summary: Following a difficult first round of testing, the remaining two bladesmiths head home with only five days to forge the legendary Crusader Sword.

episodes.name: The Elizabethan Rapier
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths have to use an age-old technique to make their signature weapons; two finalists head to their home forges to create one of history's most notorious weapons, the rapier.

episodes.name: The Roman Gladius
episodes.summary: After a hard round of tests that literally breaks a blade in two, the finalists get the chance to make one of the most important weapons from history, the Roman Gladius.

episodes.name: The Moro Kris
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths have forged a signature weapon using everyday steel objects; two competitors will move on and are given only five days to create the mystical Moro Kris Sword, a distinctive blade that dates all the way back to 300 B.C.

episodes.name: The War Hammer
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths have to choose wisely as they are asked to dumpster dive for the right steel to be turned into a hardened blade of their choosing; after five days at their home forges, the smiths return their war hammers in hand.

episodes.name: Khopesh
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths are given a twisted challenge when they are asked to create a weapon from cable steel; after two rounds only two are left to return home and forge an Egyptian Khopesh.

episodes.name: The Scottish Claymore
episodes.summary: Four blade smiths face grueling challenges when the electricity and power tools are taken away from them; only two will survive and move on to the final round where they'll have just five days to create the iconic Scottish Claymore.

episodes.name: Spiked Shield
episodes.summary: The blade smiths are asked to forge three or more metals into a blade of their signature style; two move on to the final round returning home to make a legendary spiked shield; only one emerges to be crowned the Forged in Fire Champion.

episodes.name: Viking Sword
episodes.summary: In a race against time, four bladesmiths have to salvage material from a car and forge a blade; two will make it to the final round where they will have just five days to create a Viking sword.

episodes.name: Nepalese Kukri
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths are tasked with the challenge of shaping four very different types of metal into a fully functional deadly weapon; two will have just five days to make one of the most lethal weapons in military history, the Nepalese Kukri.

episodes.name: The Shotel
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are challenged with taking high carbon steel and wrought iron and forging a fully functional weapon; two will move on to the final round where they'll have just five days to make the Ethiopian Shotel.

episodes.name: The Cutlass
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths must turn failed blades from last season into fully-functional weapons; two bladesmiths go home with just five days to forge the legendary Cutlass Sword.

episodes.name: Khanda
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths must create a weapon in their signature style from a large pile of mixed metal that is welded together; two return home to forge the mysterious Khanda.

episodes.name: Tabar
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths take an ordinary garden lawnmower and use its metal to create one of their signature blades; two will make it to the final round during which they must forge a Tabar, a battle-ax from Southern Asia.

episodes.name: Champions Edition
episodes.summary: Four champions return for a chance to prove who among them is the best of the best; after two rounds, only two will move on to the final round where they will have to create a weapon that stumped previous contestants -- the Scottish Claymore.

episodes.name: Fan Favorites
episodes.summary: Fan favorites return for a shot at victory to make their signature style blades with materials from a surprising source; after two rounds, two smiths are left to take on the challenge of re-creating a weapon they've never seen before, the hook sword.

episodes.name: Butterfly Swords
episodes.summary: Four new contestants try to craft blades from a pile of tools, both old and new; the final two contestants must craft Chinese butterfly swords.

episodes.name: The Falcata
episodes.summary: Four contestants must create blades out of high-carbon steel while also forging the hammers they'll use to make them; only two move on to the final round during which they have just five days to create a weapon known as the Falcata.

episodes.name: Kora Sword
episodes.summary: Four new smiths step up to the challenge of forging blades using pieces of steel harvested from power tools; while some of them excel, others are pushed to the limits of exhaustion; the final two must create a sacrificial sword from history.

episodes.name: Hunga Munga
episodes.summary: Contestants are tasked with making serrated blades out of the tools on the table; they must harvest enough steel to forge their blades without melting down an essential tool they may need later; the final two smiths attempt to forge a hunga munga.

episodes.name: The Boar Spear
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must use the steel from a suit of armor to create a signature blade; during the final round, the two remaining smiths must create a boar spear, a weapon used for both combat and hunting.

episodes.name: Xiphos Sword
episodes.summary: A group of bladesmiths must harvest steel from a piece of construction equipment to forge their blades; two remaining smiths face off to re-create a classic Greek sword used in close-quarters combat.

episodes.name: The Pandat
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must salvage steel from a junkyard to create signature blades using a hand-cranked coal forge; two smiths move onto the final round, during which they will have five days to create a Dayak war sword, the Pandat.

episodes.name: Zulu Iklwa
episodes.summary: Bladesmiths must forge a bayonet and engineer it to attach to a rifle; the final two smiths must spend five days forging the legendary African blade, the Zulu Iklwa.

episodes.name: The Pata
episodes.summary: Former winners return to forge a blade using canoe damascus; after two rounds, the remaining champions will move to the final round during which they must create a weapon known for its unique mechanics and deadly double-edged blade -- the pata.

episodes.name: The Zweihander
episodes.summary: Four competitors must forge weld blades for friction folders from tiny cubes of steel, then two smiths will return home where they will forge a German Zweihänder.

episodes.name: Cavalry Saber
episodes.summary: Each bladesmith is challenged to transform the barrel of a gun into a lethal knife; the final two smiths return home to spend five days forging one of the most legendary blades in history, the cavalry saber.

episodes.name: The Naginata
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must create a signature blade using a mystery technique; after a round of testing, two will return to their home forges where they will reproduce a Japanese naginata.

episodes.name: The Haladie
episodes.summary: For the first time ever, four bladesmiths use high carbon steel to forge a hatchet; two finalists have just five days to create an ancient Indian weapon used to both stab and slice.

episodes.name: Redemption
episodes.summary: Four previously eliminated bladesmiths return to the forge for a shot at redemption; after two rounds of competition, the two remaining smiths face off to re-create a Viking sword known for its devastating strength.

episodes.name: Judges Pick
episodes.summary: The judges pick past bladesmiths to represent them; first, the smiths must use steel from N.Y.C. streets to forge signature blades; in the final round, the competitors have five days to forge a sword that originated in West Africa, the Ida.

episodes.name: Deer Horn Knives
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths tee up for a never-before seen challenge, harvesting steel from a vintage golf club to forge signature blades; in the final round, the remaining smiths must forge a pair of iconic double bladed weapons with two times the edge.

episodes.name: The Katzbalger
episodes.summary: The competitors must forge two blades in the first round, pushing them to their limits and leading to a hospital trip; after the second round, the two remaining smiths have five days to create an iconic 15th-century combat sword, the Katzbalger.

episodes.name: Makraka
episodes.summary: Facing a new twist in the first round, four bladesmiths must forge a karambit, a curved knife that resembles a claw; the final two competitors have five days to forge one of the deadliest weapons in African history, the makraka.

episodes.name: Fans' Choice
episodes.summary: Chosen by fans, four bladesmiths return for a second shot at victory; the smiths must use their best forging techniques to make a signature blade using barbed wire; the final two smiths craft a historical Filipino weapon of war, the Panabas.

episodes.name: Akrafena
episodes.summary: Bladesmiths are tasked with forging a Kukri, the signature blade of master smith and judge, Jason Knight; after two rounds of mishaps and mischief, two smiths forge ahead in the final challenge to reproduce a distinctive African sword, the Akrafena.

episodes.name: Talwar
episodes.summary: Competitors are tasked with using mystery steel to forge a blade; the smiths fight to the finish amidst injuries and setbacks, but only two make it to the final round; two finalists have five days to recreate the sacred but lethal Talwar sword.

episodes.name: The Cinquedea
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must utilize questionable steel from mining tools to forge blades in their signature styles; ultimately, two smiths survive to forge an intricately designed and deadly Italian sword, the Cinquedea.

episodes.name: The Charay
episodes.summary: The competitors must demonstrate edged-weapon mastery when they are tasked with turning salvaged junkyard steel into a weapon; two forge ahead to the final round to recreate the legendary Charay sword.

episodes.name: Sword Breaker Redemption
episodes.summary: Four competitors return to the forge for a second chance; they must forge their signature blades using recycled steel from a jackhammer; then, the finalists must recreate a distinctive 16th-century blade called the Sword Breaker.

episodes.name: Master & Apprentice
episodes.summary: Masters compete alongside their apprentices as they take turns on the forge floor, fusing their skills to forge a cleaver using the arduous jellyroll technique; in the final round, the smiths must forge a deadly Congolese chopper, the Nzappa Zap.

episodes.name: Ngombe Ngulu
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must forge blades from a giant elevator cable; two finalists return home to recreate the African Ngombe Ngulu, known as the executioner's sword.

episodes.name: The Shamshir
episodes.summary: Four competing bladesmiths are tasked with forging a Bowie knife that will require a d-guard in the second round; only two manage to make it through to the final round where they must recreate a deadly saber called the Shamshir.

episodes.name: The Kachin Dao
episodes.summary: Smiths must use steel from old nautical equipment to forge-weld their signature blades, while being forced to do it using a metal inlay technique; then, the two finalists have just five days to forge the Kachin Dao, a deadly headhunting sword.

episodes.name: The Gladiators' Scissor
episodes.summary: With a variety of steels to choose from, the smiths are forced to create a canister Damascus billet from which they must forge a dagger; only two enter the final round where they must recreate an ancient Roman weapon known as the Scissor.

episodes.name: The Kampilan
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths head to a scrap yard to create their signature blades using harvested metal and a coal forge; in the final round, the smiths must re-create a fearsome battle weapon known as the kampilan.

episodes.name: The Kpinga
episodes.summary: The smiths are forced to layer a complex Damascus pattern into their signature-style blades; broken blades fall throughout two challenges and an unforgiving round; finalists must recreate a three-bladed African throwing knife called the Kpinga.

episodes.name: The Yatagan
episodes.summary: The competition shifts into high gear when the smiths are tasked with turning the rusted steel from a 1971 Mercury Cougar into their signature blades in just three hours; the finalists must create an elite military weapon known as the Yatagan.

episodes.name: International Championship
episodes.summary: Four of the top smiths from around the world compete in an international championship; two smiths return home empty handed, while two go on to recreate the Spadroon, a weapon that transcends borders, in their efforts to bring home the title.

episodes.name: Tabar-Shishpar
episodes.summary: Smiths are asked to forge blades from pipe wrenches; two competitors advance to the final round during which they must recreate a rare axe-mace hybrid known as the Tabar-Shishpar.

episodes.name: Ultimate Champions Edition
episodes.summary: Five returning champions must earn a spot at one of the four anvils; the four remaining smiths are given cubes to forge blades in the infamous canister Damascus challenge; then, the finalists return to their home forges to recreate the Tai Chi sword.

episodes.name: Knights Templar
episodes.summary: Smiths must forge together rusty chain mail and high quality steel to produce Knights Templar crusader daggers in round one; two finalists are sent back to their home forges on a five-day quest to recreate the iconic Knights Templar crusader sword.

episodes.name: Viking Edition
episodes.summary: Competitors march into a dry moat where they resurrect old swords and forge them into a Viking Seax, using the time-tested coal forge; the finalists return home to recreate a pair of deadly Viking War Axes.

episodes.name: Rookies Edition
episodes.summary: Five novice smiths must earn their way into the competition because one smith will be sent home before the forge lights up; the two left standing must re-create a 16th-century weapon known as the War Golok.

episodes.name: The Schiavona
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths begin on a farm where they must harvest steel from farming tools, then use coal forges to make their signature blades with a hidden lanyard hole; the two remaining smiths must recreate the Schiavona.

episodes.name: Sica Sword
episodes.summary: The smiths must forge a signature blade out of a 50-caliber flintlock pistol; despite giving it their best shot, it becomes a struggle to turn a gun into a blade and after two grueling rounds, two smiths get sent barreling towards elimination.

episodes.name: Jumonji Yari
episodes.summary: Smiths must forge functional friction folders and find the critical junction where skill meets resiliency; two finalists must re-create a Japanese trident called the Jumonji Yari, a weapon of unparalleled strength.

episodes.name: The Kabyle Flyssa
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths are challenged to salvage a cannon to make signature blades; the finalists recreate the North African Kabyle Flyssa, a blade traditionally used to break mail armor.

episodes.name: Ultimate Team Challenge
episodes.summary: Four master smiths compete alongside their apprentices to forge an iconic weapon of warfare: the trench knife; each team must work together, tagging in and out every half hour, with only one smith allowed to touch the knife at a time.

episodes.name: Karabela
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must kick their skills into gear when they're tasked with forging blades out of steel from a chain and a sprocket; only two hold it together long enough to secure a spot in the final round; the iconic Karabela saber.

episodes.name: The Zande Spear
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must forge J. Nielson's favorite blade, a Damascus European dagger; two smiths produce knives that survive J.'s merciless tests; in the final round, the remaining smiths have five days to forge a pole weapon: the Zande Spear.

episodes.name: The Navaja
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths test their mettle in a rock quarry, where they're tasked with making blades using harvested steel and coal forges; the smiths construct a blade while fighting the elements; the remaining two smiths must re-create the Spanish Navaja.

episodes.name: The German Halberd
episodes.summary: The smiths come under pressure when tasked with forging Dave Baker's favorite blade, the Scottish Dirk; two smiths head home for the final round to re-create the German Halberd, a medieval-era triple threat.

episodes.name: The Two-Handed Sword
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths are forced to harvest steel from motorcycles to forge blades in their signature style; after an intense race to the finish, the final two competitors have only five days to re-create a giant Indian two-handed sword.

episodes.name: The Naval Cutlass
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths, all veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces, dive into the fray when they are tasked with forging a combat knife from an anti-tank hedgehog; two grueling rounds of competition filled with frustration and a medical emergency.

episodes.name: The Horseman's Axe
episodes.summary: A signature blade must be forged from small springs of steel; major setbacks occur that need to be corrected before time runs out; two smiths must recreate the deadly Horseman's Axe.

episodes.name: The Lion Spear
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must craft a hatchet from pieces of odd-shaped steel; after several forging failures, parameter mishaps, and intense conditions, only two smiths head back to their home forges, where they must re-create the deadly Maasai Lion Spear.

episodes.name: The Kelewang
episodes.summary: The smiths make their signature blades out of drill bits and a chunk of mild steel; after two rounds, two smiths survive the chopping block and are sent back to their home forges to re-create a beautiful but deadly Indonesian sword, the Kelewang.

episodes.name: Bagh Nakh Blades
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths are forced to make canister Damascus using nuts and bolts; two smiths move onto the final round where they must re-create a pair of deadly Indian Bagh Nakh weapons.

episodes.name: The Glaive Guisarme
episodes.summary: Four smiths are tasked with forging the iconic KA-BAR military blade using only tiny cubes of W-1 steel; the two remaining competitors have five days in their home forges to recreate the battle-tested Glaive Guisarme.

episodes.name: Pioneer Sword
episodes.summary: Four smiths must forge a multipurpose weapon from old rescue tools; after narrowly escaping elimination, two smiths head back to their home forges to recreate a unique utilitarian tool, the Russian Pioneer Sword.

episodes.name: Wind and Fire Wheels
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are tasked with forging a signature blade from a bicycle; two smiths advance and are shocked to learn that they must re-create an ancient, mysterious weapon called wind and fire wheels.

episodes.name: The Smallsword
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are tasked with forging friction folders from a huge steel coil; in the final round, the two remaining smiths head back to their home forges to create a blade that requires both precision and detail: the French smallsword.

episodes.name: The Anthropomorphic Sword
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are tasked with forging a signature blade from W2 and a giant industrial-sized nut; only two smiths advance and head back to their home forges to re-create the Celtic anthropomorphic sword, an iconic ancient iron weapon.

episodes.name: The Kilij
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must create their signature blade out of a massive ball bearing; a series first; two smiths persevere and return to their home forges, where they must re-create one of the Ottoman Empire's most lethal sabres: the Kilij.

episodes.name: The Sawback Hunting Sword
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are taken out of the forge and transported to the great outdoors, where they struggle to forge a blade in the noonday sun; they must forage for outdoor materials and crank a coal forge, which leaves some scrambling to the end.

episodes.name: The Arming Sword
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must forge not just one, but three knives from railroad spikes in only three hours; the remaining two competitors return home to re-create the iconic Medieval Arming Sword.

episodes.name: The Sengese
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must forge a fully functional serrated knife using steel from hand scissors; the remaining two competitors return to their home forges to create a unique and challenging weapon from history: the Sengese.

episodes.name: The Qinglong Ji
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths take a shot at forging a signature blade from the steel rings of a whiskey barrel; the final two smiths head home to forge an instrument of Chinese warfare: the Qinglong Ji.

episodes.name: Hollywood Edition
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths pay homage to Hollywood; a survival knife; the final two smiths return home to re-create one of the most famous swords in cinematic history: Hattori Hanzo's 1,000-layer katana from Quentin Tarantino's "Kill Bill."

episodes.name: The Steel Crossbow
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths are tasked with creating a signature Damascus blade out of three different steels of different thicknesses; the two final competitors re-create one of the most intricate weapons in show history: the steel crossbow.

episodes.name: The Landsknecht Sword
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must craft a signature blade from a massive piece of elevator cable; the final two competitors return home to re-create a sword wielded by some of history's fiercest soldiers: the Two-Handed Landsknecht Sword.

episodes.name: Tournament: Round 1
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are tasked with creating a san mai blade from horseshoes and hoof rasps; the remaining two bladesmiths return to their home forges to create a famed weapon of the English Civil War: the mortuary sword.

episodes.name: Tournament: Round 2
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must forge a Damascus blade out of something familiar: plate armor; the remaining two bladesmiths head back to their home forges to craft an exotic hybrid of pain and protection: the Hooded Katar.

episodes.name: Tournament: Round 3
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must forge a signature Damascus blade using steel from tools; the smiths that survive two brutal rounds of testing return to their home forges to recreate a multipurpose Medieval weapon of war: the Knightly Poleaxe.

episodes.name: Tournament: Round 4
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must harvest materials from a metal sculpture to forge a needle point Damascus blade; the remaining smiths return to their own home forges to re-create a sword from the elite classes of Renaissance Europe: the Flamberge Rapier.

episodes.name: Tournament Finals
episodes.summary: In the final round of the Invitational Tournament, the winning farrier, armorer, blacksmith and modern metalworker face off to forge a wakizashi; the two finalists must then re-create the nodachi, one of the largest Japanese swords.

episodes.name: The Grim Reaper's Scythe
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must create signature slasher blades, each using a different type of metal; the two finalists return to their home forges to re-create the Grim Reaper's scythe.

episodes.name: The Steel Takedown Bow
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are tasked with forging a Crusader's dagger from a thick rod of W1 steel; the final two smiths must create Robin Hood's steel takedown bow.

episodes.name: The Bardiche
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must build coal forges using materials scavenged from a storage unit and forge signature blades without any power tools; the remaining two smiths return home to recreate a bardiche, a brutal European pole axe.

episodes.name: The Pipe Tomahawks
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are challenged with forging a canister Damascus knife using only steel wool and 1095 powder; the final two head home to re-create an important weapon from North American history - the pipe tomahawk.

episodes.name: Ring Hilted Sword
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must each forge judge Ben Abbott's favorite blade, the Celtic ring knife, using the san mai technique; the final two competitors return to their home forges to re-create Irish ring hilted swords.

episodes.name: Sword of Perseus
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths forge a blade from Greek armor and artifacts using the Go-Mai; the smiths wrestle with steels of varying hardness to try to create a blade that would make the God Hephaestus proud; two smiths re-create the mythical Sword of Perseus.

episodes.name: General Patton's Sabre
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are tasked with forging a parameter specific blade shape in just two hours; two competitors survive the heat and the clock to make it back to their home forges to re-create an American hero's signature sword: Gen. Patton's saber.

episodes.name: The Jian Sword
episodes.summary: Four smiths get thrown into the mix when they must Frankenstein a blade from one knife and combine it with a different weapon's handle; two smiths recreate one of the oldest, deadliest, and elegant blades in history: the Chinese Jian.

episodes.name: The Rock-Throwing Crossbow
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths honor the forge's legendary power hammer Big Blu by ripping it apart and forging competition choppers.

episodes.name: Halloween Edition
episodes.summary: Four smiths shiver to the bone as they salvage steel from the corpses of broken, decaying blades, and turn it into a zombie killer; two brave souls are sent back to re-create a ghoulish weapon from the Middle Ages: the war scythe.

episodes.name: The Boa-Zande Sword
episodes.summary: Four smiths must know the drill when they're tasked with forging a canister Damascus blade using different-sized drill bits.

episodes.name: The Musketeer Rapier
episodes.summary: Four smiths are tasked with transforming bits and pieces of old damascus steel into fossil damascus signature blades; in the final round, two smiths return to their home forges to recreate one of the most elegant and lethal weapons in history.

episodes.name: The Tizona of El Cid
episodes.summary: Four smiths must face the music when they are tasked with creating San-Mai blades from musical instruments.

episodes.name: Military Tribute
episodes.summary: In honor of Veteran's Day, four bladesmiths pay tribute in a special military themed competition, forging their blades from a panzer tank; two smiths have four days to recreate the Scottish Backsword as famously wielded by Captain Mad Jack Churchi.

episodes.name: Revolutionary War Spontoon
episodes.summary: Four smiths spring into action when they are tasked with creating signature blades from different sized springs.

episodes.name: The Barbarian Spatha
episodes.summary: Four smiths must salvage steel from old weapons and combine them using the hada technique to forge a pugio; only two smiths march down the Appian Way to their home forges to re-create one of the most vicious swords in Roman history.

episodes.name: Family Edition
episodes.summary: Two families go head to head in an all-out battle not only against another household, but also each other.

episodes.name: Frankish Throwing Axes
episodes.summary: Four smiths get ready for the ultimate showdown when they are tasked with forging a camp knife out of steel harvested from a barbecue; only two smiths advance to their home forges to recreate a pair of Frankish Throwing axes.

episodes.name: A Very Forged Christmas
episodes.summary: Four merry bladesmiths gather around the fire to spread holiday cheer; using gifts of high carbon steel along with some mild steel, the smiths must use the San Mai technique to forge their way onto the judges' nice list.

episodes.name: The Chinese War Sword
episodes.summary: Four smiths get ready for a cage match after being tasked with freeing their tools from a steel grate and forging a knife from it; the two remaining smiths head home to recreate a Chinese war sword.

episodes.name: The Sword in the Stone
episodes.summary: Four smiths are on a quest to forge signature blades from various Damascus patterns; after a brutal second round, the two final competitors are tasked with recreating their own version of the legendary Sword in the Stone.

episodes.name: Charlemagne's Sword
episodes.summary: Smiths crack open crucibles to reveal surprise metals they'll use to forge blades; one smith is sent packing while the others are tasked with casting bronze guards; the finalists must recreate the legendary sword of King Charlemagne, the Joyeuse.

episodes.name: The Spanish Conquistador Sword
episodes.summary: Four smiths are faced with recreating the WWII Special Forces smatchet knife, a knife famous for its versatility on the battlefield; after two rounds, the two finalists head home to recreate the infamous Spanish Conquistador sword.

episodes.name: The Pira
episodes.summary: Four smiths must navigate stormy seas by making Hada blades from materials salvaged from a ship's wheel; just two smiths sail through testing to make it to the final challenge where they must recreate the symbolic and deadly Filipino sword, the Pira.

episodes.name: French Pioneer Sword
episodes.summary: Four smiths salvage steel from old farm equipment to make classic chef knives; only two smiths slice and dice their way to the final round where they must forge the iconic Rooster Head French Pioneer Sword.

episodes.name: Darb Sri Gun Chai Battle Sword
episodes.summary: In a twist of fate, four smiths must forge a twist and stack Damascus blade; the two finalists must return home and recreate the Darb Sri Gun Chai, an enormous, double-handed Thai battle sword.

episodes.name: Zulu War Axe
episodes.summary: Four smiths are tasked with forging Japanese natas using a traditional technique; the finalists head to their home forges to recreate the prestigious Zulu war axe.

episodes.name: The Chinese Zhanmadao
episodes.summary: Four smiths are tasked with creating signature blades from 1095 steel; ultimately, two smiths make it back to their home forges to recreate the Chinese Zhanmadao.

episodes.name: The German Dussage
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are tasked with making a canister damascus blade from threaded bolts; two smiths return to their home forges to recreate the deadly German Dussage Sword.

episodes.name: First Responders Edition
episodes.summary: Four first responder bladesmiths are tasked with forging tactical knives out of rescue tools; two smiths persevere and return home to recreate one of the most important tools in a firefighter's arsenal: the Halligan Bar.

episodes.name: Game of Forge
episodes.summary: In a throwback to the Iron Age, four smiths must forge daggers relying solely on coal forges and brute force; two competitors return to present day and head back to their home forges to recreate Arya Stark's "Needle" from "Game of Thrones."

episodes.name: The Ikakalaka
episodes.summary: Four smiths determine their fate when they have to select a forging technique ranging from easy to difficult; two smiths must recreate the Ikakalaka African Sword.

episodes.name: Samurai Showdown
episodes.summary: Four smiths must forge a Japanese tanto dagger; summoning their inner warriors, the smiths fight to produce blades that are worthy of the samurai; two competitors return home to reproduce the deadly Sodegarami.

episodes.name: Baby Boomer vs Gen Z
episodes.summary: After several intense rounds, two smiths head back to their home forges to recreate ancient China's Sword of Goujian, one of the most intact artifacts ever uncovered.

episodes.name: The Nimcha
episodes.summary: Four smiths are tasked with forging signature blades from scrap metal shavings; smiths head home to re-create the Nimcha, a sword traditionally made from recycled blades.

episodes.name: Titanium Smackdown
episodes.summary: Four smiths forge handles using titanium; two competitors are able to produce weapons worthy of moving on to their home forges for another complex build: the Horseman's Tabar and Hidden Dagger.

episodes.name: Tomahawk and Bowie
episodes.summary: Four smiths are put to the test when they must forge keys to unlock boxes of steel to make a knife; two competitors are picked to head back to their home forges to re-create the tomahawk and Bowie knife.

episodes.name: Japanese Ono
episodes.summary: Four smiths are tasked with forging a blade that must fit perfectly into a puzzle piece cut out; after two rounds, the final two smiths return home to re-create the ancient samurai pole axe, the Japanese Ono.

episodes.name: Super Champion Edition
episodes.summary: Four former champions return to the forge to compete; after the first round, three move onto a fit-and-finish round; the finalist is tasked with recreating a Cossack Shashka and must defeat one of the judges to be named Super Champion.

episodes.name: The Boateng Saber
episodes.summary: In this first-ever pay-to-play competition, smiths must fork over forge funds to use the necessary tools; after two smiths are left bankrupt, the remaining two return home to re-create the most expensive sword ever sold; the Boateng Saber.

episodes.name: Summer Forging Games
episodes.summary: Four smiths test every aspect of their bladesmithing capabilities.

episodes.name: Summer Forging Games
episodes.summary: In the second half of the Forged in Fire Summer Games, three smiths remain, and they're eager to win the Damascus metal and $15,000.

episodes.name: Veteran's Knife Special
episodes.summary: In a salute to the nation's veterans, four bladesmiths with ties to the military are tasked with re-creating four unique blades co-designed by distinguished vets during a grueling three-hour forging competition.

episodes.name: The Deadly Vajra-Mushti
episodes.summary: Four smiths get rolling when they are tasked with making canister Damascus from tubes; after a couple of intense rounds in the forge, two competitors head back to their home forges to re-create a deadly and unique Indian weapon: the vajra-mushti.

episodes.name: The Ninja's Sword
episodes.summary: In this competition, it's all about Japan's shadow warriors: the ninja; four smiths must forge their own version of a ninja blade, and in a show first, the smith with the lightest blade wins an extra 20 minutes in the second round.

episodes.name: M1905 Springfield Bayonet
episodes.summary: Four smiths must rely on their math skills to determine the amount the steel needed to make their signature blades; after a couple of calculating rounds, two smiths return home to build the intricate M1905 Springfield bayonet.

episodes.name: The Giant Sword of William Wallace
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are faced with a gigantic challenge: scaling down a 9 foot long dagger to exactly a fifth of its size.

episodes.name: Forged in Fire Christmas
episodes.summary: In this Christmas competition, four smiths get on the judges' nice list by forging blades using steel from Santa's sleigh; two smiths return home to re-create the iconic sword carried by George Washington during the American Revolution.

episodes.name: The Massive Maguro Bocho
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths get cooking when they are tasked with forging a cleaver using only the steel from meat hooks. After two rounds of slicing and dicing, two smiths head back to their home forges to create the Maguro Bocho, a massive tuna knife.

episodes.name: Teeth of the Tegha
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are tasked with forging signature blades from a burned car; the smiths race to salvage the best steel to make their blades; two contestants are sent home to re-create the Serrated Tegha Sword.

episodes.name: Headhunter's Revenge
episodes.summary: Four smiths get to choose their forging method and materials, but each technique comes with its own clock for the round; after a round of testing, the two surviving smiths are tasked with creating a headhunter axe in only three days.

episodes.name: Russian Special Forces Spetsnaz
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are tasked with forging pry bar knives; after a grueling round of testing, two smiths return home to forge a pair of Spetsnaz shovels.

episodes.name: Machete of the Amazons
episodes.summary: The judges flip the script, giving the competitors the opportunity to choose their own challenge; the bladesmiths must work together to agree on the parameters before starting the round; two return home to re-create the fearsome Dahomey machete.

episodes.name: San Mai Mystery
episodes.summary: Four smiths are blindsided when they must choose from a selection of mystery steel to create san mai blades, but that isn't the only unknown -- the clock is off, leaving the smiths to rely solely on time calls for guidance.

episodes.name: Second Chance Tournament
episodes.summary: For the first time, eight former competitors head back into the arena for an epic tournament; two smiths who suffered catastrophic failures face off; two smiths who failed to turn in weapons in time get another shot to beat the clock.

episodes.name: Second Chance Tournament
episodes.summary: The Second Chance Tournament continues with two final duels; up first, two runners-up compete to prove they have what it takes to be in the No. 1 spot; then, two smiths whose blades failed to make it to testing go head-to-head.

episodes.name: Second Chance Tournament: Finals
episodes.summary: After winning their duels, the tournament concludes with four remaining smiths in an epic final battle; after a couple of grueling rounds, two survive and head back to their home forges to take on a complex weapon from the "Forged in Fire" vault.

episodes.name: Memory Game
episodes.summary: Four smiths put their memory to the test when they are tasked with re-creating a complicated blade after looking at it for only 20 seconds.

episodes.name: WWE Edition
episodes.summary: Four smiths go head-to-head in the ultimate forging battle; after an all-out smackdown, the two surviving smiths will head back to their home forges to build the gruesome Bastard Sword.

episodes.name: Arctic Forge
episodes.summary: Four smiths must brave the frigid cold in the Arctic Forge as they re-create Inuit and Viking tools from giant blocks of ice for a chance to win $10,000.

episodes.name: Civil War Battle
episodes.summary: In this special Civil War-themed competition, four smiths must turn either a massive cannonball or small grapeshots into the battle-tested Arkansas toothpick knife.

episodes.name: Casino Challenge
episodes.summary: Four smiths leave it all up to chance and allow the Wheel of Forging to determine their challenge; after the smiths press their luck in a brutal round of testing, two smiths risk it all one more time at the wheel to determine their final weapon.

episodes.name: Deadly Duo
episodes.summary: Four smiths make a single blade using the San Mai and layered Damascus techniques; the two smiths left standing re-create the Ginunting swords.

episodes.name: Fire and Water
episodes.summary: "Forged in Fire" pays homage to Korean bladesmithing by challenging four smiths to re-create the Hwando sword and attempt the dreaded water quench; two smiths advance to the final round, where they must re-create the fearsome Korean Woldo.

episodes.name: Sledgehammer Showdown
episodes.summary: It's hammer time in the forge when four smiths have to make knives out of 10 lb sledgehammers; the two surviving smiths return to their home forges to recreate the Polish War Hammer.

episodes.name: Medieval Mystery Sword
episodes.summary: Four smiths don't know what material they're working with until they open up a crate and reveal one of any number of salvaged metals.

episodes.name: Pick Your Poison
episodes.summary: In this competition, four smiths must make a difficult decision at the start that could help them later.

episodes.name: Forge of Fear
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths are challenged to craft murderous knives out of old, rusty torture devices, then fashion handles from vampire stakes.

episodes.name: The Terrifying Tuareg Takoba
episodes.summary: Four smiths turn a pile of rusty old nails into a pristine knife; after their weapons are hammered in testing, the two surviving competitors return home to re-create the terrifying North African Tuareg Takoba.

episodes.name: Barrel Full of Mystery
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths get to pick their mild steel to make a san mai blade, but the easier their choice, the more difficult their high carbon steel will be; the smiths who survive the testing then return home to re-create the Belgian Walloon sword.

episodes.name: Armed Forces Tournament
episodes.summary: Eight armed forces members redeploy to the forge for a three-part tournament where they will go head-to-head against one other smith in an intense five-hour battle.

episodes.name: Armed Forces Tournament
episodes.summary: In the second part of the Armed Forces Tournament, four U.S. service members redeploy to the forge floor to go head to head in one five-hour battle.

episodes.name: Armed Forces Tournament Finale
episodes.summary: On the finale of the Armed Forces Tournament, the four surviving smiths will face off to determine who wins it all.

episodes.name: Judges Takeover: Doug Marcaida
episodes.summary: Four smiths recreate a weapon from the mind of judge Doug Marcaida; the remaining two must recreate the Supersized Kortada.

episodes.name: Young Guns Challenge
episodes.summary: Four of the youngest champions return to turn trampolines and skateboards into knives; the remaining two must recreate the legendary German Longsword.

episodes.name: Judges Takeover: Ben Abbott
episodes.summary: Four smiths must recreate the billhook knife; the remaining two must recreate the Sutton Hoo Sword.

episodes.name: Judges Takeover: J Neilson
episodes.summary: Four smiths must create blades from the mind of J. Neilson; the remaining two must recreate the Maguindanao Kris.

episodes.name: The Dark Side
episodes.summary: Four smiths make a knife out of a guillotine; the remaining two must fashion an Executioner's Sword.

episodes.name: Judges Takover: Dave Baker
episodes.summary: Four smiths must recreate one of Dave's favorite weapons, determining who will come out on top and walk away with $10,000 and the title of Forged in Fire Champion.

episodes.name: Damascus 500
episodes.summary: Four smiths hit the fast track in a race to make a Damascus blade with the highest layer count; the remaining two have to recreate the Mesopotamian Sickle Sword.

episodes.name: The Firangi Sword
episodes.summary: The smiths have five hours to create any blade they want; the winner moves straight to the final challenge.

episodes.name: 200th Episode: Fan's Choice
episodes.summary: "Forged in Fire" marks its 200th competition; celebrating this milestone by turning complete control over to the fans, who vote on all the challenges, weapons and tests.

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: Round One
episodes.summary: Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge; three smiths compete in a single 5-hour round; their blades will be put through an intense round of testing, and only one will earn the opportunity to face off against Ben Abbott.

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: Scrap Steel Challenge
episodes.summary: Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge; three smiths compete in a 5-hour round during which they make blades out of scrap steel; these blades will be tested, with one smith getting the chance to take on Ben.

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: Broken Blade Revenge
episodes.summary: Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge; three smiths who suffered broken blades hope to rewrite history in a 5-hour round; their blades will be tested, and one of them will get the chance to face off against Ben Abbott.

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: Back for Revenge
episodes.summary: Competitor turned Judge Ben Abbott remains undefeated in the forge, but soon that could all change; two of the smiths who faced Ben in his very first competition are back to seek their revenge in a single 5-hour showdown.

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: The Final Showdown
episodes.summary: Competitor-turned-judge Ben Abbott still remains undefeated in the forge with a record of 8-0, but two smiths handpicked by Doug and Dave want to change that; after a tough five-hour forging round, their weapons must survive a round of testing.

episodes.name: Crushed Car Challenge
episodes.summary: In a new twist on the classic car challenge, four smiths have to create a knife from the most mangled mess of a vehicle ever seen on the forge floor.

episodes.name: Blackout; Championship Weapons of China
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths face double the trouble when they are tasked with forging not one, but two canister damascus knives; judge Dave Baker revisits five of the most intense championship rounds featuring the top blades of China to come out of the forge.

episodes.name: The Ninja's Sword; Strongest Championship Weapons
episodes.summary: Four smiths forge their own version of a ninja blade, with the smith with the lightest blade winning an extra 20 minutes in round two; revisiting five intense championship rounds featuring the strongest weapons built and tested in the forge.

episodes.name: Sheet Metal Challenge; Championship Weapons of Africa
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must forge a knife out of thin sheet metal; two smiths move on to re-create a serrated Indian sabre; judge Dave Baker revisits five of the most intense championship rounds featuring the top blades of Africa to come out of the forge.

episodes.name: Blades Gone Wild; Championship Axes
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths must forge a sawback machete out of steel tent stakes; two smiths return to create the Parang Nabur, a deadly Malaysian backcountry tool and weapon; Judge Dave Baker revisits five intense championship rounds featuring the top axes.

episodes.name: Double Trouble Blades; Championship Daggers and Knives
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths face double the trouble when they are tasked with forging not one, but two canister Damascus knives; after a brutal round of testing, only two smiths move forward to build an extremely challenging Cinquedea sword.

episodes.name: The Knife Fight
episodes.summary: The first-ever knife fight; competitors bring their best blade; after two rounds, only one will survive the knife fight and walk away with $10,000.

episodes.name: Championship Supersized Weapons
episodes.summary: "Forged in Fire" Judge Dave Baker revisits five of the most intense championship rounds featuring the top supersized weapons to come out of the forge.

episodes.name: Championship Polearms
episodes.summary: Judge Dave Baker revisits five of the most intense championship rounds featuring the top polearms to come out of the forge.

episodes.name: Out to Sea
episodes.summary: Three bladesmiths head to Mystic Seaport for a nautical-themed competition; after a grueling round of coal forging, two smiths travel back to their home forges to re-create the flensing knife.

episodes.name: Gladiators of the Forge: Let the Battles Begin
episodes.summary: The forge is transformed into a gladiator's arena; in the opening battle, two smiths must forge a fierce Roman era falx; the winning smith takes on a new opponent for the chance to win the most money ever awarded in the forge: $75,000.

episodes.name: Gladiators of the Forge: The Battles Continue
episodes.summary: Back at the "Forged in Fire" gladiator's arena, two more ferocious one-on-one battles rage on; the defending smith seeks to retain his title by building a gladiator favorite: the kopis; the winner advances to another round and a brand new challenger.

episodes.name: Gladiators of the Forge: Vikings vs. Gladiators
episodes.summary: Back at the "Forged in Fire" colosseum, two more intense one-on-one battles rage on; the defending champion has taken down two opponents, including a two-time gladiator of the forge; smiths forge a gladiator favorite: the deadly sica.

episodes.name: Gladiators of the Forge: A Champion's Quest
episodes.summary: Back at the "Forged in Fire" gladiator arena, two more sudden death battles are held; the defending champion has four wins under his belt but faces his toughest challenge yet forging the weapon used to assassinate Julius Caesar: the pugio daggers.

episodes.name: Gladiators of the Forge: The Final Battles
episodes.summary: It's back to the Colosseum for the last two one-on-one battles; the reigning champion has defeated six opponents, but now must face a returning challenger and forge the intricate Acinaces sword.

episodes.name: The Notorious Naga
episodes.summary: Four smiths need to either go mai or go home when they're challenged to make a five-layer knife; after their blades are put through a grueling round of testing, the two remaining smiths return home to re-create the notorious 16th-century Naga sword.

episodes.name: Fastest Blade in the West
episodes.summary: In one of the unique first rounds in Forged in Fire history, four bladesmiths must giddy-up to finish their blade first and become the fastest blade in the West; after a wild round of testing, the two remaining smiths return to their home forges to lasso up an iconic weapon of the American Frontier--the Vaquero Machete; they then must survive one final standoff to win the reward of $10,000 and the title of Forged in Fire Champion.

episodes.name: Best in Damascus
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths put it all on the line when they are challenged with creating their most dazzling Damascus knife; the smith who impresses the judges the most will bypass a brutal round of testing, heading straight to the final round.

episodes.name: Friend or Foe
episodes.summary: Two friends and two brothers enter the forge as teams to compete in an epic showdown; after working as teams to re-create a Scottish Broadsword, members of the victorious team will be divided and forced to face each other.

episodes.name: Supersized Sword
episodes.summary: Four smiths must salvage steel from a massive railroad track to make their signature big blades; two smiths head back to their home forge to build a monstrous seven-foot sword wielded by legendary warrior, Grutte Pier.

episodes.name: Supersized: Elephant Sword
episodes.summary: Four smiths must salvage steel from a couple of 250-pound coil springs to make massive San Mai blades; two smiths head back to their home forges to create a pair of enormous Elephant Swords.

episodes.name: Supersized: 5 Ton Challenge
episodes.summary: Four smiths face an enormous challenge when they must salvage steel from five tons of junk; two smiths head to their home forges to build the longest weapon in the show's history, a 9-foot Friauler Spiess.

episodes.name: Forged in Fire: Marvel's Midnight Suns
episodes.summary: The bladesmiths assemble as Marvel takes over the competition; tasked with forging iconic weapons from Marvel's video game, "Midnight Suns," the smiths must defeat the evil clock to build their blades.

episodes.name: Supersized: Hog Wild
episodes.summary: Four smiths face a colossal challenge when they must forge giant hog splitters from 12 pounds of steel.

episodes.name: On the Road: Texas Showdown
episodes.summary: Heading to Texarkana, Texas, to the Bill Moran School of Bladesmithing, the oldest bladesmithing school in the country, where three of their top smiths will be put through the ultimate test.

episodes.name: On the Road: Montana Face-Off
episodes.summary: Heading to Bigfork, Mont., to the New Agrarian School where three of their top smiths will be tested like never before; after two grueling challenges only one will go on to represent the New Agrarian School in the finals for the ultimate grand prize.

episodes.name: On the Road: Appalachian Showdown
episodes.summary: In the heart of North Carolina's Appalachian Mountains is the world-renowned Clay Spencer Blacksmith shop, where three of the forge's best smiths will be tested.

episodes.name: On the Road: Kalamazoo Combat
episodes.summary: Heading to Kalamazoo, Mich., to Combat Ready Art, where three of their top smiths will be tested like never before; after two brutal challenges, only one will go on to represent Combat Ready Art back at the home forge for the ultimate grand prize.

episodes.name: On the Road: American Champion
episodes.summary: At the home forge, four of the nation's top smiths will go head-to-head in one final battle; after three grueling challenges, only one smith will come out on top, winning $20,000 for themselves and $10,000 in forging equipment for their shop.

episodes.name: The Frankenstein Challenge
episodes.summary: Four smiths must "Frankenstein" together discarded pieces of scrap steel to make their blades; after a horrifying round of testing, the remaining two smiths retreat to their home forges to create the legendary Crusader Bible Falchion.

episodes.name: Chef's Special
episodes.summary: Four smiths get cooking when they are tasked with forging a chef's knife; only two head back to their home forge to build a brutal hog splitter.

episodes.name: Springtime for Napoleon
episodes.summary: Four smiths spring into action when they must forge signature blades from the metal found in various household items; after a couple tough rounds, two smiths head to their home forges to recreate the Napoleon Presentation Saber.

episodes.name: Instruments of Death: Masters of the Siege
episodes.summary: Four teams of expert builders must create siege weapons; from war hammers to battering rams to ballistas, the strongest weapons earn $20,000 and the title of Forged in Fire: Instruments of Death champions.

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: Mastering the Mystery
episodes.summary: Two previous champions go head-to-head in a 5-hour forging round; they make their own signature San Mai blades for the chance to compete against one of the titans of the forge.

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: Conquering the Kachin Dao
episodes.summary: Previous champions battle for the chance to compete against one of the titans of the forge; but first they must face off in a brutal five-hour challenge, where they have to pick a box and build a signature blade using whatever method is inside.

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: A Cutlass Above
episodes.summary: After facing off against a fellow champ, only one smith will remain and be tasked with making an M1917 Naval Cutlass, against either Gladiator of the Forge Jesse Hu, Superchamp Collin Sage, or Undefeated Judge Ben Abbott.

episodes.name: Beat the Unbeaten: Off the Hook
episodes.summary: Two previous champions will face off in a grueling five-hour challenge, making a blade inspired by Hollywood for the chance to duke it out against one of the titans of the forge.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Test of the Best
episodes.summary: The top champions step back into the Forged in Fire arena to face their toughest competition yet: one of the expert judges. Tasked with making the grueling Ginunting sword in just five hours, only one will be left standing to compete.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Machete Master
episodes.summary: Some of our top Forged in Fire champions head back to the forge to face their toughest competition yet: one of the judges, tasked with making an intricate Vaquero Machete, will this former champion have the skills to prove they have what it takes to Beat the Judges?

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Tackling the Tizona
episodes.summary: Two of the "Forged in Fire" champions head back into the arena for a chance at taking on one of the judges, tasked with making the legendary Tizona of El Cid in eight hours.

episodes.name: Beat the Judges: Shamshir Showdown
episodes.summary: Two former "Forged in Fire" champions duel it out in a five-hour round making a pichangatti to earn the right to go head-to-head with one of our formidable judges.

episodes.name: Champion's Cup: Quest for Glory
episodes.summary: Three winning smiths return for a shot at forging their name in Forged in Fire history.

episodes.name: Champion's Cup: Survival of the Fittest
episodes.summary: Three smiths return for a chance at becoming a two-time winner and having their name forged in history.

episodes.name: Doug Marcaida's Secrets of the Forge
episodes.summary: Doug Marcaida, Forged in Fire judge and edged weapons specialist, reveals his secrets of the forge in this special inside look; for the first time, Doug will disclose how the competition's most notorious tests are created.

episodes.name: Champion's Cup: Hunt for Victory
episodes.summary: Three smiths return for a chance to become a two-time winner and have their name forged in history; but to join this elite club, they must overcome one of the most difficult challenges ever.

episodes.name: Ben Abbott's Secrets of the Forge
episodes.summary: Ben Abbott, "Forged in Fire" competitor turned judge, reveals his secrets of the forge in this special inside look; for the first time, Ben will disclose how he's been able to stay undefeated.

episodes.name: Siberian Forge
episodes.summary: Four blade smiths turn snowflake canister Damascus into a deadly Yakut knife in freezing temperatures; after brutal testing, two competitors head home to tackle another Siberian staple.

episodes.name: The Melting Point
episodes.summary: The competition heats up when four competitors must use a metal never before seen in Forged in Fire history: copper; known for its tight forging window, the smiths must pay attention to their heat or risk melting their blades.

episodes.name: Damascus Go Mai Challenge
episodes.summary: Four smiths must combine two of the most difficult techniques in the forge to make a blade: Damascus and Go Mai; then, after an intense round of testing, two competitors head home to build an intricate 16th century side sword.

episodes.name: Pimp My Knife
episodes.summary: Four smiths put their design skills to the test when they are tasked with pimping out a machete; then, the two smiths with the most blinged out blades head back to their home forges to build history's original pimped out weapon.

episodes.name: Junkyard Meltdown
episodes.summary: Four smiths must sift through a pile of junk in order to make a signature damascus blade; after a couple of rounds, two smiths head back to their home forge to recreate a Broadsword featuring a snake-shaped grind.

episodes.name: Forged Flashbacks
episodes.summary: Digging deep inside the vault and revisit some special competitions over the years: from Gladiators and Greeks to Horror and holidays.

episodes.name: Mind Over Metal
episodes.summary: Three smiths hope to cash in when they are given the opportunity to win money after each challenge; after two tough rounds, all three smiths head back to their home forge to recreate the serrated Dussage.

episodes.name: Two-Faced Challenge
episodes.summary: Four bladesmiths must forge a blade with not one, but two Damascus billets. After an intense round, the remaining smiths experience a Forged in Fire first when they are faced with an unexpected twist. Then, two challengers head back to their home forges to recreate a pair of deadly Ginunting swords. Who will be the last smith standing and take home $10,000?

episodes.name: J. Neilson's Secrets of the Forge
episodes.summary: J. Neilson, Forged in Fire judge and notorious breaker of blades, reveals his secrets of the forge in this special inside look. For the first time ever, J. will disclose his most infamous blade breaks and the tricks to becoming a Forged in Fire champion.

episodes.name: Can With a Plan
episodes.summary: Four smiths must devise a plan when they are tasked with using three different steels to forge a canister Damascus blade. After a colossal error sends one home and brutal testing takes down another, the two remaining smiths head to their home forges to build the Italian Condottiere Sword. Who will produce a blade worthy of $10,000 and earn the title of Forged in Fire champion?

episodes.name: When the Earth Burned
episodes.summary: Against all odds, an alpha male gorgonopsid fights to protect his family from predators and the deadly heat that surrounds them at every turn.

episodes.name: When the Climate Broke
episodes.summary: A heartwarming coming-of-age story about a hatchling who grows to be a leader of her herd, helping ensure the survival for future generations.

episodes.name: When the Asteroid Fell
episodes.summary: Following our planet's most infamous mass extinction event, a mated pair of dinosaurs fight to survive an incredible 30-year period of darkness.

episodes.name: When the Seas Died
episodes.summary: The harrowing story of a giant marine reptile who scours the dying seas to find food for her unborn baby before giving birth amidst a super hurricane.

episodes.name: When the Forests Collapsed
episodes.summary: A protective mother amphibian battles to keep her brood of eggs in water while the forest around her dries out and the trees collapse.

episodes.name: When the Oceans Shrank
episodes.summary: An early fish journeys to the ends of the ocean to find a mate before his exotic and colorful reef is destroyed by freezing waters.

episodes.name: When the Continents Collided

episodes.name: When America Flooded
episodes.summary: A giant mother bear struggles to raise her two cubs in the face of a gripping ice age that eventually drives all giant mammals to extinction.
