the_first_48_wrong_place_wrong_time.title: The First 48: Wrong Place, Wrong Time

episodes.name: Game Over; Long Walk Home
episodes.summary: Enhanced with bonus footage: a young man is executed and detectives have nothing to go on, not even the victim's name; a beloved young woman is gunned down in the street, leaving a community devastated and detectives on a mission to find her killers.

episodes.name: Young Guns
episodes.summary: Enhanced episode with bonus footage; when an innocent bystander protecting a young woman is gunned down, Tulsa detectives scramble to learn who fired the fatal shots before anyone else gets hurt.

episodes.name: Stray Shot
episodes.summary: Enhanced with bonus footage; when a stray shot leaves an innocent man dead in his home, Tulsa detectives discover a neighborhood under siege by young terrors; they race to track down the killers before more blood is shed.

episodes.name: Night Out; One Gram
episodes.summary: An innocent bystander is murdered when a brawl at a nightclub turns into a gunfight; a shooting victim's 911 calls may hold the answer to his killer's identity; includes bonus footage.

episodes.name: Deadly Morning
episodes.summary: In Cleveland, a young mother walking alone to work is viciously murdered and dumped in an abandoned house; as the community reels in shock at the horrific crime, detectives make a surprising discovery about the killer; includes bonus footage.

episodes.name: Deadly Ride; Wrong Place, Wrong Time
episodes.summary: Detectives embark on a four-state manhunt to find the killer of a Cleveland driver; Miami police need citizens to loosen their lips and help them solve a murder; includes bonus footage.

episodes.name: Murder on Maiden Lane
episodes.summary: In Atlanta, a young father is gunned down by a brutal robbing crew, and Detective Tracy Lewis discovers that she may be chasing the wrong suspect.

episodes.name: Waterworld
episodes.summary: The Miami homicide team is investigating the murder of a man found naked, tied up, and floating in Biscayne Bay; investigators scour the shoreline in search of clues and follow a lead into the heart of a homeless encampment.

episodes.name: Blood Lust
episodes.summary: Updated; includes bonus footage; the city of Atlanta is gripped with fear as a deadly killer prowls the streets for unsuspecting victims--with a powerful gun; Detective David Quinn must track him down before he strikes again.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Skies
episodes.summary: Uncovering a plane crash in North Carolina that almost triggered nuclear Armageddon; the story of a UFO attack on a U.S. missile base that was suppressed for decades; a daring Israeli heist to steal a cutting-edge fighter jet.

episodes.name: Black Sites
episodes.summary: Discovering a deadly poison lab operated by the Soviet Union's infamous "Doctor Death," a vast nuclear missile site buried beneath the Greenland ice sheet, and the U.S. government's doomsday bunker concealed inside a hollowed-out mountain.

episodes.name: Extreme Missions
episodes.summary: From the depths submarine divers have plunged to tap a secret Soviet communication line to the Special Ops team of suicidal soldiers sent to hand-deploy A-bombs in enemy territory, when is "Mission: Impossible" more than just a movie?

episodes.name: Strange Weapons
episodes.summary: Teetering between the apocalyptic and absurd, declassified records will unveil the top secret weapons programs that attempted to bring down the world, uncovering the Soviet atomic test that shook the Earth with a force 1,500 times more powerful than the Hiroshima bomb, the CIA's creation of a gun that fired a shellfish-harvested toxin, and the Allies' bizarre secret plan to end World War II by feminizing Hitler.

episodes.name: Mind Games
episodes.summary: From the CIA's decades-long pursuit of the perfect truth serum to the U.S. Army's secret PsyOps in Vietnam, mind games have long been at play among countries, its enemies and even its own citizens; every one a more alarming deception than the next.

episodes.name: Deep Cover
episodes.summary: Undercover smokescreens driven by daring agents in service of executing a greater purpose.

episodes.name: Dark Science
episodes.summary: Stalin's gruesome trials to create a hybrid human-ape super army; the eerie reason East Germany's Stasi collected the scents of dissidents in airtight jars; how the CIA uncovered a secret Soviet island devoted to developing deadly bioweapons.

episodes.name: Deep Space
episodes.summary: Glimpses into NASA's covert plan to blow up the moon with a nuclear warhead, the Soviet Union's cover-up of history's deadliest space disaster, and how U.S. attempts to put spies in orbit paved the way for the first space station.

episodes.name: Spy Tech
episodes.summary: From the seemingly innocuous children's toy engineered to save an informant, to hirsute-inspired movie disguises, the government's most clandestine inventions are never what one would suspect, and that's exactly why no one never saw them coming.

episodes.name: Unholy Alliances
episodes.summary: When governments strike dark deals with cults, mobs and even sworn enemies, frosty relationships and mounting tensions are tested head on.

episodes.name: Escaping Armageddon
episodes.summary: In the razor's-edge theater of global brinkmanship, the world has come closer to annihilation than most ever knew. A NATO war game once spooked the Soviets toward a potential nuclear strike, while a daring Cold War project produced a drone-bomber hybrid capable of carrying 16 nuclear weapons. From experimental war machines to the Presidential "Doomsday Plane" built to command America through apocalypse, these are the plans that reveal how near we've stood to the unthinkable.

episodes.name: Top Secret Sites
episodes.summary: Step inside hidden areas where history was steered in secret, from Churchill's wartime bunker, complete with a direct line to FDR concealed inside his private bathroom, to a Soviet weapons base in the desert exposed only by a daring U-2 spy mission.

episodes.name: Buried Secrets
episodes.summary: David Duchovny exposes a clandestine nuclear blast set off deep below Mississippi soil, secret experiments conducted on citizens in the New York subway system, and a wartime bunker built to trap British spies underground during a Nazi invasion.

episodes.name: Black Ops
episodes.summary: A French Resistance operative hides explosives in baguettes to cripple a Nazi factory, an American soldier parachutes behind enemy lines to destroy critical supply routes, and Ukrainian forces deploy AI-guided drones to strike a Russian bomber fleet; across generations, David Duchovny takes people behind these covert operations propelled by the courage and calculation meant to alter the course of history.

episodes.name: Bizarre Weapons
episodes.summary: Desperation breeds invention, and not all of it conventional; from a British scheme to launch airborne balloons against Nazi Germany, to American bats fitted with incendiary devices, to a covert effort to manipulate monsoon rains in Vietnam, newly unearthed documents reveal how far nations were willing to bend reality to their will; in the risky calculus of war, nothing is too strange to try.

episodes.name: Cracking the Code
episodes.summary: When secrecy can be the key to survival, codebreaking becomes a battlefield of its own; a stranded American pilot in Vietnam is rescued through a code built around familiar golf courses, while Navajo Code Talkers transmit messages that help turn the tide in the Pacific during World War II; David Duchovny breaks down every breakthrough where a strategist turned language into leverage.

episodes.name: Secret Units
episodes.summary: Behind official policy often stand unofficial actors; discover the operations of Red Cell, the covert Navy SEAL team that staged attacks on U.S. bases to expose deadly weaknesses; "The Shop", the CIA's clandestine cadre of expert thieves and lock pickers who stole secrets worldwide; and the Alamo Scouts, the elite World War II special forces whose exploits remained a hidden chapter of history for decades; these units thrived where denial was policy, kept in the dark.

episodes.name: Extraordinary Experiments
episodes.summary: When science meets national security, the results can be staggering: the secretive flights of Project Argus sent nuclear warheads into space to test whether radiation could cripple Soviet weapons, while Operation LAC covertly released chemical agents over American communities to simulate biological warfare; inside Stalin's secretive laboratory, even human waste became intelligence, analyzed to decipher the minds of adversaries, proof that no angle was too extraordinary to explore.

episodes.name: Smoke and Mirrors
episodes.summary: Some of history's boldest missions succeeded because the world was looking the wrong way; the CIA concealed covert missions behind Air America's civilian façade, British intelligence planted a falsified invasion plan on a corpse to mislead Hitler, and "Agent Sonya" blended into English suburbia while funneling atomic secrets to Moscow; David Duchovny takes us into the long-spun elaborate tales governments have employed to blanket their boldest missions, showing us how the illusion works.

episodes.name: Extreme Extractions
episodes.summary: In Operation Halyard, villagers and resistance fighters built an airstrip by hand to spirit stranded airmen out of Nazi territory, while Operation Mount Hope saw American forces steal a Soviet helicopter from the African desert under cover of darkness.

episodes.name: Masters of Deception
episodes.summary: To outmaneuver the enemy, you have to sell the illusion; an FBI agent goes so deep undercover he's the best man at a Mafia wedding, while the Stasi deploys a covert network of charmers across borders to win trust and steal secrets; in Egypt, a German-born Jewish spy poses as a high-flying, champagne-soaked ex-Nazi to infiltrate its missile program for Israel.

episodes.name: Rogue Missions
episodes.summary: Some missions are so risky, they're denied before they even begin. From a covert Mossad operation to abduct a Nazi war criminal in Argentina-identified through the smallest detail, the shape of his ears-to a chilling CIA plot that used a jazz tour as cover for an assassination attempt in the Congo; to one resistance fighter volunteering to be captured and sent to Auschwitz to reveal the horrors within-these operations are proof that the most dangerous missions are often the most unthinkable.

episodes.name: Covert Heists
episodes.summary: Sometimes when governments can't negotiate their way to victory, they steal it; when the KGB sets its sights on a NATO missile, they enlist a smooth-talking German playboy armed with only a wheelbarrow, a carpet and a postage stamp; an Israeli covert operation hijacks 200 tons of uranium on the high seas to fuel a secret nuclear arsenal, while during WWII, the Allies deploy a female agent to steal top-secret naval codes, solely with seductive charm.

episodes.name: High Strangeness
episodes.summary: When conventional tactics fail, governments have been known to test the boundaries of reality; in the darkest days of World War II, Britain turns to an astrologer who claims he can alter the course of war using the power of the stars; in the jungles of Vietnam, U.S. forces turn to dowsing rods and ancient mystical practices to locate enemies hidden underground.

episodes.name: Dark Deals
episodes.summary: Some deals are made to announce headlines, while others are steered in the shadows; when the CIA wants to take out the Iraqi Prime Minister, they turn to a 20-year-old law student named Saddam Hussein, while in Guatemala, a banana company colludes with the CIA to topple the country's leader to protect its profits; decades later in Ukraine, a top-secret unit of CIA operatives thwarts Russia's invasion plans, before the world even knows the battle has begun.

episodes.name: Hidden Bases
episodes.summary: A broadcast details secret military architecture and defense installations; the account examines a 112,000-square-foot government bunker built beneath a five-star hotel, a fake wartime town constructed to conceal a factory and a secluded CIA training facility in West Virginia; the documentation highlights the historical methods utilized by intelligence and defense agencies to ensure government continuity and operational security.

episodes.name: Spy Gadgets
episodes.summary: A broadcast details historical espionage technology and covert surveillance operations; the account examines military tracking sensors used in Vietnam, a nuclear-powered surveillance device placed in the Himalayas and a Soviet listening device concealed within a gift presented to a U.S. ambassador; the documentation highlights how intelligence agencies use disguised tools to gather information during international conflicts.

episodes.name: Top Secret Tech
episodes.summary: Before they become instruments of war, they sound like impossible ideas; an American medical student develops a closed-circuit rebreather that allows Allied frogmen to slip beneath enemy harbors without a single bubble, while U.S. Army engineers create a jeep-mounted nuclear launcher known as the "atomic watermelon"; across the Atlantic, an inventor pitches an aircraft carrier to hunt U-boats, carved from wood pulp and ice; because in war, today's absurdity can become tomorrow's secret weapon.

episodes.name: Cat & Mouse
episodes.summary: Some targets are taken by force, others require a game of cat and mouse played out across continents and years of relentless chase; when the DEA fails to corner an international arms dealer, they turn not to a spy, but to a retired bush pilot to lure him out; the CIA hunts an insider from within its own headquarters, and across Europe, the world's most wanted warlord hides in plain sight as a reinvented mystic healer; while the prey changes, the pursuit never does.

episodes.name: Ingenious Disguises
episodes.summary: Some disguises hide an individual, others conceal an entire operation; a CIA vaccination campaign masks a global manhunt for the world's most wanted terrorist, while a luxury Red Sea resort operated by Mossad becomes the unlikely front for a mission to smuggle thousands of Sudanese Jews to safety; in wartime Philippines, an American singer uses charm, talent, and deception to outwit occupying forces and help rescue hundreds of POWs.

episodes.name: Hidden Bases
episodes.summary: Some strongholds are built to defend a nation, others to survive its darkest hour; beneath a five-star luxury hotel lies a 112,000-square-foot bunker built to shelter the American government through nuclear Armageddon, while a remarkable wartime deception saw the U.S. military team up with Hollywood to construct an entire fake town to conceal a vital factory from enemy eyes; a secret CIA training ground prepares the next generation of spies inside a camp.

episodes.name: The Great Unknown
episodes.summary: Burning Man grows from an anti-establishment group in San Francisco, founded by Larry Harvey in the 1980s, to a multi-million-dollar event with thousands of attendees and the backing of billionaire tech donors; first-time Burners look forward to the experience, while repeat attendees and organizers prep for the unpredictable as COVID-19 threatens the event.

episodes.summary: Inside two of America's most pressurized jails, the cameras are always rolling; in Clayton County, Georgia, crumbling infrastructure, limited shower access, and shrinking free time have pushed inmates to a breaking point; tensions boil over into confrontations; officers are attacked. Inmates fashion weapons; what begins as frustration over living conditions escalates into every jail administrator's worst nightmare: an inmate uprising.

episodes.name: Shank Search

Elsewhere, what looks like a fight reveals a far more complicated story once investigators piece together the full picture. And with contraband still flowing, Chief Green leads a sweeping shakedown that uncovers exactly how much is hiding in plain sight. Amid the chaos, officers defuse a tricky situation.

episodes.name: Rumble on the Runway

episodes.name: Lights, Camera, Sew!

episodes.name: The Sky Is the Limit
episodes.summary: The feisty fashionistas are split into pairs and told to create two looks from a block color, blue; when egos inevitably collide, see who wows with a grandstanding garment.

episodes.name: Sequins, Feathers and Fur, Oh My!
episodes.summary: Subtlety won't be tolerated in a challenge that demands opulence; the class of 2009 must design for a celebrity client: Christina Aguilera; find out which contestants have sewn their last stitch.

episodes.name: Around the World in Two Days
episodes.summary: Geography seems to be the muse for the class of 2009; find out which of the contestants create the fashion equivalents of first-class travel and who fails to take flight.

episodes.name: The Best of the Best
episodes.summary: The designers are tasked with bettering their best work in an episode containing more bitching than stitching; find out who will be cut from the increasingly catty contest.

episodes.name: The Art of Fashion
episodes.summary: The five remaining designers use art and architecture for inspiration.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: Althea, Carol Hannah, and Irina go head-to-head for the finale; Heidi Klum sends the fashionistas away to work on their collections.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The catty contest sharpens its claws for the last time; the talented trio pull out all the stops to have their fashion dreams realized.

episodes.name: Back to New York
episodes.summary: The designers meet for a toast with Heidi and Tim in New York; Tim presents the challenge during a field trip to Central Park.

episodes.name: The Fashion Farm
episodes.summary: The designers are presented with an unusual fabric choice during a challenge on a farm.

episodes.name: The Hi's and Low's of Fashion
episodes.summary: The designers bicker while working in teams of two; tensions come to a head on the runway.

episodes.name: Design Your Heart Out
episodes.summary: The designers must create looks for a gala that include the color red and will be modeled by women impacted by heart disease.

episodes.name: Run for Cover
episodes.summary: The designers get an opportunity to win an unprecedented prize; personalities clash in the workroom.

episodes.name: A Little Bit of Fashion
episodes.summary: The designers must get creative for their mini challenge.

episodes.name: Hard Wear
episodes.summary: The designers must show their construction skills.

episodes.name: The Elements of Fashion
episodes.summary: The designers must use one of the four elements as their inspiration.

episodes.name: Takin' It to the Street
episodes.summary: A team challenge leads the designers to four New York neighborhoods; one designer's partner choice leads to a contentious team pairing.

episodes.name: Hey, That's My Fabric
episodes.summary: The designers are tasked with creating their own fabric to use as a basis for their looks.

episodes.name: Sew Much Pressure
episodes.summary: A designer makes a surprise announcement; the designers must create a red carpet garment for an opinionated celebrity.

episodes.name: The Big, Top Designers
episodes.summary: The designers visit the circus for their latest inspiration, but whose garments will look clownish?

episodes.name: Finale: Part One
episodes.summary: Tim visits the hometowns of the four finalists; Mila and Jay compete to determine who will show at fashion week.

episodes.name: Finale: Part Two
episodes.summary: The final three designers show their hard work on the runway; missing models and last minute fittings cause chaos backstage.

episodes.name: And Sew It Begins
episodes.summary: The new designers are asked to create a garment from another designer's luggage in only five hours.

episodes.name: Larger Than Life
episodes.summary: The designers must create a look that will be displayed on a billboard in New York.

episodes.name: It's a Party
episodes.summary: Designers get their Unconventional Materials Challenge: to make chic looks out of party supplies.

episodes.name: Hats Off to You
episodes.summary: The designers must make garments that are influenced by hats created by British milliner Philip Treacy.

episodes.name: There IS an "I" in Team
episodes.summary: The designers are split into two teams and tasked with creating a cohesive line to match hair trends for 2010.

episodes.name: You Can Totally Wear That Again
episodes.summary: Designers must select former bridesmaid dresses and redesign them into looks that can be worn again.

episodes.name: What's Mine Is Yours
episodes.summary: The designers receive a resort-wear challenge from Michael Kors.

episodes.name: A Rough Day on the Runway
episodes.summary: The designers learn about the creation and longevity of American sportswear.

episodes.name: Race to the Finish
episodes.summary: A big reward is offered when the designers are challenged to create a high fashion look.

episodes.name: There's a Pattern Here
episodes.summary: The designers take a trip down memory lane when they are asked to create their own fabric and a garment to correspond to a memorable time in their lives.

episodes.name: A Look in the Line
episodes.summary: The designers get an opportunity to create a look for Heidi Klum's ready-to-wear line.

episodes.name: We're in a New York State of Mind
episodes.summary: The final five designers are treated to a night of luxury in a penthouse suite; a prominent New York figure gives the designers the final challenge to determine who moves on to fashion week.

episodes.name: Finale, Part 1
episodes.summary: Tim Gunn visits the hometowns of the four remaining designers.

episodes.name: Finale, Part 2
episodes.summary: The conclusion of the finale reveals the season's winning clothier.

episodes.name: Come as You Are
episodes.summary: 20 designers compete to be one of the 16 that will be chosen for the season; Tim wakes the designers for their first challenge.

episodes.name: My Pet Project
episodes.summary: The designers must choose their materials from a pet store.

episodes.name: Go Big or Go Home
episodes.summary: The designers are broken into teams of two and tasked with designing looks for stilt walkers in an outdoor challenge.

episodes.name: All About Nina
episodes.summary: The designers must create a look for Nina Garcia to wear at an important industry event.

episodes.name: Off the Track
episodes.summary: The designers learn that they must work in teams to design a piece inspired by Heidi Klum; the winners of a foot race become team captains in the challenge.

episodes.name: The Art of the Matter
episodes.summary: The designers must work with art students to create a piece of art that will serve as the inspiration for their next garment.

episodes.name: Can't We Just All Get Along?
episodes.summary: The designers work in teams of five to create their own fabric and a cohesive collection.

episodes.name: What Women Want
episodes.summary: Tim reveals that the designers will be creating looks for a group of men's significant others.

episodes.name: Image Is Everything
episodes.summary: The designers must work in teams of four to create a look for a band that will establish the band as image-makers.

episodes.name: Sew 70's
episodes.summary: The designers are challenged to be inspired by the 1970s.

episodes.name: This Is for the Birds
episodes.summary: The designers are judged in a head-to-head competition where exotic birds serve as their inspiration.

episodes.name: The Finale Challenge
episodes.summary: The judges challenge each of the designers to create a mini-collection.

episodes.name: Finale Part One
episodes.summary: Tim Gunn travels to the homes of the finalists to check on their progress.

episodes.name: Finale Part Two
episodes.summary: The designers prepare to show at fashion week; an intense debate arises at the final judging.

episodes.name: Tim Gunn: Behind the Seams of Season 9
episodes.summary: Tim reveals secrets from the show and his unedited thoughts.

episodes.name: Road to the Runway Season 10
episodes.summary: The latest crop of competing designers; appearances include Nick Verreos, Mondo Guerra and Anya Ayoung-Chee.

episodes.name: Candy Couture
episodes.summary: Designers compete in the unconventional challenge.

episodes.name: Welcome Back (or not) to the Runway
episodes.summary: Designers must work in teams of two to create gowns that will be worn to the "64th Primetime Emmy Awards."

episodes.name: Women on the Go
episodes.summary: Tensions run high while the designers are under pressure; the designers must create an outfit that transitions from day to night.

episodes.name: It's My Way on the Runway
episodes.summary: The designers must get along long enough to create cohesive looks in a team challenge.

episodes.name: Fix My Friend
episodes.summary: The designers must create new looks for women who have just gotten new hairstyles.

episodes.name: Oh My Lord and Taylor
episodes.summary: The designers get a chance to have their clothes featured in a special collection at Lord & Taylor stores.

episodes.name: Starving Artist
episodes.summary: The designers must sell goods on the street in order to earn money to buy fabric for the challenge.

episodes.name: It's All About Me
episodes.summary: In the HP Challenge designers must create their own textile & a look that represents their heritage.

episodes.name: I Get a Kick Out of Fashion
episodes.summary: The designers must create a costume for the Rockettes to wear in an upcoming show.

episodes.name: It's Fashion Baby
episodes.summary: The designers must babysit while creating looks for Heidi's "Babies R Us" collection.

episodes.name: In a Place Far, Far Away
episodes.summary: The designers are taken to a magnificent location to inspire their creation of avant-garde looks.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: Tim visits the designers' hometowns; the final four designers must present their looks to the judges to earn one of three spots in the fashion week show.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The designers present their collections at the finale fashion show; the winner is chosen.

episodes.name: There Is No I in Team
episodes.summary: Sixteen designers are surprised to discover that they will be participating in the series' first teams edition; the designers must use New York as the inspiration for their garments.

episodes.name: Spin Out
episodes.summary: The designers are tasked with creating server uniforms and ball-boy outfits for SPiN Ping Pong Social Clubs around the country.

episodes.name: Surprise Me
episodes.summary: The designers must create garments for Heidi Klum to wear for the launch of her new fragrance.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Hard and Soft
episodes.summary: Aspiring fashion designers compete for a chance to break into the industry in this reality competition. Each week, a designer is eliminated from the competition after exhibiting their work in front of a judges' panel.

episodes.name: A Little Bit Country, a Little Bit Rock N Roll
episodes.summary: The teams are challenged to design a performance look and a red carpet look for country singer Miranda Lambert.

episodes.name: Senior Fling
episodes.summary: The designers must create fashionable, age-appropriate looks for senior citizens.

episodes.name: A Sticky Situation
episodes.summary: The designers must create fashion-forward prom wear out of duct tape.

episodes.name: Take It All Off!
episodes.summary: Regrouping once again, the judges decide which designers they would like to see work together.

episodes.name: He Said, She Said
episodes.summary: The designers must create spring looks worthy of appearing in the windows of Lord & Taylor; tension rises amongst some of the design teams.

episodes.name: The Art of Fashion
episodes.summary: The designers visit the Guggenheim to get inspiration for the creation of their own print textiles to be used in their garments; a designer is driven to tears.

episodes.name: Finally on My Own
episodes.summary: The designers get the chance to show off their own aesthetic when they create editorial-worthy looks to be worn by actress Jordana Brewster in "Marie Claire."

episodes.name: Europe, Here We Come
episodes.summary: The designers travel to Berlin, Barcelona, London and Paris to get inspiration for the final challenge before the finale.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The finalists work on their collections; Tim Gunn visits each of the finalists in their hometown.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The designers show their collections in the final runway show at Lincoln Center; Michael Kors returns as a guest judge to help choose the winner.

episodes.name: Season 11 Reunion Special
episodes.summary: 16 designers reminisce about their experiences on the show; fashion editor Zanna Roberts Rassi hosts.

episodes.name: Road to the Runway Season 12
episodes.summary: Tim Gunn introduces 15 new designers who will be competing on "Project Runway" season 12.

episodes.name: Million Dollar Runway
episodes.summary: The designers are surprised to see their models wearing millions of dollars of exquisite jewels.

episodes.name: An Unconventional Coney Island
episodes.summary: The designers must win their unconventional materials by playing carnival games at Coney Island.

episodes.name: Tie the Knot
episodes.summary: Jesse Tyler Ferguson challenges the designers to create a garment that incorporates bowties.

episodes.name: YOU Choose Your Materials!
episodes.summary: The designers split into small teams so they can create minicollections inspired by items from four varied retailers.

episodes.name: Let's Go Glamping!
episodes.summary: The designers go on an overnight camping trip; the designers must use the surroundings of their campsite as inspiration for the challenge.

episodes.name: Shoes First!
episodes.summary: The designers realize that they must impress the judges; the designers must choose a shoe and then create a look based on that shoe.

episodes.name: Having a Field Day
episodes.summary: The designers compete in field day events for extra work time; the designers must create high-end performance wear for Heidi Klum's New Balance line.

episodes.summary: At brunch, Tim explains that their challenge is to design a look for the Modern Southern woman.

episodes.name: Project Runway SuperFan!
episodes.summary: The designers are paired with fans of "Project Runway," and must create looks specifically for them.

episodes.name: Next Generation...
episodes.summary: For the HP Challenge, the designers use inspirations they receive from Next Generation Innovators.

episodes.name: Butterfly Effect
episodes.summary: The designers begin to realize that they can not play it safe; the designers must create an avant-garde look for the challenge.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The finalists head home to work on their collections for New York Fashion Week; Tim Gunn visits the designers.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The finalists show their collections; the winner is chosen.

episodes.name: Season 12 Reunion Special
episodes.summary: The designers return to reminisce about their experiences on the show.

episodes.summary: Aspiring fashion designers compete for a chance to break into the industry in this reality competition. Each week, a designer is eliminated from the competition after exhibiting their work in front of a judges' panel.

episodes.name: Project Runway 13: Road to the Runway
episodes.summary: Nineteen designers are chosen to participate in the 13th season of "Project Runway."

episodes.summary: An afternoon at the movie theater becomes a challenge where the designers must create fashionable looks out of items found in a theater or film set.

episodes.summary: Heidi asks the designers to create a red carpet look that she could wear to the Creative Arts Emmys.

episodes.summary: The designers must impress the judges by creating unconventional wedding dresses.

episodes.summary: The designers must use a piece of Chopard jewelry as their inspiration; Tim surprises contestants with a trip to the Met.

episodes.name: The Rainway
episodes.summary: The designers are challenged to create avant-garde looks that must be able to withstand the elements.

episodes.summary: The designers are tasked with creating age-appropriate looks for their young models based on the American Girl Historical Character line.

episodes.summary: Each of the designers must find their muse on the streets of New York and convince a stranger to undergo a complete makeover.

episodes.name: The Highest Bidder
episodes.summary: The designers must work in pairs and bid on storage units to gather materials for their challenge; the judges throw in a twist.

episodes.name: Fashion Week: Who's In & Who's Out
episodes.summary: The final challenge decides who will go to fashion week; eliminated designers return to the workroom.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: Tim Gunn and the designers travel to Rome for inspiration and fabric shopping before heading home to work on their collections.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The finalists prepare to present their collections at New York Fashion Week; the winner is chosen.

episodes.name: Season 13 Reunion Special
episodes.summary: The season's designers take care of unfinished business and reflect on the harsh things they said about each other.

episodes.name: Road to the Runway Season 14

episodes.summary: In the season's first unconventional challenge, the designers must incorporate greeting cards into their designs.

episodes.name: Shut Up and Sew
episodes.summary: The designers are paired up and treated to a day on a cruise ship; some of the duos hit rocky water in the workroom.

episodes.name: Fashion Flip
episodes.summary: The designers are thrilled when they finally get to go to Mood; the designers must put a modern and unique twist on a classic design.

episodes.name: Gunn and Heid
episodes.summary: Tensions arise when the designers are split into two teams to battle for their fabrics in a paintball competition; the teams receive a surprise.

episodes.name: Lace to the Finish
episodes.summary: Heidi challenges the designers to create lingerie for her line; the designers get a rude awakening on the runway.

episodes.summary: The designers must go dumpster diving for recycled materials in their second unconventional materials challenge; the designers must attempt to merge the worlds of fashion and technology.

episodes.name: Broadway or Bust
episodes.summary: The designers must create fashionable looks based on the musical, "Finding Neverland"; one designer upstages the entire competition.

episodes.name: Make It Sell
episodes.summary: The designers must create ready-to-wear looks to be reproduced and sold online; a disagreement between the judges leads to the most contentious runway yet.

episodes.summary: The designers must make over real women from the "Project Runway" crew; Tim reaches his breaking point with one designer.

episodes.summary: The designers use 3-D printing technology to create avant-garde looks in a fashion forward challenge.

episodes.summary: In their final challenge before Fashion Week, the designers travel to Los Angeles to create red carpet looks; one designer takes a huge risk.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The designers head home to work on their collections and await a visit from Tim; another twist is revealed when the designers return to New York.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: After a brutal critique with the judges, the finalists rush to retool their collections for New York Fashion Week; the winner is chosen.

episodes.name: Season 14 Reunion
episodes.summary: This season's designers reunite to discuss the memorable moments from their time on the show.

episodes.name: An Unconventional Launch Party
episodes.summary: Sixteen new designers head to New York to compete; the designers must use party decorations to create their looks in the first unconventional materials challenge.

episodes.name: Just Fabulous!
episodes.summary: The task of creating an outfit that is flattering to all body types poses a greater challenge to some contestants than to others.

episodes.name: Blacklight or Daylight?
episodes.summary: The designers are tasked with creating a look that sparkles both in daylight and under black lights; unusual materials cause several designers to have anxiety.

episodes.name: Sink or Swim
episodes.summary: The designers must create their own fabric to use in a stylish swimsuit; the contestants' lack of swimsuit experience makes the challenge difficult.

episodes.name: There's No "I" in "Team"
episodes.summary: Actress and singer Sabrina Carpenter joins the judge's panel; the designers must pitch their collection ideas to raise money from a group of mystery investors; the stakes rise as the winning team members will each receive $5,000.

episodes.name: There IS Crying in Fashion
episodes.summary: The designers excitedly attend a press event, but their festive mood sours when the party turns out to be a challenge; many designers have to start over after receiving criticism from Tim Gunn.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Urban Jungle
episodes.summary: The designers recharge at Universal Studios Orlando, and must take in inspiration to design a look for Urban Jungle.

episodes.name: Project Pop Up
episodes.summary: The second Team Challenge of the season leads to tensions and tantrums as the designers are forced to work together to create three-piece collections for a SoHo pop-up shop; Kelly Osbourne returns as a guest judge.

episodes.name: Life Is Full of Surprises
episodes.summary: Each of the remaining designers is visited by a special guest from home; the designers learn that their newly arrived loved ones will be their clients for the next challenge.

episodes.name: A Power Trip
episodes.summary: The designers go on a helicopter ride above New York; the designers must create an editorial, high fashion look for "Marie Claire" magazine.

episodes.name: Bold Innovation
episodes.summary: The designers create innovative avant-garde looks, crafted from conventional fabric and unconventional metal-themed materials, in the first ever hybrid challenge.

episodes.name: An Unconventional Trip
episodes.summary: The designers learn they have yet another trip, with twists and turns that will decide which designers compete at New York Fashion Week.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: Visiting the designers at home, Tim Gunn is not impressed with everything they've created so far; the designers return to New York and present three pieces from their collections; Michael Kors returns as a guest judge.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The designers rush to put the final touches on their collections; four designers show their work at New York Fashion Week, but only one can be crowned as the winner; guest judge Zendaya joins the panel.

episodes.name: Season 15 Reunion
episodes.summary: The designers reconvene to reflect on the highs, lows and memories from the season.

episodes.name: One Size Does Not Fit All
episodes.summary: The designers must create a red-carpet look that demonstrates their fashion point of view; the designers learn they will be working with models of all sizes.

episodes.name: An Unconventional Recycling
episodes.summary: The designers struggle to make their voices heard during their first team challenge; the designers must create a fashionable look out of recyclable materials.

episodes.name: A Leap of Innovation!
episodes.summary: The designers get treated to a private screening of the film "Leap!" and a performance by Hiplet; the designers must draw inspiration for an innovative and edgy design to survive another week.

episodes.name: We're Sleeping Wear?
episodes.summary: The designers compete in the Heidi Klum Sleepwear challenge; the contestants have a slumber party on the roof of the Empire State Building.

episodes.name: Descending Into Good and Evil
episodes.summary: Drawing inspiration from "Descendants 2," the designers visit Lyndhurst Castle and are tasked with creating a look that represents good or evil.

episodes.name: Models Off Duty
episodes.summary: The models serve as inspiration for the designers to create a street-style look that will be featured in a photo shoot.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Faceoff
episodes.summary: The designers must use men's fabrics and designs to create a fashion forward look for their female models, and they must work in teams to do it.

episodes.name: Client on the Go
episodes.summary: The designers must create an on-the-go look for friends and family of the show's crew, but accusations of cheating cloud the results of a contentious runway.

episodes.name: A Little Avant Garde
episodes.summary: The fallout from the cheating scandal rocks the designers and leaves everyone wondering how they will move forward in the competition; the designers must create an avant-garde look inspired by Shopkin's characters.

episodes.name: Driving Miss Unconventional
episodes.summary: The designers must use safety materials to create a look that wows the judges in an unconventional challenge.

episodes.name: Warrior Fashion
episodes.summary: In an emotional runway, the designers create looks inspired by women who battled breast cancer, known as "Warrior Women."

episodes.name: There's Snow Business Like Sew Business
episodes.summary: The designers must create a winter-themed look that will decide who goes to New York Fashion Week and who gets left out in the cold.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: After heading home to work on their collections, the five finalists are visited by Tim who is not impressed with everything they have created; the designers return to New York and present the judges with two pieces from their collection.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The designers rush to put the final touches on their collections; four designers will have their dream of showing at New York Fashion Week, but only one designer will be chosen as the winner.

episodes.name: Season 16 Reunion Special
episodes.summary: The designers reunite with Tim Gunn to discuss their experiences, reminisce, share emotions and get to the bottom of the cheating scandal that rocked the season.

episodes.name: First Impressions
episodes.summary: Sixteen designers arrive in New York; the designers showcase their best looks and meet their mentor, Christian Siriano; the designers must create a look inspired by some of the biggest names in fashion, but with a twist.

episodes.name: The Future Is Here
episodes.summary: The designers are challenged to create a mini-collection showcasing the future of fashion; the designers find out their models will be completely transformed with special effects body modifications, inspired by Simon Huck's A. Human' exhibit.

episodes.name: All the Rage
episodes.summary: The designers are tasked with creating bold head-to-toe looks using a single print; celebrity stylist Marni Senofonte surprises the designers by lending her expertise in this go-big or go-home challenge.

episodes.name: Survive in Style
episodes.summary: The designers are whisked away for a camping trip and challenged to create survival chic looks; the workroom, accessories wall and runway are moved to the woods where the designers must battle the elements in order to stay in the competition.

episodes.name: High Fashion to High Street
episodes.summary: The designers visit the studio of trailblazer Dapper Dan, who introduced high fashion to the hip-hop world by creating luxury street wear; the designers are asked to create their own take on the future of street wear.

episodes.name: Power Play
episodes.summary: The designers each create their own female video game protagonists with a functional and stylish look fabulous enough to earn them an extra life in the competition.

episodes.name: Elegance Is the New Black
episodes.summary: The designers are surprised with an invitation to a Brandon Maxwell photo shoot featuring Karlie Kloss; the final 10 designers will have to impress Maxwell with their take on elegance; then, they are faced with a flash sale challenge.

episodes.name: Blame It on Rio
episodes.summary: Stylist Marni Senofonte challenges the designers to create a mini-collection for actress Morena Baccarin ("Deadpool") who is heading to Rio de Janeiro on vacation; the designers race to create cohesive looks that tell a vacation fashion story.

episodes.name: The Stitch Is Back
episodes.summary: The designers learn they'll be creating over-the-top looks inspired by the movie, "Rocketman," which tells the life story of musician Elton John; the designers will receive help from some highly qualified assistants for this project.

episodes.name: What Do You Care About?
episodes.summary: The designers dig deep in this challenge to use their skills to bring attention to a social cause they care about; Elaine Welteroth mentors each designer on channeling their creative voice for change; the designers are hit with a Flash Sale twist.

episodes.name: New York City of Dreams
episodes.summary: The designers head to Christian Siriano's store and atelier, where they meet the women who keep New York City moving; the designers are asked to create dream dresses for civic workers from the post office, sanitation department, FDNY, NYPD, and more.

episodes.name: The Art of Fashion
episodes.summary: It's the last challenge to determine which four designers will move on to the finale; they must create their biggest and best looks as well as designing experimental art installations, with rapper Cardi B and Bergdorf Goodman's Linda Fargo.

episodes.name: One Elle of a Day
episodes.summary: The remaining designers arrive at a new workspace to learn about their final challenge; Nina Garcia meets them at the Elle Magazine offices where they are tasked with a surprise 11th look; only three of them will move on to compete in the finale.

episodes.name: The Final Runway
episodes.summary: The final three designers grapple with all aspects of putting together a winning presentation, including casting models, hair and makeup consultations and putting the final touches on their collections; with Diane von Fürstenberg as a guest judge.

episodes.name: Blast Off
episodes.summary: With luggage still in tow, the designers are greeted at the TWA Hotel at John F. Kennedy International Airport ready to take flight with their first challenge to create an innovative look inspired by humanity's continued push into space exploration.

episodes.name: Cats of the Urban Jungle
episodes.summary: Designers must create a fresh take on a timeless classic: animal prints; taking inspiration from the 2019 movie, "Cats," the designers must tame their prints to create stylish looks that can compete on the runway and in the Flash Sale challenge.

episodes.name: Sleigh the Runway
episodes.summary: The designers are awakened by a surprise visitor; the designers are challenged to show their holiday spirit in the perfect party dress; channeling their own holiday memories, the designers must transform a winter wonderland into a wearable wonder.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Upcycle
episodes.summary: Guest mentor Karla Welch tasks the designers with dressing her client, Karlie Kloss; the designers must recycle donated clothing from a Goodwill store to create their looks, and they must be both resourceful and fast for this one-day challenge.

episodes.name: Sew 80's
episodes.summary: Singer Cyndi Lauper inspires and guest judges a team challenge; the designers must create cohesive mini-collections paying homage to Lauper's 1980s fashion style with a modern take; Christian throws out a mid-challenge twist that changes everything.

episodes.name: There Is Only One You
episodes.summary: The designers are challenged to think about their family histories and channel those stories into a look of their choosing; the stakes are high in this one-day challenge, as the designers must face and embrace who they are in order to succeed.

episodes.name: Project Runway X Ashley Longshore
episodes.summary: Collaborations between fashion designers and artists are all the rage; the designers get a chance to enter into one with painter Ashley Longshore whose outrageous pop art gives the runway some of the boldest looks of the season.

episodes.name: Sheer Genius
episodes.summary: The designers face a one-day challenge using sexy, sheer fabrics; staying in the game becomes more and more difficult for several designers who are reaching their personal limits and question their ability to make it to the end.

episodes.name: Suit Yourself
episodes.summary: The challenge is all about turning the tuxedo on its head; inspired by Christian Siriano's Oscar look for actor Billy Porter, the designers must find a way to take the tuxedo into the future with a mix of male, female and non-binary models.

episodes.name: Live and Let Tie Dye
episodes.summary: Tie-dye is back in a big way, and the designers will need to create their own textiles to elevate the trend from casual to couture; in a twist that may feel more like a trick to the designers, it's an overnight challenge.

episodes.name: Olympic Game Plan
episodes.summary: Designers are paired with real athletes who are competing to be in the 2020 Summer Olympic and Paralympic games and the designers need to make their dream outfit for a victory night celebration.

episodes.name: The Height of Avant-Garde Fashion
episodes.summary: The remaining designers must think big to make an avant-garde look that is extraordinary and in a fashion first, the runway starts with a season long retrospective, outside and 16 stories high, in New York City.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: Christian visits the remaining contestants at home as they complete their final collections, but then it's back to the workroom to refine and revise, because even though New York fashion is here, that doesn't mean everybody will show.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: The remaining designers hurry to put the final touches on their collections, balancing advice from pros while attempting not to lose their own point of view and it's game, set, match when Serena Williams joins as a guest judge for the final runway.

episodes.name: A Colorful Return
episodes.summary: The designers are split into two teams living and working separately to create mini-collections celebrating color; the competition comes to a head on the day of the runway show when they reunite hoping their team is victorious.

episodes.name: #Streetwear
episodes.summary: In their first individual challenge, the designers take on streetwear, the most relevant and individualized style in fashion; the competitors create breakout looks to catch the eye of their cool guest judge, social media fashion icon, Wisdom Kaye.

episodes.name: Haute Halloween
episodes.summary: The designers are sent to sleep in a haunted mansion to find inspiration; if they can survive the night, they'll have two days to create a hauntingly chic masquerade gown for a runway show with award-winning actress, Taraji P. Henson.

episodes.name: In Bloom
episodes.summary: For their fourth challenge, the designers show up to discover their work room has been flower flashed; the designers must create their own unique floral print from scratch and turn it into a high-end runway look.

episodes.name: Tara & Johnny Are The Best!
episodes.summary: Figure skating icons Tara Lipinski and Johnny Weir need looks for the upcoming 2022 Winter Olympics; the designers will compete in pairs and the winning looks will be worn by Tara and Johnny at the Olympics.

episodes.name: Fashion Is Back, Baby!
episodes.summary: Designers collaborate with some of New York City's most talented accessory designers; each collaborating duo is challenged to create a coordinated one-of-a-kind look and new accessory.

episodes.name: Are You Fur Real?
episodes.summary: Working in pairs, the designers must create innovative avant garde looks highlighting one of the most trendy and complicated of materials, faux fur; Billy Porter, the icon of modern avant garde fashion, is the guest judge.

episodes.name: Couch Couture
episodes.summary: The designers are challenged to solve one of fashion's eternal struggles: if comfortable can really be chic; there's nothing comfortable about designing for a one day challenge with a surprise visit from Geoffrey Mac and Cyndi Lauper.

episodes.name: The Last Straw
episodes.summary: The designers are asked to create an elegant cocktail dress from an actual cocktail bar; one of fashion's most exciting designers, Christopher John Rogers, is the judge on the guest list for this VIP party.

episodes.name: The Housewives
episodes.summary: Bravo's real housewives of Potomac, Orange County and New York City bring their signature attitudes to the catwalk for a client challenge like no other; emotions run high as each designer is paired with a housewife to create a reunion show look.

episodes.name: Haute Hair
episodes.summary: In this one-day challenge, the designers are each teamed with an up-and-coming hairstylist for a head-to-toe fashion collaboration to create an innovative design and hair look.

episodes.name: The Model as Muse
episodes.summary: For the first time ever the designers will be creating looks for the same Supermodel in this one-of-a-kind challenge.

episodes.name: The Sky Is the Limit
episodes.summary: Four designers compete for the three spots in the season finale; the designers need to show the judges their brand and vision for the future of fashion in a single look.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.summary: This season's winner is chosen at the iconic New York Fashion Week.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Designers from around the world compete in the industry's premier fashion competition.

episodes.name: Meet the All-Stars
episodes.summary: Fourteen designers from across 19 seasons of "Project Runway" descend on New York once again to vie for the coveted title that has eluded them all. The iconic designers meet one another and catch up on their successes after leaving the Runway.

episodes.name: Project Redemption
episodes.summary: For their first challenge of the competition, the designers have to rewrite history by reinventing the look that either got them eliminated or gave them the lowest score in their past, and turn it into a high-fashion moment for the runways of today.

episodes.name: Toying With Fashion
episodes.summary: The all-stars are tasked with creating a runway look using toys for FAO Schwarz.

episodes.name: Coronation Day
episodes.summary: For Coronation Day, the designers are blindly paired together and tasked with creating couture modern gowns that exemplify royalty; Wes Gordon, the Creative Director of Carolina Herrera and gown expert, serves as a guest judge.

episodes.name: Seeing Red
episodes.summary: The designers are forced to share a single bolt of fabric to demonstrate how they can stand out from one another and prove why they're the top designer; actor, producer and Emmy Award-winning writer Lena Waithe joins as guest judge.

episodes.name: Like Totally '90s
episodes.summary: The designers must create chic and cohesive mini-collections inspired by the '90s; designers take to the halls of a New York City high school to showcase their styles, all while trying to impress guest judge Jennie Garth.

episodes.name: Fashion, Inside Out
episodes.summary: The jockstrap is back; the all-stars must create high-fashion looks featuring couture undergarments in this one-day challenge; fashion icons Sergio Hudson and Paulina Porizkova help separate the hot from the not.

episodes.name: Uncut Hems
episodes.summary: It's the halfway point and the designers are hitting the road to a denim explosion; in a throwback challenge, they'll create all denim looks while competing in head-to-head battles where only one designer can be safe from elimination.

episodes.name: Below Decked Out
episodes.summary: Fan favorites from the cast of "Below Deck" walk the runway in the infamous Real Client Challenge; Real Housewife Luann de Lesseps and former Below Decker Kate Chastain guest judge to help the panel decide who will sink or swim.

episodes.name: Freedom
episodes.summary: For the first time, the final seven designers are given the freedom to design whatever they want; on the grand outdoor runway of Franklin D. Roosevelt Four Freedoms State Park, their daring "freedom looks" will be unveiled, rain or shine.

episodes.name: Double Bind
episodes.summary: The designers are faced with one of their hardest tasks yet: a one-day challenge that forces them to create one runway look that showcases two opposing fashion styles.

episodes.name: Let Me See Your Peacock!
episodes.summary: The remaining all-stars must create show-stopping red-carpet menswear looks that fully embrace the trend toward the flamboyant; Emmy Award-winning actor Colman Domingo joins the judges to help determine whose look will be in and whose will be "fowl."

episodes.name: The Sky's the Limit
episodes.summary: The final four designers push themselves higher than ever for the Avant-Garde Challenge, inspired by the breathtaking views of Manhattan from the 91st floor of Summit One Vanderbilt; famed stylist Law Roach and Steven Kolb from the CFDA guest judge.

episodes.name: The Finale
episodes.summary: In a "Project Runway" first, three all-star finalists race against the clock to complete eight finale-worthy looks in just eight days; with the pressure mounting, all these finalists are shining jewels, but only one will be crowned.

episodes.name: New House; New Rules
episodes.summary: Heidi Klum returns to host the competition series; twelve hopeful new designers are divided into two competing fashion houses and must create a look inspired by Disney princesses and villains.

episodes.name: Feel the Burn
episodes.summary: After a shake-up in the houses, the designers are challenged to create a multipurpose athleisure look that mixes fashion and function.

episodes.name: Boring to Brilliant
episodes.summary: As the competition between the two houses heats up, the designers must use their creative skills to transform boring fabric into fabulous fashion.

episodes.name: Sew Elementary
episodes.summary: The designers head back to school where they must create fashionable looks using unconventional materials before facing a shocking twist at the elimination.

episodes.name: Complementary Couture
episodes.summary: After a difficult elimination, the designers must regroup as they are tasked with creating a companion piece to their unconventional materials look from the previous challenge.

episodes.name: Hit the Streets
episodes.summary: The designers must step up their game as they are asked to create a streetwear look that speaks to their individual brand.

episodes.name: Runway Rodeo
episodes.summary: The designers saddle up for a wild ride as their next challenge requires them to create a modern take on western chic.

episodes.name: Threads of Confidence
episodes.summary: Working with real people as their clients, the designers must create looks for a night on the town that include a jaw-dropping reveal.

episodes.name: Something Wicked
episodes.summary: The designers are challenged with creating a design worthy of Oz; friendships are tested when drama unfolds on the runway.

episodes.name: See You on the Runway
episodes.summary: The final three designers must create a capsule collection to prove who deserves to win fashion's fiercest competition.

episodes.name: 22 for Season 22
episodes.summary: Heidi Klum returns to host twenty-two designers as they battle to win the big prize; a twist raises the stakes as the designers fight to secure a spot in the competition by presenting the judges with a signature look.

episodes.name: Ready, Set, Redemption!
episodes.summary: The designers have a second chance at a first impression as they are challenged to create a look that reflects their personal design style; in addition to the judges, the designers' fate will also be decided by some familiar faces.

episodes.name: In It to Win It
episodes.summary: The designers are divided into four fashion houses and challenged to create runway-worthy looks inspired by NFL teams; working together while maintaining their own creative voice proves to be difficult as emotions rise and bonds are tested.

episodes.name: Catwalk on the Wild Side
episodes.summary: In a series of head-to-head fashion battles, the designers create bold looks inspired by wild animals. Special guest models from Hulu's Get Real lineup bring the contestants' creations to life on the runway.

episodes.name: Viva la Fashion
episodes.summary: Creativity is put to the test when the designers must transform paper towels into high-fashion runway looks. The competition becomes personal when the designers must name who they believe is the weakest designer amongst them.

episodes.name: The Devil's in the Details
episodes.summary: The designers compete for a coveted opportunity: creating a red-carpet look for Heidi Klum to wear at the premiere of The Devil Wears Prada 2. Glamour, elegance and high expectations collide.

episodes.name: Battle of the Seasons
episodes.summary: The season 22 designers join forces to take on returning competitors from season 21 in the classic unconventional materials challenge. Familiar faces and unexpected materials create a high-stakes showdown.

episodes.name: Designing with the Stars
episodes.summary: Partnering with Dancing With the Stars, the designers create performance-ready fashions for some of the show's favorite professional dancers. Style and movement must work together seamlessly.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Four friends compete to embarrass each other in everyday situations.

episodes.name: Alien Transports
episodes.summary: Examining stories of strange objects witnessed by ancient cultures and written in mythology and texts.

episodes.name: Mysterious Structures
episodes.summary: The theory that alien technology helped ancient humans build megalithic stone structures.

episodes.name: Mysterious Devices
episodes.summary: Structures and artifacts throughout the world point to advanced technology in the distant past; exploring the possibility that alien technology may have helped ancient humans.

episodes.name: Faces of the Gods
episodes.summary: Ancient people described monsters and visitors from the sky; these beings might be aliens, or the product of alien experimentation on humans.

episodes.name: Mysterious Places
episodes.summary: Planes and ships go missing in the Bermuda Triangle; magnetic anomalies in Mexico's Zone of Silence; an ancient doorway carved in Peru's Puerta de Hayu Marka; Markawasi's plateau' strange rock formations.

episodes.name: Gods & Aliens
episodes.summary: Analyzing whether aliens supplied the missing link that accelerated human evolution, advancing civilization.

episodes.name: Underwater Worlds
episodes.summary: The infamous tale of the long-lost city of Atlantis; ruins of recently discovered temples beneath Lake Titicaca in Peru; ancient Indian texts, known as Sangams, describe sunken cities where aliens and humans intermingled thousands of years ago.

episodes.name: Underground Aliens
episodes.summary: A cave in Ecuador that may contain books with secrets of alien technology; an ancient underground city in Turkey; rumors of the U.S. military working alongside aliens in a secret base; recent archaeological discoveries in the Yucatan.

episodes.name: Aliens & the Third Reich
episodes.summary: Ancient alien theorists speculate that Adolf Hitler's quest for world domination was aided and abetted by extraterrestrial technology; during World War II, there are reports that Germans built a craft with the help of blueprints from alien beings.

episodes.name: Alien Tech
episodes.summary: Investigating whether mankind's quest to unlock the secrets of technology came from our imaginations or from otherworldly beings.

episodes.name: Angels and Aliens
episodes.summary: Investigating whether angels might really be travelers visiting Earth from distant planets.

episodes.name: Unexplained Structures
episodes.summary: Evidence of ancient aliens found in mysterious structures throughout the world.

episodes.name: Alien Devastations
episodes.summary: The story of the Great Flood; extraterrestrial battles that caused wide-scale destruction; reports of UFOs lurking in the shadows of recent natural disasters; The Book of Revelations and the Dead Sea Scrolls.

episodes.name: Alien Contacts
episodes.summary: Joan of Arc's defeat of the English Army; a young boy from India learns advanced mathematical formulas; an American serviceman receives a message while touching an alien aircraft; the ancient astronaut theory.

episodes.name: Aliens and the Old West
episodes.summary: A cemetery in Aurora, Texas claims to hold the body of an alien; petroglyphs depict strange beings in Utah; 19th century ranchers report seeing an otherworldly creature emerge from Elizabeth Lake; the home of Wyatt Earp in Tombstone, Ariz.

episodes.name: Aliens and Monsters
episodes.summary: Theorists speculate that a flying creature described by Hindu scripture may have been an alien craft; researchers wonder whether centaurs and other fabled creatures were the result of extraterrestrial transplantation procedures.

episodes.name: Aliens and Sacred Places
episodes.summary: Jerusalem's Temple Mount; Islam's shrine at Mecca; the temple at Baalbek, Lebanon.

episodes.name: Aliens and Temples of Gold
episodes.summary: A church in southern France is said to hold the key to alchemy; locals in Peru believe UFO sightings are connected to lost gold at the bottom of Lake Puray; a library left behind by extraterrestrials.

episodes.name: Aliens and Mysterious Rituals
episodes.summary: Festivals, coronations, funerals, and other modern rituals could reflect attempts by early humans to emulate ancient alien visitors.

episodes.name: Aliens and Ancient Engineers
episodes.summary: An ancient mountaintop fortress in Peru constructed with laser-like tools; temples at Vijayanagara India harness cosmic energy; an acoustic chamber in Malta enables interplanetary communication.

episodes.name: Aliens, Plagues and Epidemics
episodes.summary: Perplexed by unidentified bacteria, some scientists believe plagues and epidemics can be linked with extraterrestrial interventions.

episodes.name: Aliens and Lost Worlds
episodes.summary: Strange carvings in the Mayan city of Copan; the ancient Nazca people who altered their bodies and land.

episodes.name: Aliens and Deadly Weapons
episodes.summary: From gunpowder to missiles, ancient alien theorists speculate that lethal weapons may have been created with the help of extraterrestrials.

episodes.name: Aliens and Evil Places
episodes.summary: An investigation into the possible connection between extraterrestrial activity and the places with evil reputations, such as Australia's Black Mountains and the forest at the base of Mount Fuji in Japan.

episodes.name: Aliens and the Founding Fathers
episodes.summary: The founding fathers knowledge of aliens shows up in symbols, architecture and the founding documents of the United States of America.

episodes.name: Aliens and Deadly Cults
episodes.summary: People who have claimed to have otherworldly knowledge lead followers to commit horrific acts of violence.

episodes.name: Aliens and the Secret Code
episodes.summary: People consider whether ancient man's spectacular structures were built by humans alone or with otherworldly visitors.

episodes.name: Aliens and the Undead
episodes.summary: Theorists speculate about age-old stories of encounters with zombies, vampires and undead creatures and whether these stories point to meetings with extraterrestrials.

episodes.name: Aliens, Gods and Heroes
episodes.summary: Ancient alien theorists explore the extraterrestrial origins of mythological gods and ask whether stories of superhuman strength, supernatural powers and the ability to fly can be traced to factual events involving alien beings.

episodes.name: Aliens and the Creation of Man
episodes.summary: Unexplained advances in human evolution point to the work of interstellar beings.

episodes.name: The Mayan Conspiracy
episodes.summary: Extraterrestrial visitors may have influenced Mayan culture and helped ancient Mayans make striking advances in science, mathematics, time keeping, and astronomy.

episodes.name: The Doomsday Prophecies
episodes.summary: The end of the Mayan Long Count Calendar and potential alien explanations for what may come.

episodes.name: The Greys
episodes.summary: Beings with big heads and giant eyes are called the greys and have been depicted in ancient rock art and carved stone figurines found all over the world.

episodes.name: Aliens and Mega-Disasters
episodes.summary: Natural disasters in the ancient world, including volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, floods, and meteor strikes may have originated with the meddling of celestial beings.

episodes.name: The NASA Connection
episodes.summary: Research into alien contact in the recent past including evidence from former astronauts, secret government files, and NASA scientists.

episodes.name: The Mystery of Puma Punku
episodes.summary: A 14,000-year-old set of ruins with complex interlocking blocks defies explanation; some believe their origin may be extraterrestrial.

episodes.name: Aliens and Bigfoot
episodes.summary: While ancient myths and legends speak of an ape-like giant stalking the earth, theorists speculate that Bigfoot creatures belong to an alien species that once visited Earth in the distant past.

episodes.name: The Da Vinci Conspiracy
episodes.summary: Examining Leonardo da Vinci's paintings, sketches and journals look for knowledge of otherworldly technology and aliens.

episodes.name: Top 10 Revelations: The Time Travelers
episodes.summary: Considering the possibility that sightings of alien beings or UFOs may be evidence of time travelers from the future.

episodes.name: Aliens and Dinosaurs
episodes.summary: Ancient alien theorists wonder about the depiction of a stegosaurus in Angkor Wat, the world's largest ancient religious temple, and ask how the ancients could have known about dinosaurs.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Pyramids
episodes.summary: Researchers explore the strange similarities among pyramids in Egypt, Central and South America, China, Africa, and Indonesia, including a possible extraterrestrial link connecting these structures.

episodes.name: Aliens and Cover Ups
episodes.summary: In 1980, three young military men are sent into a UK forest to investigate strange lights, and they reportedly find a spacecraft, then they are ordered to never speak of the incident again; UFO encounters kept under wraps and what they reveal.

episodes.name: Alien Power Plants
episodes.summary: Ancient alien theorists speculate about the depiction of light bulbs in Egyptian hieroglyphs and the batteries discovered among Mesopotamian artifacts and whether extraterrestrials introduced electricity to ancient peoples.

episodes.name: Destination Orion
episodes.summary: Researchers suggest that the Orion constellation may have been a star-gate or an entry point for extraterrestrials visiting Earth for thousands of years.

episodes.name: The Einstein Factor
episodes.summary: Ancient alien theorists believe there is an extraterrestrial connection to the scientific genius of famous historical figures such as Albert Einstein, Galileo, Archimedes, and Aristotle.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Tombs
episodes.summary: Archeologists uncover ancient tombs filled with strange items and writings; remarkable similarities found at these sites cause theorists to believe that some of these technically advanced tombs were designed with the help of extraterrestrials.

episodes.name: Prophets and Prophecies
episodes.summary: Historical prophets may have had alien influences; there are some who believe that extraterrestrials have used intermediaries; they were used to transmit important moral, philosophical and artistic codes to humanity.

episodes.name: Beyond Nazca
episodes.summary: Hundreds of gigantic lines extend for miles throughout the Peruvian desert; scholars are divided as to who built them, and why; experts say Nazca may have been a mining operation for advanced beings.

episodes.name: Strange Abductions
episodes.summary: In 1975, Travis Walton claims to have been abducted by extraterrestrial beings, but researchers say that alien abductions have been taking place for thousands of years, as depicted in biblical stories of abductions by otherworldly beings.

episodes.name: The Von Daniken Legacy
episodes.summary: Erich von Daniken's theories that have ignited a movement known as Ancient Astronaut Theory.

episodes.name: The Viking Gods
episodes.summary: A look into the Norse Viking; how they became teachers and destroyers; the gods they worshiped were fearsome and mysterious.

episodes.name: The Monoliths
episodes.summary: Extraordinary feats of construction, created without the use of advanced tools or technology, can be found from the jungles of Costa Rica to England's rural countryside.

episodes.name: The Power of Three
episodes.summary: The ancient Egyptian design of the three pyramids of Giza; diverse cultures worship the all-knowing triads; an ancient tablet noted the power of the number three; the language of human DNA is written in a pattern of threes.

episodes.name: The Crystal Skulls
episodes.summary: Thirteen crystal skulls which are believed to hold a mystical power whose secrets will be revealed when the skulls come together to form a global grid.

episodes.name: The Anunnaki Connection
episodes.summary: In ancient Mesopotamia, the Sumerians make advances in agriculture, science, medicine, and astronomy, crediting these achievements to winged gods known as the Anunnaki.

episodes.name: Magic of the Gods
episodes.summary: Accounts of magic suggest possible evidence of advanced otherworldly knowledge.

episodes.name: The Satan Conspiracy
episodes.summary: Ancient texts indicate that Satan may have been an extraterrestrial who was more of an ally to humanity than an enemy by passing along knowledge that planted the seed for civilization.

episodes.name: Alien Operations
episodes.summary: Questioning how humans learned to heal by exploring ancient possibilities involving the human body, breakthroughs in medicine and medical procedures.

episodes.name: Emperors, Kings and Pharaohs
episodes.summary: Investigating the possible connection between powerful rulers of the past and extraterrestrial forces.

episodes.name: Mysterious Relics
episodes.summary: Theorists ask whether the truth of humankind's origins can be found in the mysterious relics revered by ancient cultures for thousands of years and found on display in museums, temples and churches.

episodes.name: Aliens and Forbidden Islands
episodes.summary: Remote islands may hold evidence of UFO activity; legends of lost islands, advanced civilizations and Eden-like paradises told by sailors throughout human history may point to ancient alien origins.

episodes.name: Aliens and The Lost Ark
episodes.summary: The Ark of the Covenant is said to have divine powers.

episodes.name: Aliens and Mysterious Mountains
episodes.summary: Exploring why ancient civilizations believed mountains were the homes of gods.

episodes.name: Aliens and Stargates
episodes.summary: Sacred entryways to the land of the gods; researchers uncover a mysterious and toxic cave in Turkey; otherworldly creatures appear and disappear in Mexico.

episodes.name: Aliens in America
episodes.summary: Strange rock carvings from 8,000 B.C.; unexplained sightings in the new world; a frightening anomaly plaguing the American west; a strange man-made cave filled with ancient objects and mummies; strange lights and unexplained weather anomalies.

episodes.name: The Star Children
episodes.summary: Children being born on Earth today can access their alien DNA to utilize special gifts and the power to transform society.

episodes.name: Treasures of the Gods
episodes.summary: Mysterious relics and sealed vaults may have been hidden on purpose and protected by an extraterrestrial source.

episodes.name: Aliens and the Red Planet
episodes.summary: Probes have been sending information about Mars back to scientists for nearly 40 years. Photographs of the planet reveal mysteries that could mean life on Mars.

episodes.name: The Shamans
episodes.summary: Spiritual leaders known as shamans have healed, protected and advised people throughout history. Exploring the possibility that shamans communicated with extraterrestrials to influence mankind.

episodes.name: Aliens and Insects
episodes.summary: Insects that have inhabited Earth for hundreds of millions of years may provide a link to extraterrestrial beings.

episodes.name: Alien Breeders
episodes.summary: Mythological tales of intimate encounters with otherworldly beings point to possible alien intervention contributing to the genetic makeup of humans.

episodes.name: Alien Transports
episodes.summary: Theorists speculate that ancient stories about fiery chariots, flying carpets and fire-breathing dragons could be descriptions of misunderstood technology involving mysterious crafts.

episodes.name: Mysterious Structures
episodes.summary: While stonecutters, scientists and archeologists are baffled by megalithic stone structures, ancient astronaut theorists speculate that humans constructed these gigantic structures with the help of alien technology.

episodes.name: Mysterious Devices
episodes.summary: Mysterious devices, including a 2,000-year-old computer, a power plant in the Great Pyramid, and a Nazi-era time machine.

episodes.name: Faces of the Gods
episodes.summary: Stories of godlike beings from throughout history may be evidence of extraterrestrial visitation.

episodes.name: The Reptilians
episodes.summary: The myths behind reptilian aliens may provide evidence that suggests the creatures are more than just science fiction.

episodes.name: The Tesla Experiment
episodes.summary: Inventor Nikola Tesla guided mankind toward a new industrial era.

episodes.name: The God Particle
episodes.summary: In 2012, scientists at the CERN laboratory announce the discovery of the God Particle, which may have been left on Earth by extraterrestrial beings and may reveal the truth about human origins.

episodes.name: Alien Encounters
episodes.summary: Stories of strange encounters during major events in history and myths containing gods that intervene in human affairs may be early accounts of alien encounters.

episodes.name: Aliens & Superheroes
episodes.summary: The ancient and modern-day superheroes may have originated from the same legends, which could have otherworldly origins.

episodes.name: Forbidden Caves
episodes.summary: Throughout the course of human history, some caves have been considered sacred places for spiritual encounter and enlightenment, while others have been feared as true portals to purgatory.

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Sphinx
episodes.summary: The Great Sphinx in Giza defies explanation, pre-dates the earliest known civilizations and may conceal the secrets of humanities very origins.

episodes.name: Aliens Among Us
