episodes.summary: Exploring the theory that mankind's technological savvy comes from the work of extraterrestrials that watch Earth from outer space; inside the Inca legend, The Book of Enoch, that describes the Watchers descending to Earth to aid our advancement.

episodes.name: The Genius Factor
episodes.summary: Many brilliant minds believed they did not possess genius, but rather genius possessed them, like a spirit.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Mummies
episodes.summary: Cultures all over the world have practiced complex techniques to preserve the human body after death; ancient Egyptians believed mummification ensured entrance into the next life; Buddhist monks practiced self-mummification.

episodes.name: Alien Resurrections
episodes.summary: Taking a look at incredible stories of the dead rising from their graves; mummies traveling into the afterlife; people on the brink of death mixing with deceased relatives in a celestial netherworld.

episodes.name: Alien Messages
episodes.summary: Messages embedded in sacred religious texts, as well as in the design and location of ancient monuments that may reveal the purpose behind human existence.

episodes.name: The Great Flood
episodes.summary: New evidence suggests that many aspects in the mythical stories of a deluge sent by the gods to engulf the world may actually be true.

episodes.name: Aliens and the Civil War
episodes.summary: Examining whether extraterrestrial beings helped save the nation during the Civil War; Abraham Lincoln experiences strange visions and premonitions; soldiers at Gettysburg see a ghostly image of George Washington.

episodes.name: Hidden Pyramids
episodes.summary: Infrared satellite technology detects pyramids hidden underneath the sand in Egypt and airborne laser sensors discover long-lost pyramids beneath the jungles of Central America; recent excavations reveal fascinating new facts about pyramids.

episodes.name: The Vanishings
episodes.summary: Stories of civilizations large and small disappearing without a trace can be found throughout history and across the globe.

episodes.name: The Alien Agenda
episodes.summary: Ancient astronaut theorists have long proposed that extraterrestrials played a pivotal role in human history, and some believe they continue to keep a careful watch over the progress of mankind.

episodes.name: Aliens B.C.
episodes.summary: Modern archaeologists are continuously discovering artifacts and sites that defy the conventional timeline of human history.

episodes.name: NASA's Secret Agenda
episodes.summary: Wernher von Braun's prediction that people would explore Mars and build a space station has become reality.

episodes.name: Aliens and Robots
episodes.summary: Robots are being programmed to do everything from performing surgery on humans, to investigating other planets; humanoid robots are quickly reaching a level of sophistication that was thought to exist only in science fiction.

episodes.name: Dark Forces
episodes.summary: In almost every culture, there are stories of opposing forces at work here on Earth; forces of a supernatural or otherworldly nature.

episodes.name: The Alien Evolution
episodes.summary: Theorists have suggested that many of the divine beings depicted in cultures actually reflect extraterrestrial visitations that human ancestors did not understand.

episodes.name: The Other Earth
episodes.summary: Scientists have found thousands of planets capable of supporting life; possibly answering the question whether human life is alone in the universe.

episodes.name: Creatures of the Deep
episodes.summary: In August 2014, Russian cosmonauts aboard the International Space Station discover living sea plankton covering parts of the windows; there might be alien life forms that inhabit the seas.

episodes.name: Circles From the Sky
episodes.summary: Over 10,000 crop circles, appearing in 50 different countries, have been reported; examining whether they are all part of an elaborate hoax or not.

episodes.name: The Alien Wars
episodes.summary: On March 19th, 2002, Gary McKinnon was arrested for hacking into 97 computers over a 13-month period; McKinnon claims that he found evidence of a secret American space fleet.

episodes.name: The Forbidden Zones
episodes.summary: Specific regions of the world that are off-limits to exploration due to warfare, instability and inaccessibility.

episodes.name: Pyramids of Antarctica
episodes.summary: Satellite imagery reveals what appears to be the tops of manmade pyramids in Antarctica; ancient astronaut theorists conjecture that extraterrestrials may have colonized an ice-free Antarctica before a global catastrophe plunged it into an ice age.

episodes.name: Destination Mars
episodes.summary: Theorists suggest that a voyage to Mars will unlock ancient mysteries about the extraterrestrial origins of the human species while providing the key to its long-term survival.

episodes.name: The Next Humans
episodes.summary: While technology spurs human evolution and takes people in a radical new direction, ancient astronaut theorists suggest that cyborg-like, super beings once walked the earth.

episodes.name: The New Evidence
episodes.summary: Satellite images, ground-penetrating radar and thermal scanning leads to new evidence that appears to substantiate the belief held by millions of people that Earth has been visited in the past by extraterrestrial beings.

episodes.name: The Visionaries
episodes.summary: Theorists suggest that extraterrestrials have been communicating with mathematicians and engineers through the universal language of mathematics and binary code, influencing Nikolai Fyodorov and other visionaries to advocate for space exploration.

episodes.name: Decoding the Cosmic Egg
episodes.summary: Theorists suggest that the iconic religious symbol of the cosmic egg demonstrates that human ancestors possessed a knowledge of the DNA double-helix spiral and human biological coding.

episodes.name: The Wisdom Keepers
episodes.summary: In Australia, Aboriginal people tell sacred stories about sky gods visiting Earth in fire-spewing crafts and "seeding" the planet.

episodes.name: The Mysterious Nine
episodes.summary: Stories of emperors, kings and pharaohs consulting a pantheon of nine gods are found in many cultures lending credence to the theory that there is an intergalactic council of nine working behind the scenes to monitor and guide humanity.

episodes.name: The Hidden Empire
episodes.summary: Theorists suggest that compelling evidence of extraterrestrial visitation exists in China, the cradle of one of the earliest and most influential civilizations on Earth.

episodes.name: The Prototypes
episodes.summary: Recent archaeological finds suggest that humans once shared the planet with various types of intelligent human-like species in a real-life version of "The Lord of the Rings."

episodes.name: Space Station Moon
episodes.summary: After Apollo 17 in 1972, the United States ends the Apollo program, leaving some to wonder if the astronauts found more than what NASA wants the public to know.

episodes.name: Russia's Secret Files
episodes.summary: Many believe that the rise of communism led to secrecy surrounding ancient and modern extraterrestrial contact in Russia; theorists point to the archaeological site of Arkaim as evidence that extraterrestrial visitations took place in Russia.

episodes.name: Beyond Roswell
episodes.summary: The U.S. military denies that the 1947 Roswell crash involved anything other than a weather balloon, but theorists claim that other UFO crashes were reported all over the world at the same time as the crash and that the wreckages were retrieved.

episodes.name: The Returned
episodes.summary: Ancient mythologies tell stories of humans being abducted by otherworldly beings, even as thousands of people continue to report being taken by aliens and then returned with implants and genetic mutations.

episodes.name: Shiva the Destroyer
episodes.summary: Theorists suggest that Shiva, an important Hindu god, may have been the leader of an extraterrestrial faction that came to Earth wielding advanced technology, pointing to an ancient rock-cut Hindu temple as proof.

episodes.name: The Alien Hunters
episodes.summary: Starting in 1947, a series of unexplained events and sightings prompts U.S. government officials to become alien hunters; theorists offer evidence that similar endeavors were made thousands of years ago.

episodes.name: Forged by the Gods
episodes.summary: Theorists speculate about metal artifacts that could provide physical evidence of extraterrestrials visiting Earth in the distant past; in Jacksonville, Fla. A strange metallic sphere falls from the sky; an ancient aluminum wedge baffles historians.

episodes.name: The Mystery of Rudloe Manor
episodes.summary: In Wiltshire, England, Rudloe Manor appears to be nothing more than an English manor house, but researchers argue it has been the epicenter of British research into UFOs since World War II.

episodes.name: The Alien Architects
episodes.summary: Ancient alien theorists speculate about why many of the architectural marvels of the ancient world bear striking similarities to one another even though they were built by civilizations separated by thousands of miles.

episodes.name: The Pharaoh's Curse
episodes.summary: According to legend, a curse was placed on the tomb of King Tutankhamun; researchers theorize that the curse came about as the result of alien technology with the purpose of protecting the truth about an otherworldly event as well as an alien device.

episodes.name: The Science Wars
episodes.summary: Archaeologists and anthropologists make discoveries that receive no notice because they don't fit into the accepted scientific paradigm, such as an ancient hammer found in Texas or elongated skulls found on nearly every continent.

episodes.name: City of the Gods
episodes.summary: Researchers suggest that the ancient site of Teotihuacan in central Mexico was once home to a highly advanced, perhaps extraterrestrial, civilization; excavations at Teotihuacan have unearthed discoveries out of place in the ancient world.

episodes.name: The Alien Frequency
episodes.summary: Researchers find that dozens of megalithic sites across the globe were designed to emanate the exact same frequency, causing them to speculate that certain frequencies may allow humans to connect with extraterrestrial forces.

episodes.name: The Majestic Twelve
episodes.summary: A memo from 1952 surfaces informing President-elect Dwight Eisenhower about the existence of a top-secret group of scientists, government officials and military personnel who are tasked with investigating reports of UFOs.

episodes.name: The Akashic Record
episodes.summary: Researchers ask if Cloud computing represents the rediscovery of an ancient repository of knowledge known as the Akashic Record; neuroscientist Dr. Dario Nardi measures the brainwaves of Dr. Deepak Chopra as he enters a state of deep meditation.

episodes.name: Voices of the Gods
episodes.summary: Giorgio A. Tsoukalos studies India's Sanskrit texts, which are filled with descriptions of brain surgery, flying crafts, nuclear physics, and other advanced sciences; Hindu scholars attribute this knowledge to a time when gods walked among humans.

episodes.name: The Animal Agenda
episodes.summary: Theorists suggest that some extraterrestrials may closely resemble animals, as evidenced by gods depicted with animal traits; researchers suggest that some animals may have been planted here by aliens as part of an experiment to shape life on Earth.

episodes.name: The Replicants
episodes.summary: While more than 1.5 billion people believe in reincarnation, ancient astronaut theorists suggest that extraterrestrials designed the human body to be a vessel for otherworldly entities.

episodes.name: A Spaceship Made of Stone
episodes.summary: Japanese legend states that the Ishi-no-Hoden megalith, carved from a single rock and weighing roughly 500 tons, was built to depict a sky ship made of stone that the ancient people witnessed descending from the heavens.

episodes.name: The Alien Disks
episodes.summary: In China, hundreds of strange disks are discovered in a cave that appear to tell the story of an ancient extraterrestrial crash on Earth; shortly thereafter, the disks are confiscated by the Chinese government and dismissed as a hoax.

episodes.name: Return to Gobekli Tepe
episodes.summary: The ancient site of Göbekli Tepe challenges what archaeologists believe about the past; the megalithic stone complex was built over 12,000 years ago, 5,000 years before the first known civilization was said to have emerged in Mesopotamia.

episodes.name: The UFO Conspiracy
episodes.summary: In 2017, news breaks that the Department of Defense recently spent millions investigating reports of UFOs; the latest disclosure about a series of secret government UFO projects dating back decades.

episodes.name: Da Vinci's Forbidden Codes
episodes.summary: Researchers claim hidden messages can be found within the works of Leonardo da Vinci, and other art throughout history, that may reveal an extraterrestrial influence.

episodes.name: The Alien Protocols
episodes.summary: In 2017, a strange, cigar-shaped object enters the solar system from another star system, traveling in such an unusual trajectory it causes some astronomers to suggest that it could be an extraterrestrial craft.

episodes.name: Earth's Black Holes
episodes.summary: Theorists speculate about the existence of black holes on Earth, which may explain strange disappearances and other inexplicable phenomena.

episodes.name: The Desert Codes
episodes.summary: Researchers study giant ancient drawings found etched into the desert floor, which may be a part of an ancient alien code.

episodes.name: Area 52
episodes.summary: A look at whether Area 51's notoriety acts as a cover-up for much bigger, top-secret extraterrestrial experiments taking place at multiple locations.

episodes.name: Earth Station Egypt
episodes.summary: Ancient astronaut theorist Giorgio A. Tsoukalos explores the latest scientific discoveries at some of the world's most ancient places to find evidence that extraterrestrials visited Egypt in the distant past.

episodes.name: Island of the Giants
episodes.summary: Treasure hunter Marty Lagina and Ancient Astronaut theorist Giorgio A. Tsoukalos explore the bizarre statues, mysterious pyramids and gigantic structures left behind by one of the most mysterious cultures in the ancient world in Sardinia, Italy.

episodes.name: The Taken
episodes.summary: Millions of people around the world claim to have been abducted by extraterrestrials; whether or not these extraordinary accounts are some form of mass psychological delusion still remains unanswered.

episodes.name: The Sentinels
episodes.summary: Ancient astronaut theorists Giorgio A. Tsoukalos and David H. Childress explore a Polynesian land of bizarre figures and forbidden places in search of what could be the ultimate evidence of mankind's extraterrestrial origins.

episodes.name: Russia Declassified
episodes.summary: A secret alliance hidden in plain sight; joint space missions; questions remain whether or not the U.S. and Russia have been working together from the very beginning of the Space Race in preparation for the ultimate extraterrestrial encounter.

episodes.name: They Came From the Sky
episodes.summary: Ancient cultures from around the world believed that meteorites were sacred stones imbued with the power of the Gods; Ancient Astronaut theorists ask whether these space rocks could be pieces of extraterrestrial technology.

episodes.name: The Artificial Human
episodes.summary: A look at whether or not intelligent robots are a threat to humanity or the next step in human evolution; as man and machine begin to merge, humanity could be fulfilling a destiny prepared for by aliens thousands of years ago.

episodes.name: The Alien Phenomenon
episodes.summary: Erich von Däniken's "Chariots of the Gods?" suggests that aliens visited Earth in the distant past, and there are those who believe that he will be proven right.

episodes.name: Return to Mars
episodes.summary: An examination of possible encounters humans could have once colonies are established beyond Earth.

episodes.name: Return to Antarctica
episodes.summary: Antarctica may serve as home base for extraterrestrial visitors to Earth, but as human exploration of the frozen continent increases, humans may come face to face with the ruins of an ancient advanced civilization buried beneath the ice.

episodes.name: The Badlands Guardian
episodes.summary: Satellite images have revealed a giant face that appears to be carved into the Earth in Alberta, Canada, which has now become known far and wide as "The Badlands Guardian."

episodes.name: Element 115
episodes.summary: According to physicist Bob Lazar, Element 115 is the fuel source for an alien spacecraft he was hired to reverse-engineer by the U.S. government to find a way to harness its power.

episodes.name: The Sirius Connection
episodes.summary: Aliens from the tiny star Sirius B may have visited humans in the distant past, imparting the knowledge of civilization to peoples thousands of miles apart.

episodes.name: They Came from the Sea
episodes.summary: Lurking in the oceans are creatures that defy explanation, such as octopuses that can edit their own DNA or animals that can regenerate their entire brain; examining if the oceans are acting as a giant Petri dish for alien genetic experimentation.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Maya
episodes.summary: Spanish Conquistadors obliterated the historical record of the Maya in the 16th century, but did they wipe out evidence that ancient people traveled to the Americas from all over the world, and in flying craft provided by extraterrestrial visitors.

episodes.name: The Druid Connection
episodes.summary: A look at if ancient Druids traveled to New England and New York's Hudson Valley centuries ago, bringing with them the beliefs and technologies of their alien mentors, the Shining Ones of Irish myth.

episodes.name: The Reptilian Agenda
episodes.summary: Serpent gods are found in the traditions of Mesopotamia, Central and South America, India, China, Japan and the Bible; a look at if these stories describe a race of reptile-like extraterrestrials instead.

episodes.name: The Alien Infection
episodes.summary: A look at if ancient aliens could have shaped human evolution by introducing viral epidemics on Earth.

episodes.name: Project Hybrid
episodes.summary: Extraterrestrials could be altering human DNA and repopulating the Earth with alien-human hybrids; following the trail of evidence from ancient cultures to modern-day animal mutilations and alien abductions.

episodes.name: The Trans-Dimensionals
episodes.summary: According to some Ancient Astronaut theorists, entities that have been described as ghosts, angels and extraterrestrials are actually visitors from unseen realms, and they walk on Earth.

episodes.name: Islands of Fire
episodes.summary: The native Hawaiians trace their ancestry to beings from the Pleiades star system called the Akua; a look at these islands and if they once had been inhabited by extraterrestrials.

episodes.name: The Constellation Code
episodes.summary: Throughout the ancient world, structures were built to mirror the constellations in the night sky and this is only apparent when they are viewed from high above; a look at the possibility that these structures were designed as messages.

episodes.name: The Nuclear Agenda
episodes.summary: UFOs have been reported at the world's nuclear facilities ever since the first atomic bomb in 1945, with many suspecting that extraterrestrials are watching humanity's nuclear potential.

episodes.name: The Alien Mountain
episodes.summary: A mysterious mountain in northern Italy has stood witness to strange sightings in the sky and unexplainable phenomena for hundreds of years but could it be attracting extraterrestrial visitors and there could be technology within its rocky slopes.

episodes.name: The Alien Brain
episodes.summary: A look at the possibility that the human brain possesses extraordinary untapped abilities granted by extraterrestrial beings -- such as telepathy, precognition and psychokinesis; abilities that will enable the next step in the evolution of humans.

episodes.name: The Secrets of Stonehenge
episodes.summary: A shocking study reveals that the original builders of Stonehenge mysteriously vanished. But Stonehenge's mysterious Bluestone circle could have activated a portal that transported the ancient culture back to their former home among the stars.

episodes.name: Food of the Gods
episodes.summary: Divine substances were consumed by the gods but sometimes gifted to humans to impart great power or wisdom; could the food of the gods be sustenance for alien visitors and does it lend insight into humanity's future.

episodes.name: Human Hieroglyphs
episodes.summary: Tattoos, piercings, and body modification account for a nearly one-billion-dollar industry, but are these practices a bold form of self-expression or could they be motivated by a profound link to ancient ancestors.

episodes.name: The Storming of Area 51
episodes.summary: In 2019, millions responded to an internet post advocating to storm the gates of the world's most top-secret military installation -- Area 51 but when they did, the U.S. military vowed to defend the base with deadly force.

episodes.name: Countdown to Disclosure
episodes.summary: A look at if governments around the world are preparing mankind for the most startling event in human history, the official disclosure of an extraterrestrial presence on Earth.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Exoplanets
episodes.summary: Examining some of the thousands of potentially habitable exoplanets discovered over the past 20 years and whether some of them could be home to intelligent extraterrestrial life.

episodes.name: The Mystery of Nan Madol
episodes.summary: Giorgio Tsoukalos and David Childress explore the mysterious chain of manmade islets in Micronesia's Nan Madol; built from 250 million tons of volcanic rock, there are local legends that strange visitors floated the massive rocks through the air.

episodes.name: The Relics of Roswell
episodes.summary: In 1947, the U.S. military collects debris from what they claim is a crashed weather balloon outside of Roswell, N.M.; new evidence may prove that the wreckage belonged to an alien spacecraft and that remnants may have been overlooked.

episodes.name: Destination Chile
episodes.summary: The Chilean government questions whether new footage from a Navy helicopter indicates a connection to geoglyphs in the Atacama Desert.

episodes.name: The Real Men in Black
episodes.summary: Since the late 1940s, there have been countless reports of mysterious men in black that show up immediately following UFO sightings and attempt to silence witnesses; a look at declassified FBI documents and new eyewitness accounts.

episodes.name: The Mystery of the Stone Giants
episodes.summary: From Egypt to Easter Island, towering figures built by ancient man stand watch over the Earth; discussing if these stone giants are simply a testament to humanity's past or if they could depict visitors from another world.

episodes.name: The World Before Time
episodes.summary: Shocking new evidence reveals that advanced civilizations might have existed on Earth tens of thousands of years ago; is it possible that a technologically advanced society thrived on Earth, and did they leave behind a record.

episodes.name: They Came from The Pleiades
episodes.summary: In numerous ancient cultures throughout the world, stories were told of ancestors that came to Earth from the Pleiades star cluster, but could new scientific findings reveal that humankind's true origins lie not on Earth but 400 light years away.

episodes.name: The Immortality Machine
episodes.summary: In the Mojave Desert, there is a structure built to bestow everlasting life and according to the architect, the blueprint was provided by an extraterrestrial visitor known as the Integratron. Could it actually provide the key to immortality?

episodes.name: The Shapeshifters
episodes.summary: Accounts of creatures that can shape shift from one form into another can be found, but could similarities between the ancient stories and modern-day alien abduction accounts reveal that shape shifters are real and have come to Earth.

episodes.name: The Mystery of Skinwalker Ranch
episodes.summary: Nestled within a remote valley in Utah is a ranch that some believe is a hotbed of strange, inexplicable phenomena including terrifying creatures, paranormal apparitions and lights in the sky.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Guide to UFOs
episodes.summary: UFO witnesses have reported a wide variety of objects in Earth's skies and not only in modern times, but for centuries; could they offer important clues about other intelligent life.

episodes.name: Aliens and the Presidents
episodes.summary: The White House has consistently denied having any knowledge of alien craft visiting Earth, but presidential encounters with UFOs and other strange phenomena can be found going all the way back to George Washington.

episodes.name: The Divine Number
episodes.summary: In numerous sacred traditions, the number 12 holds a divine significance; it can be found repeated in ancient architecture, groups of 12 wisdom keepers and even the latest scientific principles.

episodes.name: The Lost Kingdom
episodes.summary: According to the earliest Tibetan traditions, Shambhala, the kingdom of the gods, is hidden high in the Himalayas; examining if it's possible that this mystical realm truly exists.

episodes.name: The Galactic Keyhole
episodes.summary: The mysterious symbol of the keyhole exists in mystic texts, sacred architecture and ancient artwork found all over the planet; exploring if this cryptic shape represents a profound connection to the cosmos.

episodes.name: Giants of the Mediterranean
episodes.summary: Ancient cultures recorded stories of enormous beings that descended from the sky; exploring if massive megalithic structures and reported discoveries of towering human-like skeletons reveal that the world was once inhabited by giants.

episodes.name: The Forbidden Bible
episodes.summary: Rebellious angels, giant hybrid beings, and humans taken up to a heavenly realm above the Earth; examining the possibility that The Book of Enoch was stricken from the Bible because it documents humanity's extraterrestrial origins.

episodes.name: William Shatner Meets Ancient Aliens
episodes.summary: A multitude of guests and scientists explores everything from human origins to groundbreaking archaeological finds, new understandings of the cosmos, and the profound possibility that humans are not alone in the universe.

episodes.name: Impossible Artifacts
episodes.summary: Strange ancient objects that leave archaeologists at a loss could suggest that an advanced extraterrestrial civilization existed on Earth for thousands of years.

episodes.name: The Space Travelers
episodes.summary: Humankind's most profound achievement is blasting off into the stars; what humans might learn by venturing out farther into space.

episodes.name: The UFO Pioneers
episodes.summary: In the 20th century, pioneering scientists, journalists and investigators defied convention and began documenting UFOs; experts in the 21st century look for undeniable proof of extraterrestrial visitation.

episodes.name: The Harmonic Code
episodes.summary: Archaeologists discover that many ancient sites were constructed with an acoustic purpose and often resonate at a frequency that has a profound effect on the human brain; questioning whether ancient people used these sites to contact alien beings.

episodes.name: The Lost City of Peru
episodes.summary: Giorgio A. Tsoukalos, David Childress and William Henry examine a recently discovered lost city in Peru that has upended the historical timeline of South America, revealing that civilization emerged thousands of years earlier than previously thought.

episodes.name: Top 10 Mysterious Sites
episodes.summary: An exploration of the top 10 mysterious sites on the planet that could prove alien visitation; from the age of the dinosaurs and ancient Egypt.

episodes.name: The Top Ten UFO Crashes
episodes.summary: "Ancient Aliens" is counting down ten compelling UFO crashes that have been reported across the globe; from an acorn-shaped object that crashed in the woods of rural Pennsylvania, to a mysterious craft that washed ashore in Japan.

episodes.name: The Mystery of Mount Shasta
episodes.summary: Examining the unique geology and location of Mount Shasta in northern California, to determine why it is known as a hotbed of strange events, from Big Foot sightings to UFO encounters to hikers vanishing without a trace.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Secret Projects
episodes.summary: Counting down ten of compelling and covert projects that study the UFO phenomenon; from clandestine government organizations to agents that silence UFO witnesses and secret programs to reverse engineer alien technology.

episodes.name: Top Ten Alien Encounters
episodes.summary: Counting down the world's top 10 alien encounters, from the first reported abduction event to mass UFO sightings over New York's Hudson Valley to an incident in ancient Rome.

episodes.name: Top Ten Alien Artifacts
episodes.summary: Counting down the top artifacts that could provide evidence that extraterrestrials once walked among us.

episodes.name: The Disclosure Event
episodes.summary: In 2021, the United States government broke a 70-year precedent of denying UFOs and released a groundbreaking report on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena.

episodes.name: Mystery of the Standing Stones
episodes.summary: According to Ancient Astronaut Theorists, the placement of monoliths and their geological makeup could point to extraterrestrial intervention.

episodes.name: Beneath the Sacred Temples
episodes.summary: Some of the world's most iconic, sacred temples were built atop the ruins of structures that are far more ancient; investigating what compelled early humans to rebuild in the same places again and again.

episodes.name: The World on Alert
episodes.summary: Ancient astronaut theorists suggest the evidence for unidentified aerial phenomena has become too great to ignore and that the truth about an extraterrestrial presence on Earth will soon be revealed.

episodes.name: Recovering the Ark of the Covenant
episodes.summary: Some 2,600 years ago, a sacred relic of the ancient world disappeared from history: The Ark of the Covenant; discussing if descriptions of the Ark's power could reveal what it truly is, or if it has a connection to humanity's extraterrestrial past.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Star Ancestors
episodes.summary: Exploring whether ancient accounts of "Star Ancestors" reveal profound truths about both humanity's origins and its future.

episodes.name: Alien Air Force
episodes.summary: Since 2017, the Navy has been releasing photos and videos of unidentified aerial phenomena, and ancient astronaut theorists suggest the images are nearly identical to accounts from centuries ago.

episodes.name: The Shadow People
episodes.summary: Millions of people around the world have reported encountering shadowy entities who instill fear, shortness of breath, and even paralysis; they could be figments of the imagination or visitors from other worlds or dimensions.

episodes.name: Decoding the Dragon Gods
episodes.summary: Throughout the ancient world, tales are told of fire-breathing dragons; though fearsome, they have been worshiped as the bringers of great knowledge and credited as the founders of civilization.

episodes.name: The Time Benders
episodes.summary: Today, more people than ever believe that unidentified flying objects are of alien origin; exploring the possibility that they are capable of bending both time and space.

episodes.name: Ancient Aliens On Location: Incredible Structures
episodes.summary: Giorgio Tsoukalos takes a look back at some of the structures visited all over the world that could provide undeniable evidence of extraterrestrial contact.

episodes.name: Ancient Aliens On Location: Extraordinary Encounters
episodes.summary: A look back at some extraordinary encounters that may provide evidence of an extraterrestrial presence on Earth.

episodes.name: Ancient Aliens On Location: Decoding the Alien Glyphs
episodes.summary: "Ancient Aliens" has examined the oldest and most mysterious rock art on Earth up close, and Giorgio Tsoukalos takes a look back at the incredible hieroglyphs, petroglyphs, and geoglyphs that he believes tell a worldwide story of alien visitation.

episodes.name: Ancient Aliens on Location: The UFO Investigations
episodes.summary: Giorgio Tsoukalos takes a look back at the most compelling investigations of all, and events that he believes represent real encounters with extraterrestrial visitors.

episodes.name: Ancient Aliens on Location: Mysterious Artifacts
episodes.summary: The team investigates the world's oldest and most incredible relics up close; Giorgio Tsoukalos takes a look back at the most mysterious artifacts from all over the globe, those he believes provide undeniable proof of extraterrestrial contact.

episodes.name: Ancient Aliens on Location: Evidence of Alien Life
episodes.summary: Following investigators across the globe as they go to the sites where signs of alien life have been found, Giorgio Tsoukalos takes a look back at incredible evidence that could offer definitive proof that humans are not alone in the universe.

episodes.name: The Shining Ones
episodes.summary: In Ireland, the notion of the fairy folk dates back thousands of years and originates with stories of powerful shining beings who came down from the sky; exploring if these tales have been inspired by ancient alien visitation.

episodes.name: Journey to Immortality
episodes.summary: Discussing whether ancient cultures could have encountered extraterrestrial beings that have achieved eternal life, and discussing the Ancient Astronaut Theorists suggestions.

episodes.name: Secrets of Inner Earth
episodes.summary: In the nearly 2,000-year-old text called "The Zohar," there is a curious passage that describes hidden realms beneath the surface of the Earth, each of which is said to be populated by both human and non-human intelligences.

episodes.name: Return of the Egyptian Gods
episodes.summary: In the 20th century, a mysterious British woman who claimed to be the reincarnation of an ancient Egyptian priestess shocked Egyptologists by accurately locating countless structures and artifacts in the Nile Valley.

episodes.name: The Hotspot Connection
episodes.summary: Up to 70% of UFO sightings happen in hot spots; examining what attracts UFOs and extraterrestrial visitors to these locations.

episodes.name: The Crop Circle Code
episodes.summary: More than 10,000 crop circle formations have been documented in over 50 countries.

episodes.name: Mystery of the Lost Temple
episodes.summary: The discovery of the ancient megalithic site of Karahan Tepe in southern Turkey turns the world of archaeology on its head, displaying engineering skills far beyond what the people of the time were thought to be capable of.

episodes.name: The Power of the Obelisks
episodes.summary: The towering obelisks of ancient Egypt weigh hundreds of tons; while mainstream scholars identify them as monuments to the pharaohs, ancient astronaut theorists suggest they may have served a technological purpose.

episodes.name: The MUFON Files
episodes.summary: The Mutual UFO Network is an organization devoted to the scientific investigation of unidentified aerial phenomena and other unexplained encounters; with more than five decades of investigations, MUFON's extensive database could contain proof.

episodes.name: Cosmic Impacts
episodes.summary: Meteor impacts have altered the world, creating the environment for the rise of humankind and delivering metals essential to an advanced civilization; evidence could reveal that celestial objects have been directed to Earth by alien intelligence.

episodes.name: Close Encounters of the Fifth Kind
episodes.summary: The possibility of direct human contact with extraterrestrial life within the highest levels of the U.S. government.

episodes.name: The Mysteries of Alaska
episodes.summary: The vast Alaskan wilderness is known for mysterious disappearances, electromagnetic anomalies, stories of strange creatures and UFO sightings; Alaska's many mysteries could be due to a presence that is not of this world.

episodes.name: Aliens in Our Airspace
episodes.summary: Terrifying encounters at 40,000 feet; pilot accounts of UFOs taking control of their aircraft; entire jumbo jets disappearing into thin air; since the dawn of aviation, pilots have experienced unexplainable events in the sky.

episodes.name: The Giants of Malta
episodes.summary: Enormous, megalithic structures of mysterious origins; a vast underground complex containing the remains of what some believe to be otherworldly beings; the ancient mysteries that exist on the islands of Malta could be connected to alien visitation.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Pyramid Sites
episodes.summary: "Ancient Aliens" is counting down the world's top 10 pyramid sites, from a valley in Peru with over 250 hidden pyramids to an ancient Greek city with mysterious 4,800-year-old ruins to Egypt's famous Giza Plateau.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Mysterious Devices
episodes.summary: Counting down the world's top 10 mysterious devices, from strange, grooved disks found in a cave in China to an ancient Greek computer to an incredible crystal skull unearthed in Mexico.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Mysterious Islands
episodes.summary: "Ancient Aliens" is counting down the world's top 10 mysterious islands, including sites said to be home to giants, remote landmasses that are home to massive megalithic structures, and even islands that disappear into thin air.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Alien Craft
episodes.summary: "Ancient Aliens" is counting down the top 10 alien craft, from V-shaped objects to orbs of light to flying saucers.

episodes.name: Edgar Cayce: The Sleeping Prophet
episodes.summary: In the early 1900s, Edgar Cayce, a modern-day prophet from the hills of Kentucky, becomes a worldwide sensation; he claims to receive visions of the past and future, he heals the sick, and alleges to have encounters with otherworldly beings.

episodes.name: The Gods of Greece
episodes.summary: Whether the gods of Greece including Zeus, Apollo and Poseidon from Mt. Olympus were extraterrestrial visitors to Earth.

episodes.name: The New UFO Hunters
episodes.summary: In the 21st century, UFOs have gone from fringe science to mainstream obsession; a new generation of UFO hunters employ technology, and unidentified flying objects are openly investigated by the government.

episodes.name: The Power of the Talisman
episodes.summary: For thousands of years, people have held the belief that everyday objects can possess hidden energy; talismans are seen to provide protection, good fortune, and some are thought to embody a higher power.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Mysteries of the Deep
episodes.summary: Counting down 10 mysteries of the deep, from sunken continents to puzzling ruins on the ocean floor and even artifacts that might be remnants of Atlantis; these underwater mysteries could provide a record of extraterrestrial visitation.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Alien Petroglyphs
episodes.summary: "Ancient Aliens" is looking at alien petroglyphs around the world; from strange, human-like figures to flying craft and carvings of what appear to be astronauts.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Alien Influencers
episodes.summary: Giorgio Tsoukalos looks at mysterious teachers who have appeared throughout history, including a biblical patriarch, a race of fish-people and Egypt's most controversial Pharaoh.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Extraordinary Creatures
episodes.summary: Giorgio Tsoukalos takes a look back at the top 10 reports of encounters with strange and mysterious beasts that have been investigated on "Ancient Aliens."

episodes.name: The Top Ten Hidden Alien Bases
episodes.summary: Counting down the top 10 locations around the world that may be hiding alien bases, including a cavern beneath the ice of Antarctica, a lake in China that is a hotspot for UFOs, and a pyramid under the slopes of Mount Denali.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Scariest Encounters
episodes.summary: Counting down the top 10 scariest encounters that just might be evidence of extraterrestrial visitation, from an encounter in rural Texas that left onlookers with unexplainable injuries, to mysterious cattle mutilations, and more.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Alien Codes
episodes.summary: Counting down 10 intriguing symbols and codes found across the globe that might contain proof of otherworldly contact; from glyphs in the Peruvian desert, to spiral petroglyphs embedded with advanced math, and a language with an unexplained origin.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Alien Disasters
episodes.summary: Counting down the top 10 devastating disasters that might have an otherworldly connection; from a flying monster at a nuclear incident, a meteor that wiped out the dinosaurs, and a deadly virus that might be from another world.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Sumerians
episodes.summary: More than 7,000 years ago, the ancient Sumerians established what is considered the world's first civilization; but it may be possible that these powerful beings were, in fact, extraterrestrial visitors.

episodes.name: The UFO Superhighway
episodes.summary: Along the Earth's north 37th parallel, there have been so many reports of unidentified flying objects, animal mutilations, and other mysterious events that it has been dubbed The UFO Superhighway.

episodes.name: Mysteries of Scotland
episodes.summary: For thousands of years, Scotland has been an epicenter of otherworldly phenomena; it is home to mysterious ancient stone circles, stories of strange beings, and is a major hotspot for UFO sightings.

episodes.name: Mystery of the Stone Spheres
episodes.summary: Throughout the world there are mysterious ancient stones shaped into perfect spheres; many of them show clear evidence of being manmade and some completely defy explanation; the mystery of the stone spheres could provide clues about humankind's past.

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Maya
episodes.summary: Considered by many to be the greatest civilization in the history of the Americas, the Maya thrived for more than 2,000 years; today new evidence is being discovered that completely upends our understanding of this ancient culture, and might provide evidence that the Maya came in contact with extraterrestrial visitors.

episodes.name: Unlocking the Stargates
episodes.summary: For thousands of years, cultures around the world have held a belief in stargates through which beings have traveled to Earth from distant points in the universe and even other dimensions.

episodes.name: The Whistleblowers
episodes.summary: For decades, incredible claims have been made about an extraterrestrial presence on Earth, and the government has gone to great lengths to discredit them.

episodes.name: The Search For Extraterrestrial Intelligence
episodes.summary: For thousands of years, humankind has attempted to make contact with beings from beyond Earth; now, the search for extraterrestrial intelligence is ramping up, with new technologies allowing individuals to explore the universe.

episodes.name: Jacques Vallée: UFO Pioneer
episodes.summary: On Jacques Vallee's work in the field of UFOs and his theories on alien life.

episodes.name: The Teachers
episodes.summary: Stories of god-like beings providing instruction to early humans, helping establish the first civilizations; exploring if mysterious figures who appear throughout history provide evidence that these otherworldly teachers have been here all along.

episodes.name: Egypt's Giant Tombs
episodes.summary: Deep beneath the sands of Egypt lie 24 enormous sarcophagi, and every one of them is empty; discussing what purpose those giant tombs had served.

episodes.name: The Linda Moulton Howe Files
episodes.summary: For more than four decades, award-winning journalist Linda Moulton Howe has covered the most mysterious phenomena on Earth. Could her investigations on everything from bizarre animal deaths to crop formations and alien abductions lead us to a profound new reality?

episodes.name: The Chosen
episodes.summary: From biblical patriarchs to modern day alien abductees, throughout history, there have been people who claimed to have contact with otherworldly beings; often bearing important messages for humanity.

episodes.name: Resurrecting Puma Punku
episodes.summary: Puma Punku in Bolivia features stone blocks, each carved with precision; the blocks lie scattered across the landscape, confusing archaeologists as to what the ancient site might have been.

episodes.name: The Top Ten Extraordinary Discoveries
episodes.summary: Counting down 10 discoveries that challenge traditional beliefs about human history, from a lost city hidden in the Andes to mysterious metal spheres that are not of this world and a sunken city that is said to be the home of the gods.

episodes.name: The Glowing Orb Phenomenon
episodes.summary: Counting down ten unexplainable technologies in history, from mysterious golden orbs discovered in Mexico and a sacred wooden box that could communicate with the heavens to an ancient tomb that is said to depict an astronaut.

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Aztecs
episodes.summary: The Aztecs have built a powerful and feared empire, and they have claimed that they were guided by a pantheon of more than a thousand gods who came to Earth from different parts of the universe.

episodes.name: The Glowing Orb Phenomenon
episodes.summary: Across the globe, reports of mysterious glowing orbs are on the rise; their movements frequently defy the laws of physics, and now they are even being reported near military bases, ships, and nuclear weapon facilities.

episodes.name: The Legacy of J. Allen Hynek
episodes.summary: Dr. J. Allen Hynek was a pioneering scientist who developed smart weapons, optical tracking systems and space satellites; yet he is best known as the notorious government UFO debunker who became one of the founding fathers of ufology.

episodes.name: The Volcano Factor
episodes.summary: Volcanoes have inspired countless myths and legends, but curiously, they are also major hotspots for UFO sightings; is it possible that these geological formations, which can generate great energy, are attracting otherworldly visitors?

episodes.name: The Birdman Mystery
episodes.summary: Throughout the ancient world, there are depictions of mysterious figures that appear to be half human and half bird. In many cultures, they are revered as divine and have magical abilities. But could these so-called Birdmen have truly existed? And if so, just what were they?

episodes.name: The Abduction Files
episodes.summary: All over the world, there are people who claim they have been abducted by aliens; since the 1970s, a growing number of researchers have dedicated their lives to uncover what is behind this disturbing phenomenon.

episodes.name: The Giants
episodes.summary: Examining how thousands of years ago, people all over the world described encounters with enormous, human-like beings; exploring how some archaeologists claim to have found skeletons of extraordinary size; is it possible the giants actually existed?

episodes.name: Aliens in Our Midst
episodes.summary: In the age of smartphones and social media, more evidence of otherworldly activity has come to light than ever before.

episodes.name: Britain's UFO Files
episodes.summary: From ancient sites like Stonehenge to the crop circle phenomenon and modern-day UFO sightings, Great Britain is a place of mysteries; exploring if throughout history this island has been a destination for extraterrestrial visitors.

episodes.name: Mysteries of the Norse Gods
episodes.summary: The ancient legends of the Norse read like modern science-fiction, with powerful gods wielding mythic weapons and high technology.

episodes.name: Secrets of Japan
episodes.summary: Japan is a land rich with ancient mysteries, and it has also become known as a UFO hotspot.

episodes.name: Skulls of the Gods
episodes.summary: In every corner of the world, archaeologists have found strange, elongated skulls; did our ancestors modify the shape of their skulls to resemble extraterrestrial visitors?; and might it even be possible that some of these skulls are of otherworldly origin?

episodes.name: Egypt's Lost Pyramids
episodes.summary: High above the Giza Plateau stands Egypt's most mysterious ancient site: the Lost Pyramid of Abu Rawash; today, it lies in ruins, but some researchers believe these stone blocks hold profound secrets about an extraterrestrial civilization that existed in Ancient Egypt long before our recorded history.

episodes.name: Island of the Gods
episodes.summary: Oceania contains remote Pacific islands featuring massive stone structures and strange statuary; local legends describe otherworldly visitors, adding to the mystery of these ancient sites.

episodes.name: Extraterrestrial Engineering
episodes.summary: Host Giorgio Tsoukalos explores ancient structures that defy conventional explanation; from the precisely cut stone blocks at Puma Punku to the temples of Malta and the megalithic city of Nan Madol, could these mysterious sites contain evidence of extraterrestrial contact in the distant past?

episodes.name: UFO Hot Spots
episodes.summary: Found along the California coast to New York's Hudson Valley and Northern England to Southern Chile, could these mysterious locations provide evidence of an extraterrestrial presence on Earth?

episodes.name: Mysterious Monuments
episodes.summary: Host Giorgio Tsoukalos explores the series archives to investigate mysterious moments that just might contain an extraterrestrial connection; from a stone circle in Turkey that challenges the timeline of human history to gigantic stone spheres in Bosnia and Egypt's most unusual tombs, could these monuments provide proof of extraterrestrial visitation?

episodes.name: Underwater Alien Bases
episodes.summary: Examining maritime folklore regarding aquatic entities and reviewing contemporary reports of unidentified aerial phenomena over oceanic regions and investigating whether deep-sea environments host undocumented anomalies.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Vedas
episodes.summary: Ancient scriptures called the Vedas form the foundation of Hinduism. These manuscripts are thousands of years old and describe a time when Earth was inhabited by gods who traveled the skies in flying machines and possessed extraordinary technology. Might the secrets of the Vedas reveal the truth about extraterrestrial contact in the distant past?

episodes.name: Wars of the Gods
episodes.summary: Examining alternative history theories regarding ancient myths of celestial conflicts and investigating whether geological formations match the descriptions of ancient battlefields found in folklore.

episodes.name: UFO Sightings
episodes.summary: Host Giorgio Tsoukalos probes the series archives to present the most compelling UFO SIGHTINGS. From footage of extraordinary aircraft taken by fighter pilots to a strange object filmed flying over a military base in Iraq and mysterious glowing orbs that are reported all over the world, are these remarkable sightings evidence of extraterrestrial visitation?

episodes.name: Alien A.I.
episodes.summary: Examining how researchers use artificial intelligence to analyze historical data and evaluate claims of extraterrestrial activity.

episodes.name: Hidden Messages
episodes.summary: Host Giorgio Tsoukalos examines series archives to investigate theories of historical extraterrestrial contact; the broadcast reviews aerial geoglyphs, crop circles and mathematical codes embedded in ancient global architecture to assess claims of early astronomical communication.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Amazon
episodes.summary: A documentary examines how researchers utilize remote-sensing technology, such as lidar, to map previously undocumented ancient urban networks beneath the Amazon canopy; the broadcast investigates alternative history theories regarding potential extraterrestrial influence at these newly mapped archaeological sites, evaluating whether the design of these pre-Columbian settlements aligns with ancient astronomical patterns or cosmic structures.

episodes.name: Spy Gadgets
episodes.summary: In the jungles of Vietnam, the U.S. military built sensors that could sniff out hidden enemies. A CIA operation hauled a nuclear-powered surveillance device to the summit of a Himalayan mountain. And at the height of the Cold War, the Soviet Union slipped a covert listening device inside a seemingly innocent gift presented by schoolchildren to the United States. Sometimes the most dangerous weapon in the room is the one nobody realizes is there.

episodes.name: Alien Investigators
episodes.summary: Host Giorgio Tsoukalos opens the series archives to celebrate ALIEN INVESTIGATORS that have been brave enough to ask the question, Are we alone in the universe? From a hardened skeptic turned true believer, a fearless reporter who investigated high strangeness, and a hotel manager who discovered otherworldly clues hidden in the distant past, could these investigators have uncovered proof of an alien presence on Earth?

episodes.name: Africa's Extraterrestrial Contact
episodes.summary: The origins of humanity can be traced back to Africa, and some of the oldest religious traditions across the continent describe mysterious beings who descended from the sky in thunderous vehicles. Could it be that the ancient mythology of Africa describes our first encounters with extraterrestrials?

episodes.name: Back in the Day
episodes.summary: In 1991 in South Jamaica, Queens, 15-year-old Kanan Stark is eager to join his family's growing drug business that is led by his mother, Raquel Raq Thomas.

episodes.name: Reaping and Sowing
episodes.summary: After a rival crew member is killed, Raq does whatever is necessary to get the target off Kanan's back.

episodes.name: Stick and Move
episodes.summary: Still reeling from a shocking death, Kanan pushes his way into the drug game with Marvin's help while Raq plots to take down her competition.

episodes.name: Don't Sleep
episodes.summary: All bets are off when a police raid clears out Raq's competition; promises are broken, secrets are revealed, and revenge is swift.

episodes.name: Choose Your Battles
episodes.summary: Eager to transform her business after the stash house is hit, Raq overhauls her operation; Kanan is detained after a fight with Scrappy.

episodes.name: Level Up
episodes.summary: Lou's new artist showcase becomes the nexus of the rivalry between Raq and Unique; Kanan cooks up a drug-selling scheme with Marvin.

episodes.name: Stay in Your Lane
episodes.summary: Kanan and Marvin's side hustle goes awry; Raq seeks revenge for the attack on Scrappy; Jukebox suffers a devastating blow.

episodes.name: The Cost of Business
episodes.summary: Kanan struggles after word gets back to Raq that he's behind the bad crack on the streets.

episodes.name: Loyal to the End
episodes.summary: As Marvin seeks revenge, Raq turns to Kanan for assistance only he can provide.

episodes.name: Paid in Full
episodes.summary: As the situation in the neighborhood turns dire, Raq scrambles to get Kanan out of harm's way.

episodes.name: The More Things Change
episodes.summary: Kanan returns to Queens where Raq tries to mend the many fractures in the Thomas family; as Raq expands her empire, Kanan doubts his future in the drug game; Detective Howard gets released from the hospital.

episodes.name: Mind Your Business
episodes.summary: Raq learns she may have a snitch and tasks Marvin with confirming the rumor; Lou brings in a potential new artist, but he and Crown disagree; Kanan helps Famous sell mix tapes; Jukebox tracks down her estranged mother.

episodes.name: Sleeping Dogs
episodes.summary: A surprise encounter with Howard leaves Kanan speechless; Raquel tries to settle in new territory, but while investigating a missing business associate with her money, she meets an old adversary.

episodes.name: Pay the Toll
episodes.summary: Kanan and Jukebox search for answers in family matters; when Raq's push into new territory stalls, she proposes a meeting; Crown helps Famous get settled; Still investigating Howard's shooting, Burke questions Unique.

episodes.name: What Happens in the Catskills
episodes.summary: Raq focuses on mother-son bonding with Kanan in the Catskills, but they get interrupted when business follows them; Crown disrespects Lou, bringing their simmering beef to a boil; Burke digs into Howard's personal life.

episodes.name: It's a Business, Man
episodes.summary: Raq assures everyone they need to follow orders and keep working as planned; Kanan takes on more responsibility, but things go wrong when he runs into neighborhood kids; Lou feels the pressure in his partnership with Crown.

episodes.name: No Love Lost
episodes.summary: A botched agreement with Marvin and an associate threatens everything; Burke gains traction in her investigation, and Raq searches for a new house.

episodes.name: A House Is Not a Home
episodes.summary: The rift between Raq and Kanan grows and Kanan seeks comfort elsewhere; Marvin lies low, waiting for the consequences of his actions to blow over, and Raq sees dark clouds on the horizon.

episodes.name: Anti-Trust
episodes.summary: With his living situation threatened, Famous reaches out to Lou as a last-ditch effort; Raq receives a new business proposal and eliminates a threat; Burke closes in on what really happened in Baisley Park.

episodes.name: If Y'Don't Know, Now Y'Know
episodes.summary: Decidedly his own man, Kanan strays further from his mother and sets up shop on his own on the corners of South Jamaica; worried about retaliation, Raq questions Unique; Lou's rift with Raq grows when he makes a discovery.

episodes.name: Home Sweet Home
episodes.summary: Raq makes a life-changing decision in the aftermath of the Mafia's ambush, but it's too little, too late for Kanan, as he looks to pave his own path free of his mother's lies.

episodes.name: Flipmode
episodes.summary: Raq continues her farewell tour with one last job for the Mafia while Kanan dives further into the drug game with an innovative business idea; Howard faces a new threat at the precinct.

episodes.name: Open For Business
episodes.summary: As paranoia sets in for Raq and Howard over the Task Force, Kanan and Famous launch their weed delivery business, Jukebox prepares for her audition, and Ronnie grows impatient with Unique.

episodes.name: In Sheep's Clothing
episodes.summary: New business ventures take shape for the Thomas family, but the outlook is bleaker for the Mathis brothers as Ronnie's patience runs out; Raq makes a risky move for Kanan's obedience.

episodes.name: Brothers and Keepers
episodes.summary: Tension between Ronnie and Unique comes to a head while Kanan clashes with both Raq and Famous; Juke bonds with her bandmate, and Lou works to revitalize Café Vous. Howard's attempt to manipulate the Task Force backfires.

episodes.name: Into the Darkness
episodes.summary: Dangerous secrets are revealed as Famous unburdens himself to Kanan, and Raq finally tries to make amends with Lou; Marvin struggles with his role as stage dad, and Howard attempts to get closer to the Task Force.

episodes.name: Where All Are Guilty
episodes.summary: Lou's drinking creates a problem for the whole family when Shantel goes looking for justice; Kanan assimilates into Ronnie's crew, and Raq formulates a new plan for Unique's former heroin operation.

episodes.name: Reckonings
episodes.summary: As a despondent Lou becomes a liability for the family, Raq and Marvin work to get the new heroin operation up and running amidst new competition from Kanan and Ronnie.

episodes.name: Home to Roost
episodes.summary: Ronnie and Kanan's feud with Raq intensifies as Marvin desperately searches for Lou; Famous and Jukebox find themselves at a turning point.

episodes.name: Made You Look
episodes.summary: Desperation sets in as Howard tries to evade the Task Force and Ronnie goes on the attack, leaving Raq and Kanan to make some fateful choices.

episodes.name: Gangstas Don't Die
episodes.summary: Unique endures a painful recovery fueled by hate and vengeance as other untold narratives unfold around him, filling the gaps leading up to the deadly showdown in the season three finale.

episodes.name: It's All Love
episodes.summary: Kanan and Raq navigate a new business relationship just as Unique begins to plot his quest for revenge; Lou considers a new music opportunity; Marvin goes too far on a side-job for Stefano; Juke tries to adjust to life in the Army.

episodes.name: Bygones
episodes.summary: Raq and Marvin face the aftermath of Unique's violent, clandestine comeback; Lou manages his new artist; Kanan gets through to his grandmother; Juke embraces her sexuality.

episodes.name: The Way We Were
episodes.summary: Unique forms an unlikely alliance in his vendetta against Raq while she inches closer to a new drug enterprise; Kanan takes advice from Snaps and Pop, and Jukebox's new friendship leads to a violent encounter.

episodes.name: The Nail That Sticks Up
episodes.summary: Raq and Marvin navigate a dwindling supply of product, while Lou and Imani scout artists together; Joyce's condition worsens; Famous's mother desperately tries to find him.

episodes.name: The Price of Fame
episodes.summary: Raq tries to overcome Marvin's poor judgment; Kanan recruits Jukebox to help him to get justice for his friend; Unique assembles the final pieces of his plan.

episodes.name: Allow Me to Re-introduce Myself
episodes.summary: Unique and his soldiers assume control of the corners in Queens, leaving Raq and Marvin in desperate need of more answers and more product; Kanan searches for a missing O-Cee.

episodes.name: Street Struck
episodes.summary: Raq goes on the offensive as Marvin and Lou attempt to contain the escalating situations; Jukebox joins the search for O-Cee, while Kanan looks into his theory on what happened to Famous.

episodes.name: It's About That Time
episodes.summary: Kanan investigates Krystal's disappearance; Raq faces fallout from Unique's retaliation and Marvin's mistake; Jukebox revisits her past; Lou embraces his new path.

episodes.name: Gimme the Weight
episodes.summary: A devastated Kanan furiously searches for answers and revenge; Raq attempts to stave off the collapse of her business as she and Lou prepare for a possible war with Unique.

episodes.name: By Blood
episodes.summary: Kanan makes a move that changes the Thomas family forever; Unique tries to regain a foothold in Queens as Breeze's new drug enterprise takes shape.

episodes.name: Many Men
episodes.summary: Stefano goes into business with Snaps, Pop, Breeze and Kanan, while Raq forms her own new alliances; Marvin hunts for Unique, who's quickly losing his grasp on South Jamaica.

episodes.name: Tricks
episodes.summary: Raq and Marvin launch their new operation as Kanan and Breeze's business grows stronger; Jukebox takes a big risk to protect the family.

episodes.name: Pawns & Rooks
episodes.summary: Raq's war with Kanan, Breeze and Stefano grows increasingly violent; Kanan's deception of Tiana escalates; Jukebox's misstep leaves her under threat.

episodes.name: School of War
episodes.summary: Raq and Marvin navigate a precarious situation; Kanan and Breeze deepen their partnership; Jukebox hatches a plan.

episodes.name: Dark Matter
episodes.summary: Kanan and Tiana's relationship takes a turn; Garcia makes a bold move to get Juke her answers.

episodes.summary: Fifteen-year-old Kanan Stark is eager to join his family's growing drug business in the 1990s South Jamaica, Queens.

episodes.name: A Lottery Winner's Dog House
episodes.summary: A couple wants to find a home near Stillwater, Minn., with an open floor plan and a barn in which to train German Shepherds.

episodes.name: New Jersey Minister Finds a Dream Home That Doubles as a Wedding Venue
episodes.summary: Lottery winners must choose between "Old Indian Estate," "Llewellyn Carriage House," and "The Ryerson."

episodes.name: Scratch Me Lucky California Dream Home
episodes.summary: After winning money on a scratch-off ticket, jackpot winners search for their dream home by the waterfront.

episodes.name: Second Chance Draw
episodes.summary: A couple from Ohio look for their dream home in a nice neighborhood to raise their son.

episodes.name: Florida Estate Agent Searches for a Dream Home With a View
episodes.summary: A Florida real estate agent wants to find his million dollar dream home in Jacksonville, Fla., but may decide to buy more than one property.

episodes.name: Hamptons Dream Home
episodes.summary: Lottery winners search for their dream home in the Hamptons, and they have a huge wish list that includes a mother-in-law suite and many bathrooms.

episodes.name: Downtown Dream Home
episodes.summary: A young woman wants to find a modern bachelorette pad in downtown Indianapolis that she can style herself.

episodes.name: Work-Weary Parents Use Their 1 Million Dollar Lottery Win to Buy a Family Vacation Dream Home
episodes.summary: A busy family wants to use lottery winnings to buy a waterfront vacation home in Gulf Shores, Alabama.

episodes.name: Vegas Dream Home
episodes.summary: After winning money on a scratch ticket, a retired boxer wants to find a house in Las Vegas for his family.

episodes.summary: With their tiny Columbus, Ohio, house overflowing with "stuff," a jackpot-winning couple wants to find their dream home.

episodes.name: Little Sister, Big House
episodes.summary: When a work colleague wanted to take a chance on some lottery scratchers, Ashley was happy to join in; $1 million later, Ashley can move out of her rental in Cape Girardeau, Mo., and buy her first home with her winnings.

episodes.name: Tallahassee Dream Team
episodes.summary: Shane won $1 million on a scratcher, so he and his partner, Crystal are searching for a dream home in Tallahassee, Fla.; Crystal wants a beautiful home that's move-in ready, and Shane wants a huge yard for their two dogs.

episodes.name: Texas Beach House
episodes.summary: After becoming a millionaire on a Vegas slot machine, Rick immediately bought his own dream home; now David Bromstad joins him in Galveston, Texas, to help him spend his extra cash on a Texas Beach House for the whole family.

episodes.name: My Lottery Dream Stable
episodes.summary: With bonus scenes; a family searches for a dream home with a horse stable after winning $5 million dollars on a lottery scratcher.

episodes.summary: After the rise of Silicon Valley, a couple in nearby San Jose, Calif., that never owned a home thought they would rent forever until he won $1 million on a scratch-off; David Bromstad is ready to help them find their dream home.

episodes.name: Athol Family Dream Home

episodes.name: Beginner's Luck
episodes.summary: A lottery skeptic won $1 million on the first scratch ticket she ever bought; now, with the help of property ace David Bromstad, she and her husband set out to buy the perfect retirement palace in sunny Florida.

episodes.name: Luck of the Irish
episodes.summary: Bill and Eric hit the jackpot on the St. Patrick's Day lottery and couldn't believe their good luck; the happy couple and their twins need David's help finding a larger family home on Chicago's classy North Shore.

episodes.name: Champaign Moments
episodes.summary: After purchasing a scratch card at a local garage and winning a million dollars, Scott and Paige are looking to upgrade their family home in Champaign, Ill.; David Bromstad sets out with the couple to help them find the perfect property.

episodes.summary: A self-confessed computer nerd finally came up with a $1 million win after consistently spending $6 a week on lottery tickets; it's up to David Bromstad to help him find the perfect bachelor pad in the historic seaside town of Milford, Conn.

episodes.name: Wild Wish Lists
episodes.summary: David takes a trip to the Cape to help a family find a main-road hideaway; he travels up the coast to Scituate, Mass., to help a woman find a cozy cottage; David helps an Illinois couple find a place with plenty of storage for Christmas decorations.

episodes.name: A Hero's Reward
episodes.summary: After lady luck rewards a retired firefighter for a lifetime of service with a big win, dream-home hunter David Bromstad helps him search for the perfect bachelor pad in the Lakeland region of Florida.

episodes.name: Cabin Fever
episodes.summary: A $5 million lottery win has one lucky New York woman looking for a lakefront vacation cottage where she can relax with her girlfriends; although she wants to keep it simple, David steps in to find some perfect properties in the majestic Adirondacks.

episodes.name: A Place on Pamlico Sound
episodes.summary: After scratching her way to a million-dollar win, a woman and her husband upsize their retirement plans to include a place on the shores of Pamlico Sound in North Carolina; David Bromstad helps them navigate one of the largest lagoons.

episodes.name: Million-Dollar Baby

episodes.name: Seven Million Big Ones

episodes.name: Cashed Up in Cartersville

episodes.name: Oh, My Goodness

episodes.name: Rags to Riches

episodes.name: California Dreams

episodes.name: Cabin Fever

episodes.name: Mega Secrets Revealed: Lucky in Louisville

episodes.name: Mega Secrets Revealed: Young and Rich
episodes.summary: David Bromstad helps a young Massachusetts bachelor, who scratched his way to a $4 million win, fulfill his dreams of going from tenant to landlord.

episodes.name: Mega Secrets Revealed: Tallahassee Dream Team
episodes.summary: David Bromstad helps a couple from Tallahassee, Fla., find a beautiful, new home after they win a million-dollar jackpot.

episodes.name: Mega Secrets Revealed: A Family Fortune
episodes.summary: A couple is ready to move their family of seven out of a cramped apartment after their life-changing, $750,000 win.
