episodes.summary: A Wisconsin woman doesn't hit the lottery, but she hits the jackpot with a savvy investment that pays off to the tune of eight figures; David has the largest budget he's ever been given and looks to find her the ultimate lakefront mega-mansion.

episodes.name: Family Bonds
episodes.summary: Siblings inherited money from their late brother, and after finding one a home in Palm Springs, David's ready to help the other locate a place of his own; it's a desert oasis exploration as David hunts for a stunner in the Coachella Valley.

episodes.name: Below Dock
episodes.summary: A woman is left an inheritance from her parents and decides to honor their memory by buying a generational vacation home on the Emerald Coast; David embarks on a pilgrimage for perfection as he searches for some real waterfront showstoppers.

episodes.name: Scratch Offs: Rolling in It on the Texas Plains
episodes.summary: David helps a stargazing couple who won $3.5 million find their dream home just outside of Lubbock, TX.

episodes.name: Small Town, Big Dreams
episodes.summary: After winning $1 million on a scratcher, a couple is ready to find a home outside their tiny town of Wilmot, Ohio; David Bromstad searches surrounding areas for a home that has a big yard for their grandson and two Jack Russell terriers to enjoy.

episodes.name: Newlywed and Cashed Up in Richmond
episodes.summary: After winning two million dollars, a couple is on the hunt for a big and flashy forever family home; with flamboyant outfits and dance moves, David arrives to discover brand-new communities south of Richmond where he searches for a gem of a house.

episodes.name: The Gold Lady of Naples
episodes.summary: After already spending over $5 million on her dream lake house in Wisconsin, a woman now asks David to find a dream vacation home in Naples, Florida; she's bringing her sister along, as David looks for super-bougie properties in luxury golfing communities.

episodes.name: Low Country Comfort
episodes.summary: Connecticut teachers struck it lucky just when they are ready to retire; David helps realize their dream of finding a forever home in the beach loving, low country of South Carolina where there is lots of water, boating and scenery.

episodes.name: Pensacola Peanuts
episodes.summary: Gold star do-gooders who have struggled financially scratch up a $5 million win, and they barely know what to do with it; David steps in to make sure they spend some money on themselves and help find their dream home in Pensacola, Florida.

episodes.name: Happy Dance in Tennessee
episodes.summary: Previous $1 million winners call on David to help find a second dream home near Nashville; they're looking for a picturesque place that's quiet and close to family, but the hardest part is deciding on a house while performing their happy dance.

episodes.name: Pine Island Prince and Princess
episodes.summary: Santa delivers big when a Massachusetts couple finally scratches off a $4 million win on Christmas Day; they want a vacation spot that can eventually be their retirement home, so they're enlisting David to find the perfect place.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Armed with large bank accounts and fantasies of living in mansions bigger than city blocks, lottery winners search for new homes.

episodes.name: Scratch Offs: Hot Springs Party Palace
episodes.summary: With bonus features and pop-ups, after receiving an inheritance, David helps a mother and son honor a loved one with the party palace he always wanted in Hot Springs, Arkansas.

episodes.name: Hot Springs Party Palace
episodes.summary: After receiving an inheritance, a mother and son look to honor a loved one with the vacation party palace he always wanted in Hot Springs, Ark.; David arrives to search for lake front properties big enough to accommodate a family.

episodes.name: Mega Mountain Dreams
episodes.summary: A couple missed winning a $1.6 billion jackpot by one number, but they did have all the numbers to win $1 million dollars; now, they're calling on David to help realize their dream of owning a mountain lodge in the forests of New Hampshire.

episodes.name: Brent's Bounty
episodes.summary: For someone who rarely plays the lottery, a single dad strikes it lucky when a scratcher wins him $10 million; after taking care of his loved ones, he turns to David to find a family dream home with a sparkling pool in Visalia, Calif.

episodes.name: My Lottery Scream Cabin
episodes.summary: A couple scratch off a $2 million winner and are ready to escape the heat of Florida summers; they send David on the hunt for a big holiday cabin in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Georgia.

episodes.name: Starlicious Gazing
episodes.summary: After an unexpected windfall from selling the family farm, a New York couple now has the funds to relocate to Port St. Lucie, Fla.; she wants a place to host new friends while he wants remote and quiet.

episodes.name: Jacksonville Jackpot
episodes.summary: A woman's gamble pays off to the tune of $1 million dollars after she purchased an entire book of scratchers; she and her wife are ready to find their first home in Jacksonville, Florida, and David's got some gated community stunners to choose from.

episodes.name: Greener Pastures
episodes.summary: After hitting a $926,000 jackpot, a 34-year Chicago police officer is ready to find her dream home outside the city in Crete, Ill.; David finds some properties with sprawling backyards and plenty of room for her nine grandkids to share!

episodes.name: Madame Marjorie
episodes.summary: David is on a journey to meet a California couple looking to make a fresh start in the Champagne region of France; it's a romantic and gastronomical tour of French countryside as David searches for a dream holiday home just outside of Paris.

episodes.name: BFF Bonanza
episodes.summary: Left with an inheritance, a woman and her husband are ready to find a dream home near friends and family in Richmond, Texas. She's taking her BFF of 50 years along as David searches for a house big enough for all their Grand-chicks to play and stay.

episodes.name: Melbourne Beach Hub-Life
episodes.summary: Living most of the time on the road in their RV, a couple's using an inheritance to find a place near the beach in Melbourne, Fla.; they look for a hub where they can rest and store their gear.

episodes.name: I Have a Dream
episodes.summary: After winning $1 million on a scratcher, a couple's ready to buy their first home in Rocky Mount, N.C.; David's on the hunt for homes full of charm and character.

episodes.name: Ozark Lake House
episodes.summary: After winning a hefty $250,000 on a scratcher, David helps a couple find their dream lake house in the Missouri Ozarks!

episodes.name: One for the Kids
episodes.summary: A couple with two young children were living paycheck to paycheck when their lives turn around with a $700,000 win; after a little splurging, they're asking David to help them find a forever home for their kids in Kankakee County, Ill.

episodes.name: Palm Springs Heaven
episodes.summary: After a $1.6 million Powerball win, a couple's ready to buy a home in their favorite vacation spot in Palm Springs, Calif.; they're ready to splurge, and they're calling on David to find a place their families can gather to carry on traditions.

episodes.name: Snowbirds in Florida
episodes.summary: An Ohio couple happily starting their retirement wins the lottery again, and this time it's a $5 million score! Now, they're calling on David to find a holiday house in Florida that's near the beach.

episodes.name: Totally Tucson
episodes.summary: After receiving an inheritance from his aunt, a man looks to retire early and fulfill his dream of owning a luxurious bed and breakfast; with a substantial budget, David has some sensational options with casitas and cacti in Tucson, Arizona.

episodes.name: Lottery Strikes Twice
episodes.summary: A Boston native knew she was lucky when she won a million, but now she scored a whopping $25 million on a scratcher.

episodes.name: Peace at Fort Pierce
episodes.summary: After relying on the help of friends and family, a woman needs a suitable place for her disabled husband; David's ready to find their dream home in Fort Pierce, Fla.

episodes.name: Back to the Beach
episodes.summary: Catching up with winners since filming; revisiting a North Carolina beach house; going dumpster diving in Virginia; hearing a scandalous behind-the-scenes story about a make-out session from a season one winner.

episodes.name: Double Dip
episodes.summary: Lottery winners have outgrown their California dream home, and now they're ready to find a bigger place in the Las Vegas suburbs; they're looking for lots of outdoor space, but for David, finding a Vegas home with a large lot may be a challenge.

episodes.name: Sarasota Scratcher
episodes.summary: After scratching off a $100,000 jackpot, a Sarasota woman is finally ready to find a place of her own; she's dreaming of something spacious near white sand beaches, and she's calling on David to help bust her out of a rental and into a dream home.

episodes.name: The Second Time Around
episodes.summary: When a Long Island couple relocates to North Carolina, life takes an unexpected turn; after facing a series of setbacks, a turning point comes with an inheritance from her late mother, a timely windfall that offers them the chance to start over.

episodes.name: Golden State of Mind
episodes.summary: After selling their Georgia vacation home, a couple's ready to level up with a luxe new summer home in San Diego; with David house hunting there for the first time, they're about to discover one of California's hottest markets.

episodes.name: A Lottery Dream Desert Oasis
episodes.summary: Already purchasing his family's dream home after scoring big on a $250,000 scratcher, a man strikes lucky again with a $1 million win; now, he's calling on David to brave the heat and search for a bigger, dream desert oasis in Casa Grande, Arizona.

episodes.name: A New New Jersey
episodes.summary: After receiving a life-changing inheritance, a man is ready to find a New Jersey dream home; he's spent 30 years in Washington, DC, and now he's ready to return to his home state and hopes David can help find his forever home.

episodes.name: Big Bucks in Boca Raton
episodes.summary: David Bromstad is on the hunt yet again for a couple in Boca Raton, Fla.; this is the third dream home they've called on David to find and now, David's wondering if he's doing something very wrong or very right!

episodes.name: Alabama Awaits
episodes.summary: Some windfalls come by chance, some with love and some through hard work; after nine years of medical school, a newly minted doctor and his wife search for an Alabama home they never thought possible.

episodes.name: Best Friends and Helping to Spend
episodes.summary: After a million lottery win, a mother can now help her eldest daughter buy a starter home.

episodes.name: Ojai Homecoming
episodes.summary: After tragically losing their beloved son and brother, a mother and her daughter use the proceeds of his estate to reunite in Ojai, California; David arrives to help the pair find a suitable place for farming herbs and fruit trees in his honor.

episodes.name: Casa Rica, the Essence of Dreams
episodes.summary: Former housekeepers have built a cleaning empire, and now they're ready to find a $5 million luxury vacation home in Costa Rica. With one of the biggest budgets ever, David Bromstad shows some epic homes with stunning water views!

episodes.name: Polka Dots and Palm Trees
episodes.summary: David Bromstad revisits some of his most unforgettable winners; it's an Ohio couple with a retro-chic home, a sun-soaked Florida mansion and the generous Buffalo family who shared their jackpot and kept the dream alive for everyone.

episodes.name: Midwest Charm to Gulf Shores Paradise
episodes.summary: David Bromstad checks in with past winners to see how they've grown into their dream homes; there's a cozy Ohio family retreat, a Florida couple's jackpot oasis, and a Gulf Shores beachside paradise a decade later.

episodes.name: Family, Love, and Life Updates
episodes.summary: David Bromstad hops in the time machine to catch up with past winners; he finds a couple who've expanded their Massachusetts life, a winner who found love twice and turned fixer-uppers into dream homes, and a chic Cleveland bungalow six years later.

episodes.name: Mid-West Upsize: Family Home
episodes.summary: Thanks to an inheritance, a couple's ready to upsize in Green Bay, Wisc.; they're asking David to find space for all their grandkids, but most importantly, he wants a bar where he can mix his signature Old Fashioneds and entertain his friends.

episodes.name: Mid-Winter in the Mid-West
episodes.summary: David braves arctic temperatures to help a couple find a bigger house for their expanding family in the suburbs of Cleveland; they're hoping to find their forever dream home, and David's donning his woolliest wardrobe in the sub-zero search.

episodes.name: Seven Million Big Ones
episodes.summary: A couple's 3-year-old daughter chose their $7 million winning lottery ticket! Now, David gets to upgrade them from the Poconos to the family-friendly suburbs of Lehigh Valley, Pennsylvania.

episodes.name: BFF Lottery
episodes.summary: David brings along his bestie to help another pair of besties find a dream home for a daughter in Rochester, N.Y.

episodes.name: Million Dollar Pensacola Return
episodes.summary: A million dollar winner returns to find her forever home in Pensacola, Fla.; with her daughter along on the search, this duo brings David a challenge to help find their dream place where she can retire.

episodes.name: $15 Million Unites the Family
episodes.summary: Fresh off a difficult divorce, an Ohio woman scores a $15 million lottery win that's about to change everything; now, able to retire early, David helps her relocate back to her childhood home, Vero Beach, Florida, so she can be closer to her kids.

episodes.name: Second Chance Love in Boston
episodes.summary: Former high school friends went their separate ways and reconnected later in life, and now they're newlyweds! And after a million-dollar lottery win, they're calling on David to find a dream home to entertain their family and friends in Boston.

episodes.name: From Big Rigs to Big Riches
episodes.summary: After hitting the jackpot, an ex-servicewoman is ready to leave renting behind and search for her forever home in Greensboro, North Carolina. With David and her son along for the ride, she's out to find the perfect home to begin her next chapter.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.summary: Rue returns home from rehab with no plans to stay clean and meets Jules, who's new in town, at a party at McKay's house; McKay takes an interest in Cassie; Nate and Maddy, who have broken up once again, attempt to make each other jealous.

episodes.name: Stuntin' Like My Daddy
episodes.summary: Rue becomes excited about her new friend, Jules, but struggles to put the past behind her; Nate becomes obsessed with Maddy's hookup, Tyler, while trying to get back together with Maddy; Kat finds out that a video of her has surfaced online.

episodes.name: Made You Look
episodes.summary: Kat has her first camming session; Jules falls for a boy online and asks Rue to help her take some nudes; Maddy finds something odd on Nate's phone; Cassie and McKay spend the weekend at McKay's school and go to a party at the frat he's rushing.

episodes.name: Shooks One Pt. II
episodes.summary: Rue tries to get clean for Jules and chaperones Gia at the carnival; Jules encounters Cal with his family; annoyed at their boyfriends, Cassie and Maddy decide to do Molly together; Kat hangs out with Ethan until she misreads a situation.

episodes.name: '03 Bonnie and Clyde
episodes.summary: Maddy and Nate deal with a police investigation; Rue and Jules reflect on their relationship; Kat embraces her new lifestyle.

episodes.name: The Next Episode
episodes.summary: On Halloween, Rue worries about her reliance on Jules when she starts acting strange; McKay questions his future; Nate comes up with a plan.

episodes.name: The Trials and Tribulations of Trying to Pee While Depressed
episodes.summary: Rue gets depressed and watches 22 straight episodes of a British reality show; Jules goes to visit an old friend; Cassie looks for advice in the aftermath of Halloween night.

episodes.name: And Salt the Earth Behind You
episodes.summary: East Highland holds a winter formal.

episodes.name: Trying to Get to Heaven Before They Close the Door
episodes.summary: Rue and Jules cross paths for the first time since Christmas as East Highland rings in the new year.

episodes.name: Out of Touch
episodes.summary: Jules questions Rue and Elliot's new friendship; Nate makes a tough decision; Kat's reality blurs as she ponders her relationship; Maddy contemplates ending her relationship.

episodes.name: Ruminations: Big and Little Bullys
episodes.summary: Rue pursues a new business venture as she helps forge a friendship between Jules and Elliot.

episodes.name: You Who Cannot See, Think of Those Who Can
episodes.summary: Jules and Elliot grow closer; Maddy celebrates her birthday; Cal takes a trip down memory lane.

episodes.name: Stand Still Like the Hummingbird
episodes.summary: Fate catches up with those who try to outrun it.

episodes.name: A Thousand Little Trees of Blood
episodes.summary: As relationships with mothers are tested, Rue tries to recover; Lexi questions the possible backlash from her play, and Nate celebrates his newfound freedom.

episodes.name: The Theater and Its Double
episodes.summary: Art imitates life as the East Highland crew watch their complicated dynamics reflected in Lexi's long-awaited play; Fezco gets ready to attend.

episodes.name: All My Life, My Heart Has Yearned for a Thing I Cannot Name
episodes.summary: Fragments of memories collide with the present and future.

episodes.name: Andale
episodes.summary: A few years after high school, Rue's debts finally catch up with her; hoping to finance her dream wedding, Cassie tries to become internet famous, to the disapproval of Nate, who's juggling the demands of running Cal's business.

episodes.name: America My Dream
episodes.summary: Rue travels to Mexico and confronts displacement; Jules navigates art school pressures and reflects generational struggles.

episodes.name: The Ballad of Paladin
episodes.summary: A group of childhood friends wrestle with the virtue of faith, the possibility of redemption and the problem of evil.

episodes.name: Kitty Likes to Dance
episodes.summary: Rue is offered a risky deal that draws her deeper into Alamo's world; Nate battles the city council, Maddy gives Cassie a mission that could skyrocket her new career; Lexi enlists Jules to create an original painting for LA Nights.

episodes.name: This Little Piggy
episodes.summary: As subscribers surge, Cassie and Maddy clash when the truth comes to light; Rue realizes she is in far too deep when Alamo grows increasingly suspicious; Jules' relationship teeters on the edge, and Lexi discovers her sister is once again threatening to invade her territory.

episodes.name: Stand Still and See
episodes.summary: Maybe every mistake Rue made led her to the right place after all.

episodes.name: Rain or Shine
episodes.summary: Under financial pressure, Maddy schemes to get Cassie back in the spotlight; Rue obsesses over the sign God gave her.

episodes.name: In God We Trust
episodes.summary: Danger closes in on all sides as Rue's double-dealing finally reaches its breaking point; while the medical van speeds towards the border, Maddy and Cassie must band together and Alamo is struck by a life-changing epiphany.

episodes.name: Cottage Comeback
episodes.summary: Leslie travels to Temecula, Calif., and checks into a rental with more red flags than a wine tasting has red wines; filthy shag carpeting and an unsafe sleeping loft leave Jasmine starting from scratch to revive this once cozy cottage.
